Description (en, leafgreen): Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, it has zapped many people.

document.title: Electrode — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Electrode
ID: 101
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 붐볼
Name (en): Electrode
Description (en, red): It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
Description (en, yellow): Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
Description (en, gold): It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
Description (en, silver): It stores an over­ flowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
Description (en, crystal): The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.
Description (en, ruby): ELECTRODE eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this POKéMON exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
Description (en, sapphire): One of ELECTRODE’s characteristics is its attraction to electricity. It is a problematical POKéMON that congregates mostly at electrical power plants to feed on electricity that has just been generated.
Description (en, emerald): They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
Description (en, firered): It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
Description (en, diamond): It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
Description (en, soulsilver): It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
Description (ko, x): 작은 자극에도 반응해서 폭발한다. 폭탄볼이라 불리며 두려움의 대상이 되고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 넘칠 정도의 전기 에너지를 체내에 모으고 있기 때문에 약간의 자극만으로도 폭발한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 공기 중의 전기 에너지를 먹는다. 번개가 치는 날에는 전기를 너무 먹은 붐볼이 이곳저곳에서 대폭발한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 전기에 끌리는 성질을 지녔다. 주로 발전소에 모여서 막 만들어진 전기를 먹어버리는 말썽꾼이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): One of Electrode’s characteristics is its attraction to electricity. It is a problematical Pokémon that congregates mostly at electrical power plants to feed on electricity that has just been generated.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 조금이라도 충격을 주면 체내에 있는 전기 에너지가 넘쳐서 폭발해버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Exeggcute
ID: 102
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아라리
Name (en): Exeggcute
Description (en, red): Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
Description (en, yellow): The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.
Description (en, gold): The shell is very durable. Even if it cracks, it can survive without spilling the contents.
Description (en, silver): Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
Description (en, crystal): If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.
Description (en, ruby): This POKéMON consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.
Description (en, emerald): It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.
Description (en, firered): Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.
Description (en, leafgreen): It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
Description (en, diamond): Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
Description (en, heartgold): Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.
Description (en, soulsilver): Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
Description (ko, x): 텔레파시로 대화를 하기 때문에 아라리를 갈라놓으려 해도 바로 모여들어 6마리가 된다.
Description (ko, y): 무언가의 알 같지만 실은 식물의 씨앗에 가까운 생물이라는 사실이 드러났다.
Description (en, y): Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 동료애가 강한 여섯 알은 서로 끌어당기며 빙글빙글 회전하고 있다. 껍질의 금이 늘어나면 진화가 가까워진 것.
Description (en, omega-ruby): This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, Exeggcute is close to evolution.
Description (ko, sun): 텔레파시로 동료와 교신한다. 식물과 어떤 종의 타입의 유전자를 모두 갖추고 있다고 한다.
Description (en, sun): Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.
Description (ko, moon): 여섯 마리가 하나인 포켓몬이다. 오기지게가 자주 노리지만 염동력을 사용해서 물리친다.
Description (en, moon): Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It’s often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 6마리가 1마리다. 어쩌다 1마리가 줄어도 다음날 아침이 되면 다시 6마리로 돌아와 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 알로라산 아라리는 같은 크기라도 꽤 무겁다. 내용물이 꽉 차 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although they are the same size as other Exeggcute, the ones produced in Alola are quite heavy. Their shells are packed full.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 알 하나하나가 서로를 끌어당겨서 회전한다. 6개가 아니면 불안해한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.
Description (ko, sword): 알처럼 보이지만 엄연한 포켓몬이다. 텔레파시로 동료와 교신하는 듯하다.
Description (en, sword): Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
Description (ko, shield): 6마리가 아니면 진정하지 못한다. 1마리라도 없어지면 바로 도망태세가 된다.
Description (en, shield): These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 남쪽 나라 태생인 나시의 머리는 강한 햇빛을 잔뜩 받고 점점 자라 땅에 떨어지면 아라리가 된다고 한다.

Description (ko, moon): 어느 시기가 되면 3개의 머리 중 하나가 떨어진다. 그것이 그대로 아라리로 성장해간다.
Description (en, moon): When the time comes, one of its three heads falls off. Before long, the fallen head grows into an Exeggcute.

Description (en, sword): Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

document.title: Cubone — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cubone
ID: 104
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 탕구리
Name (en): Cubone
Description (en, red): Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
Description (en, yellow): Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.
Description (en, gold): If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and emits a plain­ tive and mournful sound.
Description (en, silver): It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.
Description (en, crystal): It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its mother's skull, never revealing its true face.
Description (en, ruby): CUBONE pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the POKéMON wears are made by the tears it sheds.
Description (en, emerald): It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.
Description (en, firered): It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
Description (en, leafgreen): Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON’s real face.
Description (en, diamond): When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
Description (en, heartgold): If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.
Description (ko, x): 죽은 어미의 해골을 머리에 쓰고 있다. 외로울 때는 큰 소리로 운다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 죽은 어미의 해골을 항상 뒤집어쓰고 있어서 얼굴이 어떻게 생겼는지 모른다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 두 번 다시 만나지 못하는 어미의 모습을 보름달에서 발견하고 울음소리를 낸다. 뒤집어쓰고 있는 뼈의 얼룩은 눈물 자국이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Cubone pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the Pokémon wears are made by the tears it sheds.
Description (ko, sun): 사별한 어머니를 생각하며 큰 소리로 운다. 목소리를 들은 버랜지나가 하늘에서 노린다.
Description (en, sun): When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.
Description (ko, moon): 머리에 뒤집어쓴 두개골은 죽은 어미의 것. 죽음의 슬픔을 뛰어넘었을 때 진화한다고 전해진다.
Description (en, moon): The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 밤이 되면 죽은 엄마를 생각하며 울부짖는데, 그 탓에 천적인 버랜지나에게 발각된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 어미의 뼈를 뒤집어쓰고 있어서 얼굴도 표정도 알 수 없다. 그저 언제나 계속해서 울고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It wears its mother’s skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it’s clear that it’s always crying.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 죽은 어미의 뼈를 뒤집어썼다. 울음소리는 뼈 안에서 울려서 구슬픈 멜로디가 된다.
Description (ko, sword): 죽은 어머니를 떠올리며 울면 머리에 쓴 뼈 안에서 울음소리가 구슬프게 퍼진다.
Description (en, sword): When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.
Description (ko, shield): 죽은 어미의 뼈를 머리에 쓰고 있다. 어미의 꿈을 꾸고 울기도 하지만 눈물을 흘릴 때마다 강해진다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

document.title: Marowak — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Marowak
ID: 105
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 텅구리
Name (en): Marowak
Description (en, red): The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
Description (en, yellow): Small and weak, this POKéMON is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
Description (en, gold): It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out mes­ sages to others.
Description (en, silver): It collects bones from an unknown place. A MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world, rumors say.
Description (en, crystal): Somewhere in the world is a ceme­ tery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.
Description (en, ruby): MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This POKéMON’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
Description (en, emerald): A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
Description (en, firered): It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
Description (en, diamond): From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
Description (en, heartgold): It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.
Description (en, soulsilver): It collects bones from an unknown place. Some whisper that a MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world.
Description (ko, x): 몸집도 작으며 원래는 약했다. 뼈를 쓰기 시작하면서 성격이 흉포해졌다.
Description (ko, y): 뼈는 중요한 무기이다. 부메랑처럼 던져서 사냥감을 맞춰 기절시킨다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 어미를 만날 수 없는 슬픔을 극복한 탕구리가 늠름하게 진화한 모습이다. 단련된 마음은 간단히 꺾이지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
Description (ko, sun): 원래는 약하고 겁이 많다. 진화로 뼈다귀를 휘두르는 난폭한 성질이 된다.
Description (en, sun): Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
Description (ko, moon): 뼈다귀를 부메랑처럼 내던져서 천적이었던 버랜지나를 떨어뜨려 복수한다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is out for vengeance on its natural enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like boomerangs to try to take it down.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 뼈를 던져 버랜지나를 떨어뜨린다. 부모의 원한을 갚기 위한 것으로 추측된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It’s thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 리드미컬하게 뼈다귀를 두들겨서 동료와 연락을 주고받는다. 그 패턴은 50개 가까이 존재한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 몸집은 작고 약했지만 뼈를 능숙하게 사용해서 싸우는 흉포한 성격이 되었다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
Description (ko, sword): 슬픔을 극복하고 늠름하게 진화했다. 뼈를 무기 삼아 용감하게 적과 맞서 싸운다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
Description (ko, shield): 진화로 인해 쓰고 있던 어미의 뼈는 일체화되었고 성격은 더욱 난폭해졌다.
Description (en, shield): When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 어미를 만날 수 없는 슬픔을 극복한 탕구리가 늠름하게 진화한 모습이다. 단련된 마음은 간단히 꺾이지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
Description (ko, sun): 원래는 약하고 겁이 많다. 진화로 뼈다귀를 휘두르는 난폭한 성질이 된다.
Description (en, sun): Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
Description (ko, moon): 뼈다귀를 부메랑처럼 내던져서 천적이었던 버랜지나를 떨어뜨려 복수한다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is out for vengeance on its natural enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like boomerangs to try to take it down.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 뼈를 던져 버랜지나를 떨어뜨린다. 부모의 원한을 갚기 위한 것으로 추측된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It’s thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 리드미컬하게 뼈다귀를 두들겨서 동료와 연락을 주고받는다. 그 패턴은 50개 가까이 존재한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 몸집은 작고 약했지만 뼈를 능숙하게 사용해서 싸우는 흉포한 성격이 되었다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
Description (ko, sword): 슬픔을 극복하고 늠름하게 진화했다. 뼈를 무기 삼아 용감하게 적과 맞서 싸운다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
Description (ko, shield): 진화로 인해 쓰고 있던 어미의 뼈는 일체화되었고 성격은 더욱 난폭해졌다.
Description (en, shield): When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

document.title: Hitmonlee — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hitmonlee
ID: 106
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 시라소몬
Name (en): Hitmonlee
Description (en, red): When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
Description (en, yellow): When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on im­ pact and destroys its enemy.
Description (en, gold): This amazing POKé­ MON has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
Description (en, silver): If it starts kick­ ing repeatedly, both legs will stretch even long­ er to strike a fleeing foe.
Description (en, crystal): It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.
Description (en, ruby): HITMONLEE’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
Description (en, emerald): Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.
Description (en, firered): The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
Description (en, leafgreen): When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long, loping strides.
Description (en, diamond): Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
Description (en, heartgold): This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
Description (en, soulsilver): If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
Description (ko, x): 다리를 자유자재로 늘였다 줄였다 한다. 멀리 떨어져 있을 때도 상대를 차올릴 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 연속으로 킥을 하는 동안 양쪽 다리는 점점 길어져서 도망치려고 하는 상대도 걷어찬다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자유롭게 신축되는 다리로 강렬한 킥을 날려 상대를 발로 차 쓰러트린다. 싸운 뒤에 지친 다리를 주물러 풀어준다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Hitmonlee’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 킥이 명중하는 순간! 발바닥이 다이아몬드처럼 단단해져서 상대를 파괴한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.
Description (ko, sword): 훌륭한 밸런스 감각으로 어떤 자세라도 연속 킥을 날리는 대단한 녀석이다.
Description (ko, shield): 다리를 자유자재로 늘이고 줄인다. 상대가 멀리 떨어져 있어도 다리를 늘여서 차올릴 수 있다.

document.title: Hitmonchan — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hitmonchan
ID: 107
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 홍수몬
Name (en): Hitmonchan
Description (en, red): While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
Description (en, yellow): Punches in cork­ screw fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall in the same way as a drill.
Description (en, gold): Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
Description (en, silver): Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
Description (en, crystal): To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.
Description (en, ruby): HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working towards a world championship. This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
Description (en, emerald): A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.
Description (en, firered): The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.
Description (en, leafgreen): While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.
Description (en, diamond): The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
Description (ko, x): 팔을 비틀며 날리는 펀치는 콘크리트도 부스러뜨린다. 3분 싸우면 잠시 쉰다.
Description (ko, y): 프로 복서의 혼에 씌었다. 펀치의 스피드는 고속열차보다도 빠르다.
Description (en, y): The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 세계 챔피언을 목표했던 복서의 혼이 깃들었다고 하는 홍수몬은 불굴의 정신으로 절대 지쳐 쓰러지지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working toward a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 비틀면서 뚫는 듯한 펀치 공격! 콘크리트 벽이 드릴 모양으로 깎여나가 구멍이 뚫린다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall like a drill.
Description (ko, sword): 주변의 공기를 가르는 펀치. 스치기만 해도 화상을 입을 정도로 펀치 스피드가 매우 빠르다.
Description (ko, shield): 공기마저 베어 가르는 펀치. 하지만 3분간 공격하면 잠시 쉬고 싶어하는 것 같다.

document.title: Lickitung — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lickitung
ID: 108
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 내루미
Name (en): Lickitung
Description (en, red): Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
Description (en, yellow): Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
Description (en, gold): Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deft­ ly manipulated.
Description (en, silver): Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to any­ thing, so it is very useful.
Description (en, crystal): It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.
Description (en, ruby): Whenever LICKITUNG comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
Description (en, emerald): Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
Description (en, firered): Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon’s. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
Description (en, diamond): Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.
Description (en, platinum): When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
Description (en, heartgold): Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
Description (en, black-2): Being licked by its long, saliva-covered tongue leaves a tingling sensation. Extending its tongue retracts its tail.
Description (ko, x): 긴 혀는 끈적끈적한 침으로 덮여 있다. 어떤 것이든 달라붙어서 매우 편리하다.
Description (ko, y): 혀가 키의 2배나 된다. 먹이를 잡거나 공격을 할 때면 마치 손처럼 움직인다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 처음 본 것은 반드시 핥아본다. 혀의 감촉과 맛으로 기억해두는 것이다. 하지만 시큼한 것을 핥는 것은 조금 꺼린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Whenever Lickitung comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 긴 혀를 내밀어 몇 번이고 핥아 확인한다. 핥은 부분을 방치하면 염증이 생긴다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It checks out whatever’s around it by licking everything. If you don’t clean off a spot where it’s licked you, you’ll break out in a rash!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 더러워지면 혀로 깨끗하게 핥아 낸다. 핥고 난 뒤에도 왠지 냄새가 나서 정말로 깨끗한지는 의심스럽다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it’s really clean is...questionable.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 2m나 되는 긴 혀는 앞다리보다 능숙하게 움직일 수 있다. 혀로 핥으면 상대가 마비된다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
Description (ko, sword): 끈적끈적한 타액에 접촉한 후 그대로 방치하면 굉장히 가렵고 급기야 멈출 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, sword): If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.
Description (ko, shield): 벌레포켓몬이 주된 먹이다. 긴 혀로 상대를 핥아 마비시킨 후 통째로 삼킨다.
Description (en, shield): Bug Pokémon are Lickitung’s main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

document.title: Koffing — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Koffing
ID: 109
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 또가스
Name (en): Koffing
Description (en, red): Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
Description (en, yellow): In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
Description (en, gold): Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
Description (en, silver): The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slight­ ly airborne.
Description (en, crystal): If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison­ ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.
Description (en, ruby): If KOFFING becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This POKéMON may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
Description (en, sapphire): KOFFING embodies toxic substances. It mixes the toxins with raw garbage to set off a chemical reaction that results in a terribly powerful poison gas. The higher the temperature, the more gas is concocted by this POKéMON.
Description (en, emerald): Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.
Description (en, firered): Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
Description (en, diamond): Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
Description (en, soulsilver): The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slightly airborne.
Description (en, black-2): Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.
Description (ko, x): 얇고 풍선 같은 몸에 맹독 가스가 차있다. 가까이 오면 역겨운 냄새가 난다.
Description (ko, y): 공기보다도 가벼운 가스를 몸에 모아서 떠 있다. 가스는 냄새나는 데다가 폭발도 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자극받으면 가스의 독소가 강해져 몸의 이곳저곳에서 강하게 내뿜는다. 동그랗게 부풀어 오른 후 대폭발한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): If Koffing becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This Pokémon may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 음식물 쓰레기와 몸의 독소를 화학반응시켜 맹독 가스를 만들어 낸다. 기온이 높을수록 가스가 많이 만들어진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Koffing embodies toxic substances. It mixes the toxins with raw garbage to set off a chemical reaction that results in a terribly powerful poison gas. The higher the temperature, the more gas is concocted by this Pokémon.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 더운 곳에서는 몸 안의 가스가 부풀어 올라 파열될 위험성이 있으므로 주의해야 한다.
Description (ko, sword): 독가스로 몸 안이 가득 차 있다. 음식물 쓰레기의 악취에 이끌려 쓰레기장을 찾아간다.
Description (en, sword): Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.
Description (ko, shield): 오염된 공기를 좋아한다. 옛날 가라르지방에는 지금보다 많은 또가스가 있었다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

document.title: Weezing — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Weezing
ID: 110
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 또도가스
Name (en): Weezing
Description (en, red): Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
Description (en, yellow): It lives and grows by absorbing dust, germs and poison gases that are contained in toxic waste and garbage.
Description (en, gold): If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It con­ stantly mixes its poisonous gases.
Description (en, silver): Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the high­ est level.
Description (en, crystal): When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.
Description (en, ruby): WEEZING loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This POKéMON will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
Description (en, sapphire): WEEZING alternately shrinks and inflates its twin bodies to mix together toxic gases inside. The more the gases are mixed, the more powerful the toxins become. The POKéMON also becomes more putrid.
Description (en, emerald): By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
Description (en, firered): Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.
Description (en, leafgreen): Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two KOFFING can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
Description (en, diamond): It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
Description (en, heartgold): If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
Description (en, soulsilver): Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.
Description (en, black-2): Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.
Description (ko, x): 한쪽이 부풀어 오르면 다른 한쪽은 오그라드는 쌍둥이 또가스. 항상 체내의 독가스를 섞고 있다.
Description (en, x): If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
Description (ko, y): 극히 드물게 돌연변이로 쌍둥이인 작은 또가스가 연결된 채로 나오는 때가 있다.
Description (en, y): Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 부패한 음식물 쓰레기에서 나온 가스를 매우 좋아한다. 청소하지 않는 집에서 눌러살며 가족이 모두 잠든 한밤중에 쓰레기통을 뒤진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Weezing loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This Pokémon will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 똑같이 생긴 몸을 교대로 오그라트리고 부풀리면서 독가스를 섞고 있다. 섞을수록 독소가 강해져 악취가 난다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Weezing alternately shrinks and inflates its twin bodies to mix together toxic gases inside. The more the gases are mixed, the more powerful the toxins become. The Pokémon also becomes more putrid.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 쓰레기 속에 포함된 독가스, 세균, 먼지를 흡수하며 살고 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
Description (ko, sword): 2개의 몸에서 가스를 섞는다. 과거의 가라르에서는 흔하게 볼 수 있었다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.
Description (ko, shield): 가라르의 또도가스보다 공기를 흡입하는 힘은 조금 약하지만 내뿜는 독소는 강력하다.
Description (en, shield): It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

Description (en, leafgreen): Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two KOFFING can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
Description (en, diamond): It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
Description (en, heartgold): If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
Description (en, soulsilver): Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.
Description (en, black-2): Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.
Description (ko, x): 한쪽이 부풀어 오르면 다른 한쪽은 오그라드는 쌍둥이 또가스. 항상 체내의 독가스를 섞고 있다.
Description (en, x): If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
Description (ko, y): 극히 드물게 돌연변이로 쌍둥이인 작은 또가스가 연결된 채로 나오는 때가 있다.
Description (en, y): Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 부패한 음식물 쓰레기에서 나온 가스를 매우 좋아한다. 청소하지 않는 집에서 눌러살며 가족이 모두 잠든 한밤중에 쓰레기통을 뒤진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Weezing loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This Pokémon will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 똑같이 생긴 몸을 교대로 오그라트리고 부풀리면서 독가스를 섞고 있다. 섞을수록 독소가 강해져 악취가 난다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Weezing alternately shrinks and inflates its twin bodies to mix together toxic gases inside. The more the gases are mixed, the more powerful the toxins become. The Pokémon also becomes more putrid.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 쓰레기 속에 포함된 독가스, 세균, 먼지를 흡수하며 살고 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
Description (ko, sword): 2개의 몸에서 가스를 섞는다. 과거의 가라르에서는 흔하게 볼 수 있었다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.
Description (ko, shield): 가라르의 또도가스보다 공기를 흡입하는 힘은 조금 약하지만 내뿜는 독소는 강력하다.
Description (en, shield): It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

document.title: Rhyhorn — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:

Name: Rhyhorn
ID: 111
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 뿔카노
Name (en): Rhyhorn
Description (en, red): Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
Description (en, yellow): A POKéMON with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won't stop running until it falls asleep.
Description (en, gold): It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
Description (en, silver): It doesn't care if there is anything in its way. It just charges and destroys all ob­ stacles.
Description (en, crystal): It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
Description (en, ruby): RHYHORN runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This POKéMON may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
Description (en, sapphire): RHYHORN’s brain is very small. It is so dense, while on a run it forgets why it started running in the first place. It apparently remembers sometimes if it demolishes something.
Description (en, emerald): Once it starts running, it doesn’t stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can’t remember why it started running in the first place.
Description (en, firered): Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. Its TACKLE can knock a semitrailer flying.
Description (en, diamond): Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
Description (en, platinum): Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
Description (en, soulsilver): It doesn’t care if there is anything in its way. It just charges and destroys all obstacles.
Description (ko, x): 머리는 나쁘지만 힘이 세서 고층 빌딩도 몸통박치기로 산산조각 낸다.
Description (en, x): Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
Description (ko, y): 4개의 다리는 짧아서 잘 굽혀지지 않는다. 단지 한결같이 돌진할 뿐이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 오로지 곧장 돌진하여 부순다. 강철 덩어리에 부딪혀도 멀쩡하지만 하루가 지나면 아픔을 조금 느낀다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Rhyhorn runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This Pokémon may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 달리고 있다가 목적을 잊을 정도로 뇌가 작고 머리가 나쁘다. 뭔가를 부수면 가끔 기억해내는 것 같다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Rhyhorn’s brain is very small. It is so dense, while on a run it forgets why it started running in the first place. It apparently remembers sometimes if it demolishes something.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 단순해서 한가지 생각밖에 하지 못한다. 돌진을 시작하면 잠들 때까지 멈추지 않는다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.
Description (en, sword): Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
Description (ko, shield): 한 가지만 기억할 수 있다. 돌진하기 시작하면 이유가 무엇이었든 금방 잊어버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

Name (en): Rhydon
Description (en, red): Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
Description (en, yellow): Walks on its hind legs. Shows signs of intelligence. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
Description (en, gold): Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
Description (en, silver): Its brain devel­ oped when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.
Description (en, crystal): By lightly spin­ ning its drill- like horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.
Description (en, ruby): RHYDON’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This POKéMON’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
Description (en, sapphire): RHYDON has a horn that serves as a drill. It is used for destroying rocks and boulders. This POKéMON occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.
Description (en, emerald): Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.
Description (en, firered): It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
Description (en, leafgreen): Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (en, diamond): Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
Description (en, platinum): Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its brain developed when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.
Description (ko, x): 전신을 갑옷 같은 피부로 보호하고 있다. 2000도의 마그마 속에서도 살 수 있다.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 뿔은 다이아몬드 원석을 부수고 꼬리의 일격은 빌딩을 쓰러트린다. 단단한 피부는 대포에도 상처 입지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Rhydon’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This Pokémon’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 드릴처럼 쓰는 뿔로 암석을 파괴한다. 마그마가 뿜어져 나오기도 하지만 갑옷 같은 피부는 뜨거움을 느끼지 않는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Rhydon has a horn that serves as a drill. It is used for destroying rocks and boulders. This Pokémon occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 뒷다리만으로 걸을 수 있게 되어 지능이 발달했다. 갑옷 같은 피부는 마그마에도 견딘다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
Description (ko, sword): 진화하여 뒷다리만으로 서게 되었다. 뿔로 찌르면 암석에도 구멍이 뚫리고 만다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

document.title: Chansey — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Chansey
ID: 113
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 럭키
Name (en): Chansey
Description (en, red): A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
Description (en, yellow): A gentle and kind­ hearted POKéMON that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured POKéMON.
Description (en, gold): It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
Description (en, silver): Few in number and difficult to cap­ ture, it is said to bring happiness to the trainer who catches it.
Description (en, crystal): People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.
Description (en, ruby): CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
Description (en, emerald): CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
Description (en, firered): It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.
Description (en, leafgreen): A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.
Description (en, diamond): It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
Description (en, pearl): It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them with those who have evil in their hearts.
Description (en, platinum): A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
Description (en, soulsilver): Being few in number and difficult to capture, it is said to bring happiness to the Trainer who catches it.
Description (ko, x): 행복을 가져다준다고 전해진다. 상처 입은 사람에게 알을 나눠주는 상냥한 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 하루에 몇 개의 알을 낳는다. 그 알은 영양 만점으로 굉장히 맛있다고 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 영양 만점인 알을 매일 낳는다. 식욕을 잃은 사람도 한 번에 먹어치울 정도로 맛있는 알이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Chansey lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
Description (ko, sun): 럭키가 낳는 알은 영양이 듬뿍 들어있다. 많은 포켓몬들이 아주 좋아한다.
Description (en, sun): The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.
Description (ko, moon): 수가 적은 데다가 도주도 빠른 포켓몬이라 발견한 사람은 운이 좋은 것이다.
Description (en, moon): Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they’re also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 맛있고 영양 많은 알을 다른 포켓몬들이 자꾸 노려서 도망치는 속도가 빨라진 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It seems that other Pokémon’s efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 배에 있는 알을 노리고 마구잡이로 잡힌 역사에서 개체 수는 매우 적다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 상처 입은 자를 발견하면 영양 만점인 알을 나눠주는 상냥한 포켓몬.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 알은 영양 만점에 맛도 뛰어나다. 고급 식재료로 취급된다.
Description (en, sword): The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It’s used as a high-class cooking ingredient.
Description (ko, shield): 원래 움직임이 둔했지만 알을 노리는 자들로부터 지켜내기 위해 도주 속도가 빨라졌다.
Description (en, shield): This species was once very slow. To protect their eggs from other creatures, these Pokémon became able to flee quickly.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

Name (ko): 덩쿠리
Name (en): Tangela
Description (en, red): The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
Description (en, yellow): Its identity is obscured by masses of thick, blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
Description (en, gold): The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively un­ nerve its foes.
Description (en, silver): It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.
Description (en, crystal): During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.
Description (en, ruby): TANGELA’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
Description (en, emerald): Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.
Description (en, firered): Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.
Description (en, leafgreen): The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.
Description (en, diamond): It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
Description (en, platinum): The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
Description (en, heartgold): The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.
Description (en, black-2): Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
Description (ko, x): 수많은 움직이는 덩굴에 둘러싸여 정체불명이다. 파란 덩굴은 평생 자란다.
Description (ko, y): 움직이는 것에 덩굴을 감는다. 덩굴은 미묘하게 흔들리기 때문에 휘감기면 간지럽다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 적에게 붙잡히면 덩굴이 뚝 하고 끊긴다. 전혀 아프지 않기 때문에 그 틈에 도망간다. 다음 날에는 새로운 덩굴이 자란다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Tangela’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 몸이 파란 덩굴에 싸여 있어 정체를 알 수 없다. 덩굴은 계속해서 자란다고 한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
Description (ko, sword): 잘려도 잘려도 무한으로 늘어나는 덩굴 속의 정체는 아직 밝혀지지 않았다.
Description (en, sword): Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.
Description (ko, shield): 덩굴은 독특한 향이 난다. 가라르 일부 지역에서는 허브로 사용되고 있다.
Description (en, shield): The vines of a Tangela have a distinct scent. In some parts of Galar, Tangela vines are used as herbs.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kangaskhan
ID: 115
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 캥카
Name (en): Kangaskhan
Description (en, red): The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
Description (en, yellow): Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.
Description (en, gold): If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
Description (en, silver): To protect its young, it will never give up during battle, no matter how badly wounded it is.
Description (en, crystal): To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.
Description (en, ruby): If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby POKéMON’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
Description (en, emerald): If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.
Description (en, firered): The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.
Description (en, leafgreen): The infant rarely ventures out of its mother’s protective pouch until it is three years old.
Description (en, diamond): It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
Description (ko, x): 배의 주머니에서 새끼를 키운다. 안전할 때만 새끼를 주머니에서 꺼내어 놀게 한다.
Description (ko, y): 안전한 장소라면 새끼도 배의 주머니에서 나와서 논다. 어미는 그것을 가만히 지켜본다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 캥카의 새끼가 혼자서 놀고 있어도 절대로 잡으려 하면 안 된다. 가까이 있는 부모가 격렬히 화낸다.

Description (ko, sun): 캥카의 모성애는 깊다. 자기 아이를 지키기 위해서라면 죽음조차 두려워하지 않는다고 한다.
Description (en, sun): Kangaskhan’s maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
Description (ko, moon): 뱃속의 새끼는 대략 3년이면 자립한다. 어미가 큰 소리로 우는 것은 그때뿐이다.
Description (en, moon): The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly three years. That is the only time the mother is heard to cry wildly.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 배의 주머니에 자신의 새끼를 넣어 지킨다. 새끼에게 해를 끼치는 자는 절대 용서하지 않고 때려눕힌다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 주머니를 빠져나와 놀고 있는 새끼에게는 다가가선 안 된다. 어딘가에서 어미가 지켜보고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): You shouldn’t get close to the child when it’s playing outside its mother’s pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 배의 주머니에서 새끼를 키운다. 새끼를 지키기 위해서라면 어떤 상대든지 맞서 싸운다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.
Description (ko, sword): 배의 주머니에 새끼가 있지만 발놀림은 매우 가볍다. 재빠른 잽으로 상대를 위협한다.
Description (en, sword): Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.
Description (ko, shield): 새끼가 없는 캥카가 조난한 사람의 아이를 길렀다는 기록이 있다.
Description (en, shield): There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

Description (en, emerald): It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.
Description (en, firered): It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.
Description (en, diamond): If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
Description (en, heartgold): At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
Description (en, soulsilver): Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
Description (en, black-2): As long as its red core remains, it can regenerate its body instantly, even if it’s torn apart.
Description (ko, x): 몸의 중심에서 빛나는 핵이 있는 한 몸이 찢겨나가도 재생할 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 해변에 많이 나타나며 밤이 되면 가운데가 빨갛게 깜박거린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 여름이 끝날 무렵 밤에 모래 해변에 가면 핵이라고 불리는 기관을 붉게 빛내는 별가사리가 별처럼 보인다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Staryu’s center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these Pokémon look like the stars in the sky.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 가운데에 있는 빨간 코어를 점멸시켜 밤하늘의 별과 교신하는 것 같다. 몸은 찢겨 나가더라도 스스로 재생한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Staryu apparently communicates with the stars in the night sky by flashing the red core at the center of its body. If parts of its body are torn, this Pokémon simply regenerates the missing pieces and limbs.
Description (ko, sun): 해변에 많이 서식한다. 밤이 되면 몸의 중심이 이상하고 빨갛게 빛을 낸다.
Description (en, sun): Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.
Description (ko, moon): 네오라이트 등에게 물리지만 빨간 핵이 있는 한 바로 재생되므로 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon gets nibbled on by Lumineon and others. Thanks to its red core, it regenerates fast, so it’s unconcerned by their snack attacks.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 무수한 별들이 바다로 떨어져 별가사리가 되었다고 하는 민화가 각지에 남아 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아무리 상처를 입어도 문제없다. 재생 능력이 높아서 한나절이면 원래대로 돌아온다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 몸의 중심 부분만 남아 있으면 아무리 잘게 잘려도 재생한다고 한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.
Description (ko, sword): 늦여름 해변에 가면 규칙적인 리듬으로 빛나는 별가사리의 무리를 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.
Description (ko, shield): 물고기포켓몬에게 물리곤 하지만 몸이 찢겨도 금방 재생되기 때문에 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

Name (ko): 아쿠스타
Name (en): Starmie
Description (en, red): Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
Description (en, yellow): The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in 7 colors.
Description (en, gold): The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a dif­ ferent color each time it is seen.
Description (en, silver): Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geo­ metric shape.
Description (en, crystal): It is said that it uses the seven- colored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.
Description (en, ruby): STARMIE’s center section - the core - glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this POKéMON has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
Description (en, sapphire): STARMIE swims through water by spinning its star-shaped body as if it were a propeller on a ship. The core at the center of this POKéMON’s body glows in seven colors.
Description (en, emerald): People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.
Description (en, firered): This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
Description (en, diamond): At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
Description (en, heartgold): The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.
Description (en, soulsilver): Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geometric shape.
Description (en, black-2): Its core shines in many colors and sends radio signals into space to communicate with something.
Description (ko, x): 코어라고 불리는 중심 부분은 일곱 빛깔로 빛난다. 이것을 보석으로 삼는 사람도 있다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 몸의 중심에 있는 빨간 핵에서 밤하늘을 향해 알 수 없는 전파를 발신한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸의 중심에 있는 핵이라 불리는 부분이 일곱 빛깔로 빛나기에 바다의 보석이라는 별명이 붙었다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Starmie’s center section—the core—glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 별 모양인 몸을 스크루처럼 회전시켜 물속을 헤엄쳐 다닌다. 중앙에 있는 코어가 일곱 빛깔로 빛난다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Starmie swims through water by spinning its star-shaped body as if it were a propeller on a ship. The core at the center of this Pokémon’s body glows in seven colors.
Description (ko, sun): 빛나는 핵으로부터 의문의 전파를 송수신하고 있다고 한다. 다가가면 두통이 생길 때도 있다.
Description (en, sun): Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.
Description (ko, moon): 추상적인 몸 때문에 우주에서 온 침략자가 아닐까 하고 그 지방 사람들은 말한다.
Description (en, moon): Its unusual body shape, reminiscent of abstract art, led local people to spread rumors that this Pokémon may be an invader from outer space.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빛나는 코어는 바다의 보석이라고 불린다. 고가의 액세서리로 만들어져 은밀히 거래된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its sparkling core is called “the gem of the sea.” This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 기하학적인 몸을 회전시켜 수중에서 헤엄친다. 항상 의문의 전파를 발신하고 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 코어라고 불리는 중심 부분이 일곱 빛깔로 빛나는 것은 통신을 하고 있기 때문이라고 전해진다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.
Description (ko, sword): 강렬한 사이코 파워를 발산할 때 코어라고 불리는 기관이 일곱 색깔로 빛난다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.
Description (ko, shield): 몸을 고속으로 회전시켜 바다를 헤엄치며 작은 플랑크톤을 흡수한다.
Description (en, shield): Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

document.title: Mr. Mime — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mr. Mime
ID: 122
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마임맨
Name (en): Mr. Mime
Description (en, red): If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
Description (en, yellow): Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.
Description (en, gold): A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisi­ ble objects as it matures.
Description (en, silver): Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.
Description (en, crystal): It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.
Description (en, ruby): MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once it is believed, it will exist as if it were a real thing.
Description (en, emerald): A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.
Description (en, firered): It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.
Description (en, leafgreen): If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its broad hands.
Description (en, diamond): It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
Description (en, pearl): Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.
Description (en, platinum): It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
Description (en, heartgold): A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.
Description (ko, x): 손가락 끝에서 내는 파동이 공기를 굳혀서 벽을 만든다. 격렬한 공격도 튕겨 낸다.
Description (ko, y): 사람 속이기를 잘한다. 팬터마임으로 만든 벽이 정말로 나타난다고 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸짓으로 눈에 보이지 않는 것이 그곳에 있다고 믿게 만드는 팬터마임의 달인이다. 있다고 믿게 만든 것은 정말로 나타난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 팬터마임 실력이 굉장하다. 넋을 놓고 보다 보면 어느새 진짜 벽이 나타난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 팬터마임으로 보이지 않는 벽을 만들어 낸다. 감탄하지 않으면 연속뺨치기로 공격해 온다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming. If you don’t act impressed, it will attack you with a double slap!
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 팬터마임이 특기로 언제나 연습을 하고 있다. 없는 것도 그곳에 있다고 믿게 만든다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.
Description (ko, sword): 커다란 손바닥은 팬터마임을 하기 위해 발달했다고 생각하는 학자도 많다.
Description (en, sword): The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
Description (ko, shield): 팬터마임이 특기다. 손가락에서 내보내는 파동으로 벽을 만들어 갖은 공격으로부터 몸을 지킨다.
Description (en, shield): It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

Name (en): Scyther
Description (en, red): With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
Description (en, yellow): Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The move­ ment looks like that of a ninja.
Description (en, gold): It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
Description (en, silver): When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its pro­ tective colors make it invisible.
Description (en, crystal): It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.
Description (en, ruby): SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This POKéMON’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
Description (en, emerald): Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
Description (en, firered): It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
Description (en, leafgreen): With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of itself.
Description (en, diamond): It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
Description (en, platinum): The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
Description (en, soulsilver): When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective coloration makes it invisible.
Description (ko, x): 날카로운 낫으로 먹이를 베고 숨통을 끊는다. 매우 드물게 날개를 사용해서 난다.
Description (ko, y): 잘 드는 예리한 낫을 써서 풀숲을 베고 지나간다. 매우 빠른 움직임에 눈이 따라가지 못한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 눈에 보이지 않는 빠른 스피드가 양팔에 달린 낫의 날카로움을 한층 높여준다. 한 번 휘두르면 큰 나무도 두 동강 난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Scyther is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This Pokémon’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
Description (ko, sun): 닌자처럼 재빠른 행동으로 먹이를 혼란스럽게 한다. 한순간의 빈틈에 낫으로 잘라버린다.
Description (en, sun): It confuses its prey with its quick, ninja-like movements. Then, in an instant, it cleaves them with its scythes.
Description (ko, moon): 젊을 때는 산속에 무리 지어 살며 낫으로 싸우는 법이나 고속이동을 수련한다.
Description (en, moon): While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 날카로운 2개의 낫은 단순한 무기가 아니다. 요령 있게 먹이를 발라 먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 눈에 보이지 않는 빠른 기술은 공기를 베어 가를 정도다. 닌자라 불리며 알로라에서는 인기가 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Some call it a ninja. Its movements— imperceptibly quick—are sufficient to cleave the air in two. It’s very popular in Alola.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 풀숲에서 갑자기 튀어나와 예리한 낫으로 베어 가르는 모습은 마치 닌자 같다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.
Description (ko, sword): 싸움을 거듭하면서 낫은 점점 더 날카로워진다. 거목도 일도양단으로 베어 가른다.
Description (en, sword): As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.
Description (ko, shield): 숲속에서 많은 나무가 베인 채 쓰러져 있는 장소를 발견했다면 그곳은 스라크의 영역이다.
Description (en, shield): If you come across an area in a forest where a lot of the trees have been cut down, what you’ve found is a Scyther’s territory.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

document.title: Jynx — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Jynx
ID: 124
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 루주라
Name (en): Jynx
Description (en, red): It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
Description (en, yellow): Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.
Description (en, gold): It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depend­ ing on how it is feeling.
Description (en, silver): It speaks a lan­ guage similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.
Description (en, crystal): It has several different cry pat­ terns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.
Description (en, ruby): JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
Description (en, emerald): A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.
Description (en, firered): It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.
Description (en, diamond): Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
Description (en, heartgold): It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.
Description (en, soulsilver): It speaks a language similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.
Description (ko, x): 허리를 흔드는 듯이 걷고 있다. 방심하면 엉겁결에 따라서 춤춰버린다고 한다.
Description (en, x): It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
Description (ko, y): 인간처럼 말을 하지만 아직 무슨 말을 하는지 알 수 없어 현재 연구 중이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 춤추는 듯한 자세로 리드미컬하게 걷는다. 그 움직임은 보고 있는 사람마저 얼떨결에 허리를 흔들 정도로 경쾌하다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 독특한 리듬으로 허리를 흔든다. 알로라에 사는 루주라는 그 동작이 실로 훌륭하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 인간의 언어를 닮은 이상한 울음소리를 가졌다. 루주라가 부르는 곡을 만드는 음악가도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 특유의 리듬감을 갖고 있다. 춤추듯 경쾌하게 움직이며 허리를 흔들며 걷는다.
Description (ko, sword): 가라르의 어느 지역에서는 얼음의 여왕이라고 부르며 루주라를 두려워하며 받들었다.
Description (en, sword): In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.
Description (ko, shield): 가라르에는 아름답고 섬세한 울음소리를 가진 루주라가 많아서 팬도 있을 정도다.
Description (en, shield): The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

document.title: Electabuzz — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Electabuzz
ID: 125
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에레브
Name (en): Electabuzz
Description (en, red): Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
Description (en, yellow): If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this POKéMON has eaten electricity at a power plant.
Description (en, gold): Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its en­ tire body glows a whitish-blue.
Description (en, silver): Its body constant­ ly discharges electricity. Get­ ting close to it will make your hair stand on end.
Description (en, crystal): When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the electric currents to communicate their feelings.
Description (en, ruby): When a storm arrives, gangs of this POKéMON compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
Description (en, emerald): When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
Description (en, firered): It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
Description (en, diamond): Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
Description (en, platinum): It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
Description (en, heartgold): Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.
Description (en, black-2): Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.
Description (ko, x): 몸의 표면에는 전기가 흐르고 있다. 주변이 어두우면 전신이 푸르스름하게 빛난다.
Description (en, x): Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish blue.
Description (ko, y): 강한 전기를 좋아하여 커다란 발전소 같은 곳에 종종 나타난다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 폭풍이 오면 나무 위처럼 벼락이 떨어질 만한 높은 장소로 앞다투어 올라간다. 피뢰침 대용으로 삼는 마을도 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): When a storm arrives, gangs of this Pokémon compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.
Description (ko, sun): 갑자기 일어나는 정전의 반은 에레브가 발전소에 모여 전기를 마구 먹어대기 때문이다.
Description (en, sun): Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.
Description (ko, moon): 먹이로 먹는 전기량보다 몸에서 새는 전기량이 압도적으로 많다.
Description (en, moon): Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 온몸이 전기로 둘러싸여 있다. 팔을 빙빙 돌려 전기를 충전 후 펀치를 날린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Electricity permeates its body. It swings its arms round and round to charge up electricity before unleashing a punch.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 정전이 일어나는 원인으로 지목되는 경우가 많지만 사실은 회사의 실수인 경우가 더 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): While it’s often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 대규모 정전이 일어났을 땐 에레브가 발전소의 전기를 먹은 것임이 틀림없다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this Pokémon has eaten electricity at a power plant.
Description (ko, sword): 전기를 노리는 에레브를 퇴치하고자 땅포켓몬을 두는 발전소도 많다.
Description (en, sword): Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
Description (ko, shield): 폭풍이 치면 높은 나무 주위에 모여 번개가 떨어지기를 가만히 기다린다.
Description (en, shield): With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

document.title: Magmar — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Magmar
ID: 126
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마그마
Name (en): Magmar
Description (en, red): Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
Description (en, yellow): Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.
Description (en, gold): It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suit­ able for itself.
Description (en, silver): The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.
Description (en, crystal): It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal itself by dipping its wound into lava.
Description (en, ruby): In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This POKéMON’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
Description (en, emerald): In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.
Description (en, firered): Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly amidst flames.
Description (en, diamond): Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.
Description (en, platinum): When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
Description (en, heartgold): It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.
Description (en, black-2): The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar forms heat waves around its body, making it hard to see the Pokémon clearly.
Description (ko, x): 화산의 분화구 근처에서 발견되었다. 입에서 불꽃을 뿜어낸다. 체온은 1200도나 된다.
Description (ko, y): 화산의 분화구에서 태어나 자랐다. 태양과도 같은 불꽃의 일렁임이 전신을 감싼다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 싸우게 되면 몸에서 작열하는 불꽃을 뿜어내 상대를 위협한다. 그 열풍으로 주변의 초목도 불태운다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): In battle, Magmar blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
Description (ko, sun): 피곤하면 화구에 뛰어들어 마그마에 잠겨 몸을 치유한다. 전신이 1200도로 타고 있다.
Description (en, sun): When it’s tired, it leaps into the mouth of a volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.
Description (ko, moon): 화가 나면 전신에서 작열하는 불꽃을 뿜어 올린다. 상대를 재로 만들 때까지 멈추지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn’t calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 온몸이 불에 타고 있어서 숨을 쉬기만 해도 뜨겁다. 재채기와 동시에 불꽃을 뿜어낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 더운 곳일수록 컨디션이 좋다. 알로라의 마그마는 다른 지역에 비해 늠름하다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The hotter the place, the better they feel. Magmar in Alola are said to be hardier than those in other areas.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 화산의 분화구에서 태어났다. 전신이 불타고 있어 불구슬과 구분이 안된다.
Description (ko, sword): 불꽃으로 먹이를 꼼짝 못 하게 한다. 무의식중에 너무 오래 익혀서 까맣게 태우고는 후회한다.
Description (en, sword): Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
Description (ko, shield): 온몸이 늘 불타고 있다. 화재를 일으키는 원인 중 하나로 두려움의 대상이 되고 있다.
Description (en, shield): These Pokémon’s bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.
