document.title: Pinsir — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pinsir
ID: 127
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 쁘사이저
Name (en): Pinsir
Description (en, red): If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
Description (en, yellow): Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold, so it lives in warm places.
Description (en, gold): With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
Description (en, silver): Swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
Description (en, crystal): When the tempera­ ture drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.
Description (en, ruby): PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This POKéMON’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
Description (en, sapphire): PINSIR has a pair of massive horns Protruding from the surface of these horns are thorns. These thorns are driven deeply into the foe’s body when the pincer closes, making it tough for the foe to escape.
Description (en, emerald): Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
Description (en, firered): Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.
Description (en, leafgreen): If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.
Description (en, diamond): It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
Description (en, heartgold): With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
Description (en, soulsilver): It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
Description (en, black-2): It grips prey with its powerful pincers and will not let go until the prey is torn in half.
Description (ko, x): 2개의 뿔 사이에 먹이를 끼우고 조각날 때까지 놓지 않는다. 조각나지 않으면 저편으로 세게 내던진다.
Description (ko, y): 긴 뿔을 휘둘러서 공격을 해온다. 추울 때는 숲 깊은 곳에 몸을 숨긴다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자신의 몸무게 두 배나 되는 상대를 뿔로 집어 가볍게 들어 올리는 괴력을 지녔다. 추운 곳에서는 몸의 움직임이 둔해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Pinsir is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokémon’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 늠름한 2개의 뿔 표면에 있는 가시가 상대의 몸에 깊숙이 파고들어서 집히면 쉽게 벗어날 수 없다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Pinsir has a pair of massive horns. Protruding from the surface of these horns are thorns. These thorns are driven deeply into the foe’s body when the pincer closes, making it tough for the foe to escape.
Description (ko, sun): 긴 뿔로 상대를 끼워 넣어 그대로 두 동강을 내 버린다. 파워풀하지만 추운 것을 싫어한다.
Description (en, sun): It grips its prey in its pincers and splits them apart. Although it is a powerful Pokémon, it can’t deal with the cold.
Description (ko, moon): 뿔의 일격은 큰 나무조차도 부러뜨릴 정도다. 알로라에서는 투구뿌논이 최대의 라이벌이다.
Description (en, moon): One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 투구뿌논과 영역 다툼을 한다. 알로라에서는 어째서인지 헤라크로스와 사이가 좋은 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 늠름하지만 추위가 약점이다. 밤이 되면 나뭇잎 속에 몸을 파묻고 잔다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it’s tough, it can’t handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 뿔로 집은 다음 있는 힘껏 조인다! 추워지면 움직일 수 없게 되므로 따뜻한 곳에 산다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in warm places.
Description (ko, sword): 뿔로 서로의 등급을 매긴다. 굵고 훌륭한 뿔을 가진 쁘사이저일수록 이성에게 인기다.
Description (en, sword): These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.
Description (ko, shield): 뿔로 먹이를 찔러 넣어 그대로 두 동강으로 만들거나 강제로 던져버린다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

document.body:

Name: Pinsir
ID: 127
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 쁘사이저
Name (en): Pinsir
Description (en, red): If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
Description (en, yellow): Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold, so it lives in warm places.
Description (en, gold): With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
Description (en, silver): Swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
Description (en, crystal): When the tempera­ ture drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.
Description (en, ruby): PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This POKéMON’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
Description (en, sapphire): PINSIR has a pair of massive horns Protruding from the surface of these horns are thorns. These thorns are driven deeply into the foe’s body when the pincer closes, making it tough for the foe to escape.
Description (en, emerald): Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
Description (en, firered): Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.
Description (en, leafgreen): If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.
Description (en, diamond): It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
Description (en, heartgold): With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
Description (en, soulsilver): It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
Description (en, black-2): It grips prey with its powerful pincers and will not let go until the prey is torn in half.
Description (ko, x): 2개의 뿔 사이에 먹이를 끼우고 조각날 때까지 놓지 않는다. 조각나지 않으면 저편으로 세게 내던진다.
Description (ko, y): 긴 뿔을 휘둘러서 공격을 해온다. 추울 때는 숲 깊은 곳에 몸을 숨긴다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자신의 몸무게 두 배나 되는 상대를 뿔로 집어 가볍게 들어 올리는 괴력을 지녔다. 추운 곳에서는 몸의 움직임이 둔해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Pinsir is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokémon’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 늠름한 2개의 뿔 표면에 있는 가시가 상대의 몸에 깊숙이 파고들어서 집히면 쉽게 벗어날 수 없다.

Description (ko, sun): 긴 뿔로 상대를 끼워 넣어 그대로 두 동강을 내 버린다. 파워풀하지만 추운 것을 싫어한다.
Description (en, sun): It grips its prey in its pincers and splits them apart. Although it is a powerful Pokémon, it can’t deal with the cold.
Description (ko, moon): 뿔의 일격은 큰 나무조차도 부러뜨릴 정도다. 알로라에서는 투구뿌논이 최대의 라이벌이다.
Description (en, moon): One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 투구뿌논과 영역 다툼을 한다. 알로라에서는 어째서인지 헤라크로스와 사이가 좋은 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 늠름하지만 추위가 약점이다. 밤이 되면 나뭇잎 속에 몸을 파묻고 잔다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it’s tough, it can’t handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 뿔로 집은 다음 있는 힘껏 조인다! 추워지면 움직일 수 없게 되므로 따뜻한 곳에 산다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in warm places.
Description (ko, sword): 뿔로 서로의 등급을 매긴다. 굵고 훌륭한 뿔을 가진 쁘사이저일수록 이성에게 인기다.
Description (en, sword): These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.
Description (ko, shield): 뿔로 먹이를 찔러 넣어 그대로 두 동강으로 만들거나 강제로 던져버린다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

document.title: Tauros — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tauros
ID: 128
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 켄타로스
Name (en): Tauros
Description (en, red): When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
Description (en, yellow): A rowdy POKéMON with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won't stop until it hits something.
Description (en, gold): They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its bat­ tle-scarred horns.
Description (en, silver): After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.
Description (en, crystal): These violent POKéMON fight with other mem­ bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.
Description (en, ruby): This POKéMON is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
Description (en, emerald): It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
Description (en, firered): When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.
Description (en, diamond): Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
Description (en, heartgold): They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.
Description (ko, x): 3개의 꼬리로 자신을 때려서 투지가 끓어오르면 전속력으로 돌진해온다.
Description (ko, y): 몸통박치기로 공격해 올 때 3개의 꼬리로 자신의 몸을 가차 없이 때린다.
Description (en, y): When it is about to tackle, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 항상 날뛰지 않으면 성에 차지 않는다. 싸울 상대가 없을 때는 큰 나무를 들이받아 쓰러트리고 맘을 가라앉힌다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): This Pokémon is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
Description (ko, sun): 세계 각지에 켄타로스에 타서 생활해온 역사가 있으나 그 시초는 알로라라고 한다.
Description (en, sun): Historically, people in areas all over the world have ridden Tauros, but the practice is said to have started in Alola.
Description (ko, moon): 난폭한 포켓몬이지만 알로라지방의 켄타로스는 조금 침착하다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): Although it’s known to be a fierce Pokémon, Tauros in the Alola region are said to possess a measure of calmness.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 집단생활을 한다. 무리 중에서 가장 굵고 길며 상처가 많은 뿔을 가진 것이 보스다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 알로라의 켄타로스가 다른 지방보다 조금 차분한 것은 기후와 관련이 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The climate seems to be related to the reason Tauros in Alola are a little calmer than those in other regions.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 넘치는 체력의 난동꾼. 달리기 시작하면 몸통박치기를 할 때까지 끝없이 돌진한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.
Description (ko, sword): 꼬리로 자신의 몸을 때리기 시작하면 위험하다. 맹렬한 스피드로 덤벼든다.
Description (en, sword): When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.
Description (ko, shield): 가라르에 서식하는 켄타로스는 기질이 거칠어서 사람이 등에 올라타는 것을 허용하지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

Description (en, sword): When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.
Description (ko, shield): 가라르에 서식하는 켄타로스는 기질이 거칠어서 사람이 등에 올라타는 것을 허용하지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

document.title: Magikarp — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Magikarp
ID: 129
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 잉어킹
Name (en): Magikarp
Description (en, red): In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
Description (en, yellow): Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers and shallow puddles.
Description (en, gold): An underpowered, pathetic POKéMON. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.
Description (en, silver): For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like PIDGEOTTO to catch it mid-jump.
Description (en, crystal): This weak and pathetic POKéMON gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
Description (en, ruby): MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a POKéMON that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
Description (en, sapphire): MAGIKARP is virtually useless in battle as it can only splash around. As a result, it is considered to be weak. However, it is actually a very hardy POKéMON that can survive in any body of water no matter how polluted it is.
Description (en, emerald): Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.
Description (en, firered): It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.
Description (en, diamond): It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.
Description (en, pearl): It is unable to swim against even slow-moving currents. It always splashes about for some reason.
Description (en, platinum): A MAGIKARP living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
Description (en, heartgold): An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.
Description (en, black): A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
Description (ko, x): 힘도 스피드도 거의 없다. 세상에서 가장 약하고 한심한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, x): It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
Description (ko, y): 아주 먼 옛날에는 좀 더 강했던 것 같다. 그러나 지금은 안쓰러울 정도로 약하다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 튀어 오르기만 하는 한심한 포켓몬이다. 왜 튀어 오르는지 조사한 연구자가 있을 정도로 무조건 튀고 튀고 튀어 오르기만 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Magikarp is a pathetic excuse for a Pokémon that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 튀어오르기만으로는 만족스럽게 싸울 수 없어서 약하다고 여겨지고 있지만 아무리 더러워진 물에서라도 살 수 있는 끈질긴 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Magikarp is virtually useless in battle as it can only splash around. As a result, it is considered to be weak. However, it is actually a very hardy Pokémon that can survive in any body of water no matter how polluted it is.
Description (ko, sun): 힘은 약하고 믿음직스럽지 못하지만 번식력만은 엄청나다. 질릴 정도로 눈에 띈다.
Description (en, sun): Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you’ll soon grow tired of seeing them.
Description (ko, moon): 무턱대고 튀어 올라서 바로 공격당하지만 잉어킹 덕분에 많은 포켓몬이 살아남을 수 있다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): Its reckless leaps make it easy pickings for predators. On the bright side, many Pokémon enjoy longer life spans, thanks to Magikarp.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먼 옛날에는 그럭저럭 강한 편이었으나 시간이 흐르면서 점점 약해졌다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 생명력이 강해서 더러운 물이라도 문제없다. 전 세계의 물가에 서식하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Thanks to their strong hold on life, dirty water doesn’t bother them at all. They live in waters all over the world!
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 못 미덥기로 유명한 포켓몬. 바다, 강, 연못, 물웅덩이 등 다양한 곳에서 헤엄치고 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers, and shallow puddles.
Description (ko, shield): 유속이 빠른 곳에서는 그저 떠내려갈 뿐인 약하고 한심한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, shield): This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

document.title: Gyarados — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gyarados
ID: 130
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 갸라도스
Name (en): Gyarados
Description (en, red): Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
Description (en, yellow): Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
Description (en, gold): They say that during past wars, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
Description (en, silver): Once it appears, it goes on a ram­ page. It remains enraged until it demolishes every­ thing around it.
Description (en, crystal): It appears when­ ever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through.
Description (en, ruby): When MAGIKARP evolves into GYARADOS, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this POKéMON’s wildly violent nature.
Description (en, sapphire): Once GYARADOS goes on a rampage, its ferociously violent blood doesn’t calm until it has burned everything down. There are records of this POKéMON’s rampages lasting a whole month.
Description (en, emerald): It is an extremely vicious and violent POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.
Description (en, firered): It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
Description (en, diamond): Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.
Description (en, pearl): In ancient literature, there is a record of a GYARADOS that razed a village when violence flared.
Description (en, platinum): Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
Description (en, heartgold): They say that during past strife, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
Description (en, soulsilver): Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.
Description (en, black): Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
Description (ko, x): 분쟁이 일어난 마을을 다 태워버렸다는 기록이 고문서에 남아 있다.
Description (en, x): In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.
Description (ko, y): 거의 모습을 드러내지 않지만 한번 날뛰면 커다란 도시가 괴멸하는 경우도 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 잉어킹에서 갸라도스로 진화할 때 뇌세포의 구조가 재구성되기 때문에 성격이 난폭해진다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): When Magikarp evolves into Gyarados, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this Pokémon’s wildly violent nature.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 한 번 날뛰기 시작하면 모든 것을 불태워야 난폭한 피가 가라앉는다. 한 달간을 날뛴 기록이 남아 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Once Gyarados goes on a rampage, its ferociously violent blood doesn’t calm until it has burned everything down. There are records of this Pokémon’s rampages lasting a whole month.
Description (ko, sun): 갸라도스를 화나게 한 어떤 마을은 하룻밤 만에 다 타버려서 흔적도 없어졌다고 전해진다.
Description (en, sun): A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.
Description (ko, moon): 갸라도스가 나타난 장소는 파괴될 운명이라고 믿고 있는 사람도 있다.
Description (en, moon): There are people who swear that any place Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 파괴광선을 무자비하게 쏘아 주변 일대를 태워 버린다. 파괴의 신이라고 부르는 지방도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it’s called “the deity of destruction.”
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 진화 에너지가 뇌세포를 강하게 자극한 결과 매우 난폭한 성격으로 변화했다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The energy from evolution stimulated its brain cells strongly, causing it to become very ferocious.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 야만스럽고 파괴적인 성격이다. 먼 옛날 마을을 불태워버렸다는 기록이 있는 공포의 포켓몬.
Description (ko, sword): 성격이 매우 흉포하다. 입에서 나오는 파괴광선은 모든 것을 태워버린다.
Description (en, sword): It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
Description (ko, shield): 한번 난동부리기 시작한 갸라도스는 태풍이 사납게 휘몰아쳐도 모든 것을 다 태워버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

document.title: Lapras — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lapras
ID: 131
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 라프라스
Name (en): Lapras
Description (en, red): A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
Description (en, yellow): A gentle soul that can read the minds of people. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
Description (en, gold): They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their num­ ber has dwindled.
Description (en, silver): It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.
Description (en, crystal): This gentle POKéMON loves to give people rides and provides a ve­ ry comfortable way to get around.
Description (en, ruby): People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this POKéMON is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
Description (en, emerald): People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
Description (en, firered): Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.
Description (en, leafgreen): A POKéMON that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people on its back.
Description (en, diamond): It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
Description (en, heartgold): They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.
Description (en, black-2): Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.
Description (ko, x): 부드러운 마음의 소유자다. 좀처럼 다투지 않아 많이 잡혔기 때문에 수가 줄었다.
Description (ko, y): 사람의 말을 이해하는 높은 지능을 가지고 있다. 사람을 태우고 바다를 건너는 것을 좋아한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 사람이 멸종의 위기로 몰아갔다. 석양이 내리면 수가 줄어든 동료를 찾아 슬픈 목소리로 노래한다고 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
Description (ko, sun): 높은 지능을 가졌으며 인간의 말을 이해한다. 기분이 좋아지면 아름다운 목소리로 노래한다.
Description (en, sun): Its high intelligence enables it to comprehend human speech. When it’s in a good mood, it sings in its beautiful voice.
Description (ko, moon): 밀렵으로 멸종 위기에 처했다가 소중히 보호한 결과 오히려 수가 너무 늘었다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 사람을 태우고 헤엄치는 것을 좋아한다. 알로라지방에서는 소중한 수상 교통수단이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it’s an important means of transportation over water.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 너무 소중히 여겨져서 수가 너무 늘었다. 라프라스가 너무 많은 바다에는 물고기포켓몬이 줄어든다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They’ve been so cherished that there’s now an overabundance. The fish Pokémon population has declined in waters with too many Lapras.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 인간의 말을 이해하는 착한 마음의 소유자다. 사람을 등에 태우고 바다를 건넌다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
Description (ko, sword): 영리하고 마음 착한 포켓몬. 아름다운 소리로 노래 부르며 바다 위를 헤엄친다.
Description (en, sword): A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
Description (ko, shield): 추위에 강해서 얼음 바다에서도 끄떡없다. 피부는 매끈매끈하고 조금 차갑다.
Description (en, shield): Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 사람이 멸종의 위기로 몰아갔다. 석양이 내리면 수가 줄어든 동료를 찾아 슬픈 목소리로 노래한다고 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
Description (ko, sun): 높은 지능을 가졌으며 인간의 말을 이해한다. 기분이 좋아지면 아름다운 목소리로 노래한다.
Description (en, sun): Its high intelligence enables it to comprehend human speech. When it’s in a good mood, it sings in its beautiful voice.
Description (ko, moon): 밀렵으로 멸종 위기에 처했다가 소중히 보호한 결과 오히려 수가 너무 늘었다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 사람을 태우고 헤엄치는 것을 좋아한다. 알로라지방에서는 소중한 수상 교통수단이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it’s an important means of transportation over water.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 너무 소중히 여겨져서 수가 너무 늘었다. 라프라스가 너무 많은 바다에는 물고기포켓몬이 줄어든다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They’ve been so cherished that there’s now an overabundance. The fish Pokémon population has declined in waters with too many Lapras.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 인간의 말을 이해하는 착한 마음의 소유자다. 사람을 등에 태우고 바다를 건넌다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
Description (ko, sword): 영리하고 마음 착한 포켓몬. 아름다운 소리로 노래 부르며 바다 위를 헤엄친다.
Description (en, sword): A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
Description (ko, shield): 추위에 강해서 얼음 바다에서도 끄떡없다. 피부는 매끈매끈하고 조금 차갑다.
Description (en, shield): Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

document.title: Ditto — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ditto
ID: 132
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메타몽
Name (en): Ditto
Description (en, red): Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
Description (en, yellow): When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost perfect copy of its oppo­ nent.
Description (en, gold): It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.
Description (en, silver): Its transformation ability is per­ fect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.
Description (en, crystal): When it encount­ ers another DITTO, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
Description (en, ruby): DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this POKéMON manages to get details wrong.
Description (en, emerald): A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.
Description (en, firered): It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.
Description (en, leafgreen): Capable of copying an opponent’s genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
Description (en, diamond): It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.
Description (en, black-2): It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
Description (ko, x): 전신의 세포를 재구성해서 본 것의 모양과 똑 닮게 변신하는 능력을 가지고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 몸의 세포 구성을 스스로 바꿔서 다른 생명체로 변신한다.
Description (en, y): It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸의 세포를 재구성하여 변신한다. 전에 봤던 것을 기억해내면서 바뀌면 조금 다른 형태가 되어버린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this Pokémon manages to get details wrong.
Description (ko, sun): 세포를 재구성하여 본 상대와 똑같이 모습을 변화시킨다. 재현도는 개체에 따라 다르다.
Description (en, sun): It can reorganize its cells to make itself into a duplicate of anything it sees. The quality of the duplicate depends on the individual.
Description (ko, moon): 놀라운 변신 능력으로 누구와도 동료가 될 수 있다. 메타몽끼리는 사이가 나쁘다.
Description (en, moon): With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 뭐든지 변신할 수 있지만 메타몽마다 잘하는 변신과 잘 못하는 변신이 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 본 적이 있는 것으로 변신한다. 단 눈앞에 없는 것으로 변신할 때는 기억에 따르기 때문에 실패하기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It transforms into whatever it sees. If the thing it’s transforming into isn’t right in front of it, Ditto relies on its memory—so sometimes it fails.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 상대를 본 순간 몸이 녹는 것처럼 변화하기 시작한다. 거의 똑같은 모습으로 변신한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.
Description (ko, sword): 전신의 세포를 재구성해서 본 것과 똑 닮게 변신하지만 힘이 빠지면 원래대로 돌아간다.
Description (ko, shield): 메타몽끼리 만나게 되면 상대와 똑같은 모습이 되기 위해 평소보다 격렬하게 움직인다.
Description (en, shield): When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

document.title: Eevee — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Eevee
ID: 133
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이브이
Name (en): Eevee
Description (en, red): Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
Description (en, yellow): Its genetic code is unstable, so it could evolve in a variety of ways. There are only a few alive.
Description (en, gold): It has the ability to alter the com­ position of its body to suit its surrounding envi­ ronment.
Description (en, silver): Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its en­ vironment changes.
Description (en, crystal): Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
Description (en, ruby): EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.
Description (en, emerald): An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.
Description (en, firered): An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONES.
Description (en, diamond): A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
Description (en, platinum): Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
Description (en, heartgold): It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.
Description (en, black-2): Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
Description (ko, x): 진화할 때 모습과 능력이 바뀜으로써 혹독한 환경에 적응하는 희귀한 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 불안정한 유전자 덕분에 여러 가지 진화 가능성을 간직하고 있는 특수한 포켓몬.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 사는 환경에 따라 돌연변이하는 불안정한 유전자를 지닌 포켓몬이다. 돌의 방사선이 진화를 일으킨다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.
Description (ko, sun): 언밸런스하고도 불안정한 유전자를 가지고 있어 다양한 진화의 가능성을 품고 있다.
Description (en, sun): Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.
Description (ko, moon): 지금까지 조사에 의하면 무려 8종류의 포켓몬으로 진화할 가능성을 갖고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 이브이만 매우 불안정한 유전자를 갖고 있는 이유는 아직 해명되지 않았다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 주위의 영향을 받기 쉬운 유전자를 가졌다. 어버이가 된 트레이너의 얼굴에도 닮아 간다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its genes are easily influenced by its surroundings. Even its face starts to look like that of its Trainer.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 다양한 모습으로 진화한다. 이브이의 유전자는 진화의 비밀을 밝혀낼 열쇠다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): It can evolve into a variety of forms. Eevee’s genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.
Description (ko, sword): 주위의 환경에 맞춰서 몸의 구조를 바꿔나가는 능력의 소유자다.
Description (ko, shield): 불안정한 유전자 덕분에 여러 가지 진화의 가능성을 가지고 있는 특수한 포켓몬.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

Name (en): Vaporeon

Description (en, diamond): It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.

Description (en, ultra-moon): It detects nearby moisture with its fin. When its fin begins trembling rapidly, that means rain will fall in a few hours.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 세포 조직이 물 분자와 비슷하기 때문에 물에 녹아들면 모습이 보이지 않게 된다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It melts into the water and becomes invisible.
Description (ko, sword): 샤미드의 모든 지느러미가 조금씩 떨리기 시작했다면 몇 시간 뒤에 비가 내린다는 표시다.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 촉수를 이용하여 먹이를 잡는다. 껍질이 너무 커진 탓에 움직임이 둔해져서 멸종했다고 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 무거운 껍질 때문에 멸종했다고 추정되는 고대 포켓몬. 대포무노의 먼 선조인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It’s apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 촉수로 먹이를 휘감아 움직임을 봉쇄한 뒤 날카로운 이빨로 마무리한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It wraps its prey in its tentacles to immobilize them and then finishes them off with its sharp fangs.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 날카로운 이빨을 가졌지만 껍질이 너무 커서 제대로 움직이지 못해 멸종한 듯하다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.
Description (ko, sword): 크고 무거운 껍질 때문에 움직임이 둔해져서 먹이를 잡지 못해 멸종했다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.
Description (ko, shield): 날카로운 이빨은 바위도 부수지만 촉수가 닿는 범위 안의 먹이만 공격할 수 있다.
Description (en, shield): Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

document.title: Kabuto — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kabuto
ID: 140
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 투구
Name (en): Kabuto
Description (en, red): A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
Description (en, yellow): A POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It uses the eyes on its back while hiding on the sea floor.
Description (en, gold): On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
Description (en, silver): This POKéMON lived in ancient times. On rare occasions, it has been discovered as a living fossil.
Description (en, crystal): Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.
Description (en, ruby): KABUTO is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The POKéMON has not changed at all for 300 million years.
Description (en, emerald): It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.
Description (en, firered): This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.
Description (en, leafgreen): A POKéMON that was regenerated from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor long ago.
Description (en, diamond): It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
Description (en, soulsilver): This Pokémon lived in ancient times. On rare occasions, it has been discovered as a living fossil.
Description (ko, x): 3억 년 전에 모래 해변에서 살고 있었던 것으로 추측된다. 단단한 껍질이 몸을 보호한다.
Description (ko, y): 고대 생물의 화석에서 재생된 포켓몬. 단단한 껍데기로 몸을 지키고 있다.
Description (en, y): This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 화석에서 부활한 포켓몬이지만 드물게 살아 있는 투구를 발견할 수 있다. 그 모습은 3억 년 동안 변치 않았다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Kabuto is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokémon has not changed at all for 300 million years.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 3억 년 전에 번성했던 포켓몬. 어느 지방에서는 지금도 드물게 살아 있는 모습을 볼 수 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It’s said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 극히 일부 지역을 제외하고 멸종해 버린 포켓몬이다. 단단한 껍질로 몸을 지킨다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This Pokémon became extinct everywhere, except in a few areas. It protects itself with its hard shell.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 화석에서 재생된 포켓몬. 해저에 숨어서 등에 달린 눈으로 주변을 살폈던 것 같다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.
Description (ko, sword): 거의 멸종된 포켓몬이다. 3일에 1번 탈피하여 껍질을 점점 단단하게 만든다.
Description (en, sword): This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.
Description (ko, shield): 멸종되었다는 이야기가 있지만 일부 지역에서는 제법 많이 목격되는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

document.title: Kabutops — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kabutops
ID: 141
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 투구푸스
Name (en): Kabutops
Description (en, red): Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
Description (en, yellow): A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.
Description (en, gold): In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
Description (en, silver): With sharp claws, this ferocious, ancient POKéMON rips apart prey and sucks their body fluids.
Description (en, crystal): It was able to swim quickly thro­ ugh the water by compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.
Description (en, ruby): KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The POKéMON was apparently evolving from being a water-dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.
Description (en, emerald): KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.
Description (en, firered): It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains their fluids.
Description (en, diamond): It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
Description (en, soulsilver): With sharp claws, this ferocious, ancient Pokémon rips apart prey and sucks their body fluids.
Description (ko, x): 수중을 이동할 때 손발을 작게 접고 등껍질을 구부려 빠르게 헤엄친다.
Description (ko, y): 날렵한 몸으로 재빠르게 헤엄친다. 잡은 먹이는 낫으로 베어 체액을 빨아들이는 듯하다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 물속을 헤엄쳐 먹이를 잡았었다. 물에서의 생활을 지나 땅에서 살 수 있도록 아가미나 다리 등이 변화되기 시작했다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Kabutops swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokémon was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 육지에서도 활동할 수 있도록 신체가 변화하기 시작했지만 때가 늦어서 멸종해 버렸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn’t adapt in time and went extinct.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 약 29노트로 헤엄친다. 재빠르게 먹이에 다가가 낫으로 베어 갈라 마무리한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It swims at speeds of roughly 29 knots, quickly closing in on its prey and slashing into them with its scythes to finish them off.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.
Description (ko, sword): 먹이를 베어 갈라 체액을 빨아먹는다. 남은 몸은 다른 포켓몬의 먹이가 된다.
Description (en, sword): Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 멸종한 이유는 불명확하다. 따듯한 바다에 살고 있던 난폭한 고대의 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, shield): The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

document.title: Aerodactyl — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Aerodactyl
ID: 142
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 프테라
Name (en): Aerodactyl
Description (en, red): A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
Description (en, yellow): A savage POKéMON that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
Description (en, gold): A vicious POKéMON from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
Description (en, silver): This vicious POKé­ MON is said to have flown in an­ cient skies while shrieking high- pitched cries.
Description (en, crystal): In prehistoric times, this POKéMON flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.
Description (en, ruby): AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
Description (en, emerald): AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.
Description (en, firered): It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.
Description (en, leafgreen): A ferocious, prehistoric POKéMON that goes for the enemy’s throat with its serrated, sawlike fangs.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
Description (en, heartgold): A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
Description (en, soulsilver): This vicious Pokémon is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.
Description (ko, x): 호박에 남아 있던 공룡의 유전자에서 부활시켰다. 높은 소리로 울며 난다.
Description (ko, y): 날카로운 목소리로 울부짖으며 고대의 넓은 하늘을 날아다녔다고 여겨지는 거칠고 사나운 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 호박에서 추출한 유전자를 재생하여 부활한 공룡시대의 포켓몬이다. 하늘의 왕이었다고 상상된다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
Description (ko, sun): 공룡시대의 포켓몬이다. 톱 같은 엄니로 먹이를 찢어서 먹었다.
Description (en, sun): A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.
Description (ko, moon): 고대 하늘의 왕. 거대한 운석의 낙하로 멸종했다는 설이 뿌리깊다.
Description (en, moon): In ancient times, it ruled the skies. A widely accepted theory is that it went extinct due to a large meteor impact.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 호박에 남겨진 유전자로 복원시켰다. 예상 밖으로 흉포하여 희생자도 발생했다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 고대의 넓은 하늘을 제집처럼 날아다녔다. 땅에 내려오면 걷는 것도 느리고 약했다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It flew through the open skies over the ancient continent as if they were its own. When it touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 호박에서 추출한 유전자를 연구해서 부활시킨 먼 옛날의 사나운 포켓몬.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
Description (ko, sword): 고대의 거칠고 사나운 포켓몬이다. 완벽한 복원은 현대의 과학으로도 불가능하다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.
Description (ko, shield): 톱 같은 이빨은 강철포켓몬의 피부도 갈기갈기 베어 가른다.
Description (en, shield): Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

document.title: Snorlax — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Snorlax
ID: 143
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 잠만보
Name (en): Snorlax
Description (en, red): Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
Description (en, yellow): Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.
Description (en, gold): What sounds like its cry may ac­ tually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
Description (en, silver): Its stomach's di­ gestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.
Description (en, crystal): This POKéMON's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.
Description (en, ruby): SNORLAX’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
Description (en, emerald): SNORLAX’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.
Description (en, firered): It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
Description (en, diamond): Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.
Description (en, pearl): It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn’t feel full unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.
Description (en, platinum): When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
Description (en, heartgold): What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its stomach’s digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.
Description (ko, x): 하루에 먹을 것을 400kg 먹지 않으면 성에 차지 않는다. 다 먹으면 잠이 들어 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 곰팡이가 피어 있거나 상했어도 괜찮다. 잠만보의 위는 무엇이든 소화시킬 수 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 먹고 자는 것을 반복하다 하루가 끝난다. 큰 배 위를 놀이터로 삼은 아이들이 있을 정도로 얌전한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Snorlax’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
Description (ko, sun): 최강의 위를 가졌다고 전해진다. 질뻐기의 독조차 잠만보의 혀에는 향신료인 셈이다.
Description (en, sun): Its stomach is said to be incomparably strong. Even Muk’s poison is nothing more than a hint of spice on Snorlax’s tongue.
Description (ko, moon): 매일 400kg의 먹이를 먹는다. 먹기 시작할 때부터 졸기 시작하여 자는 동안에도 먹고 있다.
Description (en, moon): It eats nearly 900 pounds of food every day. It starts nodding off while eating—and continues to eat even while it’s asleep.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹거나 자는 것밖에 안 하지만 일단 진심을 다하게 되면 굉장한 파워를 발휘하는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It doesn’t do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먹는 것 외에는 관심이 없다. 낮잠 중에 배 위에 올라타도 전혀 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has no interest in anything other than eating. Even if you climb up on its stomach while it’s napping, it doesn’t seem to mind at all!
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 약간 곰팡이가 피어 있어도 신경 쓰지 않고 먹어 치운다. 배탈이 나는 일도 없다.
Description (ko, sword): 하루에 400kg의 음식을 먹지 않으면 성에 차지 않는다. 다 먹으면 잠이 들어 버린다.
Description (ko, shield): 위장이 튼튼해서 곰팡이가 피거나 썩은 것을 먹어도 배탈이 나지 않는다.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Articuno
ID: 144
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 프리져
Name (en): Articuno
Description (en, red): A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
Description (en, yellow): A legendary bird POKéMON. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
Description (en, gold): The magnificent, seemingly translu­ cent wings of this legendary bird POKéMON are said to be made of ice.
Description (en, silver): One of the legen­ dary bird POKéMON, it chills moisture in the atmosphere to create snow while flying.
Description (en, crystal): Legendary bird POKéMON. As it flies through the sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.
Description (en, ruby): ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.
Description (en, firered): One of the legendary bird POKéMON. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.
Description (en, diamond): A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
Description (en, heartgold): The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.
Description (en, soulsilver): One of the legendary bird Pokémon, it chills moisture in the atmosphere to create snow while flying.
Description (ko, x): 전설의 새포켓몬이다. 공기 중의 수분을 얼려 눈보라를 만들어 낼 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 설산에서 추워 죽을 것 같을 때 눈앞에 나타난다고 하는 전설의 냉동포켓몬.
Description (en, y): A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 얼음을 조종하는 전설의 새포켓몬이다. 날갯짓하면 공기가 차갑게 식기 때문에 프리져가 날면 눈이 온다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 겨울 하늘의 공기 중에 있는 수분을 얼려서 눈을 내리게 하는 전설의 새포켓몬.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
Description (ko, sword): 푸르고 아름다운 날개는 얼음으로 되어 있다고 전해진다. 긴 꼬리를 나부끼며 설산 위를 난다.
Description (en, sword): It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
Description (ko, shield): 얼음을 자유자재로 조종하는 힘을 가졌다. 영구 동토의 설산에 살고 있다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

Description (en, heartgold): This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.
Description (en, soulsilver): This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear only when a thundercloud parts into two halves.
Description (ko, x): 구름 위에서 거대한 번개를 내리치며 나타난다. 전설의 새포켓몬이다.
Description (en, x): A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
Description (ko, y): 번개 구름 안에 있다고 전해지는 전설의 포켓몬이다. 번개를 자유로이 조종한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 전기를 조종하는 전설의 새포켓몬이다. 평상시는 번개 구름 속에서 지낸다. 번개를 맞으면 힘이 솟아난다.

Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
Description (ko, sword): 전기를 자유로이 조종한다. 새까만 번개 구름 안에 거처가 있다고 전해지고 있다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

Description (ko, y): 전설의 새포켓몬 중의 1마리다. 파이어가 모습을 보이면 봄이 찾아온다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 불꽃을 조종하는 전설의 새포켓몬이다. 몸이 상처 입으면 분화구의 마그마에 들어가 전신을 불태워 상처를 치료한다고 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 밤하늘조차 붉게 물들일 정도로 격렬하게 타오르는 날개로 날갯짓하는 전설의 새포켓몬.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A legendary bird Pokémon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
Description (ko, sword): 날갯짓을 하면 날개의 불꽃이 빨갛고 아름답게 빛나는 전설의 새포켓몬 중 1마리다.
Description (en, sword): It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
Description (ko, shield): 아름답게 타오르는 날개로 산길을 비춰 조난자를 도왔다고 전해져 오고 있다.
Description (en, shield): There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

document.body:

Name: Dratini
ID: 147
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 미뇽
Name (en): Dratini
Description (en, red): Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
Description (en, yellow): The existence of this mythical POKéMON was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
Description (en, gold): It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
Description (en, silver): This POKéMON is full of life ener­ gy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.
Description (en, crystal): It sheds many lay­ ers of skin as it grows larger. Dur­ ing this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
Description (en, ruby): DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
Description (en, emerald): A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
Description (en, firered): Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.
Description (en, leafgreen): Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.
Description (en, diamond): It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
Description (en, soulsilver): This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.
Description (ko, x): 목격자가 적기 때문에 환상의 포켓몬이라고 불리고 있다. 탈피한 껍질이 발견되고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 탈피를 반복하면 점점 크게 자라게 되는 생명력 넘치는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 미뇽이 탈피를 반복하는 것은 몸속에서 생명 에너지가 점점 부풀어 올라 억제할 수 없게 되기 때문이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
Description (ko, sun): 탈피를 반복하며 커진다. 허물을 다듬어서 만든 부츠는 최고급품이다.
Description (en, sun): It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.
Description (ko, moon): 어떤 낚시꾼이 10시간의 싸움 끝에 낚아 올려 존재가 확인되었다.
Description (en, moon): After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 아직 약해서 물밑으로 몸을 숨기고 가라앉는 것을 먹으면서 얌전히 지낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매일 비슷한 페이스로 탈피를 반복하며 커진다. 방금 탈피한 피부는 부드럽다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It sheds its skin—almost on a daily basis—and grows larger. Its skin is soft just after it’s been shed.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 오랫동안 환상 속의 존재로 여겨졌지만 최근 누군가가 낚시에 성공하여 그 존재가 확인되었다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
Description (ko, sword): 폭포 아래와 같이 물살이 센 물가에서 살고 있다. 탈피를 반복하면서 크게 성장한다.
Description (en, sword): Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.
Description (ko, shield): 오랫동안 환상이라고 불렸다. 이마에 있는 작은 돌기는 성장하고 있는 뿔이다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

Description (en, emerald): A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
Description (en, firered): It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.
Description (en, leafgreen): A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. It is said to have the ability to change the weather.
Description (en, diamond): If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.
Description (ko, x): 수정 같은 구슬에는 날씨를 자유롭게 조종하는 능력이 담겨 있는 듯하다.
Description (ko, y): 오라에 싸여있는 신성한 생명체인 듯하다. 날씨를 바꾸는 힘을 가졌다고 한다.
Description (en, y): A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. It is said to have the ability to change the weather.

Description (ko, sun): 수정 같은 구슬에는 날씨를 조종하는 힘이 숨겨져 있다고 전해진다.
Description (en, sun): It has long been thought that its crystalline orbs are imbued with the power to control the weather.
Description (ko, moon): 날씨를 지배하는 존재로서 태고부터 농업에 종사하는 사람들에게 받들어져 왔다.
Description (en, moon): From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 날씨를 조종한다는 믿음 때문에 신뇽이 있는 호수에는 공물이 끊이지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 새해에 몸을 구부리며 하늘을 나는 모습을 보면 1년 동안 건강하다고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Some say that if you see it at the start of the year, flying through the sky and twisting its body, you’ll be healthy all year long.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 목격한 사람의 말에 의하면 몸에서 오라가 나와서 신비로웠다고 한다.
Description (ko, sword): 깨끗한 바다나 호수에 산다. 날씨를 조종하는 힘으로 바람을 타고 하늘로 오른다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.
Description (ko, shield): 꼬리의 구슬에 힘을 모아 날씨를 조종한다. 오라에 둘러싸인 모습은 신비롭다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

document.title: Dragonite — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dragonite
ID: 149
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 망나뇽
Name (en): Dragonite
Description (en, red): An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
Description (en, yellow): It is said that this POKéMON lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, it is only a rumor.
Description (en, gold): It is said that this POKéMON con­ stantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drown­ ing people.
Description (en, silver): This marine POKé­ MON has an impres­ sive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.
Description (en, crystal): It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.
Description (en, ruby): DRAGONITE is capable of circling the globe in just sixteen hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
Description (en, emerald): It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
Description (en, firered): It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.
Description (en, leafgreen): Only a very few people ever see this POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
Description (en, diamond): It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.
Description (en, heartgold): It is said that this Pokémon constantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drowning people.
Description (en, soulsilver): This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.
Description (ko, x): 커다란 몸집으로 하늘을 난다. 지구를 약 16시간 만에 일주한다.
Description (ko, y): 넓은 바다의 어딘가에 거처가 있다고 전해진다. 난파한 배를 육지까지 이끌어 준다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 16시간 만에 지구를 한 바퀴 돌 수 있다. 폭풍으로 난파 직전인 배를 발견하면 육지까지 유도하는 상냥한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dragonite is capable of circling the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
Description (ko, sun): 조난당한 남자가 도움을 받아 따라간 외딴섬은 망나뇽만의 낙원이었다.
Description (en, sun): This Pokémon saved a shipwrecked man, taking him to a remote island—a paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.
Description (ko, moon): 평소에는 극히 온화하지만 역린을 건드리면 모든 것을 부술 때까지 진정하지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it’s satisfied.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 성난 바다도 아랑곳하지 않고 날아간다. 그 모습을 본 선장은 바다의 화신이라고 불렀다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship’s captain dubbed this Pokémon “the sea incarnate.”
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 상냥한 포켓몬으로 바다에 빠진 인간이나 포켓몬을 구해 주었다는 이야기가 자주 들린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): You’ll often hear tales of this kindhearted Pokémon rescuing people or Pokémon that are drowning.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 넓은 바다 어딘가를 거처로 삼아 날아서 이동한다고 전해지지만 어디까지나 소문에 지나지 않는다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, these are only rumors.
Description (ko, sword): 물에 빠진 사람이나 포켓몬을 발견하면 반드시 도와주는 마음 착한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sword): It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.
Description (ko, shield): 바다의 화신이라고 불린다. 망나뇽 형태의 조각상을 뱃머리에 두는 배도 많다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 작열하는 불꽃으로 주변에 아지랑이를 만들어내서 모습을 숨길 수 있다. 불타오르며 폭발하는 바람은 모든 것을 태운다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

Name (en): Croconaw
Description (en, gold): If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
Description (en, silver): It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.
Description (en, crystal): The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.
Description (en, ruby): Once CROCONAW has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
Description (en, emerald): Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.
Description (en, diamond): Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
Description (ko, x): 이빨이 빠져도 계속해서 자란다. 항상 입안에는 48개의 이빨이 나 있다.
Description (ko, y): 한번 물면 이빨이 빠질 때까지 절대 놓지 않는다. 빠진 이빨은 바로 자라난다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 한 번 물고 늘어지면 절대로 놓지 않는다. 이빨 끝이 낚싯바늘처럼 휘어져 있어서 한 번 들어가면 빠지지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 꼬리선
Name (en): Sentret
Description (en, gold): A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
Description (en, silver): It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
Description (en, crystal): When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
Description (en, ruby): When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this POKéMON becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

Description (en, heartgold): A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

Description (ko, y): 먼 곳까지 볼 수 있도록 꼬리를 사용해서 선다. 상대를 발견하면 큰 소리로 동료에게 알린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 잠잘 때는 교대로 망을 본다. 위험을 탐지하면 동료를 깨운다. 무리에서 떨어지면 무서워서 자지 못한다.

document.body:

ID: 163

Name (ko): 부우부
Name (en): Hoothoot
Description (en, gold): It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
Description (en, silver): It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.
Description (en, crystal): It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.
Description (en, ruby): HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this POKéMON begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
Description (en, emerald): It has an internal organ that senses the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
Description (en, diamond): It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.
Description (en, pearl): It switches its standing foot so quickly, it can’t be seen. It cries at the same time every day.
Description (en, platinum): It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.
Description (ko, x): 체내의 시간 감각은 어느 때든 정확해서 규칙적인 리듬으로 목을 기울인다.
Description (ko, y): 항상 한 발로 서 있다. 발을 교체하는 순간이 빨라서 좀처럼 볼 수 없다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸 안에 지구의 자전을 감지해내는 기관을 지니고 있어서 매일 같은 시간이 되면 울음소리를 낸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Hoothoot has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this Pokémon begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 매일 정해진 리듬에 맞춰 목을 기울인다. 옛날 사람들은 시계 대용으로 길렀다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매일 정해진 시간에 운다. 옛날 사람들은 시간을 알리는 신의 사자라며 소중히 여겼다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It cries out at the same time every day. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.
Description (ko, shield): 언제나 정해진 시간이 되면 울음소리를 내어 시계 대용으로 데리고 다니는 트레이너도 있다.
Description (en, shield): It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

document.body:

Name (ko): 야부엉
Name (en): Noctowl
Description (en, gold): Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
Description (en, silver): When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 de­ grees to sharpen its intellectual power.
Description (en, crystal): Its extremely soft feathers make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.

Description (en, pearl): If it flips its head upside down, it’s a sign that it is engaged in very complex thinking.
Description (en, platinum): Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
Description (ko, x): 양쪽 눈이 특수한 구조다. 적은 양의 빛이라도 잘 모아 어둠 속에서도 주위를 분별한다.
Description (ko, y): 뭔가를 생각해내면 목을 180도 회전시켜 두뇌 회전을 높인다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 약간의 빛만으로도 볼 수 있는 우수한 눈과 날갯소리를 내지 않는 부드러운 깃털 덕분에 어둠 속에서 먹이를 절대 놓치지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Noctowl never fails at catching prey in darkness. This Pokémon owes its success to its superior vision that allows it to see in minimal light, and to its soft, supple wings that make no sound in flight.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 어둠 속에서도 뚜렷이 볼 수 있는 눈을 갖고 있어 먹이를 놓치지 않는다. 어둠의 제왕이라고도 불린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it “the emperor of dark nights.”
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 머리가 거꾸로 되었을 때는 매우 고민하고 있다는 증거다. 가만히 두지 않으면 쪼아 댄다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it turns its head entirely upside down, you know it’s troubled by something. If you don’t leave it be, it will peck you.
Description (ko, sword): 특수한 구조의 두 눈은 약간의 빛만 있으면 어둠 속에서도 낮처럼 볼 수 있다.
Description (ko, shield): 무언가를 생각하기 시작하면 목을 180도 회전시켜 두뇌 회전을 높인다.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸통과 다리의 연결 부위에서 나는 액체의 냄새로 동료와 커뮤니케이션을 취하고 있다. 냄새의 차이로 기분을 전한다고 한다.

Description (en, sun): They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.
Description (ko, moon): 냄새나는 체액으로 동료와 커뮤니케이션을 한다. 화가 났을 때의 냄새는 시큼하다.
Description (en, moon): They communicate with one another using bodily fluids that give off odors. When they’re angry, their odor smells sour.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 추위에 매우 약한 포켓몬. 온난한 알로라에서는 매우 생기가 넘치는 모습을 볼 수 있다.

Description (en, diamond): It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
Description (en, soulsilver): The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.
Description (ko, x): 밤하늘의 별이 깜빡일 때 반짝이는 가루를 흩뿌리며 훨훨 날아간다.
Description (ko, y): 등의 별 모양은 밤하늘의 별의 숫자에 반응하여 커졌다가 작아졌다가 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 별이 많이 보이는 공기가 깨끗한 장소에는 레디안이 많이 산다고 한다. 별빛을 에너지로 삼기 때문이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live Ledian in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this—the Pokémon uses the light of the stars as its energy.
Description (ko, sun): 별빛이 에너지라고 전해지지만 평범하게 나무열매도 매우 좋아한다. 낮에는 풀을 뒤집어쓰고 잔다.
Description (en, sun): While it’s believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.
Description (ko, moon): 4개의 팔로 펀치를 날리며 싸운다. 1발의 위력은 별로지만 횟수로 승부한다.
Description (en, moon): In battle, it throws punches with all four arms. The power of each individual blow is piddly, so it aims to win by quantity rather than quality.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 등의 모양은 밤하늘의 별과 연관이 있다고 전해지지만 자세한 것은 아직 알려지지 않았다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 반짝이는 가루를 흩뿌리며 밤하늘을 난다. 가루가 몸에 붙으면 좋은 일이 생긴다고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

document.title: Spinarak — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Spinarak
ID: 167
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 페이검
Name (en): Spinarak
Description (en, gold): It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
Description (en, silver): It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits pa­ tiently for prey to be trapped.
Description (en, crystal): If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.
Description (en, ruby): The web spun by SPINARAK can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this POKéMON can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
Description (en, emerald): The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.
Description (en, firered): It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
Description (en, diamond): It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
Description (en, soulsilver): It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
Description (ko, x): 가늘고 튼튼한 실을 뿜어 엮어서 덫을 만들고 먹이가 걸리기만을 기다린다.
Description (ko, y): 먹이가 근처를 지나갈 때까지 자신의 둥지에서 며칠이고 같은 모습으로 가만히 기다린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 실로 만든 함정은 제2의 신경이다. 실에 전해지는 약간의 진동만으로 먹이의 종류를 알 수 있다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The web spun by Spinarak can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this Pokémon can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
Description (ko, sun): 좋아하는 에블리가 둥지에 걸릴 때까지 무작정 기다린다. 정말 참을성 많은 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sun): It waits intently until its preferred prey, Cutiefly, gets caught in its web. In fact, it’s quite a patient Pokémon.
Description (ko, moon): 튼튼한 실을 꼬아서 물고기포켓몬을 잡는 그물을 만드는 어부도 있다.
Description (en, moon): Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 실을 내뿜어 만든 둥지는 제법 튼튼하다. 10kg의 바위를 올려도 끄떡없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): With threads from its mouth, it fashions sturdy webs that won’t break even if you set a rock on them.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 이빨의 독은 그다지 강하진 않지만 둥지에 걸려서 움직일 수 없는 먹이를 약하게 만들기에는 충분하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
