document.title: Ariados — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ariados
ID: 168
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아리아도스
Name (en): Ariados
Description (en, gold): It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
Description (en, silver): A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.
Description (en, crystal): Rather than mak­ ing a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls.
Description (en, ruby): ARIADOS’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This POKéMON constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
Description (en, emerald): Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
Description (en, diamond): It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
Description (en, heartgold): It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
Description (ko, x): 엉덩이뿐 아니라 입에서도 실을 내기 때문에 봐서는 어느 쪽이 머리인지 모른다.
Description (ko, y): 먹이의 몸에 실을 붙여 일부러 풀어준다. 실을 더듬어 가면 동료까지 잡을 수 있기 때문이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 발끝에는 작은 갈고리발톱이 있어서 천장이나 수직인 벽도 걸을 수 있다. 가늘고 튼튼한 실로 적을 조른다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Ariados’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This Pokémon constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
Description (ko, sun): 아리아도스의 실을 사용해 직물을 짜는 지역도 있다. 튼튼한 천으로 호평이다.
Description (en, sun): There are some areas where people use the string Ariados spins for their own weaving. The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.
Description (ko, moon): 엉덩이에서도 입에서도 실을 뿜는다. 실로 먹이를 휘감아 잡고 천천히 체액을 빨아들인다.
Description (en, moon): It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 밤마다 먹이를 찾아 떠돈다. 발견한 먹이에 실을 내뿜어 움직이지 못하게 하고 이빨로 갉아먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 실을 뿜어서 먹이를 잡는다. 밤이 되면 둥지를 떠나 적극적으로 사냥에 나선다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

document.title: Crobat — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Crobat
ID: 169
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 크로뱃
Name (en): Crobat
Description (en, gold): It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
Description (en, silver): The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.
Description (en, crystal): As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.
Description (en, ruby): If this POKéMON is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that CROBAT has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
Description (en, sapphire): CROBAT sneaks up on its intended prey using wings that barely make a sound. This POKéMON rests by hanging on a tree branch with its rear legs that serve as wings.
Description (en, emerald): Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
Description (en, leafgreen): It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
Description (en, diamond): Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
Description (en, pearl): A Pokémon that gained vastly enhanced flying performance by having its legs turn into wings.
Description (en, platinum): The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
Description (en, black-2): Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
Description (ko, x): 4장으로 수가 늘어난 날개로 어둠 속을 조용히 날아간다. 주위를 지나쳐도 눈치채지 못한다.
Description (ko, y): 4장으로 늘어난 날개를 사용하여 더욱 빠르고 조용하게 날아 먹이가 눈치채지 않게 살며시 다가간다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 팔이나 다리 어느 한쪽만으로 날갯짓할 때는 긴 거리를 날고 있다는 증거다. 지치면 날갯짓하는 날개를 바꾼다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): If this Pokémon is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that Crobat has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 귀를 기울이지 않으면 들리지 않을 정도로 작은 날갯소리로 노린 먹이에게 살며시 다가간다. 뒷다리의 날개로 가지를 붙잡고 쉰다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Crobat sneaks up on its intended prey using wings that barely make a sound. This Pokémon rests by hanging on a tree branch with its rear legs that serve as wings.
Description (ko, sun): 양발이 날개가 된 결과 지상에서 움직이는 것이 서툴다. 기어 돌아다니는 것밖에 못 한다.
Description (en, sun): Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can’t move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.
Description (ko, moon): 4장의 날개로 빠르고 조용하게 난다. 눈치채기 전에 먹이를 덥석 문다. 순식간에 피를 뽑아낸다.
Description (en, moon): Silent and swift in its four-winged flight, it bites down on its prey before they realize what’s happening. In a heartbeat, it drains their blood.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 이빨이 예리해서 어둠 속에서 물려 피를 빨려도 통증이 없기 때문에 금세 알아차리지 못한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won’t notice any pain or realize you’ve been bitten.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 사람이나 포켓몬의 피가 먹이다. 잠시만 피를 빨지 않아도 약해져서 날지 못하게 되어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.
Description (ko, sword): 양발이 날개로 변화했다. 소리를 내지 않고 고속으로 날아 먹이의 목덜미에 이빨을 꽂는다.
Description (en, sword): Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.
Description (ko, shield): 4장의 날개를 자유자재로 움직이며 날갯짓한다. 좁은 동굴에서도 속도를 늦추지 않고 날아다닐 수 있다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

document.title: Chinchou — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Chinchou
ID: 170
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 초라기
Name (en): Chinchou
Description (en, gold): It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
Description (en, silver): On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communi­ cation is its constantly flash­ ing lights.
Description (en, crystal): Its antennae, whi­ ch evolved from a fin, have both po­ sitive and neg­ ative charges flo­ wing through them.
Description (en, ruby): CHINCHOU lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This POKéMON flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
Description (en, sapphire): CHINCHOU’s two antennas are filled with cells that generate strong electricity. This POKéMON’s cells create so much electrical power, it even makes itself tingle slightly.
Description (en, emerald): When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight’s reach.
Description (en, firered): On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
Description (en, leafgreen): It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
Description (en, diamond): It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
Description (ko, x): 어두운 해저에서는 항상 깜빡거리고 있는 촉수의 빛만이 통신수단이다.
Description (ko, y): 2개의 촉수 끝에서 플러스와 마이너스의 전기를 흘려보내 상대를 마비시킨다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 2개의 촉수로 플러스와 마이너스 전기를 흘려 먹이를 기절시킨다. 전기의 빛은 동료와의 신호다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Chinchou lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This Pokémon flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 강한 전기를 발생시키는 세포가 2개의 촉수 안에 채워져 있다. 자신도 조금은 찌릿하고 마비된다고 한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Chinchou’s two antennas are filled with cells that generate strong electricity. This Pokémon’s cells create so much electrical power, it even makes itself tingle slightly.
Description (ko, sun): 2개의 촉수는 원래는 지느러미이다. 전기를 발산해서 먹이를 마비시킨 다음 덮친다.
Description (en, sun): Its two antennae were originally fins. It discharges electricity to stun its prey before attacking.
Description (ko, moon): 빛이 닿지 않는 해저에 산다. 촉수를 빛내 동료들과 커뮤니케이션을 한다.
Description (en, moon): It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 2개의 촉수가 어렴풋이 빛나 먹이를 불러들인다. 밤낚시에 편리한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 빛나는 촉수를 깜빡여서 초라기끼리 서로의 영역을 주장한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Chinchou blink their shining antennae at one another to claim their respective turf.
Description (ko, sword): 지느러미가 변해서 만들어진 촉수는 각각 플러스와 마이너스의 전기가 흐르고 있다.
Description (en, sword): Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.
Description (ko, shield): 어두운 해저에서는 항상 깜빡거리는 촉수의 빛이 유일한 통신 수단이다.

document.title: Lanturn — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lanturn
ID: 171
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 랜턴
Name (en): Lanturn
Description (en, gold): The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
Description (en, silver): It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
Description (en, crystal): This POKéMON uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.
Description (en, ruby): LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This POKéMON produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
Description (en, sapphire): LANTURN is known to emit light. If you peer down into the dark sea from a ship at night, you can sometimes see this POKéMON’s light rising from the depths where it swims. It gives the sea an appearance of a starlit night.
Description (en, emerald): The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.
Description (en, leafgreen): The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
Description (en, diamond): LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
Description (en, soulsilver): It blinds prey with an intense burst of light. With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon swallows it in a single gulp.
Description (en, black): Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
Description (ko, x): 심해를 헤엄치는 랜턴의 불빛은 수면까지 다다른다. 심해의 별이라고 불리고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 눈부신 빛을 발산하여 상대의 눈을 안 보이게 만들어 움직이지 못하는 동안에 통째로 삼켜버린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 심해의 별이라 불리는 포켓몬이다. 촉수 안의 박테리아와 체액을 화학 반응시켜서 빛을 만든다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Lanturn is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This Pokémon produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 밤중에 배에서 어두운 바다를 들여다보면 심해를 헤엄치는 랜턴의 빛이 별이 총총한 하늘처럼 보이는 일이 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Lanturn is known to emit light. If you peer down into the dark sea from a ship at night, you can sometimes see this Pokémon’s light rising from the depths where it swims. It gives the sea an appearance of a starlit night.
Description (ko, sun): 밤에 해면을 들여다보다 반짝이는 별 같은 빛이 보이면 그것은 랜턴이다.
Description (en, sun): Should you peer into the ocean at night and see a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.
Description (ko, moon): 강한 빛을 발산해 먹이의 눈을 멀게 한다. 허점이 생기면 전격을 먹인다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 촉수에 사는 박테리아가 랜턴의 체액을 빨아들일 때 강한 발광 현상이 일어난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn’s bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 바닷속 깊고 깊은 곳에 산다. 빛으로 먹이의 눈을 멀게 해서 풀이 죽은 틈을 타 통째로 삼킨다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It blinds its prey with light, using the moment they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.
Description (ko, sword): 랜턴이 내는 빛은 5000m의 깊이에서도 수면까지 전해질 정도로 밝다.
Description (ko, shield): 강한 빛을 발산해 먹이의 눈을 멀게 한다. 허점을 보이면 전격을 먹인다.

document.title: Pichu — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pichu
ID: 172
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 피츄
Name (en): Pichu
Description (en, gold): It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
Description (en, silver): Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
Description (en, crystal): It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.
Description (en, ruby): PICHU charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this POKéMON.
Description (en, sapphire): When PICHU plays with others, it may short out electricity with another PICHU, creating a shower of sparks. In that event, this POKéMON will begin crying, startled by the flash of sparks.
Description (en, emerald): It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
Description (en, diamond): The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
Description (en, pearl): It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.
Description (en, platinum): The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 미래를 내다보고 있지만 그것의 변화를 바라지 않아서 가만히 움직이지 않는다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): While it can see the future, it has no desire to change it, which is probably why it remains motionless at all times.
Description (ko, sword): 움직이거나 울음소리를 내지 않고 가만히 있는 것은 과거와 미래를 보고 있기 때문이라고 여겨진다.
Description (ko, shield): 과거와 미래를 내다볼 수 있다. 매일 태양의 움직임을 관찰하는 이상한 포켓몬이다.

Name (en): Mareep
Description (en, gold): If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
Description (en, silver): Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
Description (en, crystal): It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
Description (en, ruby): MAREEP’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail grows.
Description (en, emerald): Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
Description (en, leafgreen): If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
Description (en, diamond): Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
Description (en, black-2): When cold weather increases static electricity, its wool doubles in size and the tip of its tail glows slightly.
Description (ko, x): 푹신푹신한 털은 정전기가 쌓이면 2배로 부풀어 오른다. 만지면 감전되어 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 푹신푹신한 털은 공기를 가득 품고 있어 여름은 시원하고 겨울은 따뜻한 것이 특징이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 털의 마찰로 정전기가 모인다. 전력이 많이 모일수록 꼬리 끝에 붙은 전구가 밝게 빛난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Mareep’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 메리프의 털로 만든 의복은 정전기가 잘 일어나기 때문에 특수한 가공이 되어 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Clothing made from Mareep’s fleece is easily charged with static electricity, so a special process is used on it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 솜털이 마찰하여 전기가 모인다. 귀엽다고 맨손으로 만지면 따끔하게 저리고 아프다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

Name (en): Flaaffy
Description (en, gold): As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
Description (en, silver): Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
Description (en, crystal): Because of its rubbery, electric­ ity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electric­ ity in its fur.
Description (en, ruby): FLAAFFY’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
Description (en, emerald): Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
Description (en, leafgreen): As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.
Description (en, diamond): If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
Description (en, black-2): Not even downy wool will grow on its rubbery, nonconductive patches of skin that prevent electrical shock.
Description (ko, x): 푹신푹신한 털은 전기를 모으기 쉽지만 고무 같은 피부 덕분에 자신은 마비되지 않는다.
Description (ko, y): 털에 모아둔 전기가 다 채워지면 꼬리가 반짝인다. 접촉하면 마비되는 털을 날린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 털의 성질이 변화하기 때문에 적은 양으로도 많은 전기를 만들어낸다. 전기를 차단하는 반질반질한 피부를 가졌다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Flaaffy’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 털이 나지 않은 고무 같은 피부는 전기가 통하지 않아 만져도 안전하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 푹신푹신한 털에 전기를 저장한다. 너무 많이 저장해서 여기저기 반질반질하게 털이 빠져 버렸다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ampharos
ID: 181
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 전룡
Name (en): Ampharos
Description (en, gold): The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
Description (en, silver): The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.
Description (en, crystal): When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.
Description (en, ruby): AMPHAROS gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this POKéMON to send signals back and forth with others far away.
Description (en, emerald): It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
Description (en, leafgreen): The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
Description (en, diamond): The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
Description (en, black-2): The tip of its tail shines so brightly it can be used to send sea-navigation beacons to distant foreign shores.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리 끝이 빛나며 반짝인다. 빛이 아득히 먼 곳까지 닿아서 길 잃은 자들의 이정표가 된다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 전룡의 빛은 우주에서도 보인다. 옛날 사람은 전룡의 빛을 써서 멀리 있는 동료와 신호를 주고받았다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 꼬리의 빛은 우주까지 도달하여 어디에 있든 바로 알 수 있다. 그래서 평소에는 끄고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 꼬리는 강하고 밝게 빛난다. 뱃사람들의 길잡이로서 옛날부터 소중히 여겨져 왔다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

Name: Bellossom

Name (ko): 아르코
Name (en): Bellossom
Description (en, gold): BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
Description (en, silver): Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
Description (en, crystal): When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.
Description (en, ruby): When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This POKéMON’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.

Description (en, emerald): Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
Description (en, diamond): When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
Description (en, heartgold): BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
Description (ko, x): 가끔 아르코가 모여서 춤을 추는 듯한 동작을 보인다. 태양을 부르는 의식이라 전해진다.
Description (en, x): Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
Description (ko, y): 장마의 계절이 끝나면 따뜻한 햇살에 이끌려나온 아르코가 춤추기 시작한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 태양의 빛을 잔뜩 받으면 몸의 잎사귀가 빙글빙글 돌기 시작한다. 아르코의 춤은 남쪽 나라의 명물이다.

Description (ko, sword): 남국에 널리 분포하여 서식하고 있다. 춤출 때 꽃잎끼리 서로 부딪혀서 기분 좋은 소리가 울려 퍼진다.
Description (ko, shield): 가끔 아르코가 모여서 춤을 추는 듯한 동작을 한다. 태양을 부르는 의식이라 전해진다.

Name (en): Marill
Description (en, gold): The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
Description (en, silver): The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.
Description (en, crystal): The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
Description (en, ruby): MARILL’s oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water’s surface, it’s a sure indication that this POKéMON is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
Description (en, sapphire): When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, MARILL wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This POKéMON’s tail is flexible and configured to stretch.
Description (en, emerald): Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water’s resistance.
Description (en, leafgreen): The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.
Description (en, diamond): Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.
Description (en, pearl): The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.
Description (en, platinum): The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.
Description (en, black): The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.
Description (en, black-2): The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.
Description (ko, x): 전신의 털은 물을 튕겨내는 성질을 지녀 물을 끼얹어도 말라 있다.
Description (ko, y): 꼬리의 끝에는 물보다 가벼운 기름이 가득 차 있어서 부낭 대신 쓸 수 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 기름이 가득한 꼬리는 튜브 대용이다. 수면에 꼬리만 떠 있을 때는 잠수하여 물풀을 먹고 있다는 표시다.

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 흐름이 빠른 강에서 먹이를 잡을 때는 꼬리를 강가의 나무줄기에 휘감는다. 꼬리는 탄력이 있어서 늘어나는 구조다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, Marill wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This Pokémon’s tail is flexible and configured to stretch.
Description (ko, sword): 둥근 꼬리는 튜브 대용이다. 그 안에는 영양으로 가득 찬 기름이 들어 있다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.
Description (ko, shield): 물을 잘 튕겨내는 털은 차가운 바다에 있다가 나와도 금방 말라서 춥지 않다.
Description (en, shield): Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 공기로 풍선을 만들 수 있다. 포켓몬이 물에 빠져 있으면 공기 방울을 만들어내 호흡을 할 수 있게 해준다.

Description (en, silver): It disguises it­ self as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

Description (en, emerald): It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
Description (en, firered): It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
Description (en, leafgreen): Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
Description (en, diamond): Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
Description (en, pearl): It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.
Description (en, platinum): To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
Description (en, heartgold): Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
Description (ko, x): 항상 나무인 척하고 있다. 몸의 구조는 식물보다 돌이나 바위에 가까운 듯하다.
Description (ko, y): 습격당하지 않도록 나무 흉내를 낸다. 물에 약하기 때문에 비가 내리면 어느 순간에 모습을 감춰버린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 적에게 습격당하지 않으려 나무인 척한다. 양손이 일 년 내내 초록빛이라 겨울에는 가짜임이 바로 들통 난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Sudowoodo camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because its hands remain green throughout the year, the Pokémon is easily identified as a fake during the winter.
Description (ko, sun): 공격을 당하지 않기 위해 나무인 척 하지만 싫어하는 물을 뒤집어쓰면 당황해서 도망가버린다.
Description (en, sun): To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.
Description (ko, moon): 노인을 중심으로 인기다. 초록색 부분이 클수록 마니아의 평가가 높아지는 듯하다.
Description (en, moon): Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It’s a particular favorite among elderly people.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 노인에게 인기로 전문지가 있을 정도다. 애호가는 팔의 길이와 각도에 신경 쓴다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s so popular with the elderly that there’s a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 유연하면서도 강인한 팔은 같은 포즈를 계속해서 취하는 동안 단련된 덕분에 얻을 수 있었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The result of its holding the same pose all the time is arms that have become supple yet strong.
Description (ko, sword): 바람도 불지 않는데 흔들리는 나무를 발견했다면 그게 바로 꼬지모다. 비가 오는 날에는 모습을 감춘다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
Description (ko, shield): 습격당하지 않도록 나무 흉내를 낸다. 물에 약하기 때문에 비가 내리면 어느 틈에 모습을 감춰버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

document.body:

Name (ko): 왕구리
Name (en): Politoed
Description (en, gold): If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
Description (en, silver): Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
Description (en, crystal): When it expands its throat to croak out a tune, nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.
Description (en, ruby): The curled hair on POLITOED’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this POKéMON earns from its peers.
Description (en, emerald): The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
Description (en, leafgreen): If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
Description (en, diamond): It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
Description (en, black): It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
Description (ko, x): 3마리 이상 왕구리가 모이면 반드시 고함치는 듯한 울음소리로 합창하기 시작한다.
Description (ko, y): 울음소리가 울려 퍼지면 여기저기에서 발챙이와 슈륙챙이들이 모인다.
Description (en, y): If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 머리의 말린 머리칼은 왕의 징표이다. 길고 아름답게 말린 왕구리일수록 동료에게 존경받는다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The curled hair on Politoed’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.
Description (ko, sun): 달밤에 모여 대합창을 한다. 그 울음소리는 고함치는 것 같아 아름답지는 않지만 멋이 있다.
Description (en, sun): They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.
Description (ko, moon): 발챙이와 슈륙챙이의 리더. 왕구리가 크게 꾸짖으면 모두 겁을 먹고 그 자리에 엎드린다.
Description (en, moon): It’s the leader of Poliwag and Poliwhirl. When Politoed roars, they all cower in fear.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 고함치는 듯한 울음소리임에도 어느 작곡가는 영향을 받아 아름다운 발라드를 만들었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although its cries sound like screams, a composer created a beautiful ballad that was influenced by the sounds.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 둥글게 말린 머리칼이 길고 훌륭한 왕구리일수록 많은 발챙이나 슈륙챙이가 따르고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and Poliwhirl that will obey it.
Description (ko, sword): 밤이 되면 연못 근처에 나타난다. 고함치는 듯한 울음소리로 영역을 알린다.
Description (en, sword): At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.
Description (ko, shield): 수컷의 울음소리가 더 크다. 나지막하고 위협적인 목소리로 우는 왕구리가 암컷에게 인기다.
Description (en, shield): The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

document.body:

ID: 196
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에브이
Name (en): Espeon
Description (en, gold): It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.
Description (en, silver): By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weath­ er or its foe's next move.
Description (en, crystal): The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.
Description (en, ruby): ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said that this POKéMON developed its precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
Description (en, emerald): An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
Description (en, firered): By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.
Description (en, leafgreen): It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.
Description (en, diamond): Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.
Description (en, platinum): Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
Description (en, black-2): Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather...and its foes’ thoughts.
Description (ko, x): 상대의 움직임을 예지할 때 두 갈래로 갈라져 있는 꼬리의 끝이 미세하게 떨리고 있다.
Description (en, x): The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.
Description (ko, y): 전신의 세밀한 털로 공기의 흐름을 알아차려 상대의 생각이나 날씨를 예측한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 인정한 트레이너에게는 극히 충실하다. 트레이너를 위험에서 지키기 위해 예지능력이 발달했다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.
Description (ko, sun): 가늘고 짧은 털로 공기의 흐름부터 상대의 행동까지 순식간에 읽어버린다.
Description (en, sun): It can instantaneously sense its opponent’s movements by feeling air currents with its fine fur.
Description (ko, moon): 이마의 구슬에서 사이코 파워를 방사해서 싸운다. 파워가 다하면 구슬의 색이 흐려진다.
Description (en, moon): It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 원래는 아무런 능력도 없었지만 몸을 지키기 위해 예지 능력에 눈뜨게 됐다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it originally had no powers at all, people say its precognitive faculties were awakened by its need to protect itself.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 햇빛을 받으면 이마의 구슬에 사이코 파워가 모인다. 밤에 하는 싸움에 약하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Psychic power builds up in the orb on its forehead as it bathes in the sunshine. Espeon is not good at battling at night.
Description (ko, sword): 공기의 흐름을 읽어내서 앞으로의 날씨와 상대의 움직임 등을 모두 맞혀버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

Description (en, heartgold): When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
Description (en, black-2): When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it’s filled with a mysterious power.
Description (ko, x): 달빛이 이브이의 유전자를 변화시켰다. 어둠에 숨어 먹이를 기다린다.
Description (en, x): The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
Description (ko, y): 달의 파동을 쬐면 전신의 고리 모양이 빛나며 이상한 힘이 넘친다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 달의 파동을 받아 진화한 포켓몬이다. 어둠 속에 가만히 숨어 상대를 살핀다. 습격할 때 몸의 둥근 무늬가 빛난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon’s waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
Description (ko, sun): 화가 나면 전신의 모공으로부터 독소가 섞인 땀을 뿜어내어 상대의 눈을 노린다.
Description (en, sun): When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.
Description (ko, moon): 어둠에 녹아드는 검은 털. 가만히 먹이의 틈을 살피며 숨통을 노리고 덤벼든다.
Description (en, moon): With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its throat, and then eats it.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 야행성 포켓몬. 큰 눈동자는 칠흑 같은 어둠에서도 먹이의 모습을 정확하게 찾아낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon is nocturnal. Even in total darkness, its large eyes can spot its prey clearly!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 어둠 속에 숨어 먹이를 노린다. 습격하는 순간 몸의 둥근 무늬가 희미하고 이상하게 빛난다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It lurks in the dark of night looking for prey. At the moment it pounces, the rings on its body glow dimly but ominously.
Description (ko, shield): 보름달이 뜬 밤이나 흥분했을 때 전신의 고리 무늬가 노랗게 빛난다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

document.body:

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 니로우
Name (en): Murkrow
Description (en, gold): Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
Description (en, silver): It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.
Description (en, crystal): It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.
Description (en, ruby): MURKROW was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This POKéMON shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
Description (en, emerald): MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.
Description (en, diamond): It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.
Description (en, pearl): It appears near travelers to lure them into deep forests. It is said to carry misfortune.
Description (en, platinum): If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
Description (en, black-2): If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
Description (ko, x): 반짝이는 물건을 주워 비밀 장소에 숨겨 둔다. 나옹과 자주 쟁탈전을 벌인다.
Description (en, x): It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another’s stashes.
Description (ko, y): 밤에 모습을 발견하면 불길한 일이 생긴다고 여겨져 몹시 미움받는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 불행을 가져온다고 하여 두려움의 대상이었다. 반짝반짝 빛나는 것에 흥미를 보이며 여성의 반지를 가져가려 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
Description (ko, sun): 해가 지면 일어나 저녁 하늘을 난다. 니로우가 날기 전에 집에 돌아가라는 속담도 있다.
Description (en, sun): They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, “Get home before the Murkrow fly.”
Description (ko, moon): 불길의 상징으로 미움받지만 사이 좋은 트레이너에게는 반짝반짝 빛나는 물건을 선물한다.
Description (en, moon): Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it’s generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it’s close to.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 반짝이는 것을 매우 좋아한다. 보물을 찾아 보석을 모으는 한바이트 둥지에 몰래 들어가기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It has a weakness for shiny things. It’s been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 보스를 위해 반짝반짝 빛나는 것을 찾고 있다. 불길한 존재로 여겨 몹시 싫어하는 사람도 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow’s presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Slowking
ID: 199
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 야도킹
Name (en): Slowking
Description (en, gold): It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
Description (en, silver): When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.
Description (en, crystal): Every time it ya­ wns, SHELLDER injects more poi­ son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.
Description (en, ruby): SLOWKING undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this POKéMON apparently forgets everything it has learned if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
Description (en, emerald): It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
Description (en, firered): When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.
Description (en, leafgreen): It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
Description (en, diamond): Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
Description (en, black): Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
Description (ko, x): 대단한 지성과 번뜩이는 재치를 가지고 있다. 어떤 때라도 당황하거나 소란 피우지 않고 느긋하게 있다.
Description (ko, y): 물렸을 때 머리에 깊게 스며든 독소에 의해 심상치 않은 능력에 눈을 뜬 야돈이다.
Description (en, y): When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 세계의 불가사의를 밝혀내기 위해 매일 연구하고 있지만 머리에 있는 셀러가 벗겨지면 전부 잊어버리는 것 같다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.
Description (ko, sun): 물린 독소의 영향으로 천재적인 두뇌를 가지게 되었다. 사이코 파워를 자유자재로 다룬다.
Description (en, sun): A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
Description (ko, moon): 갈피를 못 잡을 때는 야도킹에게 물어보라는 속담이 남아있는 지역도 있을 정도로 똑똑한 것으로 유명하다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: “When in doubt, ask Slowking.”
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머릿속으로는 항상 세계를 바꿀 정도의 아이디어가 넘쳐 흐르지만 번뜩이는 순간 잊어버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s constantly coming up with new ideas that would change the world, but as soon as it hits upon a new idea, it forgets it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 바다의 현자라고 불린다. 하랑우탄과 지혜를 겨루지만 결과는 대체로 무승부다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s called “the sage of the sea.” It engages in battles of wits with Oranguru, but the result is usually a draw.
Description (ko, sword): 셀러의 독소가 야돈의 뇌를 돌아다니면서 숨겨진 지능을 기적적으로 각성시켰다.
Description (en, sword): Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.
Description (ko, shield): 아무리 어려운 문제를 물어봐도 모두 해결해주지만 그 누구도 야도킹의 말을 이해하지 못한다.
Description (en, shield): Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

Description (en, firered): When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.
Description (en, leafgreen): It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
Description (en, diamond): Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
Description (en, black): Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

Description (ko, y): 물렸을 때 머리에 깊게 스며든 독소에 의해 심상치 않은 능력에 눈을 뜬 야돈이다.
Description (en, y): When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.
Description (ko, sun): 물린 독소의 영향으로 천재적인 두뇌를 가지게 되었다. 사이코 파워를 자유자재로 다룬다.
Description (en, sun): A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
Description (ko, moon): 갈피를 못 잡을 때는 야도킹에게 물어보라는 속담이 남아있는 지역도 있을 정도로 똑똑한 것으로 유명하다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: “When in doubt, ask Slowking.”
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머릿속으로는 항상 세계를 바꿀 정도의 아이디어가 넘쳐 흐르지만 번뜩이는 순간 잊어버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s constantly coming up with new ideas that would change the world, but as soon as it hits upon a new idea, it forgets it.

Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s called “the sage of the sea.” It engages in battles of wits with Oranguru, but the result is usually a draw.
Description (ko, sword): 셀러의 독소가 야돈의 뇌를 돌아다니면서 숨겨진 지능을 기적적으로 각성시켰다.
Description (en, sword): Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.
Description (ko, shield): 아무리 어려운 문제를 물어봐도 모두 해결해주지만 그 누구도 야도킹의 말을 이해하지 못한다.

document.body:

Description (en, gold): It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

Description (en, crystal): It loves to watch people it's scar­ ed. It frightens them by screaming loudly or appear­ ing suddenly.

Description (en, platinum): A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
Description (en, heartgold): It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
Description (ko, x): 무서워하는 마음을 빨간 구슬로 흡수해 영양분으로 만든다. 낮에는 어두운 곳에서 잠자고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 밤중에 사람이 울부짖는 울음소리를 내어 모두를 놀라게 하는 장난꾸러기다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 흐느껴 우는 듯한 울음소리로 겁을 준다. 상대의 두려워하는 마음을 빨간 구슬로 흡수하여 영양분으로 삼는 것 같다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.

Description (en, sun): It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.
Description (ko, moon): 아무도 없는 방에서 흐느껴 우는 듯한 소리가 들린다면 그것은 무우마의 장난임에 틀림없다.
Description (en, moon): If you hear a sobbing sound emanating from a vacant room, it’s undoubtedly a bit of mischief from Misdreavus.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 놀라게 하는 것이 삶의 낙이다. 목의 빨간 구슬에 귀를 대면 안에서 비명이 들려온다.

Description (en, ultra-moon): What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn’t deal well with folks who aren’t easily frightened.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 드릴 꼬리를 사용해서 뒤쪽을 향해 땅을 파고 들어가 복잡한 형태의 둥지를 땅속 깊이 만드는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 지면을 파고 다니며 이동한다. 디그다와 서로의 터널을 사이좋게 같이 사용하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another’s tunnels happily.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 사람의 모습을 보면 꼬리로 구멍을 파서 도망가 버린다. 만났다면 운이 좋은 것이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.
Description (ko, sword): 작은 날개를 갖고 있어서 먼 옛날에는 하늘을 날았다고 주장하는 학자도 있다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.
Description (ko, shield): 미로 같은 굴에 산다. 흙냄새로 자신이 있는 곳을 알 수 있어 절대 길을 잃지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

document.title: Gligar — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gligar
ID: 207
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 글라이거
Name (en): Gligar
Description (en, gold): It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
Description (en, silver): It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
Description (en, crystal): It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.
Description (en, ruby): GLIGAR glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This POKéMON hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
Description (en, emerald): It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.
Description (en, leafgreen): It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
Description (en, diamond): It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey’s face.
Description (en, platinum): It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
Description (en, black-2): It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it’s stunned with surprise.
Description (ko, x): 보통은 벼랑에 붙어 있다. 먹이를 발견하면 날개를 펼쳐 바람을 타고 날아 덮친다.
Description (ko, y): 얼굴을 겨냥하고 날아와 들러붙어 먹이가 놀라는 사이에 독침을 찌른다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 소리 내지 않고 미끄러지듯 활공한다. 양손의 커다란 손톱과 발의 발톱으로 먹이의 얼굴에 달라붙어 독침을 찌른다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

document.title: Steelix — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Steelix
ID: 208
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 강철톤
Name (en): Steelix
Description (en, gold): Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
Description (en, silver): It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
Description (en, crystal): The many small metal particles that cover this POKéMON's body reflect bright light well.
Description (en, ruby): STEELIX lives even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig towards the earth’s core. There are records of this POKéMON reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
Description (en, emerald): STEELIX live even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig toward the earth’s core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than diamond.
Description (en, diamond): Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
Description (en, pearl): It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.
Description (en, platinum): It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
Description (en, soulsilver): It’s said that if an ONIX lives for 100 years, its composition becomes diamondlike as it evolves into a STEELIX.
Description (en, black-2): The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.
Description (ko, x): 땅속의 높은 압력과 열로 단련된 몸은 어떠한 금속보다도 단단하다.
Description (ko, y): 튼튼한 턱으로 암석을 깨물어 부수고 나아간다. 아주 캄캄한 땅속 에서도 보이는 눈을 가지고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 롱스톤보다 깊은 땅속에 살고 있다. 지구의 중심을 향해 파고들어 가서 깊이가 1km에 달하기도 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Steelix lives even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth’s core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
Description (ko, sword): 롱스톤이 100년 이상 살면 몸의 성분이 다이아몬드처럼 변한다고 전해진다.
Description (en, sword): It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
Description (ko, shield): 흙과 함께 삼킨 강철이 축적되어 몸이 변화한 것이라 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

document.title: Snubbull — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Snubbull
ID: 209
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 블루
Name (en): Snubbull
Description (en, gold): Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
Description (en, silver): It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its af­ fectionate ways.
Description (en, crystal): In truth, it is a cowardly POKéMON. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.
Description (en, ruby): By baring its fangs and making a scary face, SNUBBULL sends smaller POKéMON scurrying away in terror. However, this POKéMON seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
Description (en, emerald): By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.
Description (en, firered): It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
Description (en, diamond): Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
Description (ko, x): 활발하고 노는 것을 좋아하는 성격. 잘 따르기 때문에 함께 놀고 싶어 하는 여성들이 많다.
Description (ko, y): 작은 포켓몬이 도망칠 정도의 무서운 얼굴이 반대로 귀엽다며 여성에게 인기가 있는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 이빨을 드러내고 무서운 얼굴을 하면 작은 포켓몬은 겁을 먹고 도망친다. 남겨진 블루는 조금 외로워 보인다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): By baring its fangs and making a scary face, Snubbull sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
Description (ko, sun): 얼굴은 우락부락하지만 사실은 꽤 겁쟁이다. 필사적으로 위협하는 표정이 여성들에게 인기 있다.
Description (en, sun): Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.
Description (ko, moon): 으르렁거리는 소리는 상대를 불안하게 만든다. 평소에는 느긋한 성격으로 하루의 절반은 자고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 금방 따르고 금방 응석을 부린다. 하는 행동과 생김새의 격차 때문에 젊은 여성은 헤롱헤롱하는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 겉보기와 다르게 겁쟁이라 다른 강아지포켓몬과 함께 있으면 괴롭힘을 당할 때도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

document.title: Granbull — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Granbull
ID: 210
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 그랑블루
Name (en): Granbull
Description (en, gold): It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
Description (en, silver): Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.
Description (en, crystal): It can make most any POKéMON run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
Description (en, ruby): GRANBULL has a particularly well- developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the POKéMON to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.
Description (en, emerald): It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.
Description (en, leafgreen): It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
Description (en, diamond): It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
Description (en, soulsilver): Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.
Description (ko, x): 얼굴에 어울리지 않게 겁이 많다. 그러나 한번 화내기 시작하면 큰 이빨로 반격한다.
Description (ko, y): 커다란 입을 벌리고 두꺼운 송곳니를 드러내면 대부분의 포켓몬이 도망친다.
Description (en, y): It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 아래턱이 매우 발달한 포켓몬이다. 이빨이 무거워서 목을 기울이고 있다. 놀라게 하지 않으면 무턱대고 물지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Granbull has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the Pokémon to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.
Description (ko, sun): 발달한 아래턱과 묵직한 이빨이 무기다. 화나게 하지 않는 한 웬만해서는 물거나 하지 않는다.
Description (en, sun): Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked, it rarely bites.
Description (ko, moon): 블루 이상으로 겁쟁이다. 겉모습과의 차이가 인기를 얻어 젊은 여성에게 인기가 높다.
Description (en, moon): More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 턱의 힘은 강력하지만 다툼을 좋아하지 않아 그다지 싸우는 걸 볼 기회가 많지 않다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 젊은 여성에게 인기가 많지만 겁쟁이인데다가 섬세하기 때문에 지킴이로는 무능하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Qwilfish — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Qwilfish
ID: 211
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 침바루
Name (en): Qwilfish
Description (en, gold): To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
Description (en, silver): The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They in­ ject a toxin that causes fainting.
Description (en, crystal): When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.
Description (en, ruby): QWILFISH sucks in water, inflating itself. This POKéMON uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
Description (en, emerald): A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.
Description (en, firered): The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
Description (en, diamond): It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
Description (ko, x): 전신의 독침을 날리기 위해 10리터의 물을 단번에 마시고 몸을 부풀린다.
Description (ko, y): 전신의 작은 바늘은 비늘이 변화한 것이다. 찔리면 독 때문에 정신을 잃게 된다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 들이마신 물의 힘을 이용하여 전신의 독침을 일제히 쏘아댄다. 헤엄치는 것이 조금 서툰 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
Description (ko, sword): 상대가 크면 클수록 몸이 터지기 직전까지 물을 들이마셔서 몸을 부풀린다.
Description (en, sword): When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent’s size.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Scizor
ID: 212
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 핫삼
Name (en): Scizor
Description (en, gold): It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
Description (en, silver): Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.
Description (en, crystal): This POKéMON's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.
Description (en, ruby): SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This POKéMON flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
Description (en, emerald): A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
Description (en, leafgreen): It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
Description (en, diamond): It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.
Description (en, platinum): It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
Description (ko, x): 강철이 함유된 집게로 잡은 것은 아무리 딱딱해도 산산조각이 난다.
Description (en, x): This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets ahold of into bits.
Description (ko, y): 강철의 몸을 가지고 있다. 눈알 무늬가 붙은 집게를 치켜들어 상대를 위협한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강철의 강도를 지닌 몸은 어지간한 공격으로는 꿈쩍도 하지 않는다. 날갯짓으로 체온을 조절한다.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Heracross
ID: 214
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 헤라크로스
Name (en): Heracross
Description (en, gold): This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
Description (en, silver): Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.
Description (en, crystal): With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou­ nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.
Description (en, ruby): HERACROSS charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This POKéMON even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
Description (en, sapphire): HERACROSS has sharp claws on its feet. These are planted firmly into the ground or the bark of a tree, giving the POKéMON a secure and solid footing to forcefully fling away foes with its proud horn.
Description (en, emerald): They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.
Description (en, leafgreen): This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
Description (en, diamond): It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.
Description (en, pearl): With powerful legs and claws, it generates enough power to hurl foes over great distances.
Description (en, platinum): It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
Description (en, heartgold): This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
Description (en, soulsilver): It is usually docile, but if it is disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.
Description (en, black-2): No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.
Description (ko, x): 자랑스러운 뿔을 상대의 배 밑에 틀어박고 단번에 들어 올려 집어 던지는 천하장사다.
Description (ko, y): 엄청난 괴력의 소유자. 자신 체중의 100배나 되는 무게도 가뿐히 내던진다.
Description (en, y): With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 똑바로 적에게 돌격하여 강인한 뿔로 들어 올려 내던진다. 큰 나무도 뿌리째 뽑아 쓰러트릴 만한 파워다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 손발의 날카로운 손발톱이 땅이나 나무에 깊숙이 박히기 때문에 자랑스런 뿔로 상대를 내던질 때 단단히 버틸 수 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Heracross has sharp claws on its feet. These are planted firmly into the ground or the bark of a tree, giving the Pokémon a secure and solid footing to forcefully fling away foes with its proud horn.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 두꺼운 뿔이 자랑거리다. 알로라에서는 투구뿌논이 최대 라이벌로 자주 싸움을 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it’s always fighting with.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 달콤한꿀을 찾아 숲속을 돌아다닌다. 괴력을 자랑하지만 나는 것은 그리 잘하지 못한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it’s not that good at flying.
Description (ko, sword): 달콤한 수액을 매우 좋아한다. 2개의 더듬이로 냄새를 따라 숲을 찾아다닌다.
Description (en, sword): Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.
Description (ko, shield): 자신 몸무게의 100배에 달하는 무게도 거뜬히 들어 올리는 괴력을 자랑하는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon takes pride in its strength, which allows it to lift things 100 times heavier than itself with no trouble at all.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

Name: Sneasel
ID: 215
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 포푸니
Name (en): Sneasel
Description (en, gold): Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
Description (en, silver): Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.
Description (en, crystal): This cunning POKéMON hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.
Description (en, ruby): SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This POKéMON seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
Description (en, emerald): A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
Description (en, diamond): It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
Description (en, pearl): It is extremely vicious and will not stop attacking until its foe is incapable of moving.
Description (en, platinum): A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
Description (en, soulsilver): Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.
Description (en, black-2): A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.
Description (ko, x): 거처에서 알을 가로채어 먹어 버린다. 날카로운 갈고리 손톱이 상대의 급소를 베어 가른다.
Description (ko, y): 예리한 손톱을 손가락 안에 감추고 있다. 갑자기 뻗어서 습격해온 상대를 풀죽게 만든다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 손발의 갈고리 손발톱을 꽂아 나무를 오른다. 부모가 없는 틈을 노려 나무 위에 있는 둥지에서 알을 훔쳐 먹는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
Description (ko, sun): 교활하고 사나운 성질을 가졌다. 부모가 없는 틈에 둥지에 침입해서 알을 훔쳐낸다.
Description (en, sun): It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
Description (ko, moon): 손톱으로 알에 구멍을 뚫어서 내용물을 마신다. 브리더에게 미움을 받아 제거될 때도 있다.

Description (en, ultra-sun): They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 어둠 속에 숨어 먹이를 노린다. 모래두지를 노리고 손톱을 세우지만 피부가 단단해서 부러지는 경우도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It blends into the dark of night to ambush its prey. Sneasel will attack Sandshrew, but its hard skin can cause Sneasel’s claws to snap off.
Description (ko, shield): 교활하고 사나운 성질을 가졌다. 부모가 없는 틈에 둥지로 침입해서 알을 훔친다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

Description (ko, sword): 머리에 난 가지는 부러져도 다시 자란다. 예쁜 것은 순산을 기원하는 부적으로 쓰인다.

Description (en, shield): These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 산호 가지는 태양의 빛을 받으면 일곱 빛깔로 반짝반짝 빛이 나 정말 아름답다. 부러져도 하룻밤이면 원래대로 자라난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Corsola’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 따뜻한 바다에 모인 코산호는 작은 포켓몬들의 은신처가 된다. 수온이 낮아지면 남쪽으로 이동한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Clusters of Corsola congregate in warm seas where they serve as ideal hiding places for smaller Pokémon. When the water temperature falls, this Pokémon migrates to the southern seas.
Description (ko, sun): 산호 가지가 머리에 자란다. 꽤 간단히 부러지지만 사흘 정도면 원래대로 돌아온다.
Description (en, sun): Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.
Description (ko, moon): 머리의 가지를 노리고 시마사리가 쫓아오면 자신의 가지를 뚝 부러뜨리고 도망친다.
Description (en, moon): Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 알로라에 사는 코산호는 핑크가 매우 선명하고 짙다. 영양이 풍부한 바다 덕분이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The pink of Corsola that live in Alola is deep and vibrant, thanks to seas filled with nutrition.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 천적인 시마사리가 잔뜩 있는 알로라에서는 머리의 가지가 짧은 코산호가 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): In Alola, where their natural enemies Mareanie are plentiful, many Corsola have stubby branches on their heads.
Description (ko, sword): 머리에 난 가지는 부러져도 다시 자란다. 예쁜 것은 순산을 기원하는 부적으로 쓰인다.
Description (en, sword): It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.
Description (ko, shield): 따뜻한 바다에 서식한다. 태고에는 가라르 근해에서도 많은 수가 서식했었다.
Description (en, shield): These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

document.title: Remoraid — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Remoraid
ID: 223
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 총어
Name (en): Remoraid
Description (en, gold): It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
Description (en, silver): Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE's under­ side to scavenge for leftovers.
Description (en, crystal): To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.
Description (en, ruby): REMORAID sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this POKéMON travels downstream from rivers.
Description (en, emerald): A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.
Description (en, firered): Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
Description (en, leafgreen): It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 100 yards.
Description (en, diamond): It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.
Description (en, pearl): It clings to MANTINE to feed on the big Pokémon’s scraps. This is an adaptation to avoid foes.
Description (en, platinum): It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.
Description (en, heartgold): It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
Description (en, black): It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.
Description (en, black-2): The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
Description (ko, x): 조준이 정확하다. 뿜어낸 물은 100m 앞에서 움직이는 먹이를 반드시 명중시킨다.
Description (ko, y): 빨판처럼 변화한 등지느러미로 만타인에게 달라붙어 먹다 남은 것을 얻어먹고 있다.
Description (en, y): Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 복근을 이용하여 마신 물을 힘차게 뿜어내서 하늘을 나는 먹이를 잡는다. 진화가 가까워지면 강을 따라 내려간다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Remoraid sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this Pokémon travels downstream from rivers.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 만타인에 달라붙어 남긴 음식을 먹고 산다. 만타인이 습격당하면 함께 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon clings to Mantine and shares in its prosperity. When its Mantine is attacked, Remoraid will fight alongside it!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 일명 바다의 스나이퍼다. 물대포는 100m 앞의 먹이도 반드시 명중시킨다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Also known as the “sniper of the seas,” its water gun can hit prey without fail from over 300 feet away.
Description (ko, sword): 입에서 뿜어내는 수류는 100m 앞에서 움직이는 사냥감조차 명중시킨다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

document.title: Octillery — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Octillery
ID: 224
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 대포무노
Name (en): Octillery
Description (en, gold): It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
Description (en, silver): It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fel­ low OCTILLERY.
Description (en, crystal): Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.
Description (en, ruby): OCTILLERY grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This POKéMON tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, OCTILLERY spews ink to escape.
Description (en, emerald): It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.
Description (en, firered): It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.
Description (en, leafgreen): It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
Description (en, diamond): It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.
Description (en, pearl): It obscures its foe’s vision by spitting a cloud of murky ink. It makes its nest among boulders.
Description (en, platinum): It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
Description (en, heartgold): It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
Description (en, black-2): It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
Description (ko, x): 구멍에 들어가고 싶어 하는 성질로 바위굴이나 항아리를 좋아해 거기서 먹물을 뿜어내 공격한다.
Description (ko, y): 튼튼한 돌머리다. 빨판이 붙어 있는 다리를 휘감아 한결같이 머리로 세게 때린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 흡반이 달린 팔로 상대를 휘감는다. 움직이지 못하게 되면 쓰러트린다. 버거울 때는 먹물을 뿜고 도망간다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Octillery grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This Pokémon tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, Octillery spews ink to escape.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 도망칠 때 내뿜는 먹물은 특별하다. 후각을 둔하게 하는 성분으로 후각이 발달한 포켓몬도 말려든다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The ink it spits when escaping is special. It contains a substance that dulls the sense of smell, so Pokémon with keen noses get lost.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 바위굴이 주된 잠자리다. 대포무노가 뱉는 새까만 먹물은 요리 재료로도 쓰인다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It usually sleeps in caves. The pitch-black ink that Octillery spits is also used for cooking.
Description (ko, sword): 구멍에 들어가고 싶어하는 성질이 있어 다른 포켓몬이 만든 굴을 빼앗고 그곳에서 잠을 잔다.
Description (ko, shield): 머리가 돌처럼 단단하다. 빨판이 붙어 있는 다리를 휘감아 끊임없이 머리로 세게 때린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

document.body:
