Name: Delibird
ID: 225
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 딜리버드
Name (en): Delibird
Description (en, gold): It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
Description (en, silver): It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its await­ ing chicks.
Description (en, crystal): It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
Description (en, ruby): DELIBIRD carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of Mt. Everest thanks to one of these POKéMON sharing its food.
Description (en, emerald): It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.
Description (en, firered): It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.
Description (en, diamond): It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
Description (en, heartgold): It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by its stored food.
Description (en, black-2): It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리로 먹이를 싸서 운반한다. 산에서 조난당한 사람에게 먹이를 나눠주는 습성이 있다.
Description (ko, y): 온종일 먹이를 나른다. 산에서 조난당한 사람이 있으면 먹이를 나눠 도와주고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 꼬리로 먹이를 둘러싸서 나르는 포켓몬이다. 딜리버드가 나눠준 먹이 덕분에 에베레스트 산을 등정한 모험가가 있었다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Delibird carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of the world’s highest mountain, thanks to one of these Pokémon sharing its food.
Description (ko, sun): 원래 추운 토지를 좋아하지만 알로라의 딜리버드는 어느 정도의 더위도 견딜 수 있는 것 같다.
Description (en, sun): Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.
Description (ko, moon): 자신의 먹이를 사람이나 포켓몬에게 나눠주는 습성이 있어 언제나 먹이를 찾아다니고 있다.
Description (en, moon): It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 조난 당한 사람에게 자신의 먹이를 나눠준다. 잡식이어서 벌레포켓몬을 건네주기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It shares its food with people who are stranded. Because Delibird is omnivorous, sometimes it gives those people bug Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 꼬리로 먹이를 둘러싸서 운반한다. 가장 큰 꼬리를 가진 딜리버드가 무리의 보스다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It wraps food in its tail to carry it around. The Delibird with the biggest tail is the boss of the flock!
Description (ko, sword): 온종일 먹이를 운반한다. 조난당한 사람이 딜리버드의 먹이로 살아났다는 이야기도 있다.
Description (ko, shield): 자신의 먹이를 사람이나 포켓몬에게 나눠주는 습성이 있어 언제나 먹이를 찾아다닌다.

Name (ko): 만타인
Name (en): Mantine
Description (en, gold): As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
Description (en, silver): Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.
Description (en, crystal): It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.
Description (en, ruby): On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This POKéMON is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
Description (en, emerald): On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
Description (en, leafgreen): As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.
Description (en, diamond): When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of MANTINE swimming as if they are in flight.
Description (en, pearl): It swims elegantly, mindless of REMORAID hitching on to its broad fins. It has a docile nature.
Description (en, platinum): While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores REMORAID that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
Description (en, heartgold): As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
Description (en, black): While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
Description (en, black-2): If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.
Description (ko, x): 헤엄쳐서 스피드가 빨라지면 파도 위에 뛰어올라 그대로 100m나 활공한다.
Description (ko, y): 유연하게 바다를 헤엄칠 때 먹다 남은 음식을 노린 총어가 지느러미에 달라붙지만 신경 안 쓴다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 맑은 날에는 바다 위를 우아하게 뛰어오르는 만타인 무리를 볼 수 있다. 총어가 들러붙어 있어도 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This Pokémon is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 우아하게 파도 위를 튀어 오르는 만타인을 그린 그림엽서나 포스터는 인기 있는 알로라 특산품이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Postcards and posters featuring Mantine leaping elegantly above the waves are popular souvenirs of Alola.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 화려하게 헤엄치는 만타인을 동경하여 서핑을 시작했다는 사람도 많이 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Many people have taken up surfing because they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.
Description (ko, sword): 헤엄쳐서 스피드가 빨라지면 파도 위로 뛰어올라 그대로 100m나 활공한다.
Description (en, sword): If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
Description (ko, shield): 여유롭게 바다를 헤엄친다. 먹다 남은 음식을 노린 총어가 달라붙어 있어도 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

document.title: Skarmory — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Skarmory
ID: 227
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 무장조
Name (en): Skarmory
Description (en, gold): Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
Description (en, silver): After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
Description (en, crystal): The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said that people once used the feathers as swords.
Description (en, ruby): SKARMORY is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This POKéMON flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
Description (en, sapphire): SKARMORY’s steel wings become tattered and bashed in from repeated battles. Once a year, the battered wings grow back completely, restoring the cutting edges to their pristine state.
Description (en, emerald): A POKéMON that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and knives.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its sturdy wings look heavy, but its bones are hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
Description (en, diamond): Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
Description (en, black-2): Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.
Description (ko, x): 가시나무 안에 둥지를 만든다. 가시에 상처를 입어가며 자라난 새끼들의 날개는 단단해진다.
Description (ko, y): 철 같은 단단한 갑옷으로 덮여 있다. 시속 300km의 스피드로 넓은 하늘을 날아다닌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 전신이 단단한 갑옷으로 둘러싸여 있다. 시속 300km의 스피드로 하늘을 날아 칼날 같은 날카로운 날개로 베어낸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Skarmory is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 싸움을 반복하여 너덜너덜해진 강철의 날개는 1년에 1회 다시 돋아나 원래의 날카로움을 되찾는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Skarmory’s steel wings become tattered and bashed in from repeated battles. Once a year, the battered wings grow back completely, restoring the cutting edges to their pristine state.
Description (ko, sun): 성장할 때마다 빠지는 날개는 얇고 날카롭다. 옛 전사들은 칼로 이용했다.
Description (en, sun): Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.
Description (ko, moon): 철로 된 몸은 튼튼하지만 녹슬기 쉬워서 비가 내리는 날엔 둥지에서 가만히 있다.
Description (en, moon): Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빠진 날개를 가공해서 만드는 식칼은 일류 요리사도 인정할 정도로 날카롭다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The wing feathers it sheds can be processed and made into knives whose sharpness is recognized by the finest chefs.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강철의 갑옷을 몸에 걸친다. 무거워 보이지만 최고 300km의 속도로 날 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!
Description (ko, sword): 날카로운 날개는 검보다 예리하다. 영역을 두고 아머까오와 격렬하게 싸운다.
Description (en, sword): The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.
Description (ko, shield): 빠진 깃털로 검을 만들 수 있어서 문장 도안으로 인기가 많다.
Description (en, shield): People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

Description (en, leafgreen): Its sturdy wings look heavy, but its bones are hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
Description (en, diamond): Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
Description (en, black-2): Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.
Description (ko, x): 가시나무 안에 둥지를 만든다. 가시에 상처를 입어가며 자라난 새끼들의 날개는 단단해진다.
Description (ko, y): 철 같은 단단한 갑옷으로 덮여 있다. 시속 300km의 스피드로 넓은 하늘을 날아다닌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 전신이 단단한 갑옷으로 둘러싸여 있다. 시속 300km의 스피드로 하늘을 날아 칼날 같은 날카로운 날개로 베어낸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Skarmory is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 싸움을 반복하여 너덜너덜해진 강철의 날개는 1년에 1회 다시 돋아나 원래의 날카로움을 되찾는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Skarmory’s steel wings become tattered and bashed in from repeated battles. Once a year, the battered wings grow back completely, restoring the cutting edges to their pristine state.
Description (ko, sun): 성장할 때마다 빠지는 날개는 얇고 날카롭다. 옛 전사들은 칼로 이용했다.
Description (en, sun): Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.
Description (ko, moon): 철로 된 몸은 튼튼하지만 녹슬기 쉬워서 비가 내리는 날엔 둥지에서 가만히 있다.
Description (en, moon): Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빠진 날개를 가공해서 만드는 식칼은 일류 요리사도 인정할 정도로 날카롭다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The wing feathers it sheds can be processed and made into knives whose sharpness is recognized by the finest chefs.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강철의 갑옷을 몸에 걸친다. 무거워 보이지만 최고 300km의 속도로 날 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!
Description (ko, sword): 날카로운 날개는 검보다 예리하다. 영역을 두고 아머까오와 격렬하게 싸운다.
Description (en, sword): The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.
Description (ko, shield): 빠진 깃털로 검을 만들 수 있어서 문장 도안으로 인기가 많다.
Description (en, shield): People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

document.body:

ID: 228

Name (en): Houndour

Description (en, silver): To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.
Description (en, crystal): Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

Description (en, emerald): HOUNDOUR communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This POKéMON’s remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.
Description (en, firered): To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.
Description (en, leafgreen): It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing prey.
Description (en, diamond): It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.
Description (en, platinum): It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
Description (ko, x): 새벽녘에 주변 일대에 울려 퍼지는 기분 나쁜 울음소리로 자신들의 영역을 어필한다.
Description (ko, y): 동료끼리만 서로 알 수 있는 울음소리로 서로의 위치를 확인해가며 먹이를 몰아붙인다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 여러 가지 울음소리를 사용하여 동료와 연락을 주고받아 먹이를 몰아간다. 팀워크는 포켓몬 중 제일이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon’s remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 동료와의 연계가 특기다. 파트너가되면 트레이너의 명령에 매우 충실하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It cooperates with others skillfully. When it becomes your partner, it’s very loyal to you as its Trainer and will obey your orders.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 동이 트기 전에 기분 나쁜 울음을 반복하여 자신들 무리의 존재를 어필한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

document.title: Houndoom — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Houndoom
ID: 229
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 헬가
Name (en): Houndoom
Description (en, gold): If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
Description (en, silver): Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.
Description (en, crystal): The pungent- smelling flame that shoots from its mouth results from toxins burn­ ing in its body.
Description (en, ruby): In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply towards the back serves a leadership role. These POKéMON choose their leader by fighting amongst themselves.
Description (en, emerald): In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
Description (en, diamond): Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.
Description (en, platinum): The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
Description (en, soulsilver): Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.
Description (ko, x): 헬가가 으스스하게 멀리서 짖으면 지옥에서 사신이 부르는 소리라고 옛날 사람들은 상상하고 있었다.
Description (ko, y): 화가 났을 때 입에서 뿜어내는 불꽃에는 독소도 섞여 있기에 화상을 입으면 계속 욱신거린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 머리의 뿔이 크게 뒤로 꺾여 있는 헬가가 그룹의 리더 격인 존재다. 동료 간에 경쟁하여 리더가 결정된다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokémon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 독소가 섞인 불꽃을 불어 상대를 처리한다. 먹이는 무리가 공평에게 나눈다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They spew flames mixed with poison to finish off their opponents. They divvy up their prey evenly among the members of their pack.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 기분 나쁜 울음소리가 특징이다. 옛날 사람들은 지옥에서 온 사자라고 여겨 두려워했다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

document.body:

Name: Kingdra
ID: 230
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 킹드라
Name (en): Kingdra
Description (en, gold): It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
Description (en, silver): It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.
Description (en, crystal): It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.
Description (en, ruby): KINGDRA lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this POKéMON creates spiraling ocean currents.
Description (en, sapphire): KINGDRA sleeps on the seafloor where it is otherwise devoid of life. When a storm arrives, the POKéMON is said to awaken and wander about in search of prey.
Description (en, emerald): It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.
Description (en, diamond): It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
Description (ko, x): 평소에는 해저동굴에 몸을 숨기고 있는 것 같다. 하품으로 소용돌이를 발생시킨다.
Description (ko, y): 어떤 생물도 접근할 수 없는 깊은 해저에서 자면서 힘을 비축하고 있다고 한다.
Description (en, y): It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 생물이 살지 않는 심해에 서식한다. 킹드라의 하품이 해류의 소용돌이를 일으킨다고 오랫동안 믿어져 왔다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Kingdra lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this Pokémon creates spiraling ocean currents.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 생물이 살지 않는 해저에서 자고 있다. 태풍이 오면 눈을 뜨고 먹이를 찾으러 돌아다닌다고 전해진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Kingdra sleeps on the seafloor where it is otherwise devoid of life. When a storm arrives, the Pokémon is said to awaken and wander about in search of prey.
Description (ko, sword): 폭풍우가 휘몰아치면 해수면에 모습을 드러낸다. 망나뇽과 맞닥뜨리면 격렬한 싸움이 시작된다.
Description (en, sword): With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.
Description (ko, shield): 떨어진 비늘은 왕족에게 헌상될 정도의 최상품으로 심오한 빛을 띤다.
Description (en, shield): Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

Description (en, emerald): PHANPY’s big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.
Description (en, firered): As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
Description (en, leafgreen): It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, this can be dangerous.
Description (en, diamond): It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
Description (en, heartgold): It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.
Description (ko, x): 애정 표현으로 코를 부딪쳐 오지만 힘이 있기 때문에 조심하지 않으면 날아가 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 몸은 작지만 힘이 장사다. 어른인 사람을 가볍게 등에 태우고 걸어 다닌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강 근처에 수직으로 구멍을 파고 산다. 사는 곳 가까이에 코의 표시를 남겨 자신의 장소라고 동료에게 알리고 있다.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

Description (en, silver): The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 단단한 몸으로 부딪치면 집도 부서진다. 그 힘을 이용해 산길을 막고 있는 토사를 치우는 일을 돕는다.

Name (en): Porygon2
Description (en, gold): This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
Description (en, silver): Further research enhanced its abil­ ities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.
Description (en, crystal): This manmade POKéMON evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprog­ rammed reactions.
Description (en, ruby): PORYGON2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made POKéMON has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
Description (en, emerald): It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
Description (en, firered): Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.
Description (en, leafgreen): This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. However, it can’t even fly.
Description (en, diamond): With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.
Description (en, platinum): It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.
Description (en, heartgold): This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.
Description (ko, x): 더욱 연구가 진행되어 능력이 올라갔다. 가끔 프로그램에 없는 행동을 보인다.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 인간이 과학의 힘으로 만들어냈다. 인공 지능을 지니고 있어서 새로운 동작이나 감정을 혼자서 익혀간다.

Description (ko, sun): 행성 개발을 시야에 넣어 당시의 최신 기술로 폴리곤을 업데이트했다.
Description (en, sun): For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.
Description (ko, moon): 행성 개발을 목표로 폴리곤을 버전 업 했지만 아직 꿈에 도달하지 못했다.
Description (en, moon): Porygon was updated to a new version in readiness for planetary development. But that dream remains unrealized as yet.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): AI를 탑재했다. 자력으로 다양한 것을 습득하지만 필요 없는 것까지 배운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn’t need to know.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 우주 공간에서도 죽지 않지만 무중력 상태에서는 제대로 몸을 가누지 못한다.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 산과 들을 뛰어다니며 하반신을 단련한다. 스피드와 파워를 겸비한 다리는 1초에 10번 킥을 날린다.

document.title: Mudkip — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mudkip
ID: 258
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 물짱이
Name (en): Mudkip
Description (en, ruby): The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
Description (en, sapphire): In water, MUDKIP breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this POKéMON will unleash its amazing power - it can crush rocks bigger than itself.
Description (en, emerald): On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water’s edge.
Description (en, firered): Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
Description (en, diamond): To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
Description (en, heartgold): Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.
Description (ko, x): 커다란 꼬리지느러미로 물을 헤치면 스피드가 쑥쑥 오른다. 작은 몸이지만 힘이 장사다.
Description (ko, y): 머리의 지느러미로 물의 흐름을 느껴 주위의 상황을 파악한다. 바위를 들어 올릴 정도로 힘이 세다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 머리의 지느러미는 매우 민감한 레이더다. 물이나 공기의 움직임을 통해 눈을 쓰지 않고 주변의 상황을 알아낼 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The fin on Mudkip’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 물속에서는 뺨의 아가미로 호흡한다. 위급해지면 몸보다 큰 바위를 산산이 부숴버리는 파워를 발휘한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

document.title: Marshtomp — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Marshtomp
ID: 259
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 늪짱이
Name (en): Marshtomp
Description (en, ruby): The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
Description (en, sapphire): MARSHTOMP is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This POKéMON’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
Description (en, emerald): Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.
Description (en, firered): It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
Description (en, diamond): Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
Description (en, heartgold): Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
Description (ko, x): 발밑이 질퍽거려도 잘 걸을 수 있는 튼튼한 다리를 가졌다. 진흙에 몸을 묻고 잠잔다.
Description (ko, y): 걸쭉하게 질퍽거리는 땅을 밟으며 생활하면서 단련되어 팔다리가 강인해졌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 지상에서도 생활할 수 있도록 몸의 표면을 얇은 점막이 둘러싸고 있다. 썰물이 된 해안에서 흙놀이를 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The surface of Marshtomp’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 물속을 헤엄치는 것보다 진흙 속에서 이동하는 편이 훨씬 빠르게 이동할 수 있다. 하반신이 발달하여 두 다리로 걷는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Swampert
ID: 260
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 대짱이
Name (en): Swampert
Description (en, ruby): SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
Description (en, sapphire): SWAMPERT predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
Description (en, emerald): If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.
Description (en, firered): Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
Description (en, diamond): It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
Description (en, heartgold): Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
Description (ko, x): 돌처럼 딱딱한 팔을 한 번 휘두르는 것만으로 거대한 돌을 조각조각으로 부순다.
Description (ko, y): 큰 배를 끌며 헤엄치는 파워의 소유자이다. 굵은 팔을 한 번 휘둘러 상대를 때려눕힌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 무게 1톤 이상인 바위 덩어리를 가볍게 잡아당기는 파워를 지닌 포켓몬이다. 탁해진 물속도 들여다볼 수 있는 시력을 지녔다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 대짱이는 파도 소리나 바닷바람의 아주 작은 차이를 지느러미로 감지하여 태풍을 예감한다. 태풍이 불면 바위를 쌓아서 둥지를 지킨다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

document.body:

Name: Poochyena
ID: 261
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 포챠나
Name (en): Poochyena
Description (en, ruby): At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
Description (en, sapphire): POOCHYENA is an omnivore - it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This POKéMON tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.
Description (en, emerald): It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.
Description (en, firered): It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
Description (en, heartgold): It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.
Description (ko, x): 집요한 성격의 포켓몬이다. 점찍은 먹이가 기진맥진 지칠 때까지 뒤쫓아간다.
Description (ko, y): 날카로운 후각으로 노린 먹이는 절대로 놓치지 않는다. 매우 끈질긴 성격이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 움직이는 것을 발견하면 바로 문다. 먹이가 기진맥진해질 때까지 쫓아다니지만 반격당하면 뒷걸음치기도 한다.

Name (en): Mightyena

Description (en, sapphire): MIGHTYENA travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the POKéMON to obey only those TRAINERS that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

document.title: Zigzagoon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:

Name: Zigzagoon
ID: 263

Description (en, sapphire): The hair on ZIGZAGOON’s back is bristly. It rubs the hard back hair against trees to leave its territorial markings. This POKéMON may play dead to fool foes in battle.
Description (en, emerald): Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

Description (en, heartgold): It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.

Description (en, shield): Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

document.title: Zigzagoon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Zigzagoon
ID: 263
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 지그제구리
Name (en): Zigzagoon
Description (en, ruby): ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
Description (en, sapphire): The hair on ZIGZAGOON’s back is bristly. It rubs the hard back hair against trees to leave its territorial markings. This POKéMON may play dead to fool foes in battle.
Description (en, emerald): Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.
Description (en, firered): A POKéMON with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
Description (en, diamond): It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
Description (en, heartgold): It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.
Description (ko, x): 지그재그로 걸어서 풀숲이나 땅에 묻혀 있는 보물을 찾아내는 것이 특기인 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, x): It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
Description (ko, y): 호기심이 왕성한 포켓몬. 무엇이든지 흥미를 가지므로 항상 지그재그로 걷고 있다.
Description (en, y): A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 항상 이쪽저쪽 지그재그로 걷는 것은 호기심이 매우 강해서 눈에 비친 여러 가지 것들에 흥미를 느끼기 때문이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 등의 뻣뻣한 털을 나무에 문질러서 자신의 영역이란 표시를 해둔다. 죽은 척하며 적의 눈을 속인다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): The hair on Zigzagoon’s back is bristly. It rubs the hard back hair against trees to leave its territorial markings. This Pokémon may play dead to fool foes in battle.
Description (ko, sword): 뻣뻣한 털을 나무에 문질러서 영역을 표시한다. 가라르의 지그제구리보다 온순하다.
Description (en, sword): It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.
Description (ko, shield): 가라르의 지그제구리가 다른 지역에 적응한 모습이다. 물건을 찾는 게 특기다.
Description (en, shield): Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

document.title: Linoone — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Linoone
ID: 264
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 직구리
Name (en): Linoone
Description (en, ruby): LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
Description (en, sapphire): When hunting, LINOONE will make a beeline straight for the prey at a full run. While this POKéMON is capable of topping 60 mph, it has to come to a screeching halt before it can turn.
Description (en, emerald): It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.
Description (en, firered): When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.
Description (en, diamond): It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
Description (en, heartgold): When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
Description (ko, x): 똑바로 달리는 스피드는 시속 100km를 가볍게 넘는다. 휘어진 길은 매우 서툴다.
Description (ko, y): 시속 100km로 먹이를 덮치지만 똑바로밖에 달릴 수 없어서 실패할 때도 많다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 똑바로 힘껏 달리며 장애물이 있을 때는 직각으로 꺾어서 피한다. 완만하게 굽은 길은 달리는 데 매우 서툴다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 먹이를 쫓아 일직선으로 질주한다. 시속 100km를 넘는 스피드를 내지만 한 번 급정지하지 않으면 꺾을 수 없다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When hunting, Linoone will make a beeline straight for the prey at a full run. While this Pokémon is capable of topping 60 mph, it has to come to a screeching halt before it can turn.
Description (ko, sword): 강하고 탄력 있는 털을 가졌다. 빠진 털로 만든 면도솔은 최고의 명품이다.
Description (en, sword): Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.
Description (ko, shield): 뛰어난 순발력과 예리한 발톱으로 먹이의 숨통을 끊는다. 굽은 길을 달리는 게 서툴다.
Description (en, shield): It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

document.title: Wurmple — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Wurmple
ID: 265
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 개무소
Name (en): Wurmple
Description (en, ruby): Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
Description (en, sapphire): WURMPLE is targeted by SWELLOW as prey. This POKéMON will try to resist by pointing the spikes on its rear at the attacking predator. It will weaken the foe by leaking poison from the spikes.
Description (en, emerald): It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.
Description (en, firered): It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.
Description (en, diamond): It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
Description (en, pearl): It spits a white silk that turns sticky when it contacts air. It is used to immobilize foes.
Description (en, platinum): Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
Description (en, heartgold): It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.
Description (ko, x): 잎사귀를 매우 좋아한다. 찌르꼬에게 습격당했을 때는 엉덩이의 가시로 물리친다.
Description (en, x): It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
Description (ko, y): 숲과 수풀에 서식한다. 적에게 습격당했을 때는 엉덩이의 독가시로 대항한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 엉덩이의 가시로 나무의 껍질을 벗기고 배어 나온 수액을 식량으로 삼는다. 흡반이 달린 다리는 유리에서도 미끄러지지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 먹이로 삼으려고 다가온 스왈로에게 엉덩이의 가시를 들이밀고 저항한다. 배어 나온 독으로 상대를 약하게 만든다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Wurmple is targeted by Swellow as prey. This Pokémon will try to resist by pointing the spikes on its rear at the attacking predator. It will weaken the foe by leaking poison from the spikes.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

document.title: Silcoon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Silcoon
ID: 266
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 실쿤
Name (en): Silcoon
Description (en, ruby): SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
Description (en, sapphire): SILCOON was thought to endure hunger and not consume anything before its evolution. However, it is now thought that this POKéMON slakes its thirst by drinking rainwater that collects on its silk.
Description (en, emerald): It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.
Description (en, firered): It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.
Description (en, diamond): It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
Description (en, pearl): It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.
Description (en, platinum): It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
Description (en, heartgold): Having wrapped silk around the branches of a tree, it quiescently awaits evolution.
Description (ko, x): 실을 나뭇가지에 휘감고 있다. 실에 묻은 빗물을 마시며 진화할 때를 기다리고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 실에 묻은 아침 이슬을 마시고 진화할 때를 기다린다. 단단한 고치가 공격을 막는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 떨어지지 않도록 실을 가지에 휘감아서 몸을 지탱하며 진화를 기다리고 있다. 작은 구멍을 통해 밖의 상황을 살핀다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 진화할 때까지 아무것도 먹지 않고 참는 것으로 여겨져 왔으나 아무래도 실에 맺힌 빗방울로 갈증을 푸는 것 같다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Silcoon was thought to endure hunger and not consume anything before its evolution. However, it is now thought that this Pokémon slakes its thirst by drinking rainwater that collects on its silk.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

document.title: Beautifly — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Beautifly
ID: 267
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 뷰티플라이
Name (en): Beautifly
Description (en, ruby): BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
Description (en, sapphire): BEAUTIFLY has a long mouth like a coiled needle, which is very convenient for collecting pollen from flowers. This POKéMON rides the spring winds as it flits around gathering pollen.
Description (en, emerald): Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.
Description (en, firered): Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.
Description (en, diamond): It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
Description (en, pearl): When flower fields bloom, it flits around, collecting pollen. Despite its appearance, it is savage.
Description (en, platinum): Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
Description (en, heartgold): Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
Description (ko, x): 색이 선명한 날개의 무늬가 특징이다. 가는 입을 뻗어 꽃의 달콤한 꿀을 흡수한다.
Description (ko, y): 가늘고 긴 입을 깊이 찔러 상대의 체액을 흡수한다. 공격적인 성격이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 달콤한 꽃가루를 매우 좋아하는 포켓몬이다. 꽃이 핀 화분을 창가에 두면 꽃가루를 모으려고 반드시 날아온다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Beautifly’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 둥글게 말린 바늘같이 생긴 긴 입은 꽃가루를 모을 때 매우 편리하다. 봄바람을 타고 꽃가루를 모으러 돌아다닌다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Beautifly has a long mouth like a coiled needle, which is very convenient for collecting pollen from flowers. This Pokémon rides the spring winds as it flits around gathering pollen.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

document.title: Cascoon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cascoon
ID: 268
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 카스쿤
Name (en): Cascoon
Description (en, ruby): CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
Description (en, sapphire): If it is attacked, CASCOON remains motionless however badly it may be hurt. It does so because if it were to move, its body would be weak upon evolution. This POKéMON will also not forget the pain it endured.
Description (en, emerald): To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.
Description (en, firered): Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
Description (en, diamond): It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
Description (en, pearl): Encased within its tough cocoon, it endures attacks. It never forgets the appearance of its foes.
Description (en, platinum): It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
Description (en, heartgold): It endures attacks with patience, because the more pain before evolution, the sturdier it becomes.
Description (ko, x): 부드러운 실로 된 몸은 시간이 지나면서 단단해진다. 진화가 임박하면 갈라지기 시작한다.
Description (ko, y): 고치에 들어가 있는 사이에 받은 공격은 진화해도 잊지 않고 반드시 앙갚음한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 카스쿤의 몸은 입에서 나온 가는 실이 몸을 둘러싸 딱딱해진 것이다. 고치 안에서 진화의 준비를 하고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 움직이면 튼튼한 몸으로 진화할 수 없어서 아무리 괴롭혀도 가만히 있는다. 그때 느낀 아픔을 계속 잊지 않는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): If it is attacked, Cascoon remains motionless however badly it may be hurt. It does so because if it were to move, its body would be weak upon evolution. This Pokémon will also not forget the pain it endured.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

document.title: Dustox — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dustox
ID: 269
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 독케일
Name (en): Dustox
Description (en, ruby): DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
Description (en, sapphire): When DUSTOX flaps its wings, a fine dust is scattered all over. This dust is actually a powerful poison that will even make a pro wrestler sick. This POKéMON searches for food using its antennae like radar.
Description (en, emerald): It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.
Description (en, firered): It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.
Description (en, diamond): A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
Description (en, pearl): It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.
Description (en, platinum): Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
Description (en, heartgold): It scatters its fine dust all over when it is attacked. It is a nocturnal Pokémon.
Description (ko, x): 야행성 포켓몬이다. 불빛에 이끌려나온 독케일이 가로수의 잎을 헤적거리며 먹어댄다.
Description (ko, y): 습격당하면 격하게 날개를 쳐서 맹독 가루를 흩뿌린다. 날이 저물면 행동을 시작한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 불빛에 이끌리는 습성을 지녔다. 거리의 불빛에 유인된 독케일 무리가 가로수의 잎을 어지르며 먹어버린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 날갯짓하면 미세한 가루가 날린다. 들이마시면 프로레슬러도 잠드는 맹독이다. 더듬이의 레이더로 먹이를 찾는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When Dustox flaps its wings, a fine dust is scattered all over. This dust is actually a powerful poison that will even make a pro wrestler sick. This Pokémon searches for food using its antennae like radar.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

document.title: Lotad — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lotad
ID: 270
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 연꽃몬
Name (en): Lotad
Description (en, ruby): LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
Description (en, sapphire): LOTAD is said to have dwelled on land before. However, this POKéMON is thought to have returned to water because the leaf on its head grew large and heavy. It now lives by floating atop the water.
Description (en, emerald): This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.
Description (en, firered): It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

Description (ko, sun): 뼈는 무게를 줄이기 위해 비어 있다. 큰 날개로 바람을 타고 넓은 하늘로 날아오른다.

Description (ko, moon): 갈모매가 어지럽게 나는 바다 아래에는 물고기포켓몬이 무리 지어 있으므로 어부들은 우선 갈모매부터 찾는다.
Description (en, moon): Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they’re circling, the ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 가늘고 긴 날개다. 상승 기류를 타고 글라이더처럼 넓은 하늘로 높이 떠오른다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): With its long, thin wings, it catches updrafts and flies like a glider high up into the sky.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 바닷가 절벽에 둥지를 짓는다. 가장 좋아하는 약어리를 찾아 바다 위를 선회하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It builds nests in cliffs by the sea. It circles the skies above the ocean looking for its favorite food—Wishiwashi.
Description (ko, sword): 깎아지른 절벽에 둥지를 만들고 바닷바람을 이용하여 넓은 하늘 위로 올라 활공한다.
Description (ko, shield): 공기의 흐름을 이용하여 날갯짓하지 않고 하늘로 날아오른다. 해변의 절벽에 둥지를 만든다.

document.title: Pelipper — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pelipper
ID: 279
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 패리퍼
Name (en): Pelipper
Description (en, ruby): PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
Description (en, sapphire): PELIPPER searches for food while in flight by skimming the wave tops. This POKéMON dips its large bill in the sea to scoop up food, then swallows everything in one big gulp.
Description (en, emerald): It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
Description (en, firered): It is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.
Description (en, diamond): It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
Description (en, pearl): It acts as a delivery service by carrying small Pokémon in its bill. It bobs on the waves to rest.
Description (en, platinum): It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
Description (en, heartgold): It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.
Description (en, black-2): Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
Description (ko, x): 큰 부리를 바다에 넣고 먹이를 한 번에 많이 건져 올리려는 속셈이다.
Description (ko, y): 입속에 작은 포켓몬이나 알을 넣고 안전한 장소로 전해주는 하늘의 운반자.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 작은 포켓몬이나 알을 부리에 넣고 나르는 하늘의 운반자다. 바닷가의 험한 절벽에 둥지를 만든다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 해수면을 스칠 듯이 날며 먹이를 찾는다. 큰 부리를 바닷속에 넣고 먹이를 퍼 올려 한입에 먹는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Pelipper searches for food while in flight by skimming the wave tops. This Pokémon dips its large bill in the sea to scoop up food, then swallows everything in one big gulp.
Description (ko, sun): 크게 부풀어 오른 부리는 유치원생 정도의 어린아이라면 쏙 들어갈 수 있는 크기이다.
Description (en, sun): Its spacious beak is large enough for a small child to fit right inside.
Description (ko, moon): 먹이를 모으는 일은 젊은 수컷의 일이다. 커다란 부리에 먹이를 저장해서 동료가 기다리는 둥지까지 운반한다.
Description (en, moon): Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 부풀린 부리 안에 작은 포켓몬을 넣어 운반한다. 어디로 데려가는지는 알 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It places small Pokémon into its spacious beak and carries them around. No one knows where it’s taking them.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 커다란 부리로 약어리를 건져 올려 통째로 삼킨다. 한 번에 30마리 이상 먹어 치운다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It scoops up Wishiwashi in its huge beak and swallows them whole. It can devour more than 30 at one go!
Description (ko, sword): 입속에 작은 포켓몬이나 알을 넣고 안전한 장소로 운반해주는 하늘의 배달꾼.
Description (ko, shield): 해면 아주 가까이 날아 큰 부리로 해수와 함께 먹이를 건져 나른다.

document.title: Ralts — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ralts
ID: 280
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 랄토스
Name (en): Ralts
Description (en, ruby): RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
Description (en, sapphire): RALTS has the ability to sense the emotions of people. If its TRAINER is in a cheerful mood, this POKéMON grows cheerful and joyous in the same way.
Description (en, emerald): A RALTS has the power to sense the emotions of people and POKéMON with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
Description (en, firered): It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses hostility.
Description (en, diamond): It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
Description (en, platinum): If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
Description (en, heartgold): The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.
Description (ko, x): 빨간 뿔로 사람이나 포켓몬의 따뜻한 마음을 캐치하면 전신이 미약하게 뜨거워진다.
Description (ko, y): 사람이나 포켓몬의 감정을 민감하게 캐치한다. 적의를 느끼면 그늘로 숨는다.
Description (en, y): It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 머리의 뿔로 사람의 기분을 감지한다. 사람 앞에는 좀처럼 모습을 나타내지 않지만 긍정적인 기분을 캐치하면 다가온다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 사람의 감정을 감지하는 힘을 지녀서 트레이너가 밝은 감정일 때는 함께하며 기뻐하는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Ralts has the ability to sense the emotions of people. If its Trainer is in a cheerful mood, this Pokémon grows cheerful and joyous in the same way.
Description (ko, sword): 사람이나 포켓몬의 감정을 민감하게 캐치한다. 적의가 느껴지면 그늘로 숨는다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

document.title: Kirlia — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kirlia
ID: 281
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 킬리아
Name (en): Kirlia
Description (en, ruby): It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
Description (en, sapphire): KIRLIA uses the horns on its head to amplify its psychokinetic power. When the POKéMON uses its power, the air around it becomes distorted, creating mirages of nonexistent scenery.
Description (en, emerald): A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
Description (en, firered): The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
Description (en, diamond): It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.
Description (en, platinum): If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
Description (en, heartgold): It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
Description (ko, x): 트레이너의 밝은 마음이 사이코 파워의 근원이다. 즐거워지면 빙글빙글 춤춘다.
Description (en, x): The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
Description (ko, y): 사이코 파워를 조작해 주변의 공간을 비틀고 구부려 미래를 내다볼 수 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 트레이너의 긍정적인 감정에 닿은 킬리아는 아름답게 성장한다고 한다. 발달한 뇌로 사이코 파워를 다룬다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 머리의 뿔로 증폭된 사이코 파워를 사용할 때 주변의 공간이 비틀어져 현실에는 없는 풍경이 보인다고 한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Kirlia uses the horns on its head to amplify its psychokinetic power. When the Pokémon uses its power, the air around it becomes distorted, creating mirages of nonexistent scenery.
Description (ko, sword): 트레이너가 기뻐하면 킬리아에게 에너지가 넘쳐나서 기쁜 듯이 빙글빙글 춤춘다.
Description (ko, shield): 사이코 파워를 조작해 주변의 공간을 일그러뜨려 미래를 내다볼 수 있다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

document.title: Gardevoir — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gardevoir
ID: 282
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 가디안
Name (en): Gardevoir
Description (en, ruby): GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
Description (en, sapphire): GARDEVOIR has the psychokinetic power to distort the dimensions and create a small black hole. This POKéMON will try to protect its TRAINER even at the risk of its own life.
Description (en, emerald): It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.
Description (en, firered): It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.
Description (en, diamond): It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.
Description (en, platinum): To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
Description (en, heartgold): It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.
Description (ko, x): 트레이너를 지키기 위해서라면 사이코 파워를 모두 써서 작은 블랙홀을 만들어 낸다.
Description (ko, y): 미래를 예지하는 힘을 가진다. 트레이너를 지킬 때 최대 파워를 발휘한다.
Description (en, y): It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 미래를 예지하는 능력으로 트레이너의 위험을 감지했을 때 최대 파워의 사이코 에너지를 사용한다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 사이코 파워로 공간을 비틀어 작은 블랙홀을 만들어내는 힘을 지녔다. 목숨을 걸고 트레이너를 지키는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Gardevoir has the psychokinetic power to distort the dimensions and create a small black hole. This Pokémon will try to protect its Trainer even at the risk of its own life.
Description (ko, sword): 미래를 예지하는 힘을 가졌다. 트레이너를 지킬 때 최대 파워를 발휘한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

document.title: Surskit — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Surskit
ID: 283
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비구술
Name (en): Surskit
Description (en, ruby): From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
Description (en, sapphire): If SURSKIT senses danger, it secretes a thick, sugary syrup from the tip of its head. There are some POKéMON that love eating this syrup.
Description (en, emerald): They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
Description (en, firered): They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
Description (en, diamond): It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
Description (en, heartgold): It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.
Description (ko, x): 보통은 연못에서 살고 있지만 소나기가 온 뒤에는 마을 안의 물웅덩이에 모습을 드러낸다.
Description (ko, y): 수면을 미끄러지듯이 걷는다. 머리끝에서 달콤한 냄새를 내어 먹이를 끌어들인다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 발끝에서 기름이 배어 나와 물 위를 미끄러지듯 걸을 수 있다. 연못이나 호수의 미생물을 먹고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 위험을 감지하면 머리끝에서 물엿같이 달콤한 액체가 나온다. 이것을 좋아하는 포켓몬도 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): If Surskit senses danger, it secretes a thick, sugary syrup from the tip of its head. There are some Pokémon that love eating this syrup.
Description (ko, sun): 수면을 미끄러지듯 이동한다. 먹이를 구하고자 물거미와 싸우는 일도 가끔씩 있다.
Description (en, sun): It moves as if skating on the surface of the water. It often fights with Dewpider over food.
Description (ko, moon): 위험에 처하면 머리끝에서 달콤한 액체가 배어 나온다. 새포켓몬이 싫어하는 맛이다.
Description (en, moon): When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its head. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 위기를 맞으면 돌기에서 달콤한 액체가 나온다. 이것을 모은 시럽을 빵에 바르면 맛있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): If it’s in a pinch, it will secrete a sweet liquid from the tip of its head. Syrup made from gathering that liquid is tasty on bread.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 물풀이 많은 연못이나 늪에 산다. 서식지도 먹는 먹이도 비슷한 물거미와 자주 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

document.title: Masquerain — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Masquerain
ID: 284
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비나방
Name (en): Masquerain
Description (en, ruby): MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
Description (en, sapphire): MASQUERAIN’s antennas have eyelike patterns that usually give it an angry look. If the “eyes” are droopy and appear sad, it is said to be a sign that a heavy rainfall is on its way.
Description (en, emerald): It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can’t fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
Description (en, firered): The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.
Description (en, diamond): Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
Description (en, heartgold): It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-- to and fro and sideways.
Description (ko, x): 눈알 모양의 더듬이를 가지고 있다. 4장의 날개로 떠올라 전후좌우로 움직일 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 4장의 날개로 떠올라 전후좌우로 자유자재로 날아다닐 수 있다.
Description (en, y): It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction--to and fro and sideways.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 더듬이의 눈알 무늬로 적을 위협한다. 4개의 날개를 사용하여 헬리콥터처럼 공중에서 전후좌우로 자유롭게 나아간다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction—even sideways and backwards—as if it were a helicopter.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 화난 표정의 눈알 무늬가 슬픈 듯이 처져 있을 때는 소나기가 내릴 전조라고 전해진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Masquerain’s antennas have eyelike patterns that usually give it an angry look. If the “eyes” are droopy and appear sad, it is said to be a sign that a heavy rainfall is on its way.
Description (ko, sun): 더듬이에 있는 눈알 모양으로 적을 위협한다. 4개의 날개로 전후좌우로 날아다닌다.
Description (en, sun): It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.
Description (ko, moon): 날개와 더듬이는 습기에 약하다. 비가 갠 뒤에는 태양 쪽을 향해 몸을 말린다.
Description (en, moon): Its wings and antennae don’t cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 눈알 모양으로 적을 위협한다. 그래도 안 되면 4장의 날개를 사용해 재빠르게 도망친다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns of its eyespots. If that doesn’t work, it deftly makes its escape on its set of four wings.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 얇은 날개처럼 생긴 더듬이는 습기를 머금기 쉽다. 비가 오는 날은 나무 구멍 등에서 얌전히 지낸다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

document.body:

Description (ko, y): 머리의 정수리에서 독 포자를 뿜어낸다. 포자를 들이마시면 몸의 마디마디가 아파진다.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

Description (en, x): It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
Description (ko, y): 위험을 감지하면 제트기와 같은 음량의 울음소리를 내서 적을 풀죽게 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 평소에는 주의를 기울여야 들릴 만큼 작은 목소리지만 위험을 감지하면 두통을 일으킬 만큼 큰 소리로 울어댄다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Normally, Whismur’s voice is very quiet—it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 한 번 큰 소리로 울기 시작하면 자신의 목소리에 놀라 한층 더 심하게 운다. 울음을 그치면 지쳐서 잠들어버린다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Whismur is very timid. If it starts to cry loudly, it becomes startled by its own crying and cries even harder. When it finally stops crying, the Pokémon goes to sleep, all tired out.
Description (ko, sword): 울음소리는 100데시벨을 넘는 음량이다. 가까이에서 울면 온종일 두통에 시달린다.
Description (en, sword): The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.
Description (ko, shield): 울음이 터지면 자신의 목소리에 놀라 더 격렬하게 운다. 울다 지치면 잠들어 버린다.
Description (en, shield): When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

document.title: Loudred — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Loudred
ID: 294
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 노공룡
Name (en): Loudred
Description (en, ruby): LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
Description (en, sapphire): LOUDRED shouts while stamping its feet. After it finishes shouting, this POKéMON becomes incapable of hearing anything for a while. This is considered to be a weak point.
Description (en, emerald): It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
Description (en, firered): When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.
Description (en, diamond): The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
Description (en, heartgold): It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
Description (ko, x): 마음껏 들이마신 공기를 발달한 복근을 써서 토해내 큰 소리를 낸다.
Description (ko, y): 큰 소리의 충격파로 트럭을 뒤집어 버린다. 발을 쿵쾅거리며 파워를 올린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 나무로 만든 집을 산산조각 내 날려버릴 만큼 큰 소리를 내어 상대를 혼내준다. 둥근 귀가 스피커 역할을 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Loudred’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 발을 동동 구르면서 큰 소리를 낸다. 큰 소리를 낸 후에는 잠시 동안 아무것도 듣지 못하게 되는 것이 약점이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Loudred shouts while stamping its feet. After it finishes shouting, this Pokémon becomes incapable of hearing anything for a while. This is considered to be a weak point.
Description (ko, sword): 귀는 스피커 역할을 한다. 집 한 채를 날려버릴 위력의 음파를 귀에서 내뿜는다.
Description (en, sword): Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.
Description (ko, shield): 큰 목소리는 청각뿐만 아니라 공기의 압력마저 변화시켜 상대를 날려버리고 데미지를 준다.
Description (en, shield): The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

document.title: Exploud — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Exploud
ID: 295
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 폭음룡
Name (en): Exploud
Description (en, ruby): EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
Description (en, sapphire): EXPLOUD communicates its feelings to the others by emitting whistle-like sounds from the tubes on its body. This POKéMON only raises its voice when it is in battle.
Description (en, emerald): It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
Description (en, firered): It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.
Description (en, diamond): Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
Description (en, heartgold): Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.
Description (ko, x): 폭음룡이 짖는 소리는 10km 전방까지 닿는다. 몸 곳곳의 구멍에서 갖가지 소리를 낸다.
Description (ko, y): 싸울 때 내는 으르렁거리는 소리는 마치 지진처럼 땅을 쿵쿵 울린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 큰 소리의 진동으로 지진을 일으킨다. 몸에 난 구멍으로 공기를 세차게 빨아들이기 시작하면 큰 소리를 낼 조짐이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Exploud triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸의 구멍에서 피리 같은 소리를 내서 동료에게 기분을 전달하고 있다. 큰 소리는 싸울 때만 낸다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Exploud communicates its feelings to the others by emitting whistle-like sounds from the tubes on its body. This Pokémon only raises its voice when it is in battle.
Description (ko, sword): 옛날 사람은 멀리 떨어진 마을끼리 연락하는 방법으로 폭음룡의 큰 목소리를 사용했다.
Description (en, sword): In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.
Description (ko, shield): 큰 목소리만 가진 것이 아니다. 몸의 구멍에서 다양한 소리를 내어 동료와 의사소통을 한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

document.title: Makuhita — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Makuhita
ID: 296
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마크탕
Name (en): Makuhita
Description (en, ruby): MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
Description (en, sapphire): MAKUHITA has a tireless spirit - it will never give up hope. It eats a lot of food, gets plenty of sleep, and it trains very rigorously. By living that way, this POKéMON packs its body with energy.
Description (en, emerald): It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.
Description (en, firered): It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can withstand any attack.
Description (en, diamond): It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
Description (en, heartgold): It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
Description (ko, x): 큰 나무에 몇 번이나 몸통박치기를 하며 강인한 몸과 굴하지 않는 마음을 단련한다.
Description (ko, y): 힘든 수행을 반복하며 강해진다. 어떤 공격도 참아내는 근성의 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, y): It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몇 번을 쓰러져도 포기하지 않고 일어선다. 일어설 때마다 진화를 위한 에너지가 몸 안에 점점 비축되어간다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Makuhita is tenacious—it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 절대 포기하지 않는 근성을 지녔다. 많이 먹고 잘 자고 운동하여 몸 안에 에너지가 충만하다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Makuhita has a tireless spirit—it will never give up hope. It eats a lot of food, gets plenty of sleep, and it trains very rigorously. By living that way, this Pokémon packs its body with energy.
Description (ko, sun): 원래는 다른 지방에서 데려왔지만 지금은 알로라의 마크탕이 더 유명하다.
Description (en, sun): It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.
Description (ko, moon): 아침에 눈을 뜨면 모두와 연습한다. 낮이 되면 먹이를 먹고 낮잠을 잔다. 눈을 뜨면 다시 연습을 하는 매일을 보낸다.
Description (en, moon): Their daily routine consists of training together first thing in the morning, eating and napping in the afternoon, and then more training afterward.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 나무줄기에 손바닥 치기를 하며 단련한다. 나시에게 손바닥 치기를 해서 내던져지기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It practices its slaps by repeatedly slapping tree trunks. It has been known to slap an Exeggutor and get flung away.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강한 마크탕을 키우기 위해 트레이너들이 전통적으로 만드는 전골 요리가 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

document.title: Hariyama — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hariyama
ID: 297
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 하리뭉
Name (en): Hariyama
Description (en, ruby): HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
Description (en, sapphire): HARIYAMA’s thick body may appear fat, but it is actually a hunk of solid muscle. If this POKéMON bears down and tightens all its muscles, its body becomes as hard as a rock.
Description (en, emerald): It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It’s been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.
Description (en, firered): It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.
Description (en, diamond): It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
Description (en, heartgold): It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.
Description (ko, x): 두 다리로 땅을 힘껏 밟아서 파워를 모은다. 손바닥 치기 한 방으로 10톤 트럭을 날려버린다.
Description (ko, y): 몸집이 큰 포켓몬들과 힘 겨루는 것을 매우 좋아한다. 손바닥 치기로 트럭을 멀리 날려 버린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 다양한 장소에서 손바닥 치기 연습에 힘쓴다. 강렬한 손바닥 치기 공격을 맞으면 전봇대도 한 방에 두 동강 난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Hariyama practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 살이 찐 몸은 근육 덩어리다. 힘껏 전신에 힘을 집중하면 근육은 바위만큼 단단해진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Hariyama’s thick body may appear fat, but it is actually a hunk of solid muscle. If this Pokémon bears down and tightens all its muscles, its body becomes as hard as a rock.
Description (ko, sun): 괴력으로 알려졌지만 나이가 들면 싸우는 것을 그만두고 마크탕을 훈련시키며 지낸다.
Description (en, sun): It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.
Description (ko, moon): 손바닥 치기 한 번에 트럭을 날려버릴 정도의 괴력으로 힘겨루기를 아주 좋아한다.
Description (en, moon): They love to compare their freakish strength— strength enough to send a truck flying with a single slap.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 힘겨루기를 좋아하지만, 선한 성품도 겸비하여 대결 상대를 치하하는 등 예의를 중시한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although they enjoy comparing their strength, they’re also kind. They value etiquette, praising opponents they battle.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 뚱뚱하고 큰 하리뭉이 다 강한 것은 아니다. 작지만 몸이 가볍고 기술이 뛰어난 하리뭉도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Azurill
ID: 298
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 루리리
Name (en): Azurill
Description (en, ruby): AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
Description (en, sapphire): AZURILL’s tail is large and bouncy. It is packed full of the nutrients this POKéMON needs to grow. AZURILL can be seen bouncing and playing on its big, rubbery tail.

Description (en, pearl): Its tail is filled with nutrients necessary for growth. It plays by bouncing on its tail.
Description (en, platinum): Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
Description (en, heartgold): Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.
Description (en, black-2): It swings its large, nutrient-filled tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

Description (ko, y): 영양이 채워진 큰 꼬리를 휘두르며 자신보다 벅찬 상대에게도 맞선다.
