Description (en, omega-ruby): Azurill spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 꼬리에는 성장을 위해 필요한 영양이 가득 채워져 있다. 탄력 있는 꼬리에 올라가 논다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Azurill’s tail is large and bouncy. It is packed full of the nutrients this Pokémon needs to grow. Azurill can be seen bouncing and playing on its big, rubbery tail.
Description (ko, sword): 고무공처럼 튀는 꼬리의 구슬에는 성장에 필요한 영양분이 가득 들어 있다.
Description (en, sword): The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.
Description (ko, shield): 얌전한 포켓몬이지만 화가 나면 꼬리의 큰 공을 붕붕 휘두르다 세차게 내리친다.
Description (en, shield): Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

document.title: Nosepass — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Nosepass
ID: 299
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 코코파스
Name (en): Nosepass
Description (en, ruby): NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
Description (en, sapphire): NOSEPASS had been said to be completely unmoving, with its magnetic nose pointed due north. However, close observation has revealed that the POKéMON actually moves by a little over 3/8 of an inch every year.
Description (en, emerald): Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
Description (en, firered): Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.
Description (en, diamond): Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.
Description (en, platinum): When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
Description (en, heartgold): If two of these meet, they cannot get too close because their noses repel each other.
Description (en, black-2): Its magnetic nose always faces north and draws iron objects to its body to protect itself better.
Description (ko, x): 항상 북쪽을 향한다. 자석의 코로 주변의 철을 끌어당겨 방어를 굳힌다.
Description (ko, y): 자석 코는 항상 북쪽을 향하고 있다. 여행자는 코코파스를 보고 방향을 확인한다.
Description (en, y): Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자석으로 된 코는 항상 북쪽을 향하고 있다. 코코파스끼리는 자석의 반발력 때문에 가까이에서 얼굴을 마주 볼 수가 없다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Nosepass’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 자석인 코를 북쪽으로 향한 채 전혀 움직이지 않는다고 전해졌지만 1년에 1cm 이동하는 것이 관측되었다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Nosepass had been said to be completely unmoving, with its magnetic nose pointed due north. However, close observation has revealed that the Pokémon actually moves by a little over 3/8 of an inch every year.
Description (ko, sun): 코코파스의 코의 자석은 절대로 고장 나지 않아서 여행하는 트레이너의 좋은 파트너이다.
Description (en, sun): The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.
Description (ko, moon): 강력한 자력으로 먹이를 끌어당긴다. 철을 끌어당겨 몸을 지킬 때도 있다.
Description (en, moon): It uses powerful magnetism to drag its prey toward it. It’s also been known to pull in metal, which it collects and uses to protect itself.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 1년에 1cm밖에 움직이지 않지만 위기에 처하면 회전하여 순식간에 땅속으로 파고든다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It moves less than an inch a year, but when it’s in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강력한 자력으로 먹이를 끌어당겨 움직이지 않고 사냥을 하지만 천적을 끌어당기는 일도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

document.title: Skitty — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Skitty
ID: 300
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에나비
Name (en): Skitty
Description (en, ruby): SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
Description (en, sapphire): SKITTY is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this POKéMON lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.
Description (en, emerald): A SKITTY’s adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
Description (en, firered): It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.
Description (en, diamond): It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
Description (en, heartgold): It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.
Description (en, black-2): It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
Description (ko, x): 움직이는 것을 무심코 쫓아간다. 자신의 꼬리를 쫓아서 똑같은 장소를 빙글빙글 돈다.
Description (ko, y): 자신의 꼬리를 쫓아서 놀고 있으면 눈이 핑 돌고 마는 귀여운 일면을 보인다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 움직이는 것을 발견하면 푹 빠져서 뒤쫓아 가는 습성을 지닌 포켓몬이다. 자기 꼬리를 쫓다 현기증을 일으킨다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 자신의 꼬리를 쫓아다니는 포켓몬이다. 야생에서는 숲의 나무 구멍에서 산다. 귀염성 있는 얼굴 때문에 애완동물로 인기가 높다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

Name (en): Delcatty
Description (en, ruby): DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

document.title: Sableye — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sableye
ID: 302
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 깜까미
Name (en): Sableye
Description (en, ruby): SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
Description (en, sapphire): SABLEYE digs the ground with sharpened claws to find rocks that it eats. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the POKéMON’s body surface.
Description (en, emerald): It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
Description (en, firered): It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
Description (en, diamond): It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
Description (en, heartgold): It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
Description (ko, x): 동굴의 어둠에 숨는다. 보석을 먹는 사이에 눈이 보석이 되어 버렸다.
Description (ko, y): 어두운 동굴에 거처를 만들어 예리한 손톱을 써서 보석을 파내어 먹는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 동굴 깊은 곳에서 은밀히 생활한다. 어둠 속에서 눈동자가 수상하게 빛날 때 사람의 영혼을 빼앗는다며 두려움의 대상이 되고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Sableye lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 날카로운 발톱으로 땅을 파고 돌을 먹는다. 돌에 포함된 성분은 결정이 되어 몸의 표면에 나타난다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Sableye digs the ground with sharpened claws to find rocks that it eats. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon’s body surface.
Description (ko, sun): 보석을 좋아해서 멜리시를 노리고 끈질기게 따라다니지만 한바이트가 가로채 버린다.
Description (en, sun): It’s a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.
Description (ko, moon): 보석 눈동자가 수상하게 빛날 때 사람의 영혼을 빼앗는다며 두려움의 대상이 된 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 딱딱한 발톱으로 땅에 구멍을 파고 굵은 이빨로 보석을 북북 갉는다. 멜리시를 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 신체의 표면에 먹은 보석의 성분이 떠오른다. 그 패턴은 무한대다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.
Description (ko, shield): 보석의 결정을 먹는다. 어둠 속에서는 두 눈이 보석의 빛을 낸다.

document.title: Mawile — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mawile
ID: 303
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 입치트
Name (en): Mawile
Description (en, ruby): MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
Description (en, sapphire): Don’t be taken in by this POKéMON’s cute face - it’s very dangerous. MAWILE fools the foe into letting down its guard, then chomps down with its massive jaws. The steel jaws are really horns that have been transformed.
Description (en, emerald): Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
Description (en, firered): It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
Description (en, diamond): Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
Description (en, heartgold): It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
Description (ko, x): 얌전한 얼굴로 상대를 방심하게 만들고 큰 턱으로 덥석 문다. 한번 물면 절대로 놓지 않는다.
Description (ko, y): 뿔이 변형되어 생긴 큰 턱이 머리에 달려 있다. 철골을 물어서 끊어 버린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강철 뿔이 변형된 큰 턱이다. 얌전해 보이는 얼굴에 방심하고 있으면 갑자기 뒤돌아서 덥석 문다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Mawile’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, Mawile chomps it with its gaping jaws.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 상대를 방심하게 하고 큰 턱으로 덥석 문다. 귀여운 얼굴에 속아 넘어가면 위험하다. 강철의 턱은 뿔이 변형된 것이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Don’t be taken in by this Pokémon’s cute face—it’s very dangerous. Mawile fools the foe into letting down its guard, then chomps down with its massive jaws. The steel jaws are really horns that have been transformed.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 약삭빠르고 무서운 포켓몬. 귀여운 행동으로 방심하게 한 후 느닷없이 큰 턱으로 통째로 삼켜 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 2개의 입을 가졌다. 후두부의 큰 턱에는 미각이 없어서 싫어하는 것은 이쪽으로 먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has two mouths. The big jaws on the back of its head can’t taste anything, so that’s the mouth it uses to eat foods it doesn’t like.
Description (ko, shield): 강철의 뿔이 변형되어 생긴 큰 턱으로 상대를 덥석 문다.

document.title: Aron — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Aron
ID: 304
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 가보리
Name (en): Aron
Description (en, ruby): This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
Description (en, sapphire): ARON has a body of steel. With one all-out charge, this POKéMON can demolish even a heavy dump truck. The destroyed dump truck then becomes a handy meal for the POKéMON.
Description (en, emerald): A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
Description (en, firered): It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.
Description (en, diamond): It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
Description (en, heartgold): When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.
Description (en, black-2): In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.
Description (ko, x): 평소에는 산속에서 살고 있지만 배가 고프면 산기슭에 나타나 선로나 차를 먹어 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 몸을 감싼 강철 갑옷은 진화할 때 똑 떨어져 새 갑옷이 만들어진다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강철 몸을 만들기 위해 철광석을 산에서 채광해 먹지만 가끔 다리나 레일을 먹어버리는 말썽꾸러기다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 강철의 몸으로 힘껏 부딪치면 큰 덤프트럭도 한 방에 엉망이 된다. 부서진 덤프트럭을 우적우적 먹는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Aron has a body of steel. With one all-out charge, this Pokémon can demolish even a heavy dump truck. The destroyed dump truck then becomes a handy meal for the Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 철광석을 먹거나 가끔은 철도의 레일을 먹고 몸을 지키는 강철 갑옷을 만든다.
Description (en, sword): It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.
Description (ko, shield): 진화할 때 강철의 갑옷이 떨어진다. 옛날 사람들은 주워서 일상생활에서 유용하게 사용했다.
Description (en, shield): When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

document.body:

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 갱도라
Name (en): Lairon
Description (en, ruby): LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
Description (en, sapphire): LAIRON feeds on iron contained in rocks and water. It makes its nest on mountains where iron ore is buried. As a result, the POKéMON often clashes with humans mining the iron ore.
Description (en, emerald): When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
Description (en, firered): It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.
Description (en, diamond): For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
Description (en, heartgold): It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
Description (en, black-2): Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.

Description (ko, y): 강철의 갑옷을 바위에 부딪쳤을 때 튀는 불꽃의 크기로 강함을 어필하는 습성이 있다.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Lairon feeds on iron contained in rocks and water. It makes its nest on mountains where iron ore is buried. As a result, the Pokémon often clashes with humans mining the iron ore.
Description (ko, sword): 갱도라가 사는 산은 샘물과 철광석이 풍부하여 사람과 다투는 일도 잦았다.
Description (en, sword): Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.
Description (ko, shield): 서로 몸을 부딪치며 영역 싸움을 한다. 강철의 갑옷은 잘 보면 흠집과 파인 곳이 있다.
Description (en, shield): During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

document.title: Aggron — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Aggron
ID: 306
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 보스로라
Name (en): Aggron
Description (en, ruby): AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
Description (en, sapphire): AGGRON is surprisingly protective of its environment. If its mountain is ravaged by a landslide or a fire, this POKéMON will haul topsoil to the area, plant trees, and beautifully restore its own territory.
Description (en, emerald): Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the AGGRON’s age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
Description (en, firered): It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.
Description (en, diamond): While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
Description (en, heartgold): You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.
Description (en, black-2): It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
Description (ko, x): 산을 통째로 영역으로 한다. 상처가 많은 보스로라일수록 많이 싸웠다는 것이므로 얕볼 수 없다.
Description (ko, y): 강철의 뿔로 단단한 암반을 무너뜨리며 식량이 되는 철을 찾아서 터널을 판다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 산 하나를 자신의 영역으로 만들고 침범한 상대는 봐주지 않고 때려눕힌다. 항상 산속을 돌아보고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 산사태나 산불로 산이 황폐해지면 열심히 흙을 나르고 나무 모종을 심어 자신의 영역을 깨끗히 청소한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Aggron is protective of its environment. If its mountain is ravaged by a landslide or a fire, this Pokémon will haul topsoil to the area, plant trees, and beautifully restore its own territory.
Description (ko, sword): 두꺼운 철판을 꿰뚫을 정도로 예리한 뿔을 몸통박치기와 함께 찔러넣어 상대를 처리한다.
Description (en, sword): Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.
Description (ko, shield): 먼 옛날 어떤 왕은 보스로라의 강함을 선망하여 머리 모양을 본떠 만든 투구를 쓰기도 했다.
Description (en, shield): Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

document.title: Meditite — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Meditite
ID: 307
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 요가랑
Name (en): Meditite
Description (en, ruby): MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
Description (en, sapphire): MEDITITE heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this POKéMON’s training.
Description (en, emerald): It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
Description (en, firered): It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.
Description (en, diamond): It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
Description (en, pearl): It never misses its daily yoga workouts, and it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
Description (en, platinum): It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
Description (en, heartgold): It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.
Description (ko, x): 평상시는 깊은 산속에서 수행한다. 명상을 하고 정신력을 높이면 몸이 떠오른다.
Description (ko, y): 하루에 하나만 나무열매를 먹는다. 배고픔을 참는 것으로 마음을 갈고 닦아간다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 산속에서 요가 수행을 한다. 명상을 하고 있어도 집중력이 떨어지기 때문에 수행이 끝나지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 명상으로 정신 에너지를 높이고 있다. 하루에 나무열매를 한 개만 먹는다. 별로 먹지 않는 것도 수행의 하나다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Electrike
ID: 309
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 썬더라이
Name (en): Electrike
Description (en, ruby): ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
Description (en, sapphire): ELECTRIKE runs faster than the human eye can follow. The friction from running is converted into electricity, which is then stored in this POKéMON’s fur.
Description (en, emerald): It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
Description (en, firered): It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
Description (en, diamond): Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
Description (en, heartgold): It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
Description (ko, x): 털에 모은 전기를 써서 근육을 자극함으로써 순발력을 높인다.
Description (ko, y): 정전기를 털에 비축하여 방전한다. 폭풍이 가까이 오면 온몸에서 불꽃을 튀긴다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 긴 털에 전기를 모으고 있다. 전류로 다리 근육을 자극하여 폭발적인 순발력을 낸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Electrike stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 눈에 안 보이는 스피드로 달리는 포켓몬이다. 공기의 마찰로 전기를 발생시켜 전신의 털에 비축하고 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Electrike runs faster than the human eye can follow. The friction from running is converted into electricity, which is then stored in this Pokémon’s fur.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 공기와 털의 마찰로 정전기가 발생한다. 썬더라이가 달리면 탁탁 소리가 난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 긴 털이 마찰하는 과정에서 전신에 정전기가 모인다. 스피드가 특기인 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Static electricity builds up all over its body as strands of its long fur rub together. This Pokémon boasts incredible speed.
Description (ko, shield): 정전기를 털에 모은다. 공기가 건조한 계절에는 전신에서 스파크를 뿌린다.

document.title: Manectric — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Manectric
ID: 310
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 썬더볼트
Name (en): Manectric
Description (en, ruby): MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
Description (en, sapphire): MANECTRIC discharges strong electricity from its mane. The mane is used for collecting electricity in the atmosphere. This POKéMON creates thunderclouds above its head.
Description (en, emerald): Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
Description (en, firered): It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
Description (en, diamond): It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
Description (en, heartgold): Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.
Description (ko, x): 좀처럼 사람 앞에 모습을 드러내지 않는다. 번개가 떨어진 곳에 보금자리가 있다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 갈기에서 방전을 하고 있다. 머리 위에 번개 구름을 만들고 천둥번개를 떨어뜨려 공격한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 갈기를 통해 항상 방전 중이기 때문에 불꽃이 튀어 산불이 일어나기도 한다. 싸우게 되면 번개 구름을 만들어낸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 갈기에서 강한 전기를 발산하고 있다. 공기 중의 전기를 갈기에 모아 머리 위에 번개 구름을 만들어낸다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Manectric discharges strong electricity from its mane. The mane is used for collecting electricity in the atmosphere. This Pokémon creates thunderclouds above its head.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 이상한 번개 구름 아래에는 썬더볼트가 있다. 번개와 같은 스피드로 달린다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 전기로 근육을 자극해서 재빠르게 움직일 수 있다. 근육통도 전기로 풀기 때문에 금방 낫는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

document.body:

document.title: Carvanha — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Carvanha
ID: 318
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 샤프니아
Name (en): Carvanha
Description (en, ruby): CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
Description (en, sapphire): If anything invades CARVANHA’s territory, it will swarm and tear at the intruder with its pointed fangs. On its own, however, this POKéMON turns suddenly timid.
Description (en, emerald): CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
Description (en, firered): It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.
Description (en, diamond): They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
Description (en, heartgold): They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.
Description (ko, x): 집단으로 배를 공격해 배의 밑바닥도 물어뜯어 가라앉힌다. 정글의 강에 서식한다.
Description (ko, y): 정글을 흐르는 큰 강에 서식한다. 영역에 섞여 들어온 먹이를 집단으로 덮친다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 발달한 턱과 날카롭고 뾰족한 이빨은 배 밑바닥을 물어뜯을 정도의 파괴력을 지녔다. 샤프니아에게 습격당해 가라앉은 배가 많다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Carvanha’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 영역을 침범하는 자는 집단으로 덤벼들어 뾰족한 이빨로 갈가리 찢는다. 혼자가 되면 바로 소극적인 모습을 보인다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): If anything invades Carvanha’s territory, it will swarm and tear at the intruder with its pointed fangs. On its own, however, this Pokémon turns suddenly timid.
Description (ko, sun): 무리별로 영역이 있다. 침입하는 자는 봐주지 않고 이빨을 드러내며 덤벼든다.
Description (en, sun): Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.
Description (ko, moon): 아주 적은 피 냄새에도 먹이를 찾아내 집단으로 먹이를 덮친다. 1마리만 있으면 꽤 겁쟁이다.
Description (en, moon): If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they’re rather cowardly.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 겁이 많아 1마리일 때는 사냥도 하지 않는다. 5마리 정도 모이면 갑자기 흉포해진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They’re such cowards that they won’t hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 튼튼한 턱과 이빨은 나무로 만든 배라면 간단하게 깨물어 부순다. 먹이를 두고 배쓰나이와 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.
Description (ko, sword): 먹이를 발견해도 혼자일 때는 공격하지 않는다. 동료가 오는 것을 기다린 다음 집단으로 공격한다.
Description (en, sword): It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

Description (en, shield): These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

Description (ko, y): 엉덩이에서 해수를 분사해 시속 120km의 스피드로 헤엄치는 바다의 난동꾼이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 바다의 건달이라 불리는 두려움의 대상이다. 부러져도 바로 다시 나는 이빨이 있어서 한 마리가 대형 유조선을 엉망으로 만든다.

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 바닷물을 엉덩이의 구멍으로 뿜어내서 시속 120km로 헤엄칠 수 있다. 장거리를 헤엄칠 수 없는 것이 약점이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Sharpedo can swim at speeds of up to 75 mph by jetting seawater out of its backside. This Pokémon’s drawback is its inability to swim long distances.
Description (ko, sun): 시속 120km로 먹이를 쫓아 철도 부수는 어금니로 잡는다. 통칭 바다의 건달.
Description (en, sun): It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.
Description (ko, moon): 한때 등지느러미가 귀한 식재료로 여겨져 남획된 슬픈 과거를 갖고 있다.
Description (en, moon): It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빠진 이빨을 지니고 있으면 바다에서 사고를 당하지 않는다고 믿어 액세서리 등으로 가공된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 엉덩이의 구멍으로 들이마신 바닷물을 뿜어내서 헤엄친다. 피 냄새에는 매우 민감하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It’s very sensitive to the scent of blood.
Description (ko, sword): 먹이의 냄새를 맡으면 엉덩이로 바닷물을 내뿜어서 시속 120km의 속도로 습격한다.
Description (en, sword): As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.
Description (ko, shield): 바다의 건달로 불리며 서식하는 해역에 들어간 배는 모조리 공격당한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

document.title: Wailmer — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Wailmer
ID: 320
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고래왕자
Name (en): Wailmer
Description (en, ruby): WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
Description (en, sapphire): WAILMER can store water inside its body to transform itself into a ball for bouncing around on the ground. By filling itself up with more water, this POKéMON can elevate the height of its bounces.
Description (en, emerald): While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
Description (en, firered): When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.
Description (en, diamond): On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
Description (en, heartgold): It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.
Description (en, black-2): It eats one ton of food every day. It plays by shooting stored seawater out its blowholes with great force.
Description (ko, x): 공처럼 튀면서 논다. 해수를 많이 마실수록 높이 튀게 된다.
Description (ko, y): 매일 1톤의 먹이를 먹는다. 코에서 모은 해수를 기세 좋게 내뿜으며 논다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 눈 위에 있는 콧구멍을 통해 몸에 모아둔 바닷물을 뿜어내서 사람을 놀라게 하는 것을 좋아하는 포켓몬이다.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Wailmer can store water inside its body to transform itself into a ball for bouncing around on the ground. By filling itself up with more water, this Pokémon can elevate the height of its bounces.
Description (ko, sun): 사람을 놀라게 하는 것을 좋아한다. 해수를 삼켜서 공처럼 몸을 부풀려 튀면서 논다.
Description (en, sun): It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.
Description (ko, moon): 들이마신 바닷물을 눈 위의 콧구멍으로 뿜어내어 어필한다. 매일 1톤의 약어리를 먹는다.
Description (en, moon): It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 입을 열고 헤엄쳐서 해수와 함께 먹이를 먹는다. 필요없는 물은 코로 내뿜는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매우 드물게 무리가 모래 해변에 올라오는 것은 먼 옛날 육지에 살았던 기억 때문이라고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Due to their memories of when they once lived on land, pods of them will, very rarely, wash up on shore.
Description (ko, shield): 바닷물을 많이 마시면 몸이 공처럼 튄다. 매일 1톤의 먹이를 먹는다.

document.title: Wailord — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Wailord
ID: 321
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고래왕
Name (en): Wailord
Description (en, ruby): WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
Description (en, sapphire): When chasing prey, WAILORD herds them by leaping out of the water and making a humongous splash. It is breathtaking to see this POKéMON leaping out of the sea with others in its pod.
Description (en, emerald): It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
Description (en, firered): It is among the largest of all POKéMON. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.
Description (en, diamond): The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
Description (en, heartgold): It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.
Description (en, black-2): It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
Description (ko, x): 커다란 몸을 파도 위에서 점프시켜 충격을 만들어 상대를 기절시킬 때가 있다.
Description (ko, y): 제일 큰 포켓몬이다. 숨을 들이쉬지 않고 3000m의 깊이까지 잠수할 수 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 발견된 것 중 가장 큰 포켓몬이다. 크고 넓은 바다를 느긋이 헤엄치며 큰 입으로 한 번에 대량의 먹이를 먹는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 먹이를 몰아가기 위해서 물속부터 점프하여 큰 물보라를 일으킨다. 무리로 점프하는 모습은 박력이 넘친다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When chasing prey, Wailord herds them by leaping out of the water and making a humongous splash. It is breathtaking to see this Pokémon leaping out of the sea with others in its pod.
Description (ko, sun): 무리 지어 먹이를 쫓는 습성이 있다. 큰 입으로 약어리의 무리를 통째로 삼켜버린다.
Description (en, sun): Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.
Description (ko, moon): 어찌 됐든 거대해서 인기가 있다. 고래왕 워칭은 각지에서 인기 있는 관광 코스다.
Description (en, moon): Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 너무 많은 물고기포켓몬을 먹기 때문에 개체 수가 많이 늘어나면 어부들에게 내쫓긴다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 작은 고래왕자가 샤크니아나 타타륜에게 공격당하면 무리의 동료들이 한마음이 되어 지켜 준다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When a small Wailmer is attacked by Sharpedo or Dhelmise, its whole pod works together to protect it.
Description (ko, sword): 커다란 몸으로 파도 위에서 점프해서 그 충격으로 상대를 기절시킬 때가 있다.
Description (ko, shield): 엄청나게 거대해서 인기가 있다. 고래왕 워칭은 각지에서 인기 있는 관광 코스다.

document.body:

Name: Numel
ID: 322
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 둔타
Name (en): Numel
Description (en, ruby): NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
Description (en, sapphire): NUMEL stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees F within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the POKéMON’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.
Description (en, emerald): A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
Description (en, firered): Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.
Description (en, diamond): Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
Description (en, heartgold): The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.
Description (en, black-2): The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
Description (ko, x): 이글거리는 마그마를 등의 혹에 모으고 있다. 비를 맞으면 마그마가 식어 움직임이 둔해진다.
Description (ko, y): 1200도의 마그마를 체내에 모아두고 있다. 불꽃 기술을 사용하면 혹은 작게 쪼그라든다.
Description (en, y): The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 1200도의 마그마를 몸에 저장하고 있다. 물에 젖으면 마그마가 식어서 덩어리져 무거워지므로 움직임이 둔해진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

Name (en): Camerupt

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 등의 혹은 뼈가 변형된 것이다. 펄펄 끓는 마그마를 가끔 뿜어 올린다. 화났을 때 자주 분화하는 것 같다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

Name (en): Torkoal

Description (en, sapphire): TORKOAL generates energy by burning coal. It grows weaker as the fire dies down. When it is preparing for battle, this POKéMON burns more coal.
Description (en, emerald): It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive’s horn.
Description (en, firered): It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.
Description (en, diamond): It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
Description (en, heartgold): You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
Description (ko, x): 사용할 수 없게 된 탄광에는 많은 코터스가 살며 석탄을 부지런히 캐고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 등껍질 속에 석탄을 태워서 에너지로 사용한다. 위급할 때는 까만 그을음을 뿜어낸다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 산을 파서 석탄을 발견하면 부지런히 등껍질의 빈 곳에 넣고 태우는 포켓몬이다. 습격당하면 검은 연기를 내고 도망간다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Torkoal digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 석탄을 태워서 에너지를 만들어낸다. 불의 기세가 약해지면 기운이 없어져 싸울 때는 석탄을 많이 태운다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Torkoal generates energy by burning coal. It grows weaker as the fire dies down. When it is preparing for battle, this Pokémon burns more coal.
Description (ko, sun): 석탄이 에너지의 근원이다. 코터스가 사는 산에는 많은 석탄이 잠들어 있다.
Description (en, sun): Coal is the source of Torkoal’s energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.
Description (ko, moon): 등껍질 안의 불꽃이 꺼지면 죽어버린다. 집에서 키우기 위해서는 항상 태울 것이 필요하다.
Description (en, moon): If the fire burning within its shell goes out, it will die. Those who wish to raise one in their home must always keep something flammable at hand.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 등껍질에서 내뿜는 연기로 몸 상태를 알 수 있다. 기세가 격렬할 때는 건강하다는 증거다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): You can tell how it’s feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 석탄을 태워서 에너지를 만든다. 석탄이 다 타 버리면 움직이지 못하게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It burns coal to produce energy. When it has burned through all of its coal, it becomes unable to move.
Description (ko, sword): 등껍질 속에 석탄을 태워서 에너지로 사용한다. 위급할 때는 까만 매연을 뿜어낸다.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Spinda
ID: 327
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 얼루기
Name (en): Spinda
Description (en, ruby): All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
Description (en, sapphire): No two SPINDA are said to have identical spot patterns on their hides. This POKéMON moves in a curious manner as if it is stumbling in dizziness. Its lurching movements can cause the opponent to become confused.
Description (en, emerald): It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe’s aim.
Description (en, firered): No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.
Description (en, diamond): No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
Description (en, heartgold): The chances of two SPINDA having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.
Description (en, black): No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
Description (ko, x): 똑같은 얼룩무늬의 얼루기는 없다. 휘청휘청거리는 걸음걸이로 상대의 노림수를 피한다.

Description (en, y): The chances of two Spinda having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

Description (en, omega-ruby): All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 똑같은 얼룩무늬는 없다고 전해진다. 항상 어지러운 것처럼 비틀거리며 움직이는데 이에는 상대를 혼란시키는 효과가 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): No two Spinda are said to have identical spot patterns on their hides. This Pokémon moves in a curious manner as if it is stumbling in dizziness. Its lurching movements can cause the opponent to become confused.
Description (ko, sun): 휘청휘청 불안한 걸음걸이지만 얼루기 본인은 똑바로 걷고 있다고 생각한다.
Description (en, sun): Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it’s walking in a straight line.
Description (ko, moon): 얼룩무늬는 1마리 1마리 다르다. 얼룩 위치의 근소한 차이를 즐기는 마니아도 있다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): Each and every Spinda has a slightly different configuration of spots. There are collectors who enjoy the tiny differences in their spot patterns.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 걸음걸이가 비틀비틀 불안하다. 긴 시간 계속 걸으면 기분이 나빠진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its steps are shaky and stumbling. Walking for a long time makes it feel sick.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 개체마다 얼룩무늬가 다르다. 비틀거리는 움직임으로 상대의 공격을 절묘하게 피한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

Name (en): Trapinch
Description (en, ruby): TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Trapinch is a patient hunter. It digs an inescapable pit in a desert and waits for its prey to come tumbling down. This Pokémon can go a whole week without access to any water.
Description (ko, sun): 1주일은 아무것도 먹지 않고 살 수 있다. 보금자리의 속에서 먹이가 오기만을 가만히 기다린다.

Description (en, moon): To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

Description (en, ultra-moon): People continue to have their hearts stolen by its enchanting songs and find themselves stranded in the desert.
Description (ko, shield): 날갯짓하는 소리가 여성의 아름다운 노랫소리와 닮아서 사막의 정령이라고 불린다.
Description (en, shield): It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

document.title: Swablu — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Swablu
ID: 333
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파비코
Name (en): Swablu
Description (en, ruby): SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
Description (en, sapphire): SWABLU loves to make things clean. If it spots something dirty, it will wipe and polish it with its cottony wings. If its wings become dirty, this POKéMON finds a stream and showers itself.
Description (en, emerald): A POKéMON that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
Description (en, firered): It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.
Description (en, diamond): Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.
Description (en, platinum): It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
Description (en, heartgold): Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.
Description (en, black-2): For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
Description (ko, x): 사람의 머리 위에 살짝 앉아 모자처럼 구는 것을 왠지 좋아한다.
Description (ko, y): 솜 같은 날개를 손질하는 일은 절대 거르지 않는다. 더러워지면 물로 깨끗하게 씻는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 뭉게구름처럼 푹신한 날개를 지녔다. 사람을 무서워하지 않고 솜 모자처럼 머리에 살포시 앉는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 지저분한 것을 보면 솜 같은 날개로 부지런히 닦아내는 깔끔쟁이 포켓몬이다. 날개가 지저분해지면 강에서 물로 씻는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Swablu loves to make things clean. If it spots something dirty, it will wipe and polish it with its cottony wings. If its wings become dirty, this Pokémon finds a stream and showers itself.
Description (ko, sword): 솜 같은 날개에는 공기가 들어 있어 만지면 푹신푹신한 느낌이 든다. 항상 꼼꼼하게 손질한다.
Description (en, sword): Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.
Description (ko, shield): 솜구름처럼 보이기 때문에 적의 눈에 잘 띄지 않는다. 세대를 거치면서 날개가 하얗게 되었다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

document.title: Altaria — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Altaria
ID: 334
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파비코리
Name (en): Altaria
Description (en, ruby): ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
Description (en, sapphire): ALTARIA sings in a gorgeous soprano. Its wings are like cotton clouds. This POKéMON catches updrafts with its buoyant wings and soars way up into the wild blue yonder.
Description (en, emerald): It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
Description (en, firered): If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.
Description (en, diamond): It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.
Description (en, platinum): If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
Description (en, heartgold): It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
Description (en, black-2): On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
Description (ko, x): 넓은 하늘을 느긋하게 난다. 파비코리의 아름다운 콧노래를 들으면 황홀한 꿈을 꾸는 기분이다.
Description (ko, y): 맑은 날 뭉게구름에 뒤섞이면서 넓은 하늘을 자유롭게 날아다니며 아름다운 소프라노로 노래한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 뭉게구름에 뒤섞여 넓은 하늘을 떠돈다. 맑은 목소리로 멜로디를 지저귀면 그 소리를 들은 자들은 꿈꾸는 듯한 기분이 된다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 아름다운 소프라노 음색으로 노래하는 포켓몬이다. 솜구름 같은 날개로 상승기류를 타고 넓은 하늘로 날아오른다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Altaria sings in a gorgeous soprano. Its wings are like cotton clouds. This Pokémon catches updrafts with its buoyant wings and soars way up into the wild blue yonder.
Description (ko, sword): 넓은 하늘을 유유히 날면서 듣는 이를 사로잡는 아름다운 콧노래를 부른다.
Description (en, sword): As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.
Description (ko, shield): 온순한 성질이지만 화나게 하면 날카로운 울음소리로 위협하며 가차 없이 공격한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

document.title: Barboach — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:

Name: Barboach
ID: 339
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 미꾸리
Name (en): Barboach
Description (en, ruby): BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
Description (en, sapphire): BARBOACH’s body is covered with a slimy film. If a foe grabs it, this POKéMON just slips out of the enemy’s grip. This POKéMON grows weak if the slimy coating dries up.
Description (en, emerald): Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH’s body.
Description (en, firered): It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.
Description (en, diamond): It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
Description (en, pearl): Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.
Description (en, platinum): Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
Description (en, heartgold): BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.
Description (ko, x): 전신이 미끈미끈한 체액으로 덮여있기 때문에 잡아도 미끈하게 빠져나갈 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 수염은 우수한 레이더다. 탁해진 물속에서도 수염을 써서 먹이를 찾아낸다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 민감한 수염은 우수한 레이더다. 진흙 속에서 2개의 수염만을 내놓고 먹이가 가까이 오는 것을 기다리고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Barboach’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸이 미끈미끈한 막으로 덮여 있어서 적에게 붙잡혀도 매끄럽게 도망칠 수 있다. 미끈미끈한 막이 마르면 몸이 약해진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Barboach’s body is covered with a slimy film. If a foe grabs it, this Pokémon just slips out of the enemy’s grip. This Pokémon grows weak if the slimy coating dries up.
Description (ko, sun): 2개의 수염은 민감한 레이더이다. 진흙으로 탁해진 물속에서도 먹이의 위치를 감지한다.
Description (en, sun): Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.
Description (ko, moon): 미끄러운 몸은 잡기 힘들다. 맨손으로 잡은 수를 겨루는 축제가 있을 정도다.
Description (en, moon): Its slippery body is hard to grasp, so much so that there are festivals where people compete to see how many they can catch barehanded.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 전신이 미끈미끈하다. 새포켓몬이 쪼아도 미끄덩 미끄러져 도망칠 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its entire body is gooey. When pecked at by bird Pokémon, it slips and slides its way to freedom.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수염에 신경이 모여 있다. 인간의 코나 혀와 같이 냄새나 맛을 감지해 낸다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its whiskers are filled with nerves. They can sense smells and flavors just as a person’s nose or tongue would.
Description (ko, sword): 미끈미끈한 몸은 잡기 어렵다. 어떤 지방에서는 진흙이 굳어져서 미꾸리가 생겨났다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, shield): 2개의 긴 수염으로 탁한 강바닥을 더듬는다. 미끈미끈한 점막으로 몸을 보호한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

document.title: Whiscash — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:

Name: Whiscash

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메깅
Name (en): Whiscash
Description (en, ruby): WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
Description (en, sapphire): If WHISCASH goes on a wild rampage, it sets off a quake-like tremor with a radius of over three miles. This POKéMON has the ability to predict real earthquakes.
Description (en, emerald): Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
Description (en, firered): It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

Description (en, pearl): As a result of causing tremors by thrashing about, it developed the ability to foretell real quakes.
Description (en, platinum): It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
Description (en, heartgold): It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.

Description (en, y): It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything--if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): If Whiscash goes on a wild rampage, it sets off a quake-like tremor with a radius of over three miles. This Pokémon has the ability to predict real earthquakes.
Description (ko, sun): 움직이는 것이라면 뭐든지 먹으려는 대식가다. 평소에는 늪 바닥에서 가만히 먹이를 기다리고 있다.
Description (en, sun): A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

Description (en, ultra-sun): Whiscash shakes the ground at high intensities to intimidate its opponents. It swallows its prey whole—along with mud from the swamp floor.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 시력은 그다지 좋지 않다. 수염으로 물의 진동을 감지해서 먹이의 위치를 찾아낸다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its vision is not that good. It senses vibrations in the water with its whiskers to determine the location of its prey.
Description (ko, sword): 늪 바닥에 거처를 만든다. 살아 있는 것이라면 가리지 않고 뭐든 먹어버리고 마는 대식가다.
Description (en, sword): It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

Description (en, legends-arceus): Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

Description (en, heartgold): It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

Description (ko, x): 고대의 진흙인형이 괴이한 광선을 쬐어 생명이 깃들면서 포켓몬이 되었다.
Description (ko, y): 2만 년 전에 고대인이 진흙으로 만든 인형에 생명이 깃들었다고 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 괴이한 광선을 쬔 고대인의 진흙인형에 생명이 깃들었다고 전해진다. 공중에 떠서 이동하고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Claydol are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 2만 년 전에 번창한 고대 문명의 진흙 인형에서 태어난 수수께끼의 포켓몬이다. 양손에서 빔을 발사한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Claydol is an enigma that appeared from a clay statue made by an ancient civilization dating back 20,000 years. This Pokémon shoots beams from both its hands.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 젖으면 몸이 녹아버린다. 비가 오면 사이코 파워로 전신을 감싸서 지킨다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 고대인이 하늘에서 내려온 무언가를 본떠서 만들었다고 한다. 양팔에서 빔을 발사한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The ancient people who made it apparently modeled it after something that descended from the sky. It fires beams from both arms.
Description (ko, sword): 2만 년 전 고대인이 만든 진흙인형에서 태어난 듯한 의문의 포켓몬.
Description (ko, shield): 고대인의 진흙인형에서 태어난 것 같다. 염력을 사용해 공중을 떠다닌다.

document.title: Lileep — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lileep
ID: 345
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 릴링
Name (en): Lileep
Description (en, ruby): LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
Description (en, sapphire): LILEEP is an ancient POKéMON that was regenerated from a fossil. It remains permanently anchored to a rock. From its immobile perch, this POKéMON intently scans for prey with its two eyes.
Description (en, emerald): It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.
Description (en, firered): It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.
Description (en, diamond): It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
Description (en, heartgold): It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
Description (ko, x): 촉수를 꽃잎으로 보이게 하여 가까이 온 먹이를 잡는다. 1억 년 전에 멸종했다.
Description (ko, y): 약 1억 년 전의 해저에서 살고 있던 고대의 포켓몬이다. 과학의 힘으로 부활했다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 약 1억 년 전에 멸종한 포켓몬이다. 해저의 바위에 붙어서 꽃잎 같은 촉수로 가까이 온 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 화석에서 재생된 고대의 포켓몬이다. 바위에 딱 붙어 있어서 걸을 수 없다. 두 개의 눈으로 가만히 먹이를 찾고 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Lileep is an ancient Pokémon that was regenerated from a fossil. It remains permanently anchored to a rock. From its immobile perch, this Pokémon intently scans for prey with its two eyes.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 고대의 따듯한 바다에 살았다. 해초로 둔갑해 먹이를 기다리다가 다가오면 통째로 삼킨다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강력한 흡반으로 바위에 달라붙어 있어서 아무리 거친 파도가 쳐도 떠내려가지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It sticks to rocks with its powerful suckers and can’t be washed away no matter how rough the surf gets.
Description (ko, sword): 화석에서 복원된 포켓몬. 약 1억 년 전에 따뜻한 바다에 서식했었다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.
Description (ko, shield): 해저 바위에 달라붙어 먹이가 가까이 오면 꽃잎처럼 생긴 촉수로 감아버린다.
Description (en, shield): Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

document.title: Cradily — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cradily
ID: 346
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 릴리요
Name (en): Cradily
Description (en, ruby): CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
Description (en, sapphire): CRADILY’s body serves as an anchor, preventing it from being washed away in rough seas. This POKéMON secretes a strong digestive fluid from its tentacles.
Description (en, emerald): It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.
Description (en, firered): It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.
Description (en, diamond): It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
Description (en, heartgold): It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.
Description (ko, x): 따뜻한 바다의 얕은 곳에 있다. 바닷물이 빠지면 모래 해변에 숨어 있는 먹이를 파내어 먹는다.
Description (ko, y): 8개의 촉수로 먹이를 감싸 강한 소화액으로 녹이고 나서 우걱우걱 먹는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 바다 밑에서 먹이를 찾아 돌아다닌다. 나뭇가지 같은 목을 자유롭게 늘여서 8개의 촉수로 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸이 추와 같은 역할을 해서 바다가 거칠어져도 떠내려가는 일이 없다. 촉수에서 강한 소화액이 나온다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Cradily’s body serves as an anchor, preventing it from being washed away in rough seas. This Pokémon secretes a strong digestive fluid from its tentacles.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 평소에는 얕은 여울 바다 밑에 살고 물이 빠지면 그대로 지상으로 올라가 먹이를 찾았다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 고대 바다의 육식 포켓몬. 8개의 촉수로 먹이를 잡아서 소화액으로 녹여 가며 먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This carnivorous Pokémon lived in primordial seas. It catches prey in its eight tentacles and dissolves them with digestive fluid as it eats.
Description (ko, sword): 다리가 짧아 걸음이 느리지만 목과 촉수가 3배로 늘어나서 멀리 있는 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (en, sword): It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.
Description (ko, shield): 촉수로 먹이를 잡은 후 그대로 소화액으로 녹여 영양분을 흡수한다.
Description (en, shield): Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

document.title: Anorith — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Anorith
ID: 347
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아노딥스
Name (en): Anorith
Description (en, ruby): ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
Description (en, sapphire): ANORITH is said to be a type of POKéMON predecessor, with eight wings at the sides of its body. This POKéMON swam in the primordial sea by undulating these eight wings.
Description (en, emerald): It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.
Description (en, firered): It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
Description (en, heartgold): An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.
Description (ko, x): 포켓몬의 조상 중 하나다. 해저의 바위 지대에 숨어 있는 먹잇감을 늘어나는 발톱으로 잡는다.
Description (en, x): It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
Description (ko, y): 화석에서 부활한 포켓몬의 조상 중 하나. 바다에서 살고 발톱으로 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 태고의 화석에서 되살아난 포켓몬이다. 따뜻한 바다에 서식하며 발달한 2개의 발톱으로 먹이를 꽉 잡는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 포켓몬의 조상 중 하나라고 전해지고 있다. 몸의 측면에 붙어 있는 8개의 날개를 구부려 태고의 바다를 헤엄쳤다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Anorith is said to be a type of Pokémon predecessor, with eight wings at the sides of its body. This Pokémon swam in the primordial sea by undulating these eight wings.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 화석에서 복원한 아노딥스를 바다에 놓아줘도 기운이 없다. 당시와 수질이 다르기 때문이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don’t thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 고대 벌레포켓몬의 일종. 8장의 날개를 사용해서 제법 빠르게 헤엄쳤다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon. With eight wings, it could apparently swim a lot faster than you’d expect.
Description (ko, sword): 화석에서 복원된 포켓몬. 1억 년 전의 바다에 살며 2개의 발톱으로 사냥을 했었다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.
Description (ko, shield): 8장의 날개를 배의 노처럼 움직여 빠르게 헤엄친다. 벌레포켓몬 선조의 일종이다.
Description (en, shield): Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

document.title: Armaldo — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Armaldo
ID: 348
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아말도
Name (en): Armaldo
Description (en, ruby): ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
Description (en, sapphire): ARMALDO is a POKéMON species that became extinct in prehistoric times. This POKéMON is said to have walked on its hind legs, which would have been more convenient for life on land.
Description (en, emerald): ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.
Description (en, firered): Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.
Description (en, diamond): It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
Description (en, heartgold): Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
Description (ko, x): 늘었다 줄었다 하는 거대한 손톱으로 먹이를 찔러서 잡는다. 튼튼한 갑옷을 몸에 두르고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 등껍질이 감싸고 있는 몸은 매우 단단하다. 날카로운 손톱으로 먹이를 찔러서 먹는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 등껍질은 어떠한 공격이라도 튕겨낸다. 늘었다 줄었다 하는 거대한 2개의 발톱은 철판을 찔러 뚫을 정도의 위력을 지녔다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Armaldo’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 오랜 옛날 멸종된 포켓몬의 한 종류다. 땅 위에서 살 때 편리하도록 2개의 다리로 걸을 수 있게 됐다고 한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Armaldo is a Pokémon species that became extinct in prehistoric times. This Pokémon is said to have walked on its hind legs, which would have been more convenient for life on land.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 지상에 살며 먹이를 찾아 바다로 사냥을 나갔다. 날카로운 발톱이 최대 무기다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 바다에서 살다가 지상에서도 살 수 있게 되었다. 일부 벌레포켓몬의 조상인 것으로 밝혀졌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Armaldo adapted from living in water to living on land. It has been determined that it is the ancestor of some bug Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 진화해서 육지로 올라왔다. 하반신이 강화되어 꼬리로 가하는 일격은 굉장한 파괴력을 자랑한다.
Description (en, sword): After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.
Description (ko, shield): 육지에서 생활하지만 헤엄도 잘 친다. 먹이를 찾아 바다로 잠수해 날카로운 발톱으로 꼼짝 못 하게 한다.
Description (en, shield): Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

document.title: Feebas — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Feebas
ID: 349
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 빈티나
Name (en): Feebas
Description (en, ruby): FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
Description (en, sapphire): While FEEBAS’s body is in tatters, it has a hardy and tenacious life force that enables it to live anywhere. However, this POKéMON is also slow and dimwitted, making it an easy catch.
Description (en, emerald): FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.
Description (en, firered): Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.
Description (en, diamond): It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.
Description (en, pearl): It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.
Description (en, platinum): It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
Description (en, heartgold): It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.
Description (ko, x): 무엇이든 먹기 때문에 더러운 강이나 호수에서도 살 수 있다. 누구도 주목하지 않는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 제일 볼품없는 포켓몬이다. 수초가 많은 강바닥에 한데 모여 살고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 태어날 때부터 지느러미가 너덜너덜 보기 흉해서 아무도 상대해주지 않는 포켓몬이다. 바다와 강 양쪽 모두에서 생활할 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Feebas’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸은 엉망이지만 어디에서든 살아갈 수 있는 끈질긴 생명력을 지닌 포켓몬이다. 하지만 아둔해서 금방 붙잡힌다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): While Feebas’s body is in tatters, it has a hardy and tenacious life force that enables it to live anywhere. However, this Pokémon is also slow and dimwitted, making it an easy catch.
Description (ko, sun): 더러운 물이라도 아무렇지 않은 터프한 포켓몬. 하지만 추레하고 초라해서 인기는 없다.
Description (en, sun): A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn’t popular.
Description (ko, moon): 겉모습이 좋지 않아 인기는 없지만 경이로운 생명력을 지니고 있어 연구대상이 되고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 모습이 초라해서 아무도 잡지 않는다. 맛없어 보여서 아무도 먹지 않는다. 결과적으로 개체 수만 점점 늘어난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They look ragged, so no one catches them. They look like they’d taste bad, so predators won’t eat them. And their numbers continue to grow.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 외모가 초라해서 대부분 사람은 거들떠보지도 않지만 빈티나만을 모으는 컬렉터도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Because of its wretched appearance, most people pay it no attention, but there are some who collect Feebas—and Feebas alone!
Description (ko, sword): 겉모습이 좋지 않아 인기는 없지만 경이로운 생명력을 지니고 있어 연구 대상이 되고 있다.
Description (ko, shield): 볼품없고 못생긴 포켓몬이지만 강인한 생명력을 가져 약간의 물만 있어도 살아남는다.

document.body:

Name (en): Milotic
Description (en, ruby): MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
Description (en, sapphire): MILOTIC live at the bottom of large lakes. When this POKéMON’s body glows a vivid pink, it releases a pulsing wave of energy that brings soothing calm to restless spirits.

Description (en, x): Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

Description (en, y): It is the world’s most beautiful Pokémon. There are many works of art featuring Milotic.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 가장 아름다운 포켓몬이라고 불리고 있다. 분노나 증오의 마음을 치유하여 분쟁을 진정시키는 힘을 지니고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 큰 호수의 밑바닥에 살고 있다. 몸이 선명한 핑크빛으로 반짝일 때 피폐해진 마음을 치유하는 파동을 발산한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Milotic live at the bottom of large lakes. When this Pokémon’s body glows a vivid pink, it releases a pulsing wave of energy that brings soothing calm to troubled hearts.
Description (ko, sun): 가장 아름다운 포켓몬으로 불리며 많은 예술가에게 영감을 주고 있다.
Description (en, sun): Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
Description (ko, moon): 맑은 호수 바닥에 산다. 전쟁이 일어날 때 나타나 사람들의 마음을 치유한다.
Description (en, moon): It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people’s minds and hearts.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 가장 아름답다고 하지만 빈티나가 좋아서 기른 트레이너에게는 미묘한 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While Milotic is said to be the most beautiful Pokémon, Trainers who like Feebas and have raised it are seemingly disappointed by Milotic.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 큰 호수 바닥에 산다. 아름다운 그 모습은 보는 이의 마음의 부정함을 없앤다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its dwelling place is the bottom of big lakes. Those who behold its loveliness are said to have their hearts purified.
Description (ko, shield): 밀로틱의 아름다운 모습을 본 자는 황폐해진 마음이 치유된다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Castform
ID: 351
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 캐스퐁
Name (en): Castform
Description (en, ruby): CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
Description (en, sapphire): CASTFORM borrows the power of nature to transform itself into the guises of the sun, rain clouds, and snow clouds. This POKéMON’s feelings change with the weather.
Description (en, emerald): It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
Description (en, firered): It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.
Description (en, diamond): Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
Description (en, heartgold): This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.
Description (en, black-2): Temperature and weather affect its cellular structure, so this Pokémon changes form according to the weather.
Description (ko, x): 기온이나 습도의 변화가 몸의 세포에 영향을 주어 모습을 바꾸는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 자연의 힘을 받아 태양, 빗물, 설운으로 모습을 바꾸는 능력을 가지고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 날씨에 따라 모습이 바뀌는 포켓몬이다. 작은 몸을 지키기 위해 대자연의 거대한 힘을 사용할 수 있게 됐다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Castform’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 자연의 힘을 받아 태양과 빗방울 그리고 설운으로 모습을 바꾸는 포켓몬이다. 날씨가 바뀌면 기질도 바뀐다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Castform borrows the power of nature to transform itself into the guises of the sun, rain, and snow-clouds. This Pokémon’s feelings change with the weather.
Description (ko, sun): 날씨에 따라 모습을 바꾼다. 기온과 습도의 변화가 세포에 영향을 준다고 한다.
Description (en, sun): It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
Description (ko, moon): 기온이나 습도에 세포가 민감하게 반응해 모습이 멋대로 변해버린다.
Description (en, moon): Its form changes on its own, due to its cells’ sensitive reactions to temperature and humidity.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 날씨에 따라 모습이 바뀌지만, 화학 반응의 결과일 뿐 자신의 의지는 아닌 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although its form changes with the weather, that is apparently the result of a chemical reaction and not the result of its own free will.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 날씨에 따라 모습이 바뀐다. 날씨가 궂을수록 성질도 난폭해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!
