document.title: Kecleon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kecleon
ID: 352
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 켈리몬
Name (en): Kecleon
Description (en, ruby): KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
Description (en, sapphire): KECLEON alters its body coloration to blend in with its surroundings, allowing it to sneak up on its prey unnoticed. Then it lashes out with its long, stretchy tongue to instantly ensnare the unsuspecting target.
Description (en, emerald): A POKéMON that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if it is startled.
Description (en, firered): It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.
Description (en, diamond): It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
Description (en, heartgold): It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.
Description (ko, x): 몸의 색을 자유롭게 바꾸는 능력을 가지고 있다. 배에 있는 톱니무늬만은 바뀌지 않는다.
Description (ko, y): 몸의 색을 바꿔 풍경에 녹아들어 먹이에게 다가간다. 배의 모양은 지울 수 없다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸의 색을 자유로이 바꿔서 주변의 경치에 녹아들 수 있다. 배의 삐쭉삐쭉한 무늬만은 바꿀 수 없다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception—this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸을 경치와 같은 색으로 바꿔 먹이에게 들키지 않고 살며시 다가간다. 길게 늘어나는 혓바닥으로 빠르게 잡는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Kecleon alters its body coloration to blend in with its surroundings, allowing it to sneak up on its prey unnoticed. Then it lashes out with its long, stretchy tongue to instantly ensnare the unsuspecting target.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸의 색을 바꿔 경치에 녹아든다. 오랫동안 방치하면 토라져서 모습을 볼 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 숨을 때 말고도 기분이나 컨디션에 따라 몸의 색이 바뀐다. 색이 진할수록 건강하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

document.title: Shuppet — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Shuppet
ID: 353
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 어둠대신
Name (en): Shuppet
Description (en, ruby): SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
Description (en, sapphire): SHUPPET grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people. It roams through cities in search of grudges that taint people.
Description (en, emerald): This POKéMON roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.
Description (en, firered): It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.
Description (en, diamond): It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
Description (en, heartgold): It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
Description (en, black-2): It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.
Description (ko, x): 머리의 뿔로 원한과 질투의 감정을 먹는다고 전해진다. 한밤중에 활발하게 활동한다.
Description (en, x): It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice-- or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
Description (ko, y): 원망하는 감정을 매우 좋아한다. 원한을 가지고 있는 사람이 사는 집 처마 밑에 죽 매달려 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 질투와 원한의 감정에 이끌린다. 누군가를 원망하는 마음이 강해지면 어둠대신이 처마 밑에 죽 줄을 선다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Shuppet is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 사람의 마음속에 있는 원한과 질투 같은 감정을 먹고 성장하는 포켓몬이다. 원망하는 마음을 찾아 마을을 헤맨다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Shuppet grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people. It roams through cities in search of grudges that taint people.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 원한, 시샘, 질투 같은 감정을 먹기 때문에 사람에게는 고마운 존재다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 해질녘에 어둠대신이 줄지어 있는 집과는 어울리지 말라는 오랜 속담이 남아 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

document.title: Banette — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Banette
ID: 354
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 다크펫
Name (en): Banette
Description (en, ruby): BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
Description (en, sapphire): A cursed energy permeated the stuffing of a discarded and forgotten plush doll, giving it new life as BANETTE. The POKéMON’s energy would escape if it were to ever open its mouth.
Description (en, emerald): An abandoned plush doll became this POKéMON. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.
Description (en, firered): Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.
Description (en, diamond): A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
Description (en, heartgold): This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.
Description (en, black-2): A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge of being thrown away. It seeks the child who disowned it.
Description (ko, x): 버려진 인형에 원념이 깃들어 포켓몬이 되었다. 자신을 버린 아이를 찾고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 강한 원념이 인형을 포켓몬으로 바꿨다. 입을 열면 저주의 에너지가 빠져나간다.
Description (en, y): Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자신의 몸을 바늘로 상처 낼 때 강한 저주 에너지가 발생한다. 원래는 버려진 불쌍한 인형이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 버려진 인형의 솜에 저주 에너지가 스며들어 포켓몬이 되었다. 입을 열면 에너지가 빠져나간다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): A cursed energy permeated the stuffing of a discarded and forgotten plush doll, giving it new life as Banette. The Pokémon’s energy would escape if it were to ever open its mouth.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 버려진 인형에 원념이 깃들었다. 자신을 버린 자를 찾아내 복수할 셈이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 버려진 원념에 의해 태어난다. 소중히 대하면 만족해서 원래의 인형으로 돌아간다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

document.title: Duskull — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Duskull
ID: 355
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 해골몽
Name (en): Duskull
Description (en, ruby): DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
Description (en, sapphire): DUSKULL wanders lost among the deep darkness of midnight. There is an oft- told admonishment given to misbehaving children that this POKéMON will spirit away bad children who earn scoldings from their mothers.
Description (en, emerald): A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal POKéMON that roams about under the cloak of darkness.
Description (en, firered): Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.
Description (en, diamond): It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
Description (en, platinum): It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
Description (en, heartgold): If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.
Description (ko, x): 어디까지라도 먹이를 쫓아가는 집념이 강한 성격이지만 아침 해가 떠오르면 포기한다.
Description (ko, y): 말을 잘 안 듣는 아이를 발견하면 한밤중에 어딘가로 데려간다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 아무리 두꺼운 벽이라도 통과한다. 한 번 노려지면 아침 해가 뜰 때까지 계속 쫓겨 다니게 된다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Duskull can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 한밤중 어둠에 섞여 떠돌고 있다. 엄마에게 꾸중을 듣는 나쁜 아이는 해골몽이 잡아간다는 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Duskull wanders lost among the deep darkness of midnight. There is an oft-told admonishment given to misbehaving children that this Pokémon will spirit away bad children who earn scoldings from their mothers.
Description (en, sword): If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.
Description (ko, shield): 모습을 투명하게 하고 몰래 먹잇감에 다가간다. 두꺼운 벽을 통과하는 능력을 지녔다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

document.title: Dusclops — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dusclops
ID: 356
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 미라몽
Name (en): Dusclops
Description (en, ruby): DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
Description (en, sapphire): DUSCLOPS absorbs anything, however large the object may be. This POKéMON hypnotizes its foe by waving its hands in a macabre manner and by bringing its single eye to bear. The hypnotized foe is made to do DUSCLOPS’s bidding.
Description (en, emerald): It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.
Description (en, firered): Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
Description (en, diamond): Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.
Description (en, platinum): It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
Description (en, heartgold): Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
Description (ko, x): 몸 안에서 불타고 있는 도깨비불을 들여다보면 영혼을 빼앗겨버린다.
Description (ko, y): 몸 안은 빈 공간으로 이루어져 있어서 들여다본 상대를 빨아들여 버린다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸 안에는 텅 비어서 아무것도 없다. 블랙홀처럼 무엇이든 빨아들이며 빨려 들어가면 되돌아 올 수 없다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dusclops’s body is completely hollow—there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 아무리 큰 것도 빨아들인다. 괴상한 손의 움직임과 외눈의 힘으로 상대를 최면 상태로 만들어 조종한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Dusclops absorbs anything, however large the object may be. This Pokémon hypnotizes its foe by waving its hands in a macabre manner and by bringing its single eye to bear. The hypnotized foe is made to do Dusclops’s bidding.
Description (ko, sword): 몸속은 텅 비어 있다. 입을 열면 블랙홀처럼 무엇이든 빨아들인다.
Description (ko, shield): 떠도는 사람의 영혼을 찾아 텅 빈 체내로 빨아들인다. 그 후 영혼이 어떻게 되는지는 알 수 없다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

document.title: Tropius — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tropius
ID: 357
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 트로피우스
Name (en): Tropius
Description (en, ruby): The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
Description (en, sapphire): Children of the southern tropics eat as snacks the fruit that grows in bunches around the neck of TROPIUS. This POKéMON flies by flapping the leaves on its back as if they were wings.
Description (en, emerald): It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.
Description (en, firered): It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
Description (en, diamond): Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.
Description (en, platinum): Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
Description (en, heartgold): The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.
Description (en, black-2): It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.
Description (ko, x): 커다란 잎으로 하늘을 날며 아이들에게 인기가 많은 목에 생기는 달콤한 과일을 나눠준다.
Description (ko, y): 목의 송이는 1년에 2번 열매를 맺는다. 달고 맛있다. 남쪽에 사는 아이들의 간식이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 목에 난 송이는 달콤해서 아이들에게 인기가 많다. 과일을 매우 좋아하여 계속 먹다 보니 목에 과일이 열리게 됐다고 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The bunches of fruit around Tropius’s neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 남쪽 나라의 아이들은 트로피우스의 목에 난 과일 송이를 간식으로 먹는다. 등의 잎사귀를 펄럭거려 하늘을 난다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Children of the southern tropics eat as snacks the fruit that grows in bunches around the neck of Tropius. This Pokémon flies by flapping the leaves on its back as if they were wings.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 알로라에 사는 트로피우스는 다른 지방에 비해 목에 열리는 송이가 특히 달콤하고 맛있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 목에 난 송이는 맛있어서 인기다. 따뜻한 장소에는 트로피우스를 키우는 목장이 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

document.title: Chimecho — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Chimecho
ID: 358
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 치렁
Name (en): Chimecho
Description (en, ruby): CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
Description (en, sapphire): In high winds, CHIMECHO cries as it hangs from a tree branch or the eaves of a building using a suction cup on its head. This POKéMON plucks berries with its long tail and eats them.
Description (en, emerald): They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.
Description (en, firered): It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.
Description (en, diamond): To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.
Description (en, pearl): Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
Description (en, platinum): Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
Description (en, heartgold): It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
Description (ko, x): 머리의 빨판으로 나뭇가지나 집의 처마 밑에 매달린다. 7종류의 음색을 나누어 쓴다.
Description (ko, y): 초음파 울음소리를 가지고 있다. 둥둥 떠서 바람을 타고 긴 거리를 여행한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 목소리를 몸의 빈 곳에 메아리치게 한다. 화가 났을 때의 울음소리는 적을 날려버릴 위력을 지닌 초음파가 된다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 바람이 강해지면 나뭇가지나 처마 끝에 머리의 흡반으로 매달려 울기 시작한다. 긴 꼬리로 나무열매를 집어서 먹는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): In high winds, Chimecho cries as it hangs from a tree branch or the eaves of a building using a suction cup on its head. This Pokémon plucks berries with its long tail and eats them.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

document.title: Absol — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Absol
ID: 359
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 앱솔
Name (en): Absol
Description (en, ruby): Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
Description (en, sapphire): ABSOL has the ability to foretell the coming of natural disasters. It lives in a harsh, rugged mountain environment. This POKéMON very rarely ventures down from the mountains.
Description (en, emerald): It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived POKéMON that has a life-span of 100 years.
Description (en, firered): It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.
Description (en, diamond): It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
Description (en, platinum): Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
Description (en, heartgold): It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.
Description (en, black-2): It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.
Description (ko, x): 재해의 위험을 감지한다. 위험을 알리는 때에만 사람 앞에 나타난다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 재해의 징조를 느끼면 모습을 보이기 때문에 재앙을 부르는 포켓몬으로 오해받고 있었다.
Description (en, y): It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom bringer.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 앱솔이 사람들 앞에 나타나면 반드시 지진이나 해일 등의 재해가 일어나서 재난포켓몬이라는 별명으로 불렸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 자연재해를 감지하는 힘을 지녔다. 험한 산악 지대에 서식하며 좀처럼 산기슭에는 내려오지 않는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Absol has the ability to foretell the coming of natural disasters. It lives in a harsh, rugged mountain environment. This Pokémon very rarely ventures down from the mountains.
Description (ko, sun): 미신이 만연했던 옛날에 재앙을 초래한다고 미움을 받아 산속으로 쫓겨났다.
Description (en, sun): Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.
Description (ko, moon): 재앙을 가져온다고 전해지지만 실제로는 온화한 성질이다. 재해의 위기를 사람들에게 알린다.
Description (en, moon): Although it’s said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 비록 겉모습은 불길하지만 논밭을 지키거나 이변을 사람에게 알려 주는 고마운 존재다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 노인들은 재난포켓몬이라고 부르며 미워하지만 재해를 예지하는 능력에 관심이 높아지고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

document.title: Wynaut — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Wynaut
ID: 360
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마자
Name (en): Wynaut
Description (en, ruby): WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
Description (en, sapphire): WYNAUT gather on moonlit nights to play by squeezing up against each other. By being squeezed, this POKéMON gains endurance and is trained to dole out powerful counterattacks.
Description (en, emerald): A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.
Description (en, firered): It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
Description (en, diamond): It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
Description (en, heartgold): It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
Description (ko, x): 무리를 지어 행동하는 습성이 있다. 잠들 때는 동굴 안에서 동료들과 서로 몸을 붙인다.
Description (ko, y): 동료들과 밀어내기 놀이를 하면서 인내심이 강한 성격으로 자란다. 달콤한 과일을 매우 좋아한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 언제나 싱글벙글 미소 짓는 마자. 화났을 때는 꼬리에 주목하자. 땅을 탁탁 치고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 달밤에 동료들과 밀어내기 놀이를 한다. 이리저리 밀리면 인내심이 강해진다. 강렬한 카운터를 쓰는 훈련이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Wynaut gather on moonlit nights to play by squeezing up against each other. By being squeezed, this Pokémon gains endurance and is trained to dole out powerful counterattacks.
Description (ko, sword): 많은 동료와 함께 행동한다. 밀어내기 놀이로 인내심과 근성을 강하게 단련한다.

document.title: Snorunt — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Snorunt
ID: 361
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 눈꼬마
Name (en): Snorunt
Description (en, ruby): SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
Description (en, sapphire): SNORUNT survives by eating only snow and ice. Old folklore claims that a house visited by this POKéMON is sure to prosper for many generations to come.
Description (en, emerald): They tend to move about in groups of around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
Description (en, firered): It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (en, diamond): In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.
Description (en, platinum): It is said that several SNORUNT gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
Description (en, heartgold): It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.
Description (en, black): It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
Description (ko, x): 커다란 잎사귀 아래서 여러 마리의 눈꼬마가 모여 사이좋게 살고 있다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 눈꼬마가 자리 잡은 집은 부자가 된다고 하는 전설이 설국에는 남아 있다.
Description (en, y): In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 눈이 많은 땅에서 사는 포켓몬이다. 봄이나 여름처럼 눈이 내리지 않는 계절에는 석회암 동굴 깊은 곳에서 조용히 산다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Snorunt live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 눈이나 얼음만 먹고 생활하고 있다. 눈꼬마가 찾아간 집은 대대로 번창한다는 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Snorunt survives by eating only snow and ice. Old folklore claims that a house visited by this Pokémon is sure to prosper for many generations to come.
Description (ko, sun): 어느새 알로라에서 늘어나 있었다. 눈꼬마가 살고 있는 집은 자자손손 번창한다고 한다.
Description (en, sun): Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.
Description (ko, moon): 추운 땅에서만 살 수 있다. 영하 100도의 환경에서도 건강하게 뛰어다닌다.
Description (en, moon): It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 눈과 얼음이 주요 먹이다. 따듯한 알로라에서는 한정된 장소에서만 살 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It’s only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 추운 토지의 부자들은 모두 어린 시절에 눈꼬마와 놀았던 추억이 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Rich people from cold areas all share childhood memories of playing with Snorunt.
Description (ko, sword): 한밤중에 나타나는 눈꼬마는 큰 눈을 내리게 한다고 전해진다. 눈과 얼음을 먹으며 지낸다.
Description (en, shield): It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

document.title: Glalie — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Glalie
ID: 362
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 얼음귀신
Name (en): Glalie
Description (en, ruby): GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
Description (en, sapphire): GLALIE has the ability to freely control ice. For example, it can instantly freeze its foe solid. After immobilizing its foe in ice, this POKéMON enjoys eating it in leisurely fashion.
Description (en, emerald): A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.
Description (en, firered): It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
Description (en, diamond): To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
Description (en, platinum): It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
Description (en, heartgold): It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.
Description (ko, x): 공기 중의 수분을 얼려서 얼음 갑옷으로 몸을 둘러싸 몸을 보호한다.
Description (en, x): To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
Description (ko, y): 공기 중의 수분을 단숨에 얼게 하는 힘으로 먹이를 냉동시켜 버린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 바위로 된 몸을 얼음 갑옷으로 단단히 했다. 공기 중의 수분을 얼려서 자유로운 형태로 바꾸는 능력을 지닌 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 얼음을 자유롭게 사용하는 힘을 지녔다. 먹이를 한순간에 얼려 움직이지 못하게 하고 맛있게 먹는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Glalie has the ability to freely control ice. For example, it can instantly freeze its prey solid. After immobilizing its prey in ice, this Pokémon enjoys eating it in leisurely fashion.
Description (ko, sun): 등정을 코앞에 둔 설산에서 조난당한 등산가의 원통함이 바위에 씌어서 태어났다고 한다.
Description (en, sun): Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.
Description (ko, moon): 커다란 입에서 뿜는 냉기로 먹이는 한순간에 꽁꽁. 그대로 아드득아드득 잡아먹는다.
Description (en, moon): Its prey is instantaneously frozen stiff by the cold air it exhales from its huge mouth. While they’re in that frozen state, it gobbles them up.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹이를 얼려 통째로 갉아먹는다. 하지만 바닐프티처럼 처음부터 얼어 있는 포켓몬을 더 좋아한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 그다지 단단하지 않은 바위가 본체다. 공기 중의 수분을 얼려 얼음의 장갑을 몸에 두른다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its actual body is a rock that isn’t particularly hard. Glalie absorbs moisture from the air and drapes itself in an armor of ice.
Description (ko, sword): 불꽃에도 녹지 않는 얼음으로 된 몸. 공기 중의 수분을 순식간에 얼려버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

Description (en, sun): Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.
Description (ko, moon): 커다란 입에서 뿜는 냉기로 먹이는 한순간에 꽁꽁. 그대로 아드득아드득 잡아먹는다.
Description (en, moon): Its prey is instantaneously frozen stiff by the cold air it exhales from its huge mouth. While they’re in that frozen state, it gobbles them up.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹이를 얼려 통째로 갉아먹는다. 하지만 바닐프티처럼 처음부터 얼어 있는 포켓몬을 더 좋아한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 그다지 단단하지 않은 바위가 본체다. 공기 중의 수분을 얼려 얼음의 장갑을 몸에 두른다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its actual body is a rock that isn’t particularly hard. Glalie absorbs moisture from the air and drapes itself in an armor of ice.
Description (ko, sword): 불꽃에도 녹지 않는 얼음으로 된 몸. 공기 중의 수분을 순식간에 얼려버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

document.title: Spheal — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Spheal
ID: 363
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 대굴레오
Name (en): Spheal
Description (en, ruby): SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
Description (en, sapphire): SPHEAL always travels by rolling around on its ball-like body. When the season for ice floes arrives, this POKéMON can be seen rolling about on ice and crossing the sea.
Description (en, emerald): It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
Description (en, firered): Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.
Description (en, diamond): It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
Description (en, heartgold): It crosses the oceans by rolling itself on drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm when the temperature is below freezing.
Description (en, black-2): They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
Description (ko, x): 아직 능숙하게 헤엄치지 못하고 구르는 쪽이 빨리 움직일 수 있다. 기쁘면 다 같이 손뼉을 친다.
Description (ko, y): 북실북실한 털로 몸이 뒤덮여있기 때문에 얼음 위를 굴러도 차갑지 않다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 걷는 것보다 구르는 편이 단연 빠르다. 식사 시간에는 모두가 일제히 손뼉을 치며 기뻐하기 때문에 꽤 시끄럽다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Spheal is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 항상 굴러서 이동하는 포켓몬이다. 얼음이 떠다니는 계절에는 얼음 위를 굴러 바다를 건너는 모습을 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Spheal always travels by rolling around on its ball-like body. When the season for ice floes arrives, this Pokémon can be seen rolling about on ice and crossing the sea.
Description (ko, sword): 두꺼운 지방에 둘러싸인 완벽하게 둥근 몸을 가졌다. 걷는 것보다 굴러가는 게 더 빠르다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon’s body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It’s faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.
Description (ko, shield): 파도에 떠다니며 바다의 상태를 살핀다. 먹이를 발견하면 무리의 씨카이저에게 알린다.
Description (en, shield): As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probes the sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs the Walrein in its herd.
Description (en, legends-arceus): During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

document.title: Sealeo — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sealeo
ID: 364
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 씨레오
Name (en): Sealeo
Description (en, ruby): SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
Description (en, sapphire): SEALEO often balances and rolls things on the tip of its nose. While the POKéMON is rolling something, it checks the object’s aroma and texture to determine whether it likes the object or not.
Description (en, emerald): SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.
Description (en, firered): It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.
Description (en, diamond): It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
Description (en, heartgold): It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
Description (en, black-2): Be it Spheal or Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.
Description (ko, x): 코의 신경이 민감하다. 처음 보는 것은 코로 문질러서 기억한다.
Description (ko, y): 둥글면 몬스터볼이든 대굴레오든 코 위에 올려 자유자재로 빙글빙글 돌린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 처음 본 것은 반드시 코로 빙글빙글 돌려보는 습성을 지녔다. 대굴레오를 돌리며 놀기도 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a Spheal on its nose.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 늘 코로 무언가를 돌리고 있다. 돌리면서 냄새나 감촉을 확인하여 좋아하는 것과 싫어하는 것을 구별한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Sealeo often balances and rolls things on the tip of its nose. While the Pokémon is rolling something, it checks the object’s aroma and texture to determine whether it likes the object or not.
Description (ko, sword): 유빙 위에서 생활한다. 헤엄치다가 먹이의 냄새를 맡고는 찾아내서 잡는다.
Description (en, sword): Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimming when they’re on the hunt, seeking out their prey by scent.
Description (ko, shield): 대굴레오나 몬스터볼 등 둥근 것이라면 뭐든지 코 위에 올려놓고 돌리는 습성이 있다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round things on its nose, whether those things are Poké Balls or Spheal.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

document.title: Walrein — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Walrein
ID: 365
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 씨카이저
Name (en): Walrein
Description (en, ruby): WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
Description (en, sapphire): WALREIN swims all over in frigid seawater while crushing icebergs with its grand, imposing tusks. Its thick layer of blubber makes enemy attacks bounce off harmlessly.
Description (en, emerald): To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.
Description (en, firered): It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.
Description (en, diamond): It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
Description (en, heartgold): It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.
Description (en, black-2): Not only does its thick blubber keep it warm, it also protects it from attacks. It shatters ice with its prized tusks.
Description (ko, x): 큰 얼음을 이빨로 부순다. 두꺼운 지방은 추위뿐만 아니라 상대의 공격도 이겨낸다.
Description (ko, y): 믿음직한 송곳니로 유빙을 부스러뜨린다. 두꺼운 지방으로 적의 공격을 이겨낸다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 발달한 2개의 이빨은 10톤이나 되는 빙산을 일격에 분쇄한다. 지방이 두꺼워서 영하의 기온에서도 끄떡없다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Walrein’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing 10 tons with one blow. This Pokémon’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 큰 이빨로 빙산을 깨트리며 영하의 바다를 헤엄쳐 다닌다. 두꺼운 지방이 공격을 튕겨낸다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Walrein swims all over in frigid seawater while crushing icebergs with its grand, imposing tusks. Its thick layer of blubber makes enemy attacks bounce off harmlessly.
Description (ko, sword): 2, 30마리가 무리를 이룬다. 적에게 공격받으면 리더는 몸을 던져서 무리를 지킨다.
Description (en, sword): Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals. When a threat appears, the herd’s leader will protect the group with its life.
Description (ko, shield): 이빨은 평생 자란다. 싸우다 부러져도 1년이 지나면 원래의 훌륭한 이빨로 복원된다.
Description (en, shield): Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

document.title: Clamperl — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Clamperl
ID: 366
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 진주몽
Name (en): Clamperl
Description (en, ruby): CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
Description (en, sapphire): CLAMPERL grows while being protected by its rock-hard shell. When its body becomes too large to fit inside the shell, it is sure evidence that this POKéMON is getting close to evolution.
Description (en, emerald): A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.
Description (en, firered): It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.
Description (en, diamond): It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
Description (en, heartgold): When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.
Description (ko, x): 일생에 한 번 진화할 때 사이코 파워를 증폭시키는 이상한 진주를 만든다.
Description (ko, y): 단단한 껍데기로 감싸여 평생 동안 단 1개의 훌륭한 진주를 만든다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 튼튼한 껍데기는 몸을 지키는 것뿐 아니라 먹이를 집어서 잡을 수도 있다. 성장한 진주몽의 조개껍데기는 상처투성이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Clamperl’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection—it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 단단한 껍데기에 보호받으며 성장한다. 몸이 껍데기보다 커져 버리면 진화의 순간이 가까워진 증거다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Clamperl grows while being protected by its rock-hard shell. When its body becomes too large to fit inside the shell, it is sure evidence that this Pokémon is getting close to evolution.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 보기와는 다르게 육식이다. 2개의 껍질로 먹이를 꽉 물고 움직이지 않을 때까지 놓지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 진주몽의 진주는 매우 귀하다. 셀러의 진주의 10배 이상 가치가 있다고도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Huntail
ID: 367
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 헌테일
Name (en): Huntail
Description (en, ruby): HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
Description (en, sapphire): HUNTAIL’s tail is shaped like a fish. It uses the tail to attract prey, then swallows the prey whole with its large, gaping mouth. This POKéMON swims by wiggling its slender body like a snake.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Huntail’s tail is shaped like a fish. It uses the tail to attract prey, then swallows the prey whole with its large, gaping mouth. This Pokémon swims by wiggling its slender body like a snake.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 헤엄치는 힘은 그다지 강하지 않다. 꼬리를 흔들어 먹이를 유인해 다가오면 덥석 문다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 심해에 서식한다. 헌테일이 해변에 올라오면 불길한 일이 일어난다는 전설이 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gorebyss

Name (ko): 분홍장이
Name (en): Gorebyss
Description (en, ruby): GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 헤엄치는 모습은 우아하고 매우 아름답지만 먹이를 발견하면 가는 입을 몸에 박아 넣고 체액을 후루룩 마신다.

Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸의 색깔은 물의 온도로 변화한다. 알로라의 분홍장이는 눈부실 정도로 선명한 빛깔을 지녔다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.

Name (en): Relicanth
Description (en, ruby): RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.

Description (ko, sun): 1억 년 전부터 같은 모습이다. 체내가 기름투성이라서 심해의 수압을 견딜 수 있다.
Description (en, sun): Its form has remained the same for one hundred million years. Its body is filled with fat, so it can withstand the water pressure of the deep sea.
Description (ko, moon): 심해 조사 중 우연히 발견되었다. 이빨이 퇴화하여 빨아들이듯 미생물을 먹는다.
Description (en, moon): It was fortuitously discovered during a deep sea expedition. Its teeth have atrophied, so it now survives on microscopic organisms it sucks up.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 멸종되었고 여겨져 왔다. 시라칸의 이름은 발견한 사람의 이름을 따서 만들어졌다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 1억년 동안 전혀 모습이 바뀌지 않은 것은 생명체로서 완성되었기 때문이라고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The reason it hasn’t changed at all in a hundred million years is that it’s apparently already a perfect life-form.
Description (ko, sword): 바위처럼 단단한 비늘과 기름으로 가득 찬 부레로 심해의 수압을 견딘다.
Description (en, sword): Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.
Description (ko, shield): 심해 조사를 통해 발견되었다. 1억 년 동안 모습이 변하지 않아 살아 있는 화석이라고 불린다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

document.title: Luvdisc — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Luvdisc
ID: 370
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 사랑동이
Name (en): Luvdisc
Description (en, ruby): LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
Description (en, sapphire): LUVDISC’s heart-shaped body is a symbol of love and romance. It is said that any couple meeting this POKéMON is promised a loving relationship that never ends.
Description (en, emerald): LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one’s feelings of love.
Description (en, firered): During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.
Description (en, diamond): It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
Description (en, heartgold): Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a LUVDISC to someone you love.
Description (ko, x): 따뜻한 바다에서 서식한다. 사랑동이를 발견한 커플은 영원한 사랑이 지속된다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 번식기에는 많은 사랑동이가 산호초에 모여들어서 해수면이 핑크색으로 물든다.
Description (en, y): During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 열대의 얕은 바다에서 살고 있다. 커플을 발견하면 뒤에 붙어서 헤엄치기 때문에 이런 이름이 붙었다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Luvdisc live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 하트 모양의 몸은 애정의 상징이다. 사랑동이를 만난 커플에게는 영원한 사랑이 약속된다고 전해진다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Luvdisc’s heart-shaped body is a symbol of love and romance. It is said that any couple meeting this Pokémon is promised a loving relationship that never ends.
Description (ko, sun): 혼자가 된 사랑동이는 기력이 없어지고 빈틈이 많다. 그럴 때 패리퍼가 잡아간다.
Description (en, sun): If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes despondent, leaving itself open to attack. That is when Pelipper snatch them up.
Description (ko, moon): 커플에게 인기가 높아서 신혼 여행객이 묵는 호텔의 수영장에 방류된다.
Description (en, moon): Loving couples have a soft spot for this Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release this Pokémon into their pools.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 하트 모양의 비늘을 갖고 있으면 연인이 생긴다는 소문이 돌아 남획된 시대도 있었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): There was an era when it was overfished due to the rumor that having one of its heart-shaped scales would enable you to find a sweetheart.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 따뜻한 바다의 산호초가 서식지다. 코산호의 가지 사이에서 자는 것을 특히 좋아한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

document.title: Bagon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bagon
ID: 371
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아공이
Name (en): Bagon
Description (en, ruby): BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
Description (en, sapphire): BAGON harbors a never-ending dream of one day soaring high among the clouds. As if trying to dispel its frustration over its inability to fly, this POKéMON slams its hard head against huge rocks and shatters them into pebbles.
Description (en, emerald): Although it is small, this POKéMON is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.
Description (en, firered): Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.
Description (en, diamond): Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
Description (en, heartgold): Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike head can smash boulders into pieces.
Description (ko, x): 단련된 목 근육과 철과 같이 단단한 머리로 커다란 바위를 조각조각으로 부순다.
Description (en, x): Its well-developed neck muscles and iron-like head can smash boulders into pieces.
Description (ko, y): 넓은 하늘을 나는 것을 꿈꾸며 매일 나는 연습을 하려고 절벽에서 뛰어내린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 넓은 하늘을 나는 것을 꿈꾸며 연거푸 낭떠러지에서 뛰어내리다 보니 머리가 단련되어 강철처럼 단단해졌다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Bagon has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 넓은 하늘을 나는 것을 꿈꾸는 포켓몬이다. 날지 못하는 분함을 떨치기 위한 것인 양 큰 바위에 돌머리를 부딪쳐서 산산조각으로 부순다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Bagon harbors a never-ending dream of one day soaring high among the clouds. As if trying to dispel its frustration over its inability to fly, this Pokémon slams its hard head against huge rocks and shatters them into pebbles.
Description (ko, sun): 언젠가 날 수 있다고 믿는 것은 유전자 안의 정보가 영향을 주고 있기 때문이라고 한다.
Description (en, sun): Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.
Description (ko, moon): 강철 수준의 돌머리로 마구잡이로 박치기한다. 하늘을 날 수 없는 스트레스 때문이다.
Description (en, moon): With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 하늘을 나는 새포켓몬을 볼 때마다 부러워서 머리로 주변에 있는 것을 들이받아 산산조각으로 부숴 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Whenever it sees bird Pokémon flying through the sky, it becomes envious and smashes its surroundings to bits with headbutts.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 머리를 강하게 부딪쳐서 진화에 영향을 주는 세포를 자극하고 있다는 설도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.
Description (ko, sword): 언젠가 하늘을 날기 위해 매일같이 절벽에서 뛰어내리며 몸을 단련하는 훈련을 계속하고 있다.
Description (en, sword): Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.
Description (ko, shield): 무리를 짓지 않고 혼자서 지낸다. 단단한 화석을 단 일격으로 두 동강 내버리는 돌머리를 가졌다.
Description (en, shield): Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

document.title: Shelgon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Shelgon
ID: 372
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 쉘곤
Name (en): Shelgon
Description (en, ruby): Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
Description (en, sapphire): Covering SHELGON’s body are outgrowths much like bones. The shell is very hard and bounces off enemy attacks. When awaiting evolution, this POKéMON hides away in a cavern.
Description (en, emerald): It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.
Description (en, firered): Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.
Description (en, diamond): Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
Description (en, heartgold): It surrounds its body in an iron-hard shell to accumulate enough power to evolve.
Description (ko, x): 단단한 껍질 안은 세포가 변화를 시작하고 있다. 진화하는 순간에 껍질이 벗겨져 떨어진다.
Description (ko, y): 모든 공격을 튕겨낸다. 너무 튼튼해서 몸이 무겁기 때문에 약간 움직임이 둔하다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 단단한 껍질 내부는 세포가 변화되어 새로운 몸을 만드는 중이다. 껍질이 매우 무거워서 움직임이 둔하다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Inside Shelgon’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸을 감싸고 있는 것은 뼈와 같은 것이다. 매우 단단해서 적의 공격을 튕겨낸다. 동굴에서 몸을 숨기고 진화를 기다리고 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Covering Shelgon’s body are outgrowths much like bones. The shell is very hard and bounces off enemy attacks. When awaiting evolution, this Pokémon hides away in a cavern.
Description (ko, sun): 껍질 안에서는 폭발적인 스피드로 세포가 변화하며 진화의 준비를 하고 있다.
Description (en, sun): The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.
Description (ko, moon): 동굴 깊숙한 곳에 가만히 숨어 아무것도 먹지도 마시지도 않는다. 어째서 죽지 않는지는 의문이다.
Description (en, moon): They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don’t die is not known.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 체내의 세포가 빠르게 변화하고 있는 중이다. 단단한 껍질은 뼈와 같은 성분이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The cells within its body are changing at a bewildering pace. Its hard shell is made from the same substance as bone.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 동굴 깊숙한 곳에 산다. 단단한 껍질 속에 틀어박혀 하늘을 나는 날을 꿈꾸고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.
Description (ko, sword): 뼈와 같은 성분으로 만들어진 단단한 껍질로 몸을 감쌌다. 진화의 에너지를 비축하고 있다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.
Description (ko, shield): 먹이를 먹지 않고 공복으로 버틴다. 모은 에너지를 다 사용하면 진화가 시작되는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

document.title: Salamence — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Salamence
ID: 373
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 보만다
Name (en): Salamence
Description (en, ruby): SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
Description (en, sapphire): By evolving into SALAMENCE, this POKéMON finally realizes its long-held dream of growing wings. To express its joy, it flies and wheels all over the sky while spouting flames from its mouth.
Description (en, emerald): After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
Description (en, firered): It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
Description (en, diamond): As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
Description (en, heartgold): It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.
Description (ko, x): 화나게 하면 어쩔 도리가 없다. 모든 것을 발톱으로 갈기갈기 찢고 불꽃으로 태워서 파괴한다.
Description (ko, y): 한번 화내면 크게 난동을 부린다. 하늘을 날며 지상의 산과 들을 불꽃으로 모조리 태운다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 날개가 갖고 싶다는 굳건한 바람이 계속된 결과 몸의 세포가 돌연변이를 일으켜서 멋진 날개가 돋아났다고 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 꿈에 그리던 날개가 드디어 생겨났다. 기쁜 마음을 표현하기 위해 넓은 하늘을 날아다니며 불꽃을 내뿜으며 기뻐한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): By evolving into Salamence, this Pokémon finally realizes its long-held dream of growing wings. To express its joy, it flies and wheels all over the sky while spouting flames from its mouth.
Description (ko, sun): 화가 나면 이성을 잃고 주변을 부수며 돌아다닌다. 보만다가 녹초가 될 때까지 파괴는 계속된다.
Description (en, sun): When angered, it loses all sense of itself and destroys everything around it. The destruction will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.
Description (ko, moon): 드디어 자라난 날개로 넓은 하늘을 날아다닌다. 기쁜 마음에 화염을 뿜어 일대를 불태워 버린다.
Description (en, moon): It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 드디어 날 수 있다는 기쁨에 넓은 하늘을 날아다닌다. 지쳐서 잠들기 전까지 지상으로 거의 내려오지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Overjoyed at finally being able to fly, it flies all over the place and usually doesn’t land until it’s completely exhausted and needs to sleep.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강하게 바라고 바란 결과 몸의 세포가 돌연변이를 일으켜서 염원하던 날개를 손에 넣었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart’s desire—wings.
Description (ko, sword): 하늘을 나는 것을 꿈꿔온 결과 날개를 가진 몸으로 진화하는 데 성공한 희귀한 포켓몬.
Description (en, sword): Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.
Description (ko, shield): 넓은 하늘을 나는 기쁨에 크게 들떠 있지만 화나게 하면 손 쓸 수 없을 정도로 난폭하다.
Description (en, shield): While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

document.body:

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메탕구
Name (en): Metang
Description (en, ruby): When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
Description (en, sapphire): When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This POKéMON turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.
Description (en, emerald): The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
Description (en, firered): It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.
Description (en, diamond): It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
Description (en, heartgold): When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
Description (en, black): It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
Description (en, black-2): It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

Description (ko, y): 2마리의 메탕이 합체했다. 2개의 뇌가 연결되었기 때문에 사이코 파워는 보다 강해졌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 두 마리의 메탕이 합체한 모습이다. 두 개의 뇌를 자력 신경이 묶고 있어서 강한 사이코 에너지를 만들어 낸다.

Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 두 마리의 메탕이 합체했을 때 두 개의 뇌가 자력 신경에 의해 이어진다. 팔을 뒤로 돌리고 고속으로 이동한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This Pokémon turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.
Description (ko, sun): 2마리의 메탕이 연결되어 사이코 파워는 두 배가 된다. 단, 영리함 자체는 변하지 않는다.
Description (en, sun): When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.
Description (ko, moon): 자력을 발산하는 광물을 좋아한다. 시속 100km로 코코파스를 몰아넣는다.
Description (en, moon): It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 2개의 뇌에서 강력한 사이코 에너지를 방사하여 먹이를 움직이지 못하게 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): With its two brains, it fires powerful psychic energy to stop its prey in their tracks.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 고속으로 하늘을 날아다니다가 먹이를 발견하면 날카로운 발톱으로 꽉 잡고 놓지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.
Description (ko, sword): 2마리의 메탕이 자력으로 합체했다. 2개의 두뇌로 인해 사이코 파워가 2배로 강화되었다.
Description (en, sword): Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
Description (ko, shield): 자력으로 하늘을 난다. 험준한 산들을 누비듯이 고속으로 비행하여 먹이를 쫓는다.
Description (en, shield): Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

document.title: Metagross — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Metagross
ID: 376
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메타그로스
Name (en): Metagross
Description (en, ruby): METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
Description (en, sapphire): METAGROSS is the result of two METANG achieving fusion. When hunting, this POKéMON pins the prey to the ground under its massive body. It then eats the helpless victim using the large mouth on its stomach.
Description (en, emerald): METAGROSS has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this POKéMON is smarter than a supercomputer.
Description (en, firered): It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
Description (en, diamond): METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
Description (en, heartgold): It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
Description (en, black): Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
Description (en, black-2): With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
Description (ko, x): 4개의 뇌가 연결되어 슈퍼컴퓨터보다 대단한 계산으로 상대를 분석한다.
Description (ko, y): 메탕구가 합체해서 생겨났다. 4개의 뇌를 가진 메타그로스는 슈퍼컴퓨터 수준의 지능이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 네 개의 뇌는 슈퍼컴퓨터보다 빨리 어려운 계산 문제를 푼다. 네 개의 다리를 접고 공중에 떠오른다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 두 마리의 메탕구가 합체한 모습이다. 거대한 체구로 먹이를 억누르며 배에 있는 큰 입으로 먹는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Metagross is the result of two Metang achieving fusion. When hunting, this Pokémon pins the prey to the ground under its massive body. It then eats the helpless victim using the large mouth on its stomach.
Description (ko, sun): 4개의 발톱과 큰 몸집으로 먹이를 확실하게 누른 후 배의 이빨로 으드득 씹는다.
Description (en, sun): It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.
Description (ko, moon): 2마리의 메탕구가 연결되었다. 4개의 뇌의 병렬처리로 어떤 계산도 순식간이다.
Description (en, moon): A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing parallel processing in its four brains.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 사이코 파워뿐만 아니라 괴력도 겸비하고 있다. 4개의 다리로 먹이를 붙잡고 발톱으로 움직이지 못하게 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It boasts not only psychic powers but also fantastic strength. It grabs its prey with its four legs and holds them in place with its claws.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 슈퍼컴퓨터보다 굉장한 판단력으로 상대를 분석하여 냉정하게 궁지에 몰아넣는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.
Description (ko, sword): 기온이 영하로 내려가면 자력이 강해지기 때문에 설산에 사는 메타그로스는 매우 기운이 넘친다.
Description (en, sword): Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.
Description (ko, shield): 2마리의 메탕구가 합체한 모습이다. 슈퍼컴퓨터 수준의 두뇌를 사용해 적을 쓰러뜨린다.
Description (en, shield): Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

Description (en, shield): This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Latios
ID: 381
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 라티오스
Name (en): Latios
Description (en, ruby): LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
Description (en, sapphire): LATIOS will only open its heart to a TRAINER with a compassionate spirit. This POKéMON can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
Description (en, emerald): Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

Description (en, diamond): A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
Description (en, heartgold): It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
Description (ko, x): 높은 지능을 가진 포켓몬이다. 팔을 접어 날면 제트기를 추월할 만큼 빠르다.
Description (ko, y): 높은 지능을 가졌기 때문에 인간의 말을 이해한다. 다툼을 싫어하는 상냥한 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 본 것이나 생각한 이미지를 상대에게 영상으로 보여주는 능력을 지녔다. 인간의 말을 이해할 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 상냥한 마음씨를 가진 자만을 따른다. 팔을 접으면 공기저항이 줄어 제트기보다 빠르게 하늘을 난다.

document.title: Kyogre — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kyogre
ID: 382
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 가이오가
Name (en): Kyogre
Description (en, ruby): KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
Description (en, sapphire): KYOGRE is named in mythology as the POKéMON that expanded the sea by covering the land with torrential rains and towering tidal waves. It took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with GROUDON.
Description (en, emerald): KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
Description (en, firered): This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.
Description (en, diamond): It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
Description (en, heartgold): A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.
Description (ko, x): 많은 비와 큰 해일로 바다를 넓힌 신화의 포켓몬이다. 그란돈과 격하게 싸웠다.
Description (en, x): A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
Description (ko, y): 많은 비를 내리게 하는 능력으로 바다를 넓혔다고 전해진다. 해구의 밑바닥에서 잠들어 있었다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 자연의 힘에 의해 원시회귀하여 원래의 모습을 되찾는다. 그 힘은 폭풍을 불러들이며 바다를 확장한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 바다의 화신이라 전해지는 포켓몬. 자연의 힘을 갈구하여 그란돈과 사투를 반복한다는 전설이 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

Name (en): Rayquaza
Description (en, ruby): RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
Description (en, sapphire): RAYQUAZA is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, above the clouds. Its existence had been completely unknown because it lived so high in the sky.
Description (en, emerald): A POKéMON that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON were to fight.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 깨어났을 때 머리에 있는 종이에 적힌 소원을 이루어준다는 전설을 가졌다. 위험을 느끼면 잠든 채로 싸운다.

document.body:

Description (en, pearl): It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.
Description (en, platinum): A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
Description (en, heartgold): It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
Description (ko, x): 신세를 지는 것을 싫어한다. 트레이너의 지시를 듣지 않아 친해지기 어렵다.
Description (ko, y): 자존심이 강해서 사람에게 먹이를 얻는 것을 싫어한다. 긴 솜털이 추위를 막는다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

Name (en): Empoleon

Description (en, pearl): It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
Description (en, platinum): If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
Description (en, heartgold): It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

Description (en, legends-arceus): Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

Name (en): Starly

Description (en, platinum): Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
Description (en, heartgold): They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
Description (ko, x): 많은 수가 무리를 이루어 행동한다. 몸은 작지만 날개 치는 힘은 매우 강하다.

Description (en, platinum): A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.

Name (ko): 꼬링크
Name (en): Shinx
Description (en, diamond): All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
Description (en, pearl): Its forelegs have a muscle-based system of generating electricity. Its body shines if endangered.
Description (en, platinum): The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
Description (en, heartgold): The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.
Description (ko, x): 몸을 움직일 때마다 근육이 늘어났다 줄어들었다 하여 전기가 발생한다. 궁지에 몰리면 몸이 빛난다.
Description (ko, y): 위험을 느끼면 전신의 털이 빛난다. 그로 인해 상대가 앞을 보지 못하는 동안 도망친다.
Description (ko, sword): 근육을 수축해서 전기를 만든다. 몸을 떠는 것은 격렬하게 전기를 발생시키고 있다는 증거다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
Description (ko, shield): 털이 전기로 빛난다. 밝게 빛나는 꼬리 끝을 흔들어 동료에게 신호를 보낸다.
Description (en, shield): Electricity makes this Pokémon’s fur glow. Shinx sends signals to others of its kind by shaking the tip of its tail while the tail tip is shining brightly.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

Description (en, heartgold): By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.
Description (ko, x): 발톱에서는 한 방에 적을 기절시킬 정도로 강한 전류가 흐른다. 여러 마리가 그룹을 이루어 산다.

Description (ko, shield): 적을 만나면 100만 볼트의 위력을 가진 발톱을 드러내어 싸움에 대비한다.
Description (en, shield): Upon encountering an opponent, this Pokémon prepares for battle by extending its claws, which can put out 1,000,000 volts of electricity.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

Name (ko): 렌트라
Name (en): Luxray
Description (en, diamond): It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
Description (en, pearl): When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.
Description (en, platinum): It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
Description (en, heartgold): LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
Description (ko, x): 눈동자가 금색으로 빛날 때 벽의 저편에 숨어 있는 먹이를 찾아낼 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 렌트라의 투시 능력은 위험한 것을 발견할 때 매우 도움이 된다.
Description (en, y): Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
Description (en, omega-ruby): When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey—even those taking shelter behind a wall.
Description (ko, sword): 투시 능력을 가진 포켓몬. 두꺼운 벽 반대편에 숨어 있는 먹이를 순식간에 찾아낸다.
Description (en, sword): Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.
Description (ko, shield): 투시는 전기 에너지를 매우 많이 소모하기 때문에 오랜 시간 수면을 취해서 에너지를 비축한다.
Description (en, shield): Seeing through solid objects uses up a lot of Luxray’s electricity, so the Pokémon sleeps for long periods of time to store up energy.
Description (en, legends-arceus): They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

document.body:

Name (ko): 꼬몽울
Name (en): Budew
Description (en, diamond): Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
Description (en, pearl): It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.
Description (en, platinum): Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
Description (en, heartgold): When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
Description (en, black-2): Sensitive to changing temperatures, the bud blooms when it’s warm, releasing toxic pollen.
Description (ko, x): 따뜻한 햇볕을 쬐면 봉오리를 펴서 꽃가루를 날린다. 깨끗한 물 가까이에 거처가 있다.
Description (ko, y): 겨울 동안 봉오리를 닫고 추위를 견딘다. 봄이 되면 봉오리를 펴서 꽃가루를 날린다.
Description (ko, sword): 독을 품고 있는 꽃가루를 뿌린다. 맑은 물을 줘서 키울수록 독성은 더욱 강해진다.
Description (en, sword): The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.
Description (ko, shield): 기온 변화에 민감하다. 봉오리가 피기 시작하면 곧 봄이 온다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.
Description (en, legends-arceus): When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

Description (en, pearl): With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.
Description (en, platinum): Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
Description (en, heartgold): Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.
Description (en, black-2): Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
Description (ko, x): 달콤한 향기로 먹이를 유인해 양팔의 독 채찍을 사용하여 찌르거나 조여서 꼼짝 못하게 한다.

Description (en, sword): After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.
Description (ko, shield): 오른손의 독은 즉효성이고 왼손의 독은 지효성을 띠고 있다. 양쪽 모두 생명에 지장을 준다.
Description (en, shield): The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.
