document.title: Cranidos — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cranidos
ID: 408
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 두개도스
Name (en): Cranidos
Description (en, diamond): It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
Description (en, pearl): It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its head butts.
Description (en, platinum): A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
Description (en, heartgold): CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.
Description (ko, x): 철구 같은 화석에서 부활한 고대 포켓몬이다. 박치기로 먹이를 꼼짝 못하게 한다.
Description (en, x): It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
Description (ko, y): 대략 1억 년 전의 포켓몬이다. 정글에서 태어나 자라 방해되는 수목은 박치기로 꺾었다.
Description (en, y): A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 대략 1억 년 전의 포켓몬이다. 정글에서 태어나고 자라며 방해되는 수목은 박치기로 꺾었다.
Description (ko, sun): 1억 년 정도 전의 밀림에서 살았었다. 특기인 박치기로 프테라에게 저항했었다.
Description (en, sun): It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.
Description (ko, moon): 두개도스의 화석이 발견되는 지층에는 부러진 나무의 화석도 같이 발굴된다.
Description (en, moon): In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found, the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two are also often found.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 태곳적 포켓몬. 딱딱하고 튼튼한 두개골을 가졌지만 머리는 정말 나빴다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A primeval Pokémon, it possesses a hard and sturdy skull, lacking any intelligence within.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 단단한 두개골이 특징이다. 박치기로 나무를 부러뜨려 잘 익은 나무열매를 먹었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.
Description (en, legends-arceus): An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

document.title: Rampardos — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Rampardos
ID: 409
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 램펄드
Name (en): Rampardos
Description (en, diamond): Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
Description (en, pearl): Its skull is as hard as iron. It is a brute that tears down jungle trees while catching prey.
Description (en, platinum): If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
Description (en, heartgold): Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
Description (ko, x): 어떤 충격에도 견딜 수 있는 두꺼운 두개골에 눌려 뇌가 자라지 않았다.
Description (ko, y): 철처럼 단단한 두개골이다. 정글의 나무들을 넘어뜨려서 먹이를 잡는 난동꾼이다.
Description (ko, sun): 박치기를 반복해서 두개골은 단단하고 두꺼워졌지만 뇌는 두개도스보다 작아졌다.
Description (en, sun): The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos’s.
Description (ko, moon): 복원되어 진화한 램펄드가 도망쳐 박치기로 고층 빌딩을 파괴했다는 기록이 있다.
Description (en, moon): Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먼 옛날 사람은 화석을 발굴하여 강철보다 딱딱한 두개골로 투구를 만들었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder than steel, to make helmets.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 박치기가 특기인 고대 포켓몬이다. 뇌가 정말 작기 때문에 멍청해서 멸종했다는 설도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Shieldon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Shieldon
ID: 410
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 방패톱스
Name (en): Shieldon
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
Description (en, pearl): It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
Description (en, platinum): It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
Description (en, heartgold): It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.
Description (ko, x): 큰 나무의 줄기에 비벼서 단단한 얼굴을 닦는 습성이 있다. 뒤로부터의 공격에 약하다.
Description (ko, y): 1억 년 전의 지층에서 발굴된 화석에서 태어났다. 매우 튼튼한 얼굴을 가졌다.
Description (ko, sun): 많은 화석이 발견되었지만 얼굴 부분에 상처가 있거나 이가 빠져 있는 것은 거의 없다.
Description (en, sun): Many fossils of this Pokémon have been found, but almost none have shown signs of damage to the face.
Description (ko, moon): 튼튼한 얼굴 덕분에 적은 적었을 것으로 여겨진다. 태고의 정글에 살았다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it’s thought.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 온순한 초식 포켓몬. 튼튼한 얼굴 피부로 지면을 파고들어 나무 뿌리도 먹었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A mild-mannered, herbivorous Pokémon, it used its face to dig up tree roots to eat. The skin on its face was plenty tough.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 태고의 지층에서 화석이 발견되었지만 얼굴 이외의 부분이 발견된 적은 없다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

document.title: Bastiodon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bastiodon
ID: 411
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 바리톱스
Name (en): Bastiodon
Description (en, diamond): Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
Description (en, pearl): When attacked, they form a wall with their shieldlike faces to protect their young.
Description (en, platinum): When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
Description (en, heartgold): When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.
Description (ko, x): 옆에 한 줄로 세우면 어떤 포켓몬이라도 돌파하지 못한다. 그렇게 하여 아기를 지켜냈다.
Description (ko, y): 정면에서의 공격은 전부 튕겨낸다. 풀이나 나무열매를 먹는 얌전한 성격이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 일렬횡대로 죽 늘어서면 어떤 포켓몬이라도 돌파하지 못한다. 그렇게 하여 아기를 지켜냈다.
Description (ko, sun): 정면에서라면 어떤 공격이든 가드할 수 있지만 뒤를 뺏기면 방법이 없다.
Description (en, sun): While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.
Description (ko, moon): 램펄드와 비슷한 장소에 있었다. 2마리가 싸워 같이 쓰러져 있는 화석이 발견될 때도 있다.
Description (en, moon): It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together— seemingly from after they’d fought to the finish.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 얼굴의 뼈가 크고 딱딱해서 복원에 성공할 때까지 등뼈라고 잘못 알려져 있었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The bones of its face are huge and hard, so they were mistaken for its spine until after this Pokémon was successfully restored.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 약 1억 년 전의 포켓몬이다. 무섭게 튼튼한 얼굴은 강철 이상의 경도를 가졌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Burmy
ID: 412
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 도롱충이
Name (en): Burmy
Description (en, diamond): To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
Description (en, pearl): If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
Description (en, platinum): Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
Description (en, heartgold): It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.
Description (ko, x): 차가운 초겨울 바람을 막으려고 작은 가지나 낙엽을 재료로 도롱이를 만들어 몸을 감싼다.
Description (ko, y): 싸움으로 도롱이가 부서져 버리면 가까이 있는 재료로 도롱이를 바로 만들어 고친다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

Name (ko): 나메일
Name (en): Mothim
Description (en, diamond): It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
Description (en, pearl): It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields and mountains in constant search of floral honey.
Description (en, platinum): While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from COMBEE.
Description (en, heartgold): It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.
Description (en, black): While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

Description (en, x): It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
Description (ko, y): 한밤중에 활발하게 날아다니며 잠든 세꿀버리의 둥지에서 꿀을 훔쳐 달아난다.
Description (en, y): It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

document.title: Combee — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:

Name (ko): 세꿀버리
Name (en): Combee
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
Description (en, pearl): It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
Description (en, platinum): The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
Description (en, heartgold): At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.
Description (en, black): The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
Description (en, black-2): This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.
Description (ko, x): 태어났을 때부터 3마리가 함께한다. 비퀸을 기쁘게 하기 위해 항상 꽃의 꿀을 모으고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 모은 꿀을 거처로 운반한다. 밤에는 많은 세꿀버리가 겹쳐져 벌집이 되어 잠잔다.
Description (ko, sword): 언제나 3마리가 같이 있지만 좋아하는 꽃의 꿀은 저마다 미묘하게 다르다.
Description (en, sword): The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.
Description (ko, shield): 새벽부터 저녁때까지 꿀을 계속 모은다. 모든 것은 무리와 비퀸을 위해서다.
Description (en, shield): It ceaselessly gathers nectar from sunrise to sundown, all for the sake of Vespiquen and the swarm.
Description (en, legends-arceus): They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비퀸
Name (en): Vespiquen
Description (en, diamond): Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
Description (en, pearl): When endangered, grubs from its six-cell honeycomb strike back. There is only one in a colony.
Description (en, platinum): It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
Description (en, heartgold): It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.
Description (en, black-2): It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
Description (ko, x): 몸통은 아기들의 둥지다. 여러 페로몬을 내어 새끼들을 자유롭게 조종한다.
Description (ko, y): 몸통이 새끼들의 둥지로 되어 있다. 세꿀버리가 모은 꿀로 새끼들을 키운다.
Description (en, y): Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸통은 새끼들의 둥지다. 여러 페로몬을 내어 새끼들을 자유롭게 조종한다.
Description (ko, sword): 새끼들을 자유자재로 조종하여 상대와 싸운다. 새끼들은 비퀸을 위해 목숨을 걸고 싸운다.
Description (en, sword): It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.
Description (ko, shield): 페로몬을 발산하는 양이 많은 비퀸일수록 많은 세꿀버리를 거느리고 있다.
Description (en, shield): Vespiquen that give off more pheromones have larger swarms of Combee attendants.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

Name (en): Pachirisu
Description (en, diamond): It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
Description (en, pearl): It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.
Description (en, platinum): A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
Description (en, heartgold): It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
Description (ko, x): 정전기가 모여 톡톡 튀는 솜털을 자신이 좋아하는 나무열매와 함께 나무줄기의 구멍에 숨긴다.
Description (ko, y): 모인 전기를 나눠주려고 뺨의 주머니를 서로 비비는 파치리스가 발견되기도 한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

document.body:

Name (ko): 브이젤
Name (en): Buizel
Description (en, diamond): It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
Description (en, pearl): It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
Description (en, platinum): It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
Description (en, heartgold): It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.
Description (en, black-2): It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
Description (ko, x): 2개의 꼬리를 스크루처럼 돌려서 헤엄친다. 잠수할 때는 공기주머니가 오그라든다.
Description (ko, y): 목의 부낭을 부풀려 수면에서 얼굴을 내밀어 주변의 상황을 살피고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 2개의 꼬리를 스크루처럼 돌려서 헤엄친다. 잠수할 때는 부낭이 오그라든다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Floatzel — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Floatzel
ID: 419
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 플로젤
Name (en): Floatzel
Description (en, diamond): It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
Description (en, pearl): Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
Description (en, platinum): It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
Description (en, heartgold): With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.
Description (ko, x): 발달한 부낭으로 뜬다. 물에 빠진 사람을 구조하는 것을 돕는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 수중의 먹이를 쫓아가는 사이에 부낭이 발달했다. 고무보트처럼 사람을 태운다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cherubi — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cherubi
ID: 420
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 체리버
Name (en): Cherubi
Description (en, diamond): The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
Description (en, pearl): Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
Description (en, platinum): The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. STARLY try to peck it off.
Description (en, heartgold): It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.
Description (en, black): The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
Description (ko, x): 햇빛으로 빨갛게 물들었다. 영양분이 흡수되어 작은 구슬이 시들면 곧 진화한다는 뜻이다.
Description (ko, y): 작은 구슬에 모인 영양분을 흡수해 진화의 에너지로 삼는다.
Description (ko, sword): 영양이 듬뿍 담긴 구슬을 새포켓몬들이 아주 좋아한다. 쪼이지 않기 위해 도망 다닌다.
Description (en, sword): It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.
Description (ko, shield): 몸이 빨간 체리버일수록 영양이 많고 구슬의 맛도 달고 맛있다.
Description (en, shield): The deeper a Cherubi’s red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!
Description (en, legends-arceus): Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cherrim — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cherrim
ID: 421
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 체리꼬
Name (en): Cherrim
Description (en, diamond): It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
Description (en, pearl): It is docile as a bud, but turns cheerful when it blooms. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.
Description (en, platinum): If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
Description (en, heartgold): During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
Description (ko, x): 봉오리가 태양의 빛을 쬐어 꽃잎이 피면 활발하게 움직일 수 있게 된다.
Description (ko, y): 강한 햇살을 느끼면 움츠려 있던 꽃잎을 펼쳐 전신으로 햇빛을 받는다.
Description (ko, sword): 봉오리일 때는 얌전하고 거의 움직이지 않는다. 햇빛이 들기를 가만히 기다리고 있다.
Description (en, sword): As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.
Description (ko, shield): 겹쳐진 꽃잎은 딱딱하다. 새포켓몬에게 쪼여도 아무렇지도 않다.
Description (en, shield): Its folded petals are pretty tough. Bird Pokémon can peck at them all they want, and Cherrim won’t be bothered at all.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Shellos — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Shellos
ID: 422
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 깝질무
Name (en): Shellos
Description (en, diamond): Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
Description (en, pearl): It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape has changed to suit its habitat.
Description (en, platinum): Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
Description (en, heartgold): Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.
Description (ko, x): 부드러운 몸을 강하게 누르면 보랏빛이 나는 정체불명의 액체가 배어 나오므로 주의가 필요하다.
Description (ko, y): 사는 장소의 환경에 따라 몸의 모양과 색깔이 변화하기 쉬운 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, sun): 물가가 주요 서식지다. 서식지의 환경이나 먹이의 질에 따라 색과 모습이 다르다.
Description (en, sun): For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.
Description (ko, moon): 만지면 보라색 점액이 손에 묻는다. 아무리 씻어도 좀처럼 떨어지지 않으므로 주의.
Description (en, moon): Purple mucus sticks to the hands of anyone who touches it. Take care, as the substance is troublesome to wash off.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 평소에는 바닷속에서 지내지만, 피부가 마르기 전까지는 육지에서도 활동할 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While they normally live in the sea, they can function on land, too, until their skin dries out.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 위험을 느끼면 보라색 분비액을 내보낸다. 진땀 같은 것이라고 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it senses danger, a purple liquid oozes out of it. The liquid is thought to be something like greasy sweat.
Description (ko, sword): 환경에 따라 모습이 바뀐다. 수온이 따뜻한 바다에서는 이 모습이 된다는 설도 있다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.
Description (ko, shield): 세게 만지면 보라색의 정체 모를 액체를 내보낸다. 해롭지는 않지만 끈적거린다.
Description (en, shield): Subjecting this Pokémon to a strong force causes it to secrete a strange purple fluid. Though harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Gastrodon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gastrodon
ID: 423
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 트리토돈
Name (en): Gastrodon
Description (en, diamond): It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
Description (en, pearl): It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.
Description (en, platinum): Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
Description (en, heartgold): When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
Description (ko, x): 천적에게 습격당했을 때는 보라색 액체를 몸에서 내어 도망간다.
Description (ko, y): 아주 옛날에는 튼튼한 껍질로 몸을 보호하고 있었던 듯하다. 바다의 얕은 곳에서 서식한다.
Description (ko, sun): 재생능력이 높다. 물고기포켓몬에게 물어뜯겨도 몇 시간이면 원래대로 돌아온다.
Description (en, sun): It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.
Description (ko, moon): 눈에 보이지 않는 플랑크톤이 주된 먹이다. 육지에 올라오지만 이유는 아직 밝혀지지 않았다.
Description (en, moon): Plankton, invisible to the naked eye, is its main food source. It comes onto the land periodically, but the reason for this is not known.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 옛날에는 껍질을 등에 지고 있었다. 그 흔적이 남아 등 안에 딱딱하고 얇은 접시가 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Long ago, it had a shell on its back. There’s now a vestigial plate on its back that’s hard but thin.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 사는 장소나 먹이의 영향으로 색이나 모습이 변화한다. 파도가 잔잔한 바위해변에 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Their shape and color change, depending on their environment and diet. There are many of them at beaches where the waves are calm.
Description (ko, sword): 먹이를 찾아 육지에도 올라온다. 트리토돈이 지나간 자리에는 끈적끈적한 점액이 남아 있다.
Description (en, sword): Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.
Description (ko, shield): 흐물흐물한 몸이지만 제법 튼튼하다. 부드러워서 충격을 분산시킨다.
Description (en, shield): The softness of its body helps disperse the force of impacts, so although its body is uncommonly squishy, it’s also surprisingly resilient.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Ambipom — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ambipom
ID: 424
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 겟핸보숭
Name (en): Ambipom
Description (en, diamond): To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
Description (en, pearl): They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
Description (en, platinum): Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.
Description (en, heartgold): They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.
Description (en, soulsilver): It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.
Description (en, black): Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
Description (ko, x): 많은 무리로 행동한다. 꼬리를 맞잡아 원을 만든다. 우정의 표시인 듯하다.
Description (ko, y): 2개의 꼬리로 나무열매 껍질을 솜씨 좋게 벗겨 먹는다. 진짜 팔은 거의 쓰지 않게 되었다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머물기 좋은 나무를 두고 내던숭이 그룹과 영역 다툼을 하고 있다. 승률은 비슷하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 무엇을 하더라도 꼬리를 사용한다. 2개의 꼬리로 껴안는다면 정말로 친밀해졌다는 증거다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.
Description (en, legends-arceus): To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Drifloon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Drifloon
ID: 425
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 흔들풍손
Name (en): Drifloon
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
Description (en, pearl): It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.
Description (en, platinum): Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
Description (en, heartgold): It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.
Description (en, black-2): These Pokémon are called the “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.
Description (ko, x): 사람이나 포켓몬의 영혼이 한데 모여 태어난 포켓몬이다. 습기 많은 계절을 매우 좋아한다.
Description (ko, y): 영혼의 이정표라고 전해진다. 흔들풍손을 가지고 있는 아이는 갑자기 사라져버린다.
Description (ko, sun): 어린아이의 손을 잡고 저세상으로 데려간다고 한다. 무거운 아이를 싫어한다.
Description (en, sun): Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife. It dislikes heavy children.
Description (ko, moon): 어떤 박자에 몸이 터지면 비명 같은 소리와 함께 영혼이 흘러나온다
Description (en, moon): If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills out with a screaming sound.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 둥근 몸 안에는 많은 혼으로 가득 차 있다. 누군가를 길동무로 삼을 때마다 부풀어 오른다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 길가를 헤매는 영혼들이 한데 모여 태어난다. 아이를 동료로 만들려고 손을 잡아당긴다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Wandering souls gathered together to form this Pokémon. When trying to make friends with children, Drifloon grabs them by the hand.
Description (ko, sword): 동료가 필요한지 아이에게 다가가지만 거칠게 다뤄져서 도망가 버리는 경우도 적지 않다.
Description (en, sword): Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.
Description (ko, shield): 영혼들이 모여 탄생했다. 습기가 많은 계절에는 대량으로 나타나기도 한다.
Description (en, shield): The gathering of many souls gave rise to this Pokémon. During humid seasons, they seem to appear in abundance.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Drifblim — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Drifblim
ID: 426
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 둥실라이드
Name (en): Drifblim
Description (en, diamond): It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
Description (en, pearl): It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
Description (en, platinum): At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
Description (en, heartgold): It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
Description (en, black-2): They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.
Description (ko, x): 사람이나 포켓몬을 태우고 날지만 바람에 떠밀려 다닐 뿐이므로 어디로 날아갈지 모른다.
Description (ko, y): 낮에는 잠이 덜 깨어 떠 있지만 저녁 무렵에는 큰 무리를 지어 날아간다. 목적지는 아무도 모른다.
Description (en, y): It’s drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
Description (ko, sun): 둥실라이드에 타고 여행을 떠난 남자가 그대로 행방불명이 되었다는 사건이 있다.
Description (en, sun): There was once an incident in which a man took a trip riding a Drifblim, only to go missing.
Description (ko, moon): 석양을 나는 둥실라이드의 큰 무리는 가만히 관찰하고 있어도 어느새 사라져있다.
Description (en, moon): Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 땅거미 진 후 바람을 타며 날아다니는 둥실라이드에게 잡히면 저세상으로 데려간다는 소문이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): There’s a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you’ll be carried away to the afterlife.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 체내에 있는 가스의 원료는 영혼이다. 몸이 쪼그라지기 시작하면 사람이나 포켓몬을 데려간다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it’s thought to carry away people and Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 억울하게 죽은 영혼이 모인 모습으로도 일컬어진다. 땅거미가 질 무렵 소리 없이 떠돈다.
Description (en, sword): Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
Description (ko, shield): 사람과 포켓몬을 붙잡아 그대로 어딘가로 운반한다. 행선지는 아무도 모른다.
Description (en, shield): It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them off somewhere. Where do they go? Nobody knows.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Buneary — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Buneary
ID: 427
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이어롤
Name (en): Buneary
Description (en, diamond): It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
Description (en, pearl): When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.
Description (en, platinum): Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
Description (en, heartgold): You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.
Description (en, black-2): By extending its rolled-up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.
Description (ko, x): 항상 말고 있는 귀를 힘껏 늘리면 커다란 바위도 간단히 부순다.
Description (ko, y): 위험을 느끼면 양쪽 귀를 세워서 경계한다. 추운 밤에는 털에 얼굴을 묻고 잠잔다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 손발의 힘은 약하지만, 단단하게 만 귀를 힘껏 뻗으면 큰 바위도 산산조각 낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its arms and legs are weak, but when it rolls its ears up tight and then unleashes them with its full force, it can smash boulders to dust.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 한쪽 귀를 항상 말고 있는 것은 적에게 공격당했을 때 바로 반격하기 위해서다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it’s attacked by an enemy.
Description (ko, sword): 양쪽 귀를 말고 있을 때는 몸이나 마음이 좋지 않다는 뜻이므로 관리가 필요하다.
Description (en, sword): If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.
Description (ko, shield): 말고 있던 귀를 뻗는 힘으로 공격하는 기술은 트레이닝을 할수록 위력이 커진다.
Description (en, shield): Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.
Description (en, legends-arceus): My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

document.title: Lopunny — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lopunny
ID: 428
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이어롭
Name (en): Lopunny
Description (en, diamond): An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
Description (en, pearl): It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.
Description (en, platinum): The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
Description (en, heartgold): It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.
Description (en, black-2): Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
Description (ko, x): 경계심이 아주 강하다. 위험을 감지하면 가뿐하게 뛰어올라 달아난다.
Description (ko, y): 귀가 아주 민감한 부위이므로 상냥하고 정중하게 만지지 않으면 그 매끈한 다리에 차이게 된다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 연 2회 털갈이를 한다. 그 털로 만든 머플러나 모자는 매우 따듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 경계심이 강하고 싸움은 좋아하지 않지만 유연한 다리로 파워풀한 킥을 날린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.
Description (ko, sword): 주위 상황을 항상 신경 쓰고 있으며 위험이 닥치면 무시무시한 파괴력을 가진 킥을 날린다.
Description (en, sword): Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.
Description (ko, shield): 더운 계절이 끝나면 공기를 많이 머금은 털로 털갈이를 하여 추위에 대비한다.
Description (en, shield): Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mismagius — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mismagius
ID: 429
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 무우마직
Name (en): Mismagius
Description (en, diamond): Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
Description (en, pearl): It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
Description (en, platinum): Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
Description (en, heartgold): Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.
Description (ko, x): 주문을 외는 포켓몬이다. 상대를 고통스럽게 하는 것뿐만 아니라 행복하게 하는 주문도 있다.
Description (ko, y): 주문 같은 수상한 울음소리로 상대를 괴롭힌다. 신출귀몰하는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, sun): 예고 없이 나타나 주문을 외워 저주를 걸거나 무서운 환상을 보여준다.
Description (en, sun): It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.
Description (ko, moon): 사랑의 소원을 이뤄주는 저주를 하는 일도 있어서 목숨을 걸고 무우마직을 찾는 자도 있다.
Description (en, moon): Mismagius have been known to cast spells to make people fall in love, so some people search for this Pokémon as if their life depended on it.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 닥치는 대로 재앙과 저주를 내려 두려움의 대상이었다. 변덕을 부려 사람을 돕는 주문도 사용하기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 저주의 말을 중얼거리며 심한 두통이나 무서운 환상을 보여 줘서 괴롭힌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Honchkrow — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Honchkrow
ID: 430
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 돈크로우
Name (en): Honchkrow
Description (en, diamond): Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
Description (en, pearl): It makes its MURKROW cronies bring it food. It idles its time away, grooming itself in its nest.
Description (en, platinum): If one utters a deep cry, many MURKROW gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
Description (en, heartgold): It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.
Description (en, black): If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
Description (ko, x): 돈크로우가 낮은 목소리로 울면 즉시 니로우가 모여들기에 밤을 부르는 자라고도 전해진다.
Description (ko, y): 밤이 되면 활동을 시작한다. 많은 니로우들을 거느리고 무리를 만든다고 알려져 있다.
Description (en, y): Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
Description (ko, sun): 야행성이다. 한번 울면 100마리를 넘는 부하 니로우가 집결한다.
Description (en, sun): A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.
Description (ko, moon): 먹이를 잡는 데 실패하거나 배신한 부하 니로우를 끝까지 추적해서 처리한다.
Description (en, moon): If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it, or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt them down wherever they are and punish them.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 실패하거나 배신한 부하는 절대 용서하지 않는다. 무리의 질서를 지키기 위해 어쩔 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 적과 싸우는 것은 거의 부하다. 자신의 손을 더럽히는 것은 상대에게 마지막 일격을 가할 때뿐이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.
Description (en, legends-arceus): One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

document.title: Glameow — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Glameow
ID: 431
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 나옹마
Name (en): Glameow
Description (en, diamond): It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
Description (en, pearl): With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.
Description (en, platinum): It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
Description (en, heartgold): When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
Description (ko, x): 마음에 안 들면 발톱을 세우지만 가끔 울음소리로 응석을 부리는 성격이 일부에게 매우 인기가 있다.
Description (ko, y): 기분이 좋은 나옹마는 꼬리로 리듬 체조의 리본처럼 아름다운 움직임을 보인다.
Description (en, y): When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

document.title: Purugly — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Purugly
ID: 432
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 몬냥이
Name (en): Purugly
Description (en, diamond): It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
Description (en, pearl): To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
Description (en, platinum): It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
Description (en, heartgold): It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
Description (ko, x): 다른 포켓몬의 거처라 할지라도 편안하면 눌러앉아 자신의 거처로 삼아버린다.
Description (ko, y): 몸을 크게 보여서 상대를 위압하기 위해 두 갈래의 꼬리로 허리를 꼭 쥐고 있다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

document.title: Chingling — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Chingling
ID: 433
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 랑딸랑
Name (en): Chingling
Description (en, diamond): It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
Description (en, pearl): Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
Description (en, platinum): There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
Description (en, heartgold): It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
Description (ko, x): 뛸 때마다 딸랑딸랑 소리를 낸다. 높은 주파수의 울음소리로 상대의 귀를 들리지 않게 한다.
Description (ko, y): 뛰어오르면 입안에 있는 구슬이 사방에 반사되어 방울 같은 음색을 만들어 낸다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

document.title: Stunky — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Stunky
ID: 434
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 스컹뿡
Name (en): Stunky
Description (en, diamond): It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
Description (en, pearl): It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.
Description (en, platinum): It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
Description (en, heartgold): The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.
Description (ko, x): 엉덩이에서 뿜어지는 역한 분비액의 냄새는 범위 2km까지 멀리 퍼져 주변의 포켓몬이 자리를 뜨게 한다.
Description (ko, y): 엉덩이에서 강렬한 구린내의 액체를 날려서 몸을 지킨다. 냄새가 24시간 사라지지 않는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 엉덩이에서 뿜어지는 역한 분비액의 냄새는 반경 2km까지 멀리 퍼져 주변의 포켓몬이 자리를 뜨게 한다.
Description (ko, sword): 엉덩이를 상대의 얼굴에 겨냥해서 엄청나게 역한 분비액을 뿜는다. 분비액은 5m 떨어진 곳까지 닿는다.
Description (en, sword): From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.
Description (ko, shield): 꼬리를 들고 엉덩이를 돌리면 주의해야 한다. 기절할 정도로 악취 나는 분비액을 날릴 전조인 것이다.
Description (en, shield): If it lifts its tail and points its rear at you, beware. It’s about to spray you with a fluid stinky enough to make you faint.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Skuntank — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Skuntank
ID: 435
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 스컹탱크
Name (en): Skuntank
Description (en, diamond): It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
Description (en, pearl): It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.
Description (en, platinum): It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
Description (en, heartgold): It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리 끝에서 심한 냄새가 나는 액체를 뿌려 공격한다. 사정거리는 50m 이상이다.
Description (ko, y): 꼬리에서 역한 분비액을 날린다. 배에서 숙성된 시간이 길수록 냄새가 심해진다.
Description (ko, sword): 배 안에 모아둔 역한 분비액을 꼬리에서 뿜어서 싸운다. 냄새는 먹은 것에 따라 달라진다.
Description (en, sword): In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.
Description (ko, shield): 꼬리 끝에서 날리는 분비액의 냄새는 강렬하다. 땅에 구멍을 파서 굴을 만든다.
Description (en, shield): It digs holes in the ground to make its nest. The stench of the fluid it lets fly from the tip of its tail is extremely potent.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Bronzor — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bronzor
ID: 436
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 동미러
Name (en): Bronzor
Description (en, diamond): Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
Description (en, pearl): X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.
Description (en, platinum): There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
Description (en, heartgold): Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.
Description (en, black-2): They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.
Description (ko, x): 동미러의 등 모양에는 신비한 힘이 깃들어 있다고 옛날 사람들은 믿고 있었다.
Description (en, x): Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.
Description (ko, y): 고대 무덤에서 동미러와 똑 닮은 도구가 발굴되었지만 관계는 알 수 없다.
Description (ko, sword): 오래된 유적에 나타난다. 몸의 무늬는 가라르에 없는 낯선 문화의 것이라 수수께끼이다.
Description (en, sword): It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn’t come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.
Description (ko, shield): 닦으면 빛이 나며 진실을 비춘다고 전해지지만 동미러는 닦이는 걸 매우 싫어한다.
Description (en, shield): Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Bronzong — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bronzong
ID: 437
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 동탁군
Name (en): Bronzong
Description (en, diamond): One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
Description (en, pearl): It can summon rain clouds. People long ago revered it as the bringer of plentiful harvests.
Description (en, platinum): It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
Description (en, heartgold): Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.
Description (en, black-2): In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
Description (ko, x): 비구름을 부르는 포켓몬으로 아주 옛날부터 떠받들어졌다. 가끔 땅에 묻혀 있다.
Description (ko, y): 동탁군에게 소원을 빌면 비가 내려 농작물을 자라게 한다고 고대의 사람들은 믿고 있었다.
Description (en, y): Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.
Description (ko, sword): 비구름을 부르는 신이라 불린다. 화나게 하면 종소리를 닮은 불길한 소리로 위협한다.
Description (en, sword): Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.
Description (ko, shield): 몸의 무늬 때문에 본래 가라르에는 없던 포켓몬이라고 생각하는 학자도 많다.
Description (en, shield): Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Bonsly — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bonsly
ID: 438
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 꼬지지
Name (en): Bonsly
Description (en, diamond): It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
Description (en, pearl): It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
Description (en, platinum): It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
Description (en, heartgold): In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.
Description (ko, x): 건조한 장소를 좋아한다. 눈에서 물을 내어 몸의 수분을 조절한다.
Description (ko, y): 건조한 공기를 좋아한다. 수분을 조절할 때에 내는 물이 눈물처럼 보인다.
Description (ko, sun): 물을 싫어해 건조한 장소에 살고 있다. 주변에는 녹색이 적어 눈에 잘 띈다.
Description (en, sun): It does not deal well with water, so it lives in dry locales. Since its surroundings tend to lack greenery, it stands out noticeably.
Description (ko, moon): 몸에 불필요한 수분은 눈을 통해 밖으로 내보낸다. 그 성분은 인간의 땀과 비슷하다.
Description (en, moon): From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from its body. This liquid is similar in composition to human sweat.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 눈동자에서 수분을 방출한다. 울고 있는 것처럼 보이기 때문에 적을 방심시키는 효과도 있는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It discharges moisture from its eyes, making it look like it’s crying—apparently an effective way of getting enemies to let down their guard.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 너무 몸이 습해지면 죽어 버리기 때문에 땀처럼 눈에서 수분을 내보내고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): If its body gets too damp, it will die. So, in a process reminiscent of sweating, its eyes expel moisture.
Description (ko, sword): 땀과 눈물이 모두 눈에서 나온다. 땀은 약간 짠맛이고 눈물은 살짝 씁쓸한 맛이다.
Description (en, sword): It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.
Description (ko, shield): 건조한 바위 밭에 산다. 초록색 구슬은 마를수록 반들반들 희미하게 빛난다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon lives in dry, rocky areas. As its green spheres dry out, their dull luster increases.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mime Jr. — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mime Jr.
ID: 439
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 흉내내
Name (en): Mime Jr.
Description (en, diamond): It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
Description (en, pearl): It likes places where people gather. It mimics foes to confuse them, then makes its getaway.
Description (en, platinum): It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
Description (en, heartgold): In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
Description (ko, x): 상대의 움직임을 똑같이 흉내 내어 당황한 사이에 재빨리 도망친다.
Description (ko, y): 상대의 움직임을 흉내 내는 습성이 있다. 모방을 당한 상대는 눈을 뗄 수 없게 된다고 한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 상대의 움직임과 표정을 열심히 흉내 낸다. 아직 잘한다고는 할 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It does its absolute best to mimic the movements and expressions of its opponents, but it’s still not very good at it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 흉내내기가 특기다. 상대가 놀라면 기쁜 나머지 흉내 내고 있다는 사실을 잊어버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When this gifted mimic surprises an opponent, Mime Jr. feels so happy that it ends up forgetting it was imitating something.
Description (ko, sword): 보이는 모든 것을 흉내 낸다. 마임꽁꽁의 화려한 스텝을 끊임없이 흉내 내며 연습한다.
Description (en, sword): It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.
Description (ko, shield): 춤을 잘 추는 마임꽁꽁의 제자인 것마냥 따라다니며 스텝을 열심히 흉내 낸다.
Description (en, shield): It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Happiny — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Happiny
ID: 440
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 핑복
Name (en): Happiny
Description (en, diamond): It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
Description (en, pearl): It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
Description (en, platinum): It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
Description (en, heartgold): It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
Description (ko, x): 알을 닮은 둥근 돌을 배의 주머니에 넣고 있다. 좋아하는 상대에게 돌을 준다.
Description (ko, y): 하얗고 둥근 돌을 알이라고 생각하고는 소중히 가지고 있다. 말려 있는 머리 모양을 신경 쓰고 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 배의 주머니에 하얗고 동그란 돌을 넣고 있다. 사이가 좋아지면 나누어 주는 일도 있다.
Description (en, sun): It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.
Description (ko, moon): 작아서 아직 알을 낳을 수 없다. 대신에 하얗고 둥근 돌을 찾는다.
Description (en, moon): It’s too small to lay eggs yet. As a surrogate, it searches out round white stones.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 온순한 포켓몬이지만 배의 둥근 돌을 빼내면 울고불고 난폭해진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Usually it’s a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 하얗고 둥근 것을 보면 배의 주머니에 넣는다. 너무 많이 넣어서 움직이지 못할 때도 있을 정도다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it sees something round and white, Happiny puts it into the pouch on its stomach. It sometimes becomes overloaded and can’t move.
Description (ko, sword): 럭키를 흉내 내어 알처럼 생긴 둥근 돌을 배의 주머니에 넣고 소중히 보관한다.
Description (en, sword): Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.
Description (ko, shield): 친해진 상대에게는 소중하게 여기는 둥근 돌을 빌려준다. 돌려주지 않으면 울고불고하다가 난폭해진다.
Description (en, shield): Happiny’s willing to lend its precious round stone to those it’s friendly with, but if the stone isn’t returned, Happiny will cry and throw a tantrum.
Description (en, legends-arceus): In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Chatot — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Chatot
ID: 441
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 페라페
Name (en): Chatot
Description (en, diamond): It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
Description (en, pearl): It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like a metronome. It imitates human speech.
Description (en, platinum): Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
Description (en, heartgold): It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
Description (ko, x): 상대와 같은 울음소리를 내서 동료라고 굳게 믿게 하여 습격당하지 않도록 하고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 사람의 말을 기억해서 운다. 동료가 한 장소에 모이면 모두 똑같은 말을 기억한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Spiritomb — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Spiritomb
ID: 442
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 화강돌
Name (en): Spiritomb
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
Description (en, pearl): It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.
Description (en, platinum): Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
Description (en, heartgold): It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.
Description (ko, x): 108개의 영혼이 모여서 태어난 포켓몬이다. 쐐기돌의 균열과 연결되어 있다.
Description (ko, y): 500년 전에 나쁜 짓을 했기 때문에 쐐기돌의 균열에 몸이 연결되어 갇혀 버렸다.
Description (ko, sword): 108개의 영혼이 모여 포켓몬이 되었지만 성질이 나쁜 영혼이 섞여버린 듯하다.
Description (en, sword): Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.
Description (ko, shield): 나쁜 짓만 일삼다가 신비한 술수를 사용하는 여행자에 의해 쐐기돌에 속박당했다.
Description (en, shield): All Spiritomb’s mischief and misdeeds compelled a traveler to use a mysterious spell to bind Spiritomb to an odd keystone.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Gible — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gible
ID: 443
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 딥상어동
Name (en): Gible
Description (en, diamond): It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
Description (en, pearl): It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold, it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.
Description (en, platinum): It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
Description (en, heartgold): It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
Description (ko, x): 지열로 데워진 구멍에서 지낸다. 적이 가까이 오면 구멍에서 뛰쳐나와 커다란 입으로 물어버린다.
Description (ko, y): 동굴의 조그만 구멍을 보금자리로 쓴다. 먹이가 다가오면 재빠르게 뛰쳐나가 붙잡는다.
Description (ko, sun): 지열로 따뜻한 동굴에서 살고 있다. 그래도 추워지면 동료들과 몸을 맞대어 뭉친다.
Description (en, sun): It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will huddle close with others of its kind.
Description (ko, moon): 구멍에 숨어서 먹이나 적이 지나가면 뛰쳐나가 문다. 기세가 대단해 이가 빠질 때도 있다.
Description (en, moon): It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 움직이는 것에 반응하여 달려들어 덥석 문다. 자신이 상처를 입어도 별로 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn’t care too much.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 알로라보다 더 더운 곳이 본래 서식지다. 함께 지내려면 난방비가 든다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its original home is an area much hotter than Alola. If you’re planning to live with one, your heating bill will soar.
Description (ko, sword): 지열로 데워진 동굴의 좁은 구멍을 좋아한다. 밖에 눈보라가 쳐도 얼어붙지 않고 견딜 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.
Description (ko, shield): 움직이는 것은 무조건 공격해서 보금자리 굴로 데려간다. 입은 크지만 위는 작은 편이다.
Description (en, shield): Gible attacks anything that moves, and it drags whatever it catches into the crevice that is its lair. Despite the big mouth, Gible’s stomach is small.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Gabite — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gabite
ID: 444
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 한바이트
Name (en): Gabite
Description (en, diamond): There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
Description (en, pearl): It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.
Description (en, platinum): It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
Description (en, heartgold): As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.
Description (ko, x): 반짝반짝 빛나는 것을 아주 좋아하기에 동굴 안에서 발견한 보물을 자신의 둥지에 모아둔다.
Description (ko, y): 거처를 늘릴 때 땅속에서 나온 보석의 원석을 거처에 모아두는 습성을 가졌다.
Description (ko, sun): 드물게 탈피해서 비늘이 벗겨진다. 그 성분이 들어 있는 약은 피곤한 몸을 회복시켜 준다.
Description (en, sun): In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.
Description (ko, moon): 반짝반짝 빛나는 것을 아주 좋아한다. 보석이나 잡은 멜리시를 둥지에서 가만히 바라보고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it’s amassed or Carbink it has caught.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 반짝이는 것을 매우 좋아한다. 멜리시를 노리는 깜까미를 발견하면 격렬하게 화를 내며 덤벼든다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 탈피하면서 커진다. 비늘을 비벼서 가루로 만든 것은 한방약의 원료가 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used as raw materials for traditional medicine.
Description (ko, sword): 머리의 좌우 돌기에서 초음파를 내보내 캄캄한 동굴의 상황을 살핀다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.
Description (ko, shield): 거처인 동굴에 보석을 매장하는데 그곳에 침입자가 들어가면 즉시 발톱과 이빨로 갈기갈기 찢어버린다.
Description (en, shield): Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémon nest in, but you’ll be torn apart by claws and fangs the moment you enter one of these caves.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Garchomp — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Garchomp
ID: 445
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 한카리아스
Name (en): Garchomp
Description (en, diamond): When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
Description (en, pearl): It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
Description (en, platinum): It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
Description (en, heartgold): Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.
Description (ko, x): 몸을 접고 날개를 펼치면 마치 제트기 같다. 음속으로 날 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 제트기와 맞먹는 스피드로 하늘을 난다. 노린 먹이는 놓치지 않는다.
Description (ko, sun): 제트기만큼 빠른 속도로 난다. 새포켓몬 무리에 돌진하여 그대로 무리째 삼켜버린다.
Description (en, sun): It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.
Description (ko, moon): 머리에 달린 2개의 돌기는 센서 역할을 한다. 저 멀리 있는 먹이의 모습도 알 수 있다.
Description (en, moon): The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 음속으로 날아다니며 먹이를 찾는다. 먹이를 두고 보만다와 공중전을 펼친다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매끄럽고 뾰족한 비늘은 공기 저항을 줄일 뿐만 아니라 습격해 온 상대를 상처 입힌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its fine scales don’t just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.
Description (ko, sword): 화산이 있는 산에 서식한다. 제트기에도 지지 않는 속도로 하늘을 날아 먹이를 사냥한다.
Description (en, sword): Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.
Description (ko, shield): 지상에서도 움직임이 빠르다. 설산에서는 체온이 떨어지기 전에 먹이를 잡아 거처로 돌아간다.
Description (en, shield): Garchomp is fast both underground and above. It can bring down prey and return to its den before its body has chilled from being outside.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

Description (en, sun): It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.
Description (ko, moon): 머리에 달린 2개의 돌기는 센서 역할을 한다. 저 멀리 있는 먹이의 모습도 알 수 있다.
Description (en, moon): The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 음속으로 날아다니며 먹이를 찾는다. 먹이를 두고 보만다와 공중전을 펼친다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매끄럽고 뾰족한 비늘은 공기 저항을 줄일 뿐만 아니라 습격해 온 상대를 상처 입힌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its fine scales don’t just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.
Description (ko, sword): 화산이 있는 산에 서식한다. 제트기에도 지지 않는 속도로 하늘을 날아 먹이를 사냥한다.
Description (en, sword): Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.
Description (ko, shield): 지상에서도 움직임이 빠르다. 설산에서는 체온이 떨어지기 전에 먹이를 잡아 거처로 돌아간다.
Description (en, shield): Garchomp is fast both underground and above. It can bring down prey and return to its den before its body has chilled from being outside.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

document.body:

ID: 445
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.

Name (en): Garchomp

document.title: Munchlax — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Munchlax
ID: 446
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 먹고자
Name (en): Munchlax
Description (en, diamond): It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
Description (en, pearl): It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
Description (en, platinum): In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
Description (en, heartgold): It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.
Description (ko, x): 몸의 긴 털 안쪽에 먹이를 숨기는 습성이 있다. 숨긴 것을 잊어버린다.
Description (ko, y): 부스스한 털 안에 먹이를 숨겨서 갖고 다닌다. 먹을 때는 꿀꺽 통째로 삼킨다.
Description (ko, sun): 매일 자신의 체중과 같은 양의 먹이가 필요하다. 맛에 대해서는 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, sun): It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it’s indifferent.
Description (ko, moon): 먹을 수 있을 것 같은 것을 발견하면 일단 주워서 통째로 삼킨다. 그래서 나날이 살이 찌고 있다.
Description (en, moon): When it finds something that looks like it might be edible, it goes right ahead and swallows it whole. That’s why it gets fatter day by day.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 긴 털 아래에 음식을 숨기지만 숨긴 것을 잊어 고약한 냄새가 난다며 소동이 날 때도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먹을 만해 보이면 일단 주워서 통째로 삼킨다. 썩은 먹이라도 소화시키는 튼튼한 위를 가졌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough to handle it even if the food has gone rotten.
Description (ko, sword): 일단 많이 먹고 보는 것에 푹 빠져 있다. 맛은 상관하지 않으며 상했어도 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, sword): Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its only concern. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.
Description (ko, shield): 털 안에 먹이를 모은다. 신뢰하는 상대에게는 한 입 나눠주기도 한다.
Description (en, shield): It stores food beneath its fur. It might share just one bite, but only if it really trusts you.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

document.title: Riolu — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Riolu
ID: 447
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 리오르
Name (en): Riolu
Description (en, diamond): The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
Description (en, pearl): Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.
Description (en, platinum): It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
Description (en, heartgold): They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
Description (en, black-2): It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
Description (ko, x): 감정에 따라 모양이 변하는 파동을 서로 내어 동료끼리 커뮤니케이션을 취하고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 몸에서 발산되는 파동은 무서울 때나 슬플 때에 강해져 동료에게 위기를 알린다.
Description (ko, sun): 사람과 포켓몬의 감정이나 자연의 상태를 파동이라는 파장의 형태로 느낀다.
Description (en, sun): It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.
Description (ko, moon): 밤새 달릴 수 있는 지구력을 갖고 있고 노력가지만 아직 햇병아리다.
Description (en, moon): It’s tough enough to run right through the night, and it’s also a hard worker, but it’s still just a youngster.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 파동이라고 불리는 파를 보면 사람과 포켓몬의 마음을 알 수 있다. 위험한 상대에게는 다가가지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn’t approach dangerous opponents.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 동료와의 커뮤니케이션에 파동이라 불리는 파장을 사용한다. 울지 않아서 적에게 들키지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It uses waves called auras to communicate with others of its kind. It doesn’t make any noise during this time, so its enemies can’t detect it.
Description (ko, sword): 밤새 달릴 수 있을 정도의 체력을 가졌다. 활발해서 같이 산책하는 상대에겐 고역이다.
Description (en, sword): It’s exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.
Description (ko, shield): 상대의 감정뿐만 아니라 자연의 상태도 파동이라는 파장의 형태로 느낀다.
Description (en, shield): It can use waves called auras to gauge how others are feeling. These same waves can also tell this Pokémon about the state of the environment.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

document.title: Lucario — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lucario
ID: 448
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 루카리오
Name (en): Lucario
Description (en, diamond): It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
Description (en, pearl): By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
Description (en, platinum): A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
Description (en, heartgold): It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.
Description (en, black-2): By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
Description (ko, x): 상대가 발하는 파동을 감지하여 생각이나 움직임을 간파할 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 모든 물건이 내는 파동을 읽어내어 1km 앞에 있는 상대의 마음도 이해할 수 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 간파하는 것뿐만 아니라 파동을 조종하는 힘을 얻었다. 싸울 때도 이용한다.
Description (en, sun): Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.
Description (ko, moon): 1km 앞의 생물의 종류나 기분을 캐치한다. 파동을 이용해 무리로 먹이를 사냥한다.
Description (en, moon): They can detect the species of a living being— and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 정신을 집중하고 발산하는 파동이라고 불리는 신비한 파는 큰 바위도 산산이 부숴 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 파동의 파장으로 상대의 기분을 캐치한다. 알고 싶지 않은 일도 알게 되어 스트레스가 잘 쌓인다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Lucario reads its opponent’s feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.
Description (ko, sword): 큰 바위도 산산조각 내는 파동이라 불리는 힘을 다뤄서 먹이를 사냥한다.
Description (en, sword): It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
Description (ko, shield): 사람이 생각하는 것도 알 수 있기 때문에 정직한 마음을 가진 트레이너만 따른다.
Description (en, shield): It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainers who have justice in their hearts can earn this Pokémon’s trust.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.
