document.title: Hippopotas — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hippopotas
ID: 449
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 히포포타스
Name (en): Hippopotas
Description (en, diamond): It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
Description (en, pearl): It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.
Description (en, platinum): It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
Description (en, heartgold): It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.
Description (en, black-2): It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.
Description (ko, x): 건조한 땅에서 산다. 땀 대신 모래알을 몸에서 분비하는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 전신에 모래를 둘러서 세균으로부터 몸을 보호한다. 물에 젖는 것을 싫어한다.
Description (ko, sword): 입을 벌리고 이동하면서 모래째로 먹이를 꿀꺽 삼킨다. 모래는 코로 뿜어내서 버린다.
Description (en, sword): It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.
Description (ko, shield): 주로 낮에 활동한다. 사막의 밤은 기온이 낮아져 모래 깊숙이 들어가 잠을 잔다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

document.title: Hippowdon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hippowdon
ID: 450
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 하마돈
Name (en): Hippowdon
Description (en, diamond): It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
Description (en, pearl): Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.
Description (en, platinum): It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
Description (en, heartgold): It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
Description (ko, x): 크게 입을 벌려 자신의 강함을 어필한다. 대량의 모래를 일으켜 공격한다.
Description (ko, y): 체내에 모아둔 모래를 몸의 구멍에서 뿜어 올려 거대한 회오리를 만들어 공격한다.
Description (ko, sword): 몸에 난 구멍에는 가끔 돌이 끼인다. 돌을 빼주기 때문에 돌살이를 소중하게 지킨다.
Description (en, sword): Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 화나게 하면 굉장히 흉포해진다. 들이마신 모래를 내뿜어 모래바람을 일으킨다.
Description (en, shield): When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

document.title: Skorupi — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Skorupi
ID: 451
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 스콜피
Name (en): Skorupi
Description (en, diamond): It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
Description (en, pearl): It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.
Description (en, platinum): As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
Description (en, heartgold): It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.
Description (en, black-2): It lives in arid regions and can go without food for a year while waiting for prey.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리의 발톱으로 먹이를 집어 독을 주입한다. 독이 퍼질 때까지 절대 놓치지 않는 집념이 있다.
Description (ko, y): 모래 속에 숨어 먹이를 기다리고 있다. 꼬리의 발톱에서 독을 내서 먹이를 꼼짝 못하게 한다.
Description (ko, sword): 모래에 몸을 파묻은 채 가만히 먹이를 기다린다. 태우지네와 조상이 가깝다.
Description (en, sword): After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.
Description (ko, shield): 독이 있는 꼬리의 발톱으로 덤벼든다. 집히면 독이 스며들어 움직일 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, shield): It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon’s poison seeps in.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

document.title: Drapion — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Drapion
ID: 452
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 드래피온
Name (en): Drapion
Description (en, diamond): It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
Description (en, pearl): Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.
Description (en, platinum): Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
Description (en, heartgold): It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.
Description (en, black-2): It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
Description (ko, x): 자랑거리인 파워로 상대를 조각조각 낼 수 있으며 게다가 맹독으로 마무리한다.
Description (ko, y): 양팔의 발톱은 자동차를 동강 내는 파괴력이 있다. 발톱의 끝에서 독을 뿌린다.
Description (ko, sword): 맹독을 지녔지만 사용하는 일은 드물다. 자동차도 때려 부수는 괴력으로 마구 날뛴다.
Description (en, sword): Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.
Description (ko, shield): 사막의 악마라고 불릴 정도로 사납지만 하마돈에게는 싸움도 걸지 않고 얌전하다.
Description (en, shield): It’s so vicious that it’s called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

document.title: Croagunk — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Croagunk
ID: 453
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 삐딱구리
Name (en): Croagunk
Description (en, diamond): Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
Description (en, pearl): Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.
Description (en, platinum): It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
Description (en, heartgold): Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.
Description (en, soulsilver): Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower back pain.
Description (en, black-2): Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.
Description (ko, x): 볼에 독주머니를 가지고 있다. 상대의 틈을 노려 맹독이 배인 손가락을 꿰찌른다.
Description (ko, y): 독주머니를 부풀려서 울어 주변에 으스스한 소리를 퍼트려 상대가 풀죽으면 독찌르기를 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 볼에 독주머니를 가지고 있다. 상대의 틈을 노려 맹독이 밴 손가락을 꿰찌른다.
Description (ko, sword): 볼에 있는 독주머니를 울려서 상대를 위협한다. 풀이 죽은 틈을 타 독찌르기 공격을 한다.
Description (en, sword): It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.
Description (ko, shield): 독을 희석하면 약이 된다. 제약 회사의 마스코트가 된 후로 인기가 많아졌다.
Description (en, shield): Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

document.title: Toxicroak — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Toxicroak
ID: 454
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 독개굴
Name (en): Toxicroak
Description (en, diamond): Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
Description (en, pearl): The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.
Description (en, platinum): It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
Description (en, heartgold): Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.
Description (en, black-2): The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.
Description (ko, x): 목 주변에 독주머니를 지녔다. 목을 울리면 모여진 독이 잘 섞여져서 강력해진다.
Description (ko, y): 주먹의 가시는 긁히기만 해도 생명을 잃을 정도의 맹독을 분비하고 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 튀어 오르듯 상대에게 다가간 뒤 독손톱으로 찌르듯이 공격한다! 스치기만 해도 상대는 KO다.
Description (en, sword): It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.
Description (ko, shield): 사냥감을 처리하면 개굴개굴하며 승리를 자축하는 소리를 높인다. 두빅굴과 가까운 종이다.
Description (en, shield): It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Carnivine
ID: 455
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 무스틈니
Name (en): Carnivine
Description (en, diamond): It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
Description (en, pearl): Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.
Description (en, platinum): It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
Description (en, heartgold): It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.
Description (en, black-2): Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.
Description (ko, x): 달콤한 냄새의 타액으로 먹이를 끌어들여 큰 턱으로 꿀꺽한다. 하루에 걸쳐 먹이를 먹는다.
Description (en, x): It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
Description (ko, y): 늪지대에서 자라는 나무에 엉겨 붙어 달콤한 냄새의 타액으로 먹이를 끌어들여 한입에 먹는다.
Description (en, y): It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

document.title: Finneon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Finneon
ID: 456
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 형광어
Name (en): Finneon
Description (en, diamond): After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
Description (en, pearl): The way its two tail fins flutter while it swims has earned it the nickname “BEAUTIFLY of the Sea.”
Description (en, platinum): The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
Description (en, heartgold): Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.
Description (ko, x): 몸의 옆쪽에 있는 줄에 태양의 빛을 모아둘 수 있다. 밤이 되면 아름답게 빛난다.
Description (ko, y): 햇볕을 잔뜩 쬔 꼬리지느러미의 무늬는 어두워지면 선명한 색으로 반짝이기 시작한다.
Description (ko, sun): 핑크색의 가죽 부분은 태양광을 모아서 빛을 낸다. 위장하기 위해서라고 전해진다.
Description (en, sun): It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.
Description (ko, moon): 2장의 꼬리지느러미로 힘차게 점프한다. 해수면을 뛰어오르는 순간 갈모매가 물고 가버린다.
Description (en, moon): Its double tail fins propel its energetic jumps. When it breaks the surface of the sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on the fly.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 핑크색 모양은 밤이 되면 빛이 난다. 다이버에게 인기여서 리조트에서 길들여지기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They’re popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 빛나는 꼬리지느러미로 먹이를 유인한다. 낮에는 해수면 가까이 있다가 밤이 되면 깊은 곳으로 이동한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.
Description (en, legends-arceus): What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

document.title: Lumineon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lumineon
ID: 457
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 네오라이트
Name (en): Lumineon
Description (en, diamond): It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
Description (en, pearl): To avoid detection by predators, it crawls along the seafloor using the two fins on its chest.
Description (en, platinum): It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with LANTURN.
Description (en, heartgold): LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.
Description (en, black): It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
Description (ko, x): 깊은 바다의 밑바닥에서 산다. 4개의 지느러미 무늬를 반짝거려 먹이를 끌어들인다.
Description (ko, y): 천적에게 발견되지 않도록 가슴에 있는 2개의 지느러미로 해저에 붙어서 이동한다.
Description (ko, sun): 빛으로 먹이를 유인하지만 천적인 사나운 물고기포켓몬까지 다가온다.
Description (en, sun): With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.
Description (ko, moon): 해저에 사는 심해의 포켓몬이다. 지느러미를 사용해 해저를 기어 좋아하는 아쿠스타를 찾는다.
Description (en, moon): This deep-sea Pokémon lives at the bottom of the sea. Its fins haul it over the seabed in search of its favorite food—Starmie.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 깊은 바다 밑은 먹이가 적다. 귀한 먹이를 두고 랜턴과 격렬히 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 심해 해저를 기어가듯 헤엄친다. 환상적인 지느러미의 빛은 밤하늘의 별과 같다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

document.title: Mantyke — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mantyke
ID: 458
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 타만타
Name (en): Mantyke
Description (en, diamond): A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
Description (en, pearl): Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.
Description (en, platinum): People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.
Description (en, heartgold): When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.
Description (en, black): People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.
Description (en, black-2): The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
Description (ko, x): 등의 무늬는 지역에 따라 달라진다. 총어 무리에 섞여 헤엄치는 일이 많다.
Description (ko, y): 해수면 근처에서 헤엄치므로 배 위에서 등 모양을 관찰할 수 있다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 매우 사람을 잘 따른다. 타만타 체험 투어는 인기가 많은 비치 액티비티다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 사람을 잘 따라서 인간의 배 근처까지 다가온다. 등의 모양은 지역에 따라 다르다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.
Description (ko, sword): 바다의 수온이 낮기 때문인지 가라르지방에 사는 타만타는 약간 움직임이 둔한 듯하다.
Description (en, sword): Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.
Description (ko, shield): 총어 무리에 섞여서 헤엄친다. 적에게 습격당하면 무리와 함께 싸운다.
Description (en, shield): It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they’ll all fight together to repel attackers.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

document.title: Snover — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Snover
ID: 459
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 눈쓰개
Name (en): Snover
Description (en, diamond): It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
Description (en, pearl): In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
Description (en, platinum): Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
Description (en, heartgold): During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
Description (ko, x): 추운 계절에는 산기슭까지 내려오지만 봄이 되면 눈이 남아 있는 산 정상으로 돌아간다.
Description (ko, y): 봄이 되면 아이스캔디와 같은 촉감의 나무열매가 배의 주위에 열린다.
Description (ko, sword): 눈이 많이 쌓인 산에 산다. 눈에 다리를 찔러 넣어 수분과 냉기를 흡수한다.
Description (en, sword): It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.
Description (ko, shield): 배에 열리는 아이스크림 같은 나무열매는 가라르에 사는 달막화들이 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, shield): The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.
Description (en, legends-arceus): One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

document.title: Abomasnow — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Abomasnow
ID: 460
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 눈설왕
Name (en): Abomasnow
Description (en, diamond): It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
Description (en, pearl): It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
Description (en, platinum): They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
Description (en, heartgold): It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
Description (ko, x): 블리자드를 발생시켜 주변 일대를 새하얗게 만든다. 별명은 아이스 몬스터다.
Description (ko, y): 만년설이 쌓인 산맥에서 조용히 지낸다. 블리자드를 발생시켜 모습을 감춘다.
Description (ko, sword): 거대한 팔을 해머처럼 내리쳐서 눈쓰개를 노리는 달막화 무리를 내쫓는다.
Description (en, sword): If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.
Description (ko, shield): 블리자드를 일으키는 포켓몬이다. 커다란 몸을 흔들면 부근 일대는 금세 새하얗게 된다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

document.title: Abomasnow — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Abomasnow
ID: 460
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 눈설왕
Name (en): Abomasnow
Description (en, diamond): It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
Description (en, pearl): It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
Description (en, platinum): They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
Description (en, heartgold): It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
Description (ko, x): 블리자드를 발생시켜 주변 일대를 새하얗게 만든다. 별명은 아이스 몬스터다.
Description (ko, y): 만년설이 쌓인 산맥에서 조용히 지낸다. 블리자드를 발생시켜 모습을 감춘다.
Description (ko, sword): 거대한 팔을 해머처럼 내리쳐서 눈쓰개를 노리는 달막화 무리를 내쫓는다.
Description (en, sword): If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.
Description (ko, shield): 블리자드를 일으키는 포켓몬이다. 커다란 몸을 흔들면 부근 일대는 금세 새하얗게 된다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

document.title: Weavile — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Weavile
ID: 461
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 포푸니라
Name (en): Weavile
Description (en, diamond): They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
Description (en, pearl): It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost- covered trees and ice.
Description (en, platinum): Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
Description (en, heartgold): It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
Description (en, black-2): They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.
Description (ko, x): 눈이 많은 지방에 서식한다. 수목에 발톱으로 사인을 그려 동료에게 신호를 보낸다.
Description (ko, y): 추운 지역에서 사는 포켓몬이다. 4, 5마리의 그룹은 훌륭한 연계 작전으로 먹이를 몰아넣는다.
Description (ko, sun): 4~5마리의 그룹으로 행동한다. 바위나 나무에 표시를 남겨 연계 플레이로 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (en, sun): They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.
Description (ko, moon): 추운 장소에 살며 알로라에서는 식스테일과 모래두지가 주된 먹이다. 사냥감은 동료끼리 정확히 나눈다.
Description (en, moon): They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon’s main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 1마리가 모래두지에게 다리를 걸어 뒤집으면 다른 1마리가 날카로운 발톱으로 처리한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 영리해져서 먹이를 두고 싸우지 않게 되었다. 손톱으로 할퀴어지면 동상에 걸린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from its claws will give you a case of frostbite!
Description (ko, sword): 무리를 지어 먹이를 공격한다. 팀플레이로 맘모꾸리 같은 큰 상대도 손쉽게 처리한다.
Description (en, sword): They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.
Description (ko, shield): 발톱으로 사인을 그려 동료와 연락한다. 사인의 종류는 500가지가 넘는다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Magnezone — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Magnezone
ID: 462
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 자포코일
Name (en): Magnezone
Description (en, diamond): It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
Description (en, platinum): A group tried to use scientific means to make MAGNEZONE evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
Description (en, heartgold): Exposure to a special magnetic field changed MAGNETON’s molecular structure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.
Description (en, black): A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
Description (en, black-2): Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
Description (ko, x): 너무 강한 자력을 내어 자포코일끼리 끌어당겨 전혀 못 움직이기도 한다.
Description (ko, y): 특수한 자기장의 영향으로 레어코일이 진화했다. 3개의 유닛에서 자력을 발산한다.
Description (ko, sun): 3개의 유닛으로부터 자력을 발산한다. 밤하늘을 나는 자포코일을 UFO로 착각하는 보고가 많이 발생한다.
Description (en, sun): Three units generate magnetism. There have been many mistaken reports of UFO sightings when Magnezone flies through the night sky.
Description (ko, moon): 괴전파를 발신하면서 하늘을 날아 미지의 전파를 수신하고 있다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 자신의 영토를 레이더로 감시하고 있다. 침입자는 파괴광선으로 즉시 처분한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아직까지 우주에서 왔다고 믿는 사람들도 있다. 강력한 자력을 발산한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): There are still people who believe that this Pokémon came from outer space. It emanates a powerful magnetic field.
Description (ko, sword): 머리의 안테나로 누군가가 보낸 전파를 우주로부터 수신하여 조종당하고 있다고 전해진다.
Description (en, sword): Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it’s being controlled by some mysterious being.
Description (ko, shield): 특수한 자기장의 영향으로 몸의 분자 구조가 변화해 진화했다고 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, shield): It’s thought that a special magnetic field changed the molecular structure of this Pokémon’s body, and that’s what caused the Pokémon’s evolution.
Description (en, legends-arceus): I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Lickilicky — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lickilicky
ID: 463
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 내룸벨트
Name (en): Lickilicky
Description (en, diamond): It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
Description (en, platinum): The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
Description (en, heartgold): Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.
Description (en, soulsilver): It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.
Description (en, black-2): Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.
Description (ko, x): 쭉쭉 늘어나는 혓바닥으로 무엇이든 휘감는다. 함부로 다가가면 타액으로 끈적끈적거리게 된다.
Description (ko, y): 타액에는 어떤 것도 녹이는 성분이 충분히 포함되어 있어 핥으면 언제까지나 마비된다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 혀가 어디까지 늘어나는지 콘테스트가 열린다. 현재 최고 기록은 25m다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 손발보다 혀를 사용하는 것이 훨씬 능숙하다. 작은 콩 1알도 능숙하게 집을 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.
Description (ko, sword): 몸의 몇 배의 길이로 늘어나는 신비한 혀를 가졌다. 그 비밀은 아직 밝혀지지 않았다.
Description (en, sword): Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.
Description (ko, shield): 사람의 팔과 견줄 수 있을 정도의 활용도 높은 혀로 뭐든지 한다. 반대로 손은 무디다.
Description (en, shield): Lickilicky can do just about anything with its tongue, which is as dexterous as the human hand. In contrast, Lickilicky’s use of its fingers is clumsy.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Rhyperior — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Rhyperior
ID: 464
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 거대코뿌리
Name (en): Rhyperior
Description (en, diamond): It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
Description (en, platinum): It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
Description (en, heartgold): From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
Description (ko, x): 손바닥의 구멍에서 꼬마돌을 발사한다. 전신의 프로텍터는 화산의 분화도 견뎌낸다.
Description (en, x): From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
Description (ko, y): 바위를 손바닥의 구멍에 채워서 근육의 힘으로 발사한다. 드물게 꼬마돌을 날린다.
Description (en, y): It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
Description (ko, sword): 손에 난 구멍에 바위나 단굴을 끼운 뒤 발사한다. 장전할 수 있는 수는 한쪽 팔당 3개씩이다.
Description (en, sword): It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.
Description (ko, shield): 프로텍터로 공격을 튕겨내고 상대가 풀이 죽으면 특징적인 드릴로 관통한다.
Description (en, shield): It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tangrowth — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tangrowth
ID: 465
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 덩쿠림보
Name (en): Tangrowth
Description (en, diamond): It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
Description (en, platinum): Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
Description (en, heartgold): When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.
Description (en, black-2): Even if one of its arms is eaten, it’s fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.
Description (ko, x): 식물의 덩굴로 이루어진 팔을 늘여서 먹이를 포박한다. 팔을 먹혀도 아무렇지도 않다.
Description (ko, y): 따뜻한 계절이 오면 눈이 보이지 않을 정도로 식물의 덩굴이 계속 자란다.
Description (ko, sword): 자유자재로 늘어나는 2개의 팔은 덩굴이 뭉쳐진 것이었다는 사실이 최근 연구로 밝혀졌다.
Description (en, sword): Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
Description (ko, shield): 따듯한 땅에서 살수록 덩굴의 성장이 빠르다. 길어지면 스스로 잘라내어 짧게 만든다.
Description (en, shield): Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Electivire — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Electivire
ID: 466
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에레키블
Name (en): Electivire
Description (en, diamond): It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
Description (en, platinum): Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
Description (en, heartgold): As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
Description (en, black-2): The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.
Description (ko, x): 전기를 가득 모으면 2개의 뿔 사이에서 세차게 푸르스름한 불티를 뿌린다.
Description (ko, y): 2개의 꼬리 끝을 상대에게 바싹 대어 2만 볼트 이상의 전류를 흘려 공격한다.
Description (ko, sun): 꼬리의 끝을 적에게 밀어붙여 고압 전류를 흘려보낸다. 한순간에 적은 까맣게 탄다.
Description (en, sun): It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.
Description (ko, moon): 흥분하면 가슴을 두들긴다. 그때마다 전기 불꽃이 튀며 천둥소리가 주변에 울려 퍼진다.
Description (en, moon): When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 전기를 내뿜는 꼬리를 잡고 주먹에 전기를 머금으면 있는 힘껏 때린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It grips its tail, which spews electricity, and then beats down opponents with the power of its electrified fist.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 에레키블 1마리로 대도시 건물 전체의 전력을 1년 동안 공급할 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.
Description (ko, sword): 발전량은 심박 수에 비례한다. 싸움이 시작되면 단숨에 전압이 올라간다.
Description (en, sword): The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
Description (ko, shield): 발전량은 전기포켓몬 중에서도 손꼽히는 수준이다. 꼬리 끝에서 고압 전류를 방전한다.
Description (en, shield): In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivire is one of the best among all Electric Pokémon. It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Magmortar — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Magmortar
ID: 467
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마그마번
Name (en): Magmortar
Description (en, diamond): It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
Description (en, platinum): When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
Description (en, heartgold): It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.
Description (en, black-2): When shooting 3,600 degree F fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
Description (ko, x): 팔 끝에서 섭씨 2000도의 불구슬을 발사한다. 화산의 분화구를 거처로 삼는다.
Description (en, x): It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
Description (ko, y): 섭씨 2000도의 불구슬을 팔 끝에서 내보낸다. 입에서 뿜는 숨도 타오르고 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 화산의 화구에 산다. 1개의 화산에는 암수 한 쌍의 마그마번 밖에 없다고 한다.
Description (en, sun): They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano.
Description (ko, moon): 팔 끝에서 섭씨 2000도의 불구슬을 발사한다. 연사하면 팔 끝이 조금 녹는다.
Description (en, moon): From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 지금도 금속을 가공할 때 마그마번의 불꽃에 의존하는 공장이 적지 않다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 불구슬을 발사해서 적을 처리한다. 새까만 재가 되어서 먹이를 잡는 데는 사용하지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.
Description (ko, sword): 크게 숨을 들이쉬면 배 안의 불꽃이 더욱 거세어져서 섭씨 200도에 달하게 된다.
Description (en, sword): When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, shield): 화산의 화구에서 사는 동안 마그마 덩어리 모양의 기관을 가진 화산 같은 몸이 되었다.
Description (en, shield): Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this Pokémon’s body to resemble its environment— it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Togekiss — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Togekiss
ID: 468
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 토게키스
Name (en): Togekiss
Description (en, diamond): It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
Description (en, platinum): It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
Description (en, heartgold): As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
Description (ko, x): 다툼이 없는 평화로운 땅에 토게키스가 나타나 여러 가지 은총을 나눠줬다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, y): 서로 존재를 인정하고 쓸데없는 분쟁을 하지 않는 사람을 위해 다양한 은총을 나누어 준다.
Description (ko, sword): 분쟁이나 다툼이 일어나는 장소에는 모습을 드러내지 않는다. 최근에는 거의 보이지 않는다.
Description (en, sword): These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.
Description (ko, shield): 은총을 베푸는 존재로 전해지고 있으며 먼 옛날부터 길조로 묘사되어 왔다.
Description (en, shield): Known as a bringer of blessings, it’s been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

document.title: Yanmega — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Yanmega
ID: 469
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메가자리
Name (en): Yanmega
Description (en, diamond): By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
Description (en, platinum): Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
Description (en, heartgold): This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
Description (en, soulsilver): The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.
Description (en, black-2): It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
Description (ko, x): 고속으로 날아서 스친 상대의 목을 한순간에 물어뜯는 싸움법을 선호한다.
Description (ko, y): 6개의 다리로 어른을 껴안고도 너끈히 날 수 있다. 꼬리의 날개로 균형을 잡는다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

document.title: Leafeon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Leafeon
ID: 470
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 리피아
Name (en): Leafeon
Description (en, diamond): Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
Description (en, platinum): It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
Description (en, heartgold): When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
Description (en, black-2): With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.
Description (ko, x): 맑은 날에 잠든 리피아는 광합성을 해서 깨끗한 공기를 만들고 있다.
Description (en, x): When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
Description (ko, y): 식물처럼 광합성을 하기 때문에 리피아의 주위는 맑은 공기로 둘러싸여 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 세포구성은 동물보다는 식물에 가깝다. 광합성을 통해 안 먹어도 에너지를 얻을 수 있다.
Description (en, sun): Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.
Description (ko, moon): 어린 리피아일수록 코를 찌르는 풋내가 난다. 나이를 먹으면 낙엽 같은 냄새로 바뀐다.
Description (en, moon): The younger they are, the more they smell like fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the odor of fallen leaves.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 다툼을 좋아하지 않지만 동료를 지키기 위해서라면 꼬리의 잎사귀를 날카로운 칼날로 만들어 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it doesn’t like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 광합성으로 영양을 보충한다. 깨끗한 강이 흐르는 숲의 깊은 곳에 조용하게 살고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It gets its nutrition from photosynthesis. It lives a quiet life deep in forests where clean rivers flow.
Description (ko, sword): 잎사귀에서 나는 독특한 향기는 가라르인들의 취향에 맞다. 향수로 가공되어 인기가 높다.
Description (en, sword): Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popular perfume made using that scent.
Description (ko, shield): 꼬리는 날카로운 칼날 같다. 큰 나무도 두 동강 내는 탁월한 예리함을 자랑한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon’s tail is blade sharp, with a fantastic cutting edge that can slice right though large trees.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

document.title: Glaceon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Glaceon
ID: 471
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 글레이시아
Name (en): Glaceon
Description (en, diamond): As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
Description (en, platinum): By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
Description (en, heartgold): It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.
Description (en, black-2): It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.
Description (ko, x): 체온을 컨트롤하는 것으로 주위의 공기를 얼려서 다이아몬드 더스트를 날린다.
Description (ko, y): 체온을 내리는 것으로 전신의 털을 얼려서 날카롭고 뾰족한 바늘처럼 만들어 날린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 체온을 컨트롤하는 것으로 주위의 공기를 얼려서 다이아몬드더스트를 날린다.
Description (ko, sun): 체온을 자유자재로 컨트롤해 대기의 수분을 얼려서 다이아몬드더스트를 일으킨다.
Description (en, sun): It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.
Description (ko, moon): 털을 얼려서 날카로운 고드름처럼 뾰족하게 한 뒤 먹이를 향해 태클을 건다.
Description (en, moon): It freezes its fur into icicles, spiky and sharp, and tackles its prey.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸의 털을 얼려 예리한 바늘로 만들어 몸을 지킨다. 체온은 마이너스 60도까지 내릴 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 순식간에 주위의 수분을 얼려서 얼음 결정을 만든 후 먹이를 향해 날린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that’s around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey.
Description (ko, sword): 다이아몬드더스트를 내리게 한다. 그 아름다움에 현혹된 먹이는 눈치채기도 전에 얼어붙어 버린다.
Description (en, sword): Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it.
Description (ko, shield): 글레이시아가 발산하는 냉기는 가루눈을 만들어 내기 때문에 스키장에서 인기가 높다.
Description (en, shield): The coldness emanating from Glaceon causes powdery snow to form, making it quite a popular Pokémon at ski resorts.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

document.title: Gliscor — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gliscor
ID: 472
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 글라이온
Name (en): Gliscor
Description (en, diamond): It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
Description (en, platinum): If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
Description (en, heartgold): Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
Description (en, black-2): It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리로 나뭇가지에 매달려 먹이를 관찰한다. 틈을 봐서 상공에서 덮친다.
Description (ko, y): 날갯소리를 내지 않고 하늘을 난다. 긴 꼬리로 먹이를 잡아 송곳니로 급소를 공격한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

document.title: Mamoswine — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mamoswine
ID: 473
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 맘모꾸리
Name (en): Mamoswine
Description (en, diamond): Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
Description (en, platinum): A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
Description (en, heartgold): A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
Description (en, soulsilver): It flourished worldwide during the ice age but its population declined when the masses of ice began to dwindle.
Description (en, black-2): When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared.
Description (ko, x): 1만 년 전의 얼음 밑에서 발견된 적이 있을 정도로 오랜 옛날부터 있었던 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, x): A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
Description (ko, y): 얼음으로 만들어진 훌륭한 이빨이 있다. 빙하기가 끝나고 따뜻해졌기 때문에 수가 줄어들었다.
Description (ko, sword): 1만 년 전의 벽화에도 그려져 있다. 멸종되었다고 여겨지던 시기도 있었다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.
Description (ko, shield): 생긴 것처럼 힘이 장사다. 얼음으로 된 엄니는 추울수록 굵고 길어지면서 늠름해진다.
Description (en, shield): It looks strong, and that’s exactly what it is. As the weather grows colder, its ice tusks grow longer, thicker, and more impressive.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

document.title: Porygon-Z — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Porygon-Z
ID: 474
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 폴리곤Z
Name (en): Porygon-Z
Description (en, diamond): Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
Description (en, platinum): Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
Description (en, heartgold): Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...
Description (ko, x): 더욱 우수한 포켓몬으로 만들고자 프로그램을 추가했지만 어쩐지 괴상하게 행동하기 시작했다.
Description (ko, y): 다른 차원의 공간을 자유롭게 이동할 수 있도록 프로그램을 수정했지만 실수한 것 같다.
Description (ko, sun): 더 우월한 포켓몬을 목표로 추가한 프로그램에 문제가 있었는지 움직임이 이상하다.
Description (en, sun): In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.
Description (ko, moon): 다른 차원의 공간에서의 활동을 목표로 프로그램을 갱신했으나 괴상한 동작이 눈에 띈다.
Description (en, moon): Its program was modified to facilitate extra-dimensional activities, but that led to noticeably strange behavior.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 불안정한 거동이 눈에 띈다. 프로그램을 업데이트한 기술자의 실력이 문제인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 추가한 프로그램이 좋지 않았다. 괴상한 동작이 눈에 띄는 걸 보니 실험에 실패한 것일지도 모른다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.
Description (ko, sword): 다른 공간에 드나들 수 있는 프로그램을 추가한 결과 움직임이 불안정해졌다.
Description (en, sword): Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.
Description (ko, shield): 추가 프로그램으로 진화했다고 전해지지만 정말 진화인 건지 학회에서도 의견이 나뉜다.
Description (en, shield): Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can’t agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

document.title: Gallade — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gallade
ID: 475
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 엘레이드
Name (en): Gallade
Description (en, diamond): A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
Description (en, platinum): When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
Description (en, heartgold): Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
Description (ko, x): 상대의 생각을 민감하게 포착하는 능력을 가졌기 때문에 먼저 공격할 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 늘었다 줄었다 하는 팔꿈치의 칼날로 싸운다. 칼 뽑기의 명수 이며 예의가 바른 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, sword): 무사라 불리는 포켓몬. 무언가를 지킬 때가 아니면 팔꿈치의 칼날을 사용하지 않는다.
Description (en, sword): True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.
Description (ko, shield): 도움을 구하는 감정을 민감하게 캐치해서 상대가 있는 곳으로 급히 달려가 가세한다.
Description (en, shield): Sharply attuned to others’ wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Probopass
ID: 476
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 대코파스
Name (en): Probopass
Description (en, diamond): It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
Description (en, platinum): It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
Description (en, heartgold): It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.
Description (en, black-2): It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
Description (ko, x): 전신에서 강한 자력을 발산하고 있다. 꼬마코파스라고 불리는 3개의 유닛을 조종한다.
Description (ko, y): 꼬마코파스라고 불리는 작은 3개의 유닛을 자력으로 자유자재로 조종한다.
Description (ko, sun): 강한 자력을 뿜어내기 때문에 가까이 있는 전기 제품은 망가져 버리고 만다.
Description (en, sun): It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.
Description (ko, moon): 본체는 움직이지 않고 꼬마코파스라고 불리는 3개의 유닛을 자유자재로 조종하여 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (en, moon): The main body controls three mobile units called Mini-Noses, which it maneuvers to catch prey.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 꼬마코파스라고 불리는 유닛을 조종하지만 가끔 미아가 되어 돌아오지 않는 경우도 있는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don’t come back.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 3개의 작은 유닛을 사용해서 먹이를 잡거나 적과 싸운다. 본체는 거의 명령할 뿐이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

document.title: Dusknoir — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dusknoir
ID: 477
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 야느와르몽
Name (en): Dusknoir
Description (en, diamond): The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
Description (en, platinum): It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
Description (en, heartgold): This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.
Description (ko, x): 탄력 있는 몸 안에 갈 곳 없는 영혼을 가두어 저승으로 데려간다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, y): 머리의 안테나로 영계로부터의 전파를 수신한다. 지시를 받아 사람을 영계로 데리고 간다.
Description (ko, sword): 의지가 있는 것인지 알 수 없다. 영계로부터의 전파에 따라 사람이나 포켓몬을 데리고 간다.
Description (en, sword): At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
Description (ko, shield): 노린 상대를 배의 입으로 통째로 삼킨다. 영혼만 먹은 뒤 육체는 뱉어내고 떠난다.
Description (en, shield): With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten— Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

document.title: Froslass — PokéAPI species CSV

PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Froslass
ID: 478
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 눈여아
Name (en): Froslass
Description (en, diamond): It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
Description (en, platinum): It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
Description (en, heartgold): Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.
Description (en, soulsilver): Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS
Description (ko, x): 마이너스 50도의 냉기를 뿜어 상대를 얼려 버린다. 몸통 같은 부분은 실제로는 빈 공간이다.
Description (en, x): It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
Description (ko, y): 설산에서 조난당한 여성이 다시 태어난 것이라고 하는 전설이 눈이 많은 땅에 남아 있다.
Description (en, y): Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.
Description (ko, sun): 마음에 든 인간과 포켓몬을 냉기로 얼린다. 보금자리에 가져가서 장식한다.
Description (en, sun): When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.
Description (ko, moon): 설산에서 조난당한 여성의 영혼이 고드름에 옮겨붙었다. 남성의 영혼을 좋아한다.
Description (en, moon): The soul of a woman lost on a snowy mountain possessed an icicle, becoming this Pokémon. The food it most relishes is the souls of men.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 설산에 등산 온 남자를 얼려버려 집으로 가지고 간다. 미남만 노린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 심하게 눈보라 치는 밤에 사람이 사는 마을에 내려온다고 한다. 노크해도 문을 열어줘선 안 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it comes down to human settlements. If you hear it knocking at your door, do not open it!
Description (ko, sword): 설산에서 죽은 여자의 원념에서 태어난 포켓몬. 얼린 영혼을 즐겨 먹는다.
Description (en, sword): After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.
Description (ko, shield): 마이너스 50도의 냉기를 뿜어 먹이를 얼린 뒤 거처로 가져가서 가지런히 나열한다.
Description (en, shield): It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

document.title: Rotom — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Rotom
ID: 479
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 로토무
Name (en): Rotom
Description (en, diamond): Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
Description (en, platinum): Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
Description (en, heartgold): Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
Description (ko, x): 특수한 모터를 움직이는 동력원으로서 긴 시간 동안 연구되었던 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 플라스마로 된 몸을 가지고 있다. 전자 제품에 숨어들어 나쁜 짓을 하는 것으로 알려졌다.
Description (ko, sword): 어떤 소년의 발명에 의해 로토무를 활용한 다양한 기계가 만들어지기 시작했다.
Description (en, sword): One boy’s invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom’s unique capabilities.
Description (ko, shield): 플라스마로 된 몸으로 다양한 기계에 숨는다. 놀라게 하는 걸 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, shield): With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Uxie
ID: 480
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 유크시
Name (en): Uxie
Description (en, diamond): Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
Description (en, pearl): It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
Description (en, platinum): When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
Description (en, heartgold): According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.
Description (en, black): When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
Description (ko, x): 지식의 신이라 불리고 있다. 눈을 마주친 사람의 기억을 지워 버리는 힘을 가지고 있다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 유크시의 탄생에 의해 사람들의 생활을 풍요롭게 하는 지혜가 생겨났다고 전해진다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mesprit
ID: 481
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 엠라이트
Name (en): Mesprit
Description (en, diamond): Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
Description (en, pearl): It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.
Description (en, platinum): When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
Description (en, heartgold): This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.
Description (en, black): When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
Description (ko, x): 슬픔의 괴로움과 즐거움의 소중함을 사람들에게 가르쳐 주었다. 감정의 신이라 불리고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 호수의 밑바닥에서 잠자고 있지만 영혼이 빠져나가서 수면을 날아다닌다고 전해진다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

document.body:

Name (ko): 아그놈
Name (en): Azelf
Description (en, diamond): Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
Description (en, pearl): It is thought that UXIE, MESPRIT and AZELF all came from the same egg.
Description (en, platinum): When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
Description (en, heartgold): This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.
Description (en, black): When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
Description (ko, x): 의지의 신이라 불리고 있다. 호수의 밑바닥에서 계속 잠을 자며 세계의 균형을 지키고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 유크시, 엠라이트, 아그놈은 같은 알에서 태어난 포켓몬이라 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, y): It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

document.title: Dialga — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dialga
ID: 483
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 디아루가
Name (en): Dialga
Description (en, diamond): It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
Description (en, pearl): A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when DIALGA was born.
Description (en, platinum): A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.
Description (en, heartgold): This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.
Description (en, black): A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
Description (ko, x): 디아루가가 태어남으로써 시간이 움직이기 시작했다는 전설이 내려오는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, x): A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
Description (ko, y): 시간을 조종하는 힘을 가지고 있다. 신오지방에서는 신이라고 불리며 신화에 등장한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

ID: 497
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 샤로다
Name (en): Serperior
Description (en, black): It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
Description (en, white): They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.
Description (en, black-2): It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
Description (ko, x): 샤로다의 고상한 눈동자로 쏘아보아도 태연할 정도로 강한 상대에게만 진정한 실력을 발휘한다.
Description (ko, y): 째려보기만 해도 상대의 움직임을 멈추게 한다. 태양에너지를 체내에서 증폭시킨다.

document.body:

Name: Tepig
ID: 498
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 뚜꾸리
Name (en): Tepig
Description (en, black): It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
Description (en, white): It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.
Description (en, black-2): It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
Description (ko, x): 적의 공격을 가볍게 피하고 코로 불구슬을 쏘아댄다. 불꽃으로 나무열매를 구워 먹는다.
Description (ko, y): 구운 나무열매를 먹는 것을 매우 좋아하지만 너무 흥분해서 가끔 새까맣게 태워버린다.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pignite
ID: 499
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 차오꿀
Name (en): Pignite
Description (en, black): When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
Description (en, white): Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.
Description (en, black-2): The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
Description (ko, x): 먹을수록 태울 것이 많아져 위 속의 불꽃이 강해지고 파워도 점점 넘치게 된다.
Description (ko, y): 체내의 불꽃이 타오르면 움직임이 더 빠르고 예리해진다. 위급해지면 연기를 뿜어낸다.

Name (en): Emboar

Description (en, white): It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
Description (en, black-2): A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.

document.title: Oshawott — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Oshawott
ID: 501
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 수댕이
Name (en): Oshawott
Description (en, black): It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
Description (en, white): The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.
Description (en, black-2): The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
Description (ko, x): 배에 생기는 가리비칼은 싸울 때뿐 아니라 딱딱한 나무열매를 쪼갤 때도 사용한다.
Description (ko, y): 배에 있는 가리비칼로 싸운다. 공격을 막고 그 즉시 베어 반격한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

document.title: Dewott — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dewott
ID: 502
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 쌍검자비
Name (en): Dewott
Description (en, black): Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
Description (en, white): Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.
Description (en, black-2): As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
Description (ko, x): 물 흐르는 듯한 칼솜씨로 2개의 가리비칼을 사용하는 기술은 엄격한 수련을 통해 익힌 것이다.
Description (ko, y): 혹독한 수행 끝에 쌍검자비마다 다른 형태의 가리비칼 다루는 기술을 습득한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 물 흐르는 듯한 칼 솜씨로 2개의 가리비칼을 사용하는 기술은 엄격한 수련을 통해 익힌 것이다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

document.title: Samurott — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Samurott
ID: 503
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 대검귀
Name (en): Samurott
Description (en, black): One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
Description (en, white): Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.
Description (en, black-2): In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
Description (ko, x): 상대가 눈을 깜빡이는 동안에 앞다리에 붙어 있는 각검으로 상대를 베고 원래대로 되돌린다.
Description (ko, y): 갑옷에 내장된 검으로 한칼에 상대를 제압한다. 눈빛만으로 상대를 침묵시킨다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

document.title: Patrat — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Patrat
ID: 504
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 보르쥐
Name (en): Patrat
Description (en, black): Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
Description (en, white): Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.
Description (en, black-2): Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
Description (ko, x): 볼의 주머니에 먹이를 모아두고 며칠이고 망보기를 계속한다. 꼬리로 동료에게 신호한다.
Description (ko, y): 경계심이 강해서 반드시 한 마리는 망을 보고 있으나 뒤에서 오는 상대는 알아차리지 못한다.

Name: Watchog
ID: 505
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 보르그
Name (en): Watchog
Description (en, black): When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
Description (en, white): They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
Description (en, black-2): Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
Description (ko, x): 체내의 발광물질로 눈이나 몸을 빛나게 하여 습격해 온 상대를 풀이 죽게 만든다.
Description (ko, y): 뺨의 주머니에 모아둔 나무열매의 씨앗을 날려서 공격한다. 적을 발견하면 꼬리를 세운다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 체내의 발광 물질로 눈이나 몸을 빛나게 하여 습격해 온 상대를 풀이 죽게 만든다.
