document.title: Lillipup — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lillipup
ID: 506
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 요테리
Name (en): Lillipup
Description (en, black): It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
Description (en, white): The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
Description (en, black-2): Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.
Description (ko, x): 얼굴을 둘러싼 긴 털은 우수한 레이더다. 주위 상황을 민감히 살핀다.
Description (ko, y): 용맹한 포켓몬이지만 상대의 강함을 확인하고 싸움을 피하는 영리함도 함께 갖추고 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 컹컹 짖거나 하지 않으므로 맨션에 사는 트레이너에게 인기가 많은 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sun): Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.
Description (ko, moon): 얼굴을 둘러싼 털은 레이더 역할을 하여 싸우는 상대의 상태를 살핀다.
Description (en, moon): The long fur surrounding its face functions as radar, enabling it to probe the condition of its battle opponents.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 판단력이 뛰어난 포켓몬. 이길 수 없는 상대라고 판단되면 바로 꼬리를 내리고 도망친다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can’t defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 영리해서 트레이너가 하는 말을 잘 따르기 때문에 초보자라도 키우기 쉬워서 인기 있는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it’s intelligent, obedient to its Trainer’s commands, and easy to raise.
Description (ko, sword): 용감하고 신중하다. 얼굴을 덮고 있는 부드러운 털로 주변의 정보를 캐치한다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.
Description (ko, shield): 또래의 아이보다 훨씬 영리하다. 사랑받은 것도 혼난 것도 잊지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Herdier — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Herdier
ID: 507
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 하데리어
Name (en): Herdier
Description (en, black): It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
Description (en, white): It loyally follows its Trainer’s orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.
Description (en, black-2): This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
Description (ko, x): 트레이너를 도와주면서 다른 포켓몬을 돌보기도 하는 매우 충실한 포켓몬.
Description (ko, y): 매우 단단한 검은 털이 망토처럼 몸을 둘러싸고 있다. 입은 데미지를 줄여준다.
Description (ko, sun): 검은 털은 매우 단단하며 빠르게 자란다. 손질 비용이 들어서 큰일인 포켓몬.
Description (en, sun): Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.
Description (ko, moon): 주인의 명령에 충실하다. 그러나 아래라고 보는 상대가 하는 말은 절대로 듣지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon obeys its master’s orders faithfully. However, it refuses to listen to anything said by a person it doesn’t respect.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 검은 털은 자랄수록 딱딱하고 튼튼해져 발톱이나 이빨로도 쉽게 뚫을 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can’t easily penetrate it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먼 옛날의 벽화에 모습이 그려져 있을 정도로 오랫동안 인간과 생활을 함께해 왔다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.
Description (ko, sword): 매우 영리하고 금방 친해진다. 인간의 파트너가 된 첫 포켓몬이라는 설도 있다.
Description (en, sword): Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.
Description (ko, shield): 몸을 뒤덮은 검은 털은 두껍고 탄력이 있다. 날카로운 이빨도 튕겨낸다.
Description (en, shield): The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Stoutland — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Stoutland
ID: 508
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 바랜드
Name (en): Stoutland
Description (en, black): It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
Description (en, white): This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.
Description (en, black-2): Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.
Description (ko, x): 눈보라로 길이 막힌 산에 들어가 조난된 사람을 구해준다. 긴 털이 추위를 막는다.
Description (ko, y): 긴 털에 둘러싸이면 겨울 산에서 하룻밤을 보내도 괜찮을 정도로 따뜻하고 매우 기분이 좋다.
Description (ko, sun): 똑똑하고 온후하며 용감하다. 구조대 대원들의 믿음직한 동료이다.
Description (en, sun): Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.
Description (ko, moon): 영리해서 사람을 공격할 걱정이 없어 아이를 돌보게 하는 부모도 있다.
Description (en, moon): With this wise Pokémon, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 길고 따듯한 털 덕분에 추위는 걱정 없다. 알로라의 바랜드는 조금 괴로운 것 같다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 길고 두꺼운 털을 가졌다. 옛날 추운 지방에서는 한 집에 1마리씩 바랜드를 키웠다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.
Description (ko, sword): 사람과 사는 것을 좋아하는 듯하다. 야생에서 잡아도 3일만 지나면 사람을 따르게 된다.
Description (en, sword): These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.
Description (ko, shield): 훌륭한 수염이 특징인 포켓몬이다. 그 길이로 동료들과 우열을 가린다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Purrloin — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Purrloin
ID: 509
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 쌔비냥
Name (en): Purrloin
Description (en, black): They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
Description (en, white): Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
Description (en, black-2): Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.
Description (ko, x): 귀여운 행동으로 방심하게 한 후 그 틈에 지닌 물건을 빼앗아 간다. 화가 나면 손톱을 세워서 반격한다.
Description (ko, y): 다른 사람의 물건을 장난삼아 훔친다. 물건을 도둑맞은 사람도 애교 넘치는 행동에 빠져 용서하고 만다.
Description (ko, sword): 곤란해하는 모습을 보기 위해 사람의 물건을 훔친다. 훔처우와는 라이벌 관계다.
Description (en, sword): It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.
Description (ko, shield): 귀여운 동작으로 방심시키고 상대가 다가오면 갑자기 발톱으로 할퀴고는 웃는다.
Description (en, shield): Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

document.title: Liepard — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Liepard
ID: 510
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 레파르다스
Name (en): Liepard
Description (en, black): These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
Description (en, white): Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.
Description (en, black-2): Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
Description (ko, x): 아름다운 스타일은 전신의 발달한 근육 덕분이다. 소리도 내지 않고 밤을 달린다.
Description (ko, y): 기척을 지우고 접근한다. 상대가 눈치채기 전에 뒤쪽으로 살며시 다가가 꼼짝 못하게 한다.
Description (ko, sword): 아름다운 털과 스타일에 쉽게 매료되지만 변덕스럽고 흉포한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sword): Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 폭슬라이와 영역을 두고 다툰다. 소리를 전혀 내지 않고 먹이의 배후에 접근한다.
Description (en, shield): This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Pansage — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pansage
ID: 511
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 야나프
Name (en): Pansage
Description (en, black): This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
Description (en, white): It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
Description (en, black-2): It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
Description (ko, x): 기운이 없는 포켓몬에게 머리의 잎사귀를 나눠준다. 피로를 풀어주는 효과가 있다.
Description (ko, y): 나무열매를 잘 찾아 여기저기에서 모아 동료에게 나누어 주는 상냥함을 가졌다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Simisage — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Simisage
ID: 512
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 야나키
Name (en): Simisage
Description (en, black): Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
Description (en, white): It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
Description (en, black-2): It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
Description (ko, x): 가시가 잔뜩 박힌 꼬리를 상대에게 힘껏 쳐서 공격한다. 기질이 격한 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 기질이 격하여 가시가 박힌 꼬리를 휘두르며 싸운다. 머리의 잎사귀는 매우 쓰다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Pansear — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pansear
ID: 513
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 바오프
Name (en): Pansear
Description (en, black): When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
Description (en, white): This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.
Description (en, black-2): Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
Description (ko, x): 지능이 높고 나무열매는 구운 뒤 먹는 습성이 있다. 사람 도와주기를 좋아한다.
Description (ko, y): 화산 동굴에서 산다. 머리의 송아리 속이 불타고 있어 300도나 되는 높은 온도가 된다.
Description (en, y): This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Simisear — PokéAPI species CSV

ID: 514
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 바오키
Name (en): Simisear
Description (en, black): It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
Description (en, white): A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
Description (en, black-2): When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
Description (ko, x): 몸속에서 태운 불꽃을 머리나 꼬리로 흩뿌려서 상대를 태운다.
Description (ko, y): 흥분하면 머리나 꼬리에서 불티가 날아올라 뜨거워진다. 왜인지 달콤한 것을 매우 좋아한다.

document.title: Panpour — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Panpour
ID: 515
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 앗차프
Name (en): Panpour
Description (en, black): The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
Description (en, white): It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.
Description (en, black-2): The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
Description (ko, x): 머리 송아리에 모은 물은 영양 듬뿍. 꼬리를 사용해서 그 물을 초목에 뿌린다.
Description (ko, y): 머리의 송아리에 모은 물은 영양이 가득하다. 식물에 뿌려주면 크게 자란다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Simipour — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Simipour
ID: 516
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 앗차키
Name (en): Simipour
Description (en, black): The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
Description (en, white): The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
Description (en, black-2): It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리에서 발사하는 고압의 물은 콘크리트 벽도 파괴할 수 있는 위력을 지녔다.
Description (ko, y): 물이 깨끗한 장소를 좋아한다. 머리에 모아둔 물이 줄어들면 꼬리에서 빨아올려 보급한다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Munna — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Munna
ID: 517
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 몽나
Name (en): Munna
Description (en, black): Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
Description (en, white): It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.
Description (en, black-2): This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
Description (ko, x): 나쁜 꿈에 시달리고 있는 포켓몬이나 사람 앞에 나타나 그 꿈을 먹어버리는 포켓몬.
Description (ko, y): 사람이나 포켓몬이 꾼 꿈을 먹는다. 즐거운 꿈을 먹으면 분홍색 연기를 뿜어낸다.
Description (ko, sword): 깊은 밤중 머리맡에 나타난다. 꿈을 먹는 동안 몸에 있는 무늬가 어렴풋이 빛난다.
Description (en, sword): Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.
Description (ko, shield): 꿈을 먹고 연기를 내뿜는다. 즐거운 꿈이면 핑크색이고 악몽이면 거무스름하다.
Description (en, shield): It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Musharna — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Musharna
ID: 518
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 몽얌나
Name (en): Musharna
Description (en, black): The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
Description (en, white): With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.
Description (en, black-2): The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.
Description (ko, x): 이마에서 나오는 연기 속에는 사람이나 포켓몬이 꾼 꿈이 많이 모여 있다.
Description (ko, y): 이마에서 나오는 꿈연기는 먹은 꿈의 내용에 따라 여러 가지 색으로 변한다.
Description (ko, sword): 뿜어내는 연기가 거무스름할 때는 가까이 가지 않는 것이 좋다. 악몽이 현실이 되기 때문이다.
Description (en, sword): When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.
Description (ko, shield): 언제나 선잠을 자며 꿈을 꾼다. 잠에서 깨면 매우 불쾌해하므로 가만히 내버려 두자.
Description (en, shield): It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Pidove — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pidove
ID: 519
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 콩둘기
Name (en): Pidove
Description (en, black): Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
Description (en, white): These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
Description (en, black-2): This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
Description (ko, x): 매우 건망증이 심한 포켓몬으로 트레이너에게 명령을 받았어도 새로운 명령을 기다리고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 거리에 사는 포켓몬이다. 사람을 잘 따라서 공원이나 광장에 많이 모인다.
Description (ko, sword): 사람이 사는 곳에 나타난다. 먹이를 뿌려주면 수백 마리가 모여들기 때문에 주의해야 한다.
Description (en, sword): Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.
Description (ko, shield): 건망증이 심하고 영리하지 않지만 사람을 잘 따르고 착실해서 귀여워하는 트레이너가 많다.
Description (en, shield): It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tranquill — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tranquill
ID: 520
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 유토브
Name (en): Tranquill
Description (en, black): It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
Description (en, white): Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
Description (en, black-2): No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
Description (ko, x): 유토브가 사는 숲 속에는 싸움이 없는 평화로운 나라가 있다고 믿어진다.
Description (ko, y): 세계 어디에 있어도 자신의 둥지가 있는 곳을 알 수 있어 트레이너를 잃어버리지 않는다.
Description (ko, sword): 하늘을 나는 속도는 그저 그렇다. 아무리 멀리 떨어져 있어도 주인과 자신의 둥지를 기억하고 있다.
Description (en, sword): It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.
Description (ko, shield): 영리하고 기억력이 좋다. 배달원이 파트너로 선택하는 경우가 많다.
Description (en, shield): These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Unfezant — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Unfezant
ID: 521
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 켄호로우
Name (en): Unfezant
Description (en, black): Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
Description (en, white): Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.
Description (en, black-2): Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.
Description (ko, x): 수컷은 머리의 장식을 흔들어서 상대를 위협한다. 암컷의 비행 능력은 수컷을 뛰어넘는다.
Description (ko, y): 수컷은 머리에 장식이 있다. 트레이너가 아닌 사람은 절대 따르지 않는 성질을 가졌다.
Description (ko, sword): 높은 비행 능력을 가졌다. 암컷은 지구력이 뛰어나며 수컷은 비행 속도가 뛰어나다.
Description (en, sword): Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.
Description (ko, shield): 영리한 만큼 프라이드도 높다. 켄호로우의 트레이너가 되면 모두에게 실력을 인정받는다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Blitzle — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Blitzle
ID: 522
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 줄뮤마
Name (en): Blitzle
Description (en, black): Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
Description (en, white): When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
Description (en, black-2): Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
Description (ko, x): 번개 구름이 하늘을 뒤덮으면 나타난다. 갈기로 번개를 붙잡아 전기를 모은다.
Description (ko, y): 방전하면 갈기가 빛난다. 갈기가 빛나는 횟수나 리듬으로 동료와 대화한다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Zebstrika — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Zebstrika
ID: 523
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 제브라이카
Name (en): Zebstrika
Description (en, black): They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
Description (en, white): This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it’s angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
Description (en, black-2): When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
Description (ko, x): 격렬한 기질의 소유자. 날뛰면 갈기에서 번개를 사방팔방으로 방전한다.
Description (ko, y): 천둥번개 같은 순발력을 가지고 있다. 제브라이카가 전속력으로 달리면 천둥소리가 울려 퍼진다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Roggenrola — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Roggenrola
ID: 524
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 단굴
Name (en): Roggenrola
Description (en, black): Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
Description (en, white): They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
Description (en, black-2): The hexagonal-shaped hole is its ear. It has a tendency to walk in the direction the sound is coming from.
Description (ko, x): 육각형 귀를 가지고 있다. 땅속 깊은 곳에서 압축된 몸은 철 못지않게 단단하다.
Description (ko, y): 100년 전 대지진 때 갈라진 땅에서 발견되었다. 체내에 에너지 코어를 가지고 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 땅속 깊은 곳에서 태어났다. 가까운 친구인 꼬마돌이나 멜리시와 딱딱함을 비교한다.
Description (en, sun): Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.
Description (ko, moon): 육각형의 구멍은 귀다. 소리가 나는 쪽으로 걸어가지만 소리가 그치면 당황해서 넘어진다.
Description (en, moon): The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 육각형의 구멍은 귀다. 귀 안에 에너지 코어가 있어서 손을 넣으면 화를 낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 땅이 갈라진 곳의 단층에서 발견되었다. 몸을 구성하는 성분은 수백 년도 전의 흙이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed rock. The material that makes up its body is dirt from several hundred years ago.
Description (ko, sword): 철과 비슷하게 단단하지만 오랫동안 물에 담가두면 조금 부드러워진다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.
Description (ko, shield): 소리에 반응해 움직인다. 에너지 코어의 영향으로 만지면 조금 따듯하다.
Description (en, shield): When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Boldore — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Boldore
ID: 525
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 암트르
Name (en): Boldore
Description (en, black): When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
Description (en, white): Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
Description (en, black-2): When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
Description (ko, x): 체내에서 처리되지 못하고 빠져나온 에너지가 덩어리져서 주황색 결정이 되었다.
Description (ko, y): 기운이 넘치면 핵이 튀어나온다. 몸의 방향을 바꾸지 않고 전후좌우로 재빠르게 움직일 수 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 오렌지 결정은 에너지의 덩어리다. 한 조각으로 덤프트럭 100대분의 연료가 된다.
Description (en, sun): Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
Description (ko, moon): 동굴에서 지하수를 찾는다. 물 자체는 잘 마시지 못해서 홀짝홀짝 천천히 핥는다.
Description (en, moon): It explores caves in search of underground water. It’s not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸에서 넘쳐흐르는 에너지가 오렌지색 결정이 되었다. 다이아몬드도 부술 정도로 견고하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The energy overflowing from its body has turned into orange crystals that are hard enough to smash diamonds.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 오렌지색 결정은 큰 에너지의 덩어리다. 가치가 있어 노려지는 일도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They’re valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.
Description (ko, sword): 오렌지색 결정이 빛나기 시작하면 조심해야 한다. 에너지를 쏘아대기 때문이다.
Description (en, sword): If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.
Description (ko, shield): 소리로 주위 상황을 살핀다. 화나게 하면 몸의 방향을 바꾸지 않은 채로 쫓아온다.
Description (en, shield): It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

document.title: Gigalith — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gigalith
ID: 526
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 기가이어스
Name (en): Gigalith
Description (en, black): Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
Description (en, white): The solar energy absorbed by its body’s orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.
Description (en, black-2): The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
Description (ko, x): 거두어들인 태양광선을 에너지 코어로 반응시켜 빛의 구슬로 쏘아낸다.
Description (ko, y): 체내의 코어에서 에너지를 압축하여 쏘아대는 공격은 산을 날려버릴 만한 위력이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 거두어들인 태양 광선을 에너지 코어로 반응시켜 빛의 구슬로 쏘아낸다.
Description (ko, sun): 태양광선으로부터 만든 에너지탄은 엄청난 위력이다. 하지만 밤과 비 오는 날에는 쏠 수 없다.
Description (en, sun): The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.
Description (ko, moon): 상당한 체력을 지니고 있어 건설 관계자가 파트너를 선택할 때 선호하는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 전력으로 에너지를 쏘면 그 파워로 자신의 몸에 무수한 균열이 생긴다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 태양 광선을 흡수해서 에너지를 쏜다. 평소에는 땅속 깊은 곳에 몸을 숨기고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It’s usually lurking deep beneath the surface.
Description (ko, sword): 씩씩해서 공사 현장이나 채굴장에서 대왕끼리동이나 사람과 함께 일할 때도 있다.
Description (en, sword): This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.
Description (ko, shield): 맑은 날에만 쏠 수 있지만 에너지탄의 파괴력은 덤프트럭도 날려버릴 정도다.
Description (en, shield): Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Woobat — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Woobat
ID: 527
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 또르박쥐
Name (en): Woobat
Description (en, black): Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
Description (en, white): Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
Description (en, black-2): The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
Description (ko, x): 어두운 숲이나 동굴에서 산다. 콧구멍에서 초음파를 쏘아 주변의 모습을 살핀다.
Description (ko, y): 또르박쥐의 코가 닿은 곳에 하트 모양의 자국이 나면 좋은 일이 일어난다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, sword): 동굴을 올려다봤을 때 벽에 하트 모양 자국이 있다면 또르박쥐가 살고 있다는 증거다.
Description (en, sword): While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.
Description (ko, shield): 초음파를 발산하면서 흔들흔들 날아다닌다. 먹이인 벌레포켓몬을 찾고 있다.
Description (en, shield): It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Swoobat — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Swoobat
ID: 528
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 맘박쥐
Name (en): Swoobat
Description (en, black): It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
Description (en, white): Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
Description (en, black-2): It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
Description (ko, x): 콘크리트도 부술 정도로 강한 초음파를 낼 때 꼬리가 심하게 흔들린다.
Description (ko, y): 수컷이 암컷에게 구애할 때 발사하는 초음파에 노출되면 기분이 매우 즐거워진다.
Description (ko, sword): 아주 강력한 음파를 내보낸 후에는 지쳐서 당분간 날 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, sword): Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.
Description (ko, shield): 코의 모양이 복스럽다고 행복을 부르는 상징으로 여기는 지역도 있다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Drilbur — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Drilbur
ID: 529
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 두더류
Name (en): Drilbur
Description (en, black): It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
Description (en, white): It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
Description (en, black-2): By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
Description (ko, x): 양손의 손톱을 서로 겹치고 몸을 고속 회전시키면서 맹렬한 속도로 땅속을 헤쳐나간다.
Description (ko, y): 몸을 스핀시켜서 시속 50km의 스피드를 유지하며 똑바로 땅을 파서 나아간다.
Description (ko, sword): 양손의 손톱을 서로 겹치고 몸을 고속으로 회전시킨 뒤 먹이를 향해 돌진한다.
Description (en, sword): It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.
Description (ko, shield): 손톱으로 땅속을 파고 다니면서 키우는 채소를 해치기 때문에 농업 종사자들이 싫어한다.
Description (en, shield): It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Excadrill — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Excadrill
ID: 530
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 몰드류
Name (en): Excadrill
Description (en, black): It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
Description (en, white): More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
Description (en, black-2): Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.
Description (ko, x): 강철로 진화한 드릴은 철판을 뚫는 파괴력을 가졌다. 터널 공사에서 크게 활약한다.
Description (ko, y): 땅 밑 100m에 미로 같은 굴을 만든다. 지하철 터널에 구멍을 뚫어 버린다.
Description (ko, sword): 자연적으로 생긴 동굴로 보이지만 사실은 몰드류가 파낸 흔적인 경우는 흔히 있는 일이다.
Description (en, sword): It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.
Description (ko, shield): 별명은 드릴킹이다. 땅속을 파는 속도는 시속 150km에 달한다.
Description (en, shield): Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

document.title: Audino — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Audino
ID: 531
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 다부니
Name (en): Audino
Description (en, black): It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
Description (en, white): Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.
Description (en, black-2): Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
Description (ko, x): 귀의 더듬이로 상대의 컨디션이나 알에서 포켓몬이 언제 나올지도 알 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 귀의 더듬이가 상대에게 닿으면 심장 소리를 듣고 몸 상태나 기분을 알 수 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 뛰어난 청각을 가졌다. 2km 떨어진 곳에서 구르는 돌멩이 소리도 들을 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino’s ears.
Description (ko, shield): 마음 착한 포켓몬이다. 더듬이를 갖다 대어 상대의 마음과 몸 상태를 파악한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

document.title: Timburr — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Timburr
ID: 532
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 으랏차
Name (en): Timburr
Description (en, black): It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
Description (en, white): These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
Description (en, black-2): Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
Description (ko, x): 항상 각목을 끼고 있다. 건설 현장에 나타나 공사를 도와주는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 항상 각재를 들고 다니며 토목공사를 도와준다. 자라면 큰 각재로 바꿔 든다.
Description (ko, sword): 건축 일을 돕는 것을 좋아한다. 비가 내려서 공사를 쉬는 날에는 각목을 휘두르며 날뛴다.
Description (en, sword): It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.
Description (ko, shield): 자신의 3배 정도의 각목을 들 수 있게 된 으랏차는 머지않아 진화하게 된다.
Description (en, shield): Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Gurdurr — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gurdurr
ID: 533
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 토쇠골
Name (en): Gurdurr
Description (en, black): This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
Description (en, white): They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.
Description (en, black-2): With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
Description (ko, x): 단련된 근육의 소유자. 철골을 능숙하게 조종하여 집을 해체해준다.
Description (ko, y): 단련을 거듭한 근육덩어리 몸은 프로레슬러가 단체로 공격해도 꿈쩍도 하지 않는다.
Description (ko, sword): 동료나 근육몬과 서로 근육을 자랑한다. 진 쪽은 당분간 모습을 감춘다.
Description (en, sword): It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.
Description (ko, shield): 철골을 자유자재로 다룬다. 해체는 잘하지만 무언가를 조립하는 것은 서툴다.
Description (en, shield): Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Conkeldurr — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Conkeldurr
ID: 534
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 노보청
Name (en): Conkeldurr
Description (en, black): It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
Description (en, white): They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.
Description (en, black-2): Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
Description (ko, x): 콘크리트를 만드는 기술은 2000년 전에 노보청에게 배운 것이라고 여겨지고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 힘에 의지하지 않고 원심력을 잘 활용하여 콘크리트를 휘두르는 기술을 잘 다룬다.
Description (ko, sword): 같은 성분이라도 노보청이 배합한 콘크리트가 훨씬 견고하고 튼튼하다.
Description (en, sword): Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.
Description (ko, shield): 정말 싸울 생각이면 콘크리트 기둥을 버리고 주먹 하나로 상대를 노리고 덤벼든다.
Description (en, shield): When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tympole — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tympole
ID: 535
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 동챙이
Name (en): Tympole
Description (en, black): They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
Description (en, white): By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
Description (en, black-2): By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
Description (ko, x): 볼의 진동막을 떨어 사람에게는 들리지 않는 음파를 내어 동료에게 위험을 전달한다.
Description (ko, y): 볼을 진동시켜서 사람에게는 들리지 않는 음파를 낸다. 음파의 리듬으로 대화를 나눈다.
Description (ko, sword): 아름다운 파문이 펼쳐지는 물 아래에는 동챙이가 날카로운 소리로 울고 있다.
Description (en, sword): Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.
Description (ko, shield): 음파로 동료와 연락한다. 경계하는 울음소리는 사람이나 다른 포켓몬에게 들리지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Palpitoad — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Palpitoad
ID: 536
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 두까비
Name (en): Palpitoad
Description (en, black): When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
Description (en, white): It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
Description (en, black-2): It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
Description (ko, x): 머리의 혹을 진동시키면 물속에 파동이 일어나며 땅마저 지진처럼 흔들린다.
Description (ko, y): 수중과 육지에서 살며 길고 끈적이는 혀를 사용하여 상대의 움직임을 봉쇄한다.
Description (ko, sword): 두통을 일으킬 정도의 음파로 먹이를 충분히 약하게 만든 뒤 끈적끈적한 혀로 포박한다.
Description (en, sword): It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.
Description (ko, shield): 고운 목소리로 울 때도 있다. 몸의 돌기가 클수록 넓은 음역으로 울 수 있다.
Description (en, shield): On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

document.title: Seismitoad — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Seismitoad
ID: 537
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 두빅굴
Name (en): Seismitoad
Description (en, black): They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
Description (en, white): It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
Description (en, black-2): By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
Description (ko, x): 주먹의 혹을 진동시켜 펀치의 위력을 배가시킨다. 일격에 큰 바위를 부스러뜨린다.
Description (ko, y): 머리의 혹에서 신경을 마비시키는 액체를 날린다. 진동으로 상대를 괴롭힌다.
Description (ko, sword): 전신의 혹을 진동시켜서 지진과 같은 흔들림을 일으킨다. 삐딱구리와 가까운 종이다.
Description (en, sword): The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.
Description (ko, shield): 혹이 일으키는 바이브레이션이 마사지에 좋다고 노인에게 인기가 높은 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Throh — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Throh
ID: 538
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 던지미
Name (en): Throh
Description (en, black): When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
Description (en, white): When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.
Description (en, black-2): When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
Description (ko, x): 끈을 매면 파워가 올라간다. 야생 던지미는 덩굴풀을 엮어 자신의 띠를 만든다.
Description (ko, y): 자신보다 큰 상대와 만나면 이유 없이 내던지고 싶어 한다. 강해지면 띠를 바꾼다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 띠를 매면 파워가 올라간다. 야생 던지미는 덩굴풀을 엮어 자신의 띠를 만든다.
Description (ko, sword): 메치는 기술의 실력은 일류다. 싸움으로 흘린 땀이 배어 띠의 색이 진해져 간다.
Description (en, sword): It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.
Description (ko, shield): 5마리의 무리가 수련한다. 수련에 뒤떨어지면 띠를 버리고 무리를 떠난다.
Description (en, shield): They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Sawk — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sawk
ID: 539
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 타격귀
Name (en): Sawk
Description (en, black): The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
Description (en, white): Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
Description (en, black-2): Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
Description (ko, x): 최강의 태권당수를 목표로 산속에 틀어박혀 잠도 없이 수행한다.
Description (ko, y): 끈을 매면 기합이 들어가 펀치의 파괴력이 강해진다. 수련을 방해하면 화를 낸다.
Description (ko, sword): 한결같이 강해지기를 추구한다. 산에서 수행 중인 타격귀를 발견한다면 조용히 물러나자.
Description (en, sword): If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.
Description (ko, shield): 단련하고 단련한 타격귀가 사용하는 필살 태권당수는 바다도 가를 정도의 파괴력을 지녔다.
Description (en, shield): The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Sewaddle — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sewaddle
ID: 540
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 두르보
Name (en): Sewaddle
Description (en, black): Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
Description (en, white): This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
Description (en, black-2): Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
Description (ko, x): 잎사귀를 물어뜯어 입에서 뱉어낸 점착실로 꿰맨다. 스스로 옷을 만드는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 잎사귀로 옷을 만들기 때문에 패션 디자이너에게 마스코트로 인기가 있다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Swadloon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Swadloon
ID: 541
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 두르쿤
Name (en): Swadloon
Description (en, black): Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
Description (en, white): It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
Description (en, black-2): Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
Description (ko, x): 두르쿤이 사는 숲은 초목이 잘 자란다. 두르쿤이 낙엽을 영양분으로 바꾸기 때문이다.
Description (ko, y): 잎사귀로 몸을 감싸 추위를 막는다. 가까이 있는 낙엽을 먹으며 숲을 이동한다.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Leavanny — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Leavanny
ID: 542
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모아머
Name (en): Leavanny
Description (en, black): Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
Description (en, white): It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
Description (en, black-2): Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
Description (ko, x): 어린 포켓몬을 보면 입에서 내뿜는 점착실로 잎사귀의 옷을 지어 준다.
Description (ko, y): 낙엽이 발효되는 열로 알을 따뜻하게 한다. 잎사귀로 두르보의 포대기를 만든다.

document.title: Venipede — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Venipede
ID: 543
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마디네
Name (en): Venipede
Description (en, black): Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
Description (en, white): It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
Description (en, black-2): Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey’s location and state.
Description (ko, x): 머리와 꼬리의 더듬이로 주변 상황을 살핀다. 성격이 매우 난폭하다.
Description (ko, y): 물어서 맹독을 퍼뜨린다. 천적인 커다란 새포켓몬도 몸이 마비돼서 움직일 수 없다.
Description (ko, sword): 태우지네와는 종류가 다른 동료지만 서로 만나면 큰 싸움이 된다.
Description (en, sword): Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.
Description (ko, shield): 이빨에 맹독을 지녔다. 먹을 수 있는 먹이를 발견하면 앞뒤를 가리지 않고 덤벼든다.
Description (en, shield): Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Whirlipede — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Whirlipede
ID: 544
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 휠구
Name (en): Whirlipede
Description (en, black): Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
Description (en, white): It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.
Description (en, black-2): Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.
Description (ko, x): 단단한 껍질로 보호되고 있다. 타이어처럼 회전하여 상대에게 격렬히 몸통박치기를 날린다.
Description (ko, y): 평소에는 움직이지 않지만 공격당하면 고속 회전하여 뛰어다니다가 몸통박치기로 반격한다.
Description (ko, sword): 고속으로 회전해 상대에게 돌격한다. 최고 시속은 약 100km에 달한다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.
Description (ko, shield): 단단한 껍질과 독가시로 몸을 보호하면서 진화에 필요한 에너지를 비축하고 있다.
Description (en, shield): Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Scolipede — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Scolipede
ID: 545
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 펜드라
Name (en): Scolipede
Description (en, black): With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
Description (en, white): Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.
Description (en, black-2): It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
Description (ko, x): 먹이를 목의 가시에 끼워 넣어 움직이지 못하게 한 후 맹독을 퍼뜨려 마무리한다.
Description (ko, y): 빠른 움직임으로 적을 바싹 몰아넣어 머리의 뿔로 공격한다. 마무리 지을 때까지 봐주지 않는다.
Description (ko, sword): 목의 가시로 먹이를 잡은 채 그대로 땅으로 내동댕이쳐서 독가시를 꽂는다.
Description (en, sword): Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.
Description (ko, shield): 영역을 두고 다태우지네와 격렬하게 다툰다. 패배한 쪽이 그대로 먹이가 된다.
Description (en, shield): Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

document.title: Cottonee — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cottonee
ID: 546
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 소미안
Name (en): Cottonee
Description (en, black): When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
Description (en, white): They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.
Description (en, black-2): Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.
Description (ko, x): 공격당하면 몸에서 솜을 날린다. 상대가 솜을 소미안으로 착각하고 있는 동안 도망친다.
Description (ko, y): 집단으로 있으면 편안한지 동료를 발견하면 달라붙어 어느새 구름처럼 된다.
Description (ko, sun): 동료를 발견하면 붙는다. 너무 많이 붙어서 적란운처럼 되는 일도 있다.
Description (en, sun): When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.
Description (ko, moon): 소미안이 뱉는 솜을 사용한 베개와 이불은 가볍고 통기성이 좋은 고급품이다.
Description (en, moon): Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy— altogether top quality.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 솜을 날려 몸을 지킨다. 비에 젖으면 솜이 축축하고 무거워져 움직일 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can’t move as well.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 공격당하면 몸에 있는 솜을 날려 미끼로 쓴다. 날린 솜은 또 금방 자라난다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When attacked, it expels cotton from its body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses grows back in quickly.
Description (ko, sword): 솜을 날려 몸을 지킨다. 태풍의 바람에 휩쓸려 지구 반대편까지 갈 때도 있다.
Description (en, sword): It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
Description (ko, shield): 소미안과 백솜모카의 솜을 섞어 짠 천은 아름다워서 고급 브랜드에 사용된다.
Description (en, shield): Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Whimsicott — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Whimsicott
ID: 547
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 엘풍
Name (en): Whimsicott
Description (en, black): Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
Description (en, white): Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.
Description (en, black-2): They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
Description (ko, x): 회오리바람과 함께 나타나 집 안의 가구를 움직이거나 솜을 남기는 장난을 친다.
Description (ko, y): 아무리 좁은 틈이라도 바람처럼 빠져나간다. 하얀 털 뭉치를 남기고 간다.
Description (ko, sun): 바람을 타고 민가에 침입한다. 방 안을 솜투성이로 만들고 싱글벙글 웃으며 떠난다.
Description (en, sun): It rides on the wind and slips into people’s homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.
Description (ko, moon): 바람을 타고 나타나지만 바람이 너무 강하면 머리의 솜이 흩어져 버린다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon appears, riding upon the wind. But if the wind gusts up, it’ll blow the cotton on this Pokémon’s head clean off.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 민가에 몰래 들어가 소중한 물건을 감추거나 솜을 방 안에 여기저기 흩트러 놓는 성가신 존재이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This nuisance sneaks into people’s homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 특정한 서식지가 정해져 있지 않다. 회오리바람을 타고 여기저기에 나타나서는 장난을 친다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Whimsicott doesn’t live in a fixed location. It floats around on whirling winds, appearing all over the place to perform its mischief.
Description (ko, sword): 솜을 흩뿌리며 장난을 친다. 물을 끼얹으면 무거워져서 움직일 수 없게 되어 포기한다.
Description (en, sword): It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
Description (ko, shield): 햇빛을 받을수록 솜이 부풀어 오른다. 너무 부풀면 찢어져 주위로 흩어진다.
Description (en, shield): As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Petilil — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Petilil
ID: 548
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 치릴리
Name (en): Petilil
Description (en, black): The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
Description (en, white): Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
Description (en, black-2): The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
Description (ko, x): 머리의 잎사귀를 갉아먹으면 매우 쓰지만 지친 몸을 회복시켜주는 효과가 있다.
Description (ko, y): 치릴리는 수분과 영양이 풍부한 땅을 좋아하기 때문에 치릴리가 사는 토지는 작물이 잘 자란다.
Description (ko, sun): 머리의 잎사귀는 현기증이 날 만큼 쓰지만 몸이 피곤할 때 효과가 있다. 달여먹으면 효과가 더 크다.
Description (en, sun): Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
Description (ko, moon): 가끔 잎을 손질해주면 둥글둥글한 훌륭한 모습으로 자라난다.
Description (en, moon): By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머리의 잎을 햇볕에 말려 달여 마시면 젊은 시절의 기력이 돌아온다며 노인에게 큰 인기다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 깨끗한 물과 흙을 좋아한다. 서식지의 환경이 나빠지면 새로운 장소로 무리가 이동한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.
Description (ko, sword): 깨끗한 물가에 나타난다. 머리의 잎을 우려낸 즙은 벌레를 쫓는 데 사용하기도 한다.
Description (en, sword): Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.
Description (ko, shield): 잎사귀의 색이 짙을수록 건강하다. 잘 정돈된 밭이나 화단에 자리잡고 살기도 한다.
Description (en, shield): The deeper the color of a Petilil’s leaves, the healthier the Pokémon is. Petilil sometimes makes its home in a well-tended field or flowerbed.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

document.title: Lilligant — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lilligant
ID: 549
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 드레디어
Name (en): Lilligant
Description (en, black): Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
Description (en, white): The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
Description (en, black-2): The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
Description (ko, x): 머리에 있는 꽃 장식의 향기에는 긴장을 풀어 주는 효과가 있다. 자주 손질하지 않으면 시들어 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 베테랑 트레이너일지라도 아름다운 꽃을 피우기는 쉽지 않다. 유명 인사에게 인기가 많은 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, sun): 아무리 시간과 돈을 들여도 사람 손으로 피우는 것보다 야생에서 피는 꽃이 더 아름답다.
Description (en, sun): No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
Description (ko, moon): 파트너인 수컷이 생기면 아름다운 꽃은 곧 생기 없이 시들어 말라간다.
Description (en, moon): As soon as it finds a male to be its partner, the beautiful flower on its head darkens, droops, and withers away.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 자란 흙의 성분에 따라 꽃향기는 조금씩 다르다. 냄새를 맡으면 마음이 치유되고 평온해진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아름다워서 다른 포켓몬들에게 사랑받는다. 머리의 꽃은 손질을 게을리하면 금방 상해서 시든다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
Description (ko, sword): 일류 원예가라 하더라도 머리의 꽃을 피우는 일은 매우 어렵다고 전해진다.
Description (en, sword): It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.
Description (ko, shield): 꽃으로 만든 정유는 최고의 향을 내지만 눈이 튀어나올 정도로 비싸다.
Description (en, shield): Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers have a sublime scent, but they’re also staggeringly expensive.
Description (en, legends-arceus): I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

document.title: Basculin — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Basculin
ID: 550
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 배쓰나이
Name (en): Basculin
Description (en, black): Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
Description (en, white): Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.
Description (en, black-2): Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
Description (ko, x): 아주 난폭하고 항상 빨강과 파랑의 배쓰나이는 다투고 있다. 먹으면 의외로 맛있다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 빨강과 파랑 배쓰나이는 사이가 나쁨에도 불구하고 같은 무리에 다른 색 개체가 섞여 있다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 난폭하고 사나운 포켓몬. 빨강과 파랑의 배쓰나이는 영역을 두고 언제나 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 난폭해서 배쓰나이 무리가 나타난 호수에는 가재군이나 가재장군 정도밖에 남지 않게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That’s how violent Basculin are.
Description (ko, sword): 힘이 세기 때문에 낚시꾼들에게 인기가 많다. 무단으로 연못에 놓아줘서 점점 개체 수가 늘어나고 있다.
Description (en, sword): Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.
Description (ko, shield): 옛날에는 식탁에 올랐다. 적색근 배쓰나이의 살코기는 기름이 많아 젊은 층이 좋아한다.
Description (en, shield): In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it’s more popular with the youth.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

document.title: Sandile — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sandile
ID: 551
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 깜눈크
Name (en): Sandile
Description (en, black): They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
Description (en, white): It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
Description (en, black-2): They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.
Description (ko, x): 모래 속에 파고들어 눈과 코를 밖에 내놓고 이동한다. 검은 막이 눈을 보호한다.
Description (ko, y): 사막의 모래 속에서 생활한다. 태양 때문에 따뜻해진 모래가 체온 저하를 막아준다.
Description (ko, sun): 모래 속에 숨어서 헤엄치는 것처럼 이동한다. 적에게 들키지 않으면서 체온이 내려가지 않기 위한 지혜다.
Description (en, sun): It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.
Description (ko, moon): 모래 속에 몸을 숨기고 위를 걸어가는 먹이의 다리를 덥석 문다. 가장 좋아하는 것은 톱치.
Description (en, moon): It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 일 년 내내 따듯한 알로라는 지내기 좋은 환경이다. 사막이 아닌 곳에서도 가끔 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Alola, where it’s warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you’ll even see it outside of deserts.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아직 사냥은 서툴러서 주로 사막에서 객사한 것을 먹는다. 사막의 청소부라 불린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Sandile’s still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It’s called “the cleaner of the desert.”
Description (ko, sword): 사막의 밤은 기온이 낮기 때문에 모래 깊숙이 파고들어 해가 뜰 때까지 잠을 자면서 생활한다.
Description (en, sword): The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.
Description (ko, shield): 작지만 하체의 힘은 세다. 모래를 헤치며 사막을 헤엄치듯 이동한다.
Description (en, shield): Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

document.title: Krokorok — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Krokorok
ID: 552
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 악비르
Name (en): Krokorok
Description (en, black): They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
Description (en, white): The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
Description (en, black-2): Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.
Description (ko, x): 여러 마리가 무리를 짓는다. 안구를 감싼 막이 모래 폭풍으로부터 눈을 지켜준다.
Description (ko, y): 눈을 감싼 특수한 막이 물체의 열을 감지해서 어두워도 주변을 볼 수 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 몇 마리씩 무리를 지어 행동한다. 무리의 중심은 암컷인 경우가 많고 수컷들이 먹이를 모은다.
Description (en, sun): They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
Description (ko, moon): 눈을 감싸는 특수한 막 덕분에 한밤중에도 주변을 똑똑히 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, moon): Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the middle of the night.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸이 차가워지는 것을 매우 싫어한다. 기온이 내려가는 밤에는 사막 모래 속으로 깊숙이 파고든다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먹이의 일부는 모래 속에 묻어서 사냥에 실패했을 때의 비상식량으로 삼는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
Description (ko, sword): 어둠 속에서도 볼 수 있는 특수한 두 눈 덕분에 한밤중에도 거침없이 사냥할 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.
Description (ko, shield): 어둠 속에서도 볼 수 있는 특수한 눈을 가졌지만 사막의 밤은 춥기 때문에 잘 움직이지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

document.title: Krookodile — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Krookodile
ID: 553
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 악비아르
Name (en): Krookodile
Description (en, black): They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
Description (en, white): It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.
Description (en, black-2): Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
Description (ko, x): 아주 난폭한 포켓몬. 눈앞에서 움직이는 것은 모두 덮쳐서 깨물어 부수려고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 마주친 먹이는 놓치지 않는다. 자동차 몸체를 물어뜯을 만큼 강력한 턱을 가지고 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 모래 폭풍 속에서도 50km 앞에 있는 작은 먹이를 발견하는 특수한 두 눈을 가졌다.
Description (en, sun): Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
Description (ko, moon): 강력한 턱으로 물고 그대로 힘껏 몸을 비틀어 먹이를 절단한다.
Description (en, moon): After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 50km 떨어져 있는 먹이를 발견하면 사막을 헤엄치듯이 이동하여 덤벼들어 덥석 문다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 플라이곤이 일으키는 모래바람에 몸을 숨기고 먹이가 오는 것을 가만히 기다리고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
Description (ko, sword): 모래의 건달이라고도 불린다. 강력한 턱으로 두꺼운 철판도 쉽게 물어뜯는다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.
Description (ko, shield): 난폭하지만 먹이를 잡기 위해 모래 속에서 며칠이든 기다리는 강한 인내력도 갖고 있다.
Description (en, shield): While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

document.title: Darumaka — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Darumaka
ID: 554
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 달막화
Name (en): Darumaka
Description (en, black): When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
Description (en, white): Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
Description (en, black-2): When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100° F.
Description (ko, x): 달막화의 배설물은 뜨거워서 옛날 사람은 품에 넣고 몸을 따뜻하게 하는 데 사용했다.
Description (ko, y): 잠잘 때는 손발을 움츠리고 체내에 타고 있는 600도의 불꽃도 작아져서 차분해진다.
Description (en, y): When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 잠잘 때는 손발을 움츠리고 체내에서 타고 있는 600도의 불꽃도 작아져서 차분해진다.
Description (ko, sword): 몸 안에서 타오르는 불꽃이 힘의 원천이다. 불꽃이 작아지면 금세 잠들어 버린다.
Description (en, sword): It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.
Description (ko, shield): 자고 있을 때는 밀어도 당겨도 절대 쓰러지지 않는다. 길조의 모티브로 인기가 높다.
Description (en, shield): This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

document.title: Darmanitan — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Darmanitan
ID: 555
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 불비달마
Name (en): Darmanitan
Description (en, black): Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
Description (en, white): When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
Description (en, black-2): When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
Description (ko, x): 격렬한 싸움으로 상처 입으면 바위처럼 굳어져 묵상하며 마음을 연마한다.
Description (ko, y): 체내에서 1400도의 불꽃을 태워서 덤프트럭을 펀치로 파괴할 정도의 파워를 만든다.
Description (en, y): Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
Description (ko, sword): 혈기왕성한 포켓몬. 굵직한 팔에서 날리는 펀치는 덤프트럭도 가루로 만들어버린다.
Description (en, sword): The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
Description (ko, shield): 체내의 불꽃이 타오를수록 파워가 올라간다. 그 온도는 1400도를 넘기도 한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
