document.title: Maractus — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Maractus
ID: 556
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마라카치
Name (en): Maractus
Description (en, black): It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
Description (en, white): Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
Description (en, black-2): When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.
Description (ko, x): 템포가 빠른 춤과 소리로 꽃씨를 노리는 천적인 새포켓몬을 쫓아버린다.
Description (ko, y): 건조한 땅에서 산다. 몸을 리드미컬하게 움직이면 마라카스 같은 소리를 낸다.
Description (ko, sword): 마라카스 같은 소리를 낸다. 리듬이 경쾌해서 새포켓몬은 깜짝 놀라 허둥지둥 날아가버린다.
Description (en, sword): With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
Description (ko, shield): 일 년에 한 번 씨를 뿌린다. 꽃의 씨는 영양이 매우 풍부해 사막의 귀중한 식량이다.
Description (en, shield): Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Dwebble — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dwebble
ID: 557
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 돌살이
Name (en): Dwebble
Description (en, black): This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
Description (en, white): It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
Description (en, black-2): When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
Description (ko, x): 적당한 돌을 찾아 구멍을 뚫어 살 곳을 만든다. 부서지면 대신할 돌을 찾을 때까지 불안해한다.
Description (ko, y): 적당한 사이즈의 돌이 있으면 입에서 액체를 분비해서 안에 들어가기 위한 구멍을 판다.
Description (ko, sword): 마음에 드는 돌멩이에 구멍을 파서 보금자리로 삼는다. 단굴이나 탄동에게는 천적이다.
Description (en, sword): When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.
Description (ko, shield): 집으로 삼기 딱 좋은 돌멩이를 발견하지 못하면 하마돈의 구멍에 살기도 한다.
Description (en, shield): It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Crustle — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Crustle
ID: 558
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 암팰리스
Name (en): Crustle
Description (en, black): Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
Description (en, white): It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
Description (en, black-2): When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
Description (ko, x): 무거운 바위를 등에 지고 며칠이고 건조한 땅을 이동할 수 있는 다릿심을 가지고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 영역을 빼앗기 위해 암팰리스끼리 격렬히 싸운다. 바위가 부서진 쪽이 패배다.
Description (ko, sword): 건조한 곳을 좋아하며 비가 내리는 날에는 바위에서 나오지 않는다. 자기 영역에 대한 의식이 강하다.
Description (en, sword): This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.
Description (ko, shield): 두꺼운 발톱이 최고의 무기다. 거대코뿌리의 프로텍터조차 금이 갈 정도로 딱딱하다.
Description (en, shield): Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Scraggy — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Scraggy
ID: 559
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 곤율랭
Name (en): Scraggy
Description (en, black): Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
Description (en, white): It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
Description (en, black-2): Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
Description (ko, x): 가죽을 목까지 늘려서 방어 자세를 취한다. 고무 같은 탄력을 이용해 데미지를 줄인다.
Description (ko, y): 튼튼한 두개골이 자랑이다. 느닷없이 박치기를 하려고 하지만 무게로 자신도 휘청거린다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 여러 마리 그룹으로 행동한다. 굼뜨게 다니다 눈이 마주친 상대에게 느닷없이 박치기를 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 축 늘어난 가죽을 목까지 끌어올려서 가드한다. 가죽이 늘어난 개체일수록 대단하다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.
Description (ko, sword): 눈이 마주치면 위험하다! 상대를 가리지 않고 박치기로 공격해오는 성가신 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sword): If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 튼튼한 가죽으로 몸을 지킨다. 가죽이 다 늘어나면 진화할 때가 되었다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Scrafty — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Scrafty
ID: 560
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 곤율거니
Name (en): Scrafty
Description (en, black): Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
Description (en, white): It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
Description (en, black-2): It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
Description (ko, x): 탈피한 가죽을 끌어 올려 데미지를 줄이면서 킥! 볏이 클수록 거만하다.
Description (ko, y): 볏의 크기로 그룹의 리더를 정한다. 발차기로 콘크리트 블록을 파괴한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 거칠고 난폭하지만, 자신의 가족과 무리 동료의 영역을 매우 소중히 여기는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 침을 뱉어서 상대를 도발한다. 정해진 영역을 가지고 있으며 평생 그곳을 벗어나지 않고 산다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.
Description (ko, sword): 의욕이 없어 보이는 킥은 노보청이 들고 있는 콘크리트도 부술 정도의 파괴력을 지녔다.
Description (en, sword): As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.
Description (ko, shield): 매우 거친 성격이지만 가족과 동료와 영역은 소중히 여긴다.
Description (en, shield): While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Scrafty
ID: 560
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 곤율거니
Name (en): Scrafty
Description (en, black): Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
Description (en, white): It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
Description (en, black-2): It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
Description (ko, x): 탈피한 가죽을 끌어 올려 데미지를 줄이면서 킥! 볏이 클수록 거만하다.
Description (ko, y): 볏의 크기로 그룹의 리더를 정한다. 발차기로 콘크리트 블록을 파괴한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 거칠고 난폭하지만, 자신의 가족과 무리 동료의 영역을 매우 소중히 여기는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 침을 뱉어서 상대를 도발한다. 정해진 영역을 가지고 있으며 평생 그곳을 벗어나지 않고 산다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.
Description (ko, sword): 의욕이 없어 보이는 킥은 노보청이 들고 있는 콘크리트도 부술 정도의 파괴력을 지녔다.
Description (en, sword): As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.
Description (ko, shield): 매우 거친 성격이지만 가족과 동료와 영역은 소중히 여긴다.
Description (en, shield): While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

document.title: Sigilyph — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sigilyph
ID: 561
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 심보러
Name (en): Sigilyph
Description (en, black): They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
Description (en, white): The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
Description (en, black-2): The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
Description (ko, x): 고대 도시의 수호신이었다. 자기 영역을 침범한 상대를 사이코 파워로 공격한다.
Description (ko, y): 고대 도시의 수호신. 항상 같은 루트를 순회하며 침입자를 감시하고 있었다.
Description (ko, sword): 사이코 파워로 하늘을 난다. 고대 도시의 수호신 또는 수호신의 사자로 일컬어진다.
Description (en, sword): Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.
Description (ko, shield): 심보러가 나는 사막 아래를 조사해 보니 고대 도시로 여겨지는 자취가 발견되었다.
Description (en, shield): A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Yamask — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Yamask
ID: 562
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 데스마스
Name (en): Yamask
Description (en, black): Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
Description (en, white): These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.
Description (en, black-2): These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
Description (ko, x): 무덤에 매장된 사람의 영혼이 포켓몬으로 변했다. 죽기 전 기억이 남아 있다.
Description (ko, y): 가지고 있는 마스크는 데스마스가 사람이었을 때의 얼굴이다. 가끔 마스크를 쳐다보며 운다.
Description (ko, sword): 밤마다 유적을 떠돈다. 가지고 있는 마스크는 자신이 인간이던 시절의 얼굴이라고 한다.
Description (en, sword): It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.
Description (ko, shield): 고대인의 영혼이 포켓몬이 되어 태어났다. 자신의 얼굴을 아는 사람을 찾아 유적을 떠돈다.
Description (en, shield): The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

document.title: Cofagrigus — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cofagrigus
ID: 563
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 데스니칸
Name (en): Cofagrigus
Description (en, black): It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
Description (en, white): They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.
Description (en, black-2): Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
Description (ko, x): 가까이 다가온 인간을 삼켜서 미라로 만든다는 소문이 있다. 금괴를 즐겨 먹는다.
Description (ko, y): 진짜 관과 착각해서 다가온 도굴꾼을 몸속에 가둬버린다.
Description (ko, sword): 황금으로 된 반짝거리는 몸. 자신이 인간이었다는 사실을 이제는 기억하지 못할 것이다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.
Description (ko, shield): 오래된 묘지의 벽을 보면 왕의 부를 드러내고자 그려져 있는 경우가 많다.
Description (en, shield): There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tirtouga — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tirtouga
ID: 564
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 프로토가
Name (en): Tirtouga
Description (en, black): Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
Description (en, white): About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
Description (en, black-2): This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.
Description (ko, x): 약 1억 년 전 바다를 헤엄쳐 다녔다. 육지에 올라 먹이를 덮치는 일도 있다.
Description (ko, y): 고대 화석에서 부활했다. 1000m 깊이까지 잠수할 수 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 골격을 조사해보니 약 1000m의 심해까지 잠수할 수 있었던 것 같다.
Description (en, sun): Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.
Description (ko, moon): 많은 거북포켓몬의 조상이라 전해진다. 약 1억 년 전의 따뜻한 바다에서 살았다.
Description (en, moon): Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas approximately a hundred million years ago.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 고대 화석에서 부활했다. 바다에 살고 있었지만, 먹이를 찾아 지상으로 올라왔다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수심 1000m의 심해에서 육지에 이르기까지 넓은 범위를 사냥터로 삼았다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area, from the land to more than half a mile deep in the ocean.
Description (ko, sword): 고대의 바다에 살았다. 기어 다니는 것만 가능하지만 먹이를 위해서는 육지에 오르기도 한다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.
Description (ko, shield): 많은 거북포켓몬의 선조로 여겨지고 있는 포켓몬이다. 화석에서 복원되었다.
Description (en, shield): Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Carracosta — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Carracosta
ID: 565
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 늑골라
Name (en): Carracosta
Description (en, black): They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
Description (en, white): Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
Description (en, black-2): It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.
Description (ko, x): 바다와 육지에서 생활한다. 손바닥으로 쳐서 배 밑바닥에 구멍을 내는 파워의 소유자다.
Description (ko, y): 발달한 앞다리로 상대를 세게 쳐서 기절시켜 껍데기나 뼈까지 통째로 깨물어 부쉈다.
Description (ko, sun): 단단한 등껍질을 만들기 위해 먹이의 딱딱한 껍데기나 뼈도 통째로 깨물어 먹었다.
Description (en, sun): It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.
Description (ko, moon): 바다와 육지 양쪽에서 활동한다. 육지의 먹이는 바다로 끌고 들어가 처리한다.
Description (en, moon): Active both on land and in the sea, this Pokémon drags its land-based prey into the water to finish it off.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 턱의 힘이 무시무시하다. 암스타나 암나이트의 껍질도 아무렇지 않게 통째로 먹었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 단단한 등껍질을 더욱 튼튼하게 만들기 위해 잡은 먹이는 껍질이나 뼈까지 남기지 않고 먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.
Description (ko, sword): 먹이의 껍질과 뼈까지 남김없이 깨끗하게 먹어 치워서 등껍질은 두껍고 단단하게 성장한다.
Description (en, sword): Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s own shell grows thick and sturdy.
Description (ko, shield): 물속과 비교하면 움직임이 둔하지만 먹이를 찾아 육지에서도 활동한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Archen — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Archen
ID: 566
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아켄
Name (en): Archen
Description (en, black): Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
Description (en, white): Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
Description (en, black-2): It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.
Description (ko, x): 화석에서 부활한 포켓몬이다. 모든 새포켓몬의 조상이라 여겨지고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 새포켓몬의 조상이라고 전해진다. 날 수 없어서 가지에서 가지로 뛰어다니며 생활했다고 한다.
Description (ko, sun): 모든 새포켓몬의 조상이다. 아켄 자체는 아직 날지 못해 나무 위를 점프해서 이동했다.
Description (en, sun): It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.
Description (ko, moon): 날 수는 없었던 것 같으나 나무 위에서부터 활공하여 먹이를 잡았다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): To all appearances flightless, it was able to glide down from tall treetops to snag its prey.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 모든 새포켓몬의 선조라고 여겨져 왔지만 최근 연구에서는 아니라는 설도 대두되었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 화석에서 복원되었다. 날개는 있지만 아직 나는 것은 불가능한 고대의 새포켓몬.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.
Description (ko, sword): 화석으로부터 복원에 성공했다. 연구한 것처럼 날지는 못하지만 점프는 특기인 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.
Description (ko, shield): 새포켓몬의 선조로 불린다. 나무 위에서 살며 나무열매나 벌레포켓몬을 먹는다.
Description (en, shield): Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Archeops — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Archeops
ID: 567
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아케오스
Name (en): Archeops
Description (en, black): They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
Description (en, white): It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.
Description (en, black-2): It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
Description (ko, x): 지상에서 도움닫기를 하여 날아오른다. 동료와 협력하여 먹이를 잡는 지능을 가졌다.
Description (ko, y): 나는 것보다 달리는 것이 특기로 시속 40km로 달리던 기세로 넓은 하늘로 날아오른다.
Description (ko, sun): 날 수도 있었지만 대부분 지상을 뛰어다녔다. 그 시속은 평균 40km이다.
Description (en, sun): Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.
Description (ko, moon): 무리 지어 사냥을 했다. 먹이를 몰아넣으면 다른 동료가 하늘에서 급습한다.
Description (en, moon): They hunted in flocks. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 깃털이 매우 가늘어 숙련된 장인이 아니면 복원에 실패한다고 전해지는 고대의 포켓몬.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This ancient Pokémon’s plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 새포켓몬의 조상이라 불린다. 날갯짓하는 근육은 아직 약해서 도움닫기를 하지 않으면 날 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.
Description (ko, sword): 날아오르기 위해 도움닫기를 하는데 그 거리는 약 4km다. 도움닫기의 속도는 시속 40km다.
Description (en, sword): It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
Description (ko, shield): 비행도 가능하지만 지상에서 먹이를 사냥하는 일을 훨씬 더 잘하는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Trubbish — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Trubbish
ID: 568
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 깨봉이
Name (en): Trubbish
Description (en, black): Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
Description (en, white): The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
Description (en, black-2): Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
Description (ko, x): 쓰레기 봉지가 산업 폐기물과 화학적 변화를 일으켜서 포켓몬으로 다시 태어났다.
Description (ko, y): 비위생적인 장소를 좋아한다. 트림하듯이 토해내는 가스를 들이마시면 1주일 동안 잠에 빠진다.
Description (ko, sun): 비위생적인 곳을 좋아한다. 알로라에서는 자주 질퍽이에게 쫓겨 다니는 모습을 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, sun): Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.
Description (ko, moon): 배가 부를 때까지 쓰레기를 먹은 후 입에서 독가스를 토해낸다. 실수로 맡으면 즉시 입원해야 한다.
Description (en, moon): It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of gas will put a person in the hospital.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 숨을 쉬면 독가스가 새어 나온다. 냄새를 맡고 질뻐기가 침을 흘리며 찾아온다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Poisonous gas leaks out of it when it breathes. Muk that catch a whiff of that stench will come drooling.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 트림처럼 내뱉는 가스는 어린아이가 들이마시면 치명적일 정도로 위험하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.
Description (ko, sword): 비위생적인 장소를 좋아한다. 쓰레기를 어질러놓은 채 내버려 두면 방에 나타나 그대로 눌러앉는다.
Description (en, sword): Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
Description (ko, shield): 쓰레기가 가득 담긴 쓰레기봉투에서 태어났다. 내뿜는 독가스는 가라르의 또도가스가 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

document.title: Garbodor — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Garbodor
ID: 569
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 더스트나
Name (en): Garbodor
Description (en, black): It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
Description (en, white): They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.
Description (en, black-2): Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
Description (ko, x): 왼팔로 상대를 꼭 붙들고 입에서 악취가 나는 독가스를 토해내서 마무리한다.
Description (ko, y): 쓰레기를 흡수해서 체내에서 새로운 종류의 독가스나 독의 액체를 만들어낸다.
Description (ko, sun): 오른쪽 팔에서 날리는 독액에 주의. 살짝 닿기만 해도 미지의 독소가 침범한다.
Description (en, sun): Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you’ll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.
Description (ko, moon): 한때 알로라에서 폭발적으로 늘었지만 질퍽이가 오고 난 뒤로 개체 수가 크게 줄었다.
Description (en, moon): For a time, their numbers increased explosively in Alola. Since the arrival of Grimer, their population has decreased dramatically.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 왼쪽 팔로 적을 꼭 붙들고 독액을 온몸에 퍼부어 움직임을 막는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It locks opponents in place with its left hand, immobilizing them by entirely dousing their bodies with poisonous liquid.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 알로라의 더스트나가 좀 더 강인한 것은 질뻐기라는 천적이 있기 때문이라고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.
Description (ko, sword): 먹은 쓰레기가 체내에서 독으로 변화한다. 먹은 쓰레기에 따라 독의 주성분도 바뀐다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
Description (ko, shield): 오른팔에서 내보내는 독액은 약한 생물이 맞으면 즉사할 정도로 위험하다.
Description (en, shield): The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

document.title: Zorua — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Zorua
ID: 570
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 조로아
Name (en): Zorua
Description (en, black): It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
Description (en, white): To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
Description (en, black-2): It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
Description (ko, x): 상대와 똑 닮게 둔갑한 것처럼 보이게 하여 속이거나 놀라게 해서 그 틈에 도망가는 일이 많다.
Description (ko, y): 사람이나 다른 포켓몬으로 둔갑한다. 자신의 정체를 감추어 위험으로부터 몸을 지키는 것이다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 겁이 많은 포켓몬으로 동료와 있을 때 말고는 거의 다른 누군가로 둔갑하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 평소에 수다스러운 아이가 과묵해졌다면 조로아가 둔갑한 것일지도 모른다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
Description (ko, sword): 무언가로 둔갑하는 능력을 익힌 것은 겁이 많은 성질의 영향인 듯하다.
Description (en, sword): Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua’s ability to take on the forms of other creatures.
Description (ko, shield): 먹이를 찾아 사람으로 둔갑하여 마을에 나타나기도 한다. 주로 아이로 둔갑한다.
Description (en, shield): Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Zoroark — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Zoroark
ID: 571
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 조로아크
Name (en): Zoroark
Description (en, black): Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
Description (en, white): Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
Description (en, black-2): Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
Description (ko, x): 한 번에 많은 사람을 속이는 힘을 가졌다. 환영의 경치를 보여줘 거처를 지킨다.
Description (ko, y): 상대를 속여 무리의 안전을 유지해온 포켓몬이다. 동료 간의 결속력이 강하다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 둔갑술이 가능할 뿐만 아니라 수백 명의 사람에게 환상을 보여줄 수 있는 힘을 가졌다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It doesn’t just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 인간에게 거처를 들킬 위기에 처하면 환상을 보여줘서 숲을 떠돌게 한다고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
Description (ko, sword): 동료애가 깊은 포켓몬이다. 무서운 환상을 보게 만들어서 거처나 무리를 지킨다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.
Description (ko, shield): 고독한 트레이너는 조로아크에게 환상을 보여주도록 명령하여 혼자만의 외로움을 달랜다.
Description (en, shield): Seeking to ease the burden of their solitude, lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusions to them.
Description (en, legends-arceus): With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Minccino — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Minccino
ID: 572
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 치라미
Name (en): Minccino
Description (en, black): They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
Description (en, white): These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
Description (en, black-2): Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
Description (ko, x): 서로의 꼬리로 상대를 철저히 깨끗하게 만드는 것이 치라미끼리의 인사다.
Description (ko, y): 깨끗함을 좋아하는 포켓몬이다. 꼬리를 빗자루 대신 써서 항상 거처의 먼지를 쓸어낸다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 결벽증이 있어서 조금의 더러움도 용서하지 않는다. 꼬리를 걸레 삼아 꼼꼼히 더러운 것을 닦아 낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 자신의 몸이나 보금자리를 청소하느라 더러워진 꼬리는 깨끗한 샘물로 하루에 걸쳐서 씻는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.
Description (ko, sword): 꼬리로 더러운 것을 떨어낸다. 청소를 할 때는 도움이 되지만 결벽증이 있어서 힘들기도 하다.
Description (en, sword): The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
Description (ko, shield): 꼬리로 쓰다듬으며 서로 인사한다. 꼬리 털이 많은 쪽이 조금 으스댄다.
Description (en, shield): They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cinccino — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cinccino
ID: 573
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 치라치노
Name (en): Cinccino
Description (en, black): Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
Description (en, white): Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
Description (en, black-2): Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
Description (ko, x): 하얀 털은 감촉이 정말 좋다. 먼지나 정전기가 전혀 생기지 않는다.
Description (ko, y): 치라치노의 몸은 특별한 기름으로 뒤덮여 있어 펀치 등 상대의 공격을 받아넘긴다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 하얀 털은 몸에서 나오는 기름으로 코팅되어 적의 공격도 매끄럽게 피한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies’ attacks.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 전신에서 배어 나오는 기름은 매우 부드럽다. 거친 피부가 고민인 사람에게도 효과적이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.
Description (ko, sword): 먼지 한 톨도 용납하지 않는 결벽증. 몸에서 나오는 기름을 둥지에 발라서 코팅한다.
Description (en, sword): Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
Description (ko, shield): 특별한 기름이 스며든 털은 공격을 받아넘긴다. 기름은 높은 가격에 거래되고 있다.
Description (en, shield): A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gothita
ID: 574
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고디탱
Name (en): Gothita
Description (en, black): Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
Description (en, white): They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
Description (en, black-2): It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn’t notice attacks.
Description (ko, x): 리본 모양의 더듬이로 사이코 파워를 증폭시킨다. 무언가를 가만히 바라보고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 포켓몬이나 트레이너를 가만히 관찰한다. 고디탱만 볼 수 있는 무언가를 바라보고 있는 것 같다.
Description (ko, sword): 아직 아기지만 리본을 닮은 더듬이에 모아둔 사이코 파워로 싸울 때도 있다.
Description (en, sword): Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.
Description (ko, shield): 아무도 없는데 나직이 운다. 고디탱에게만 보이는 뭔가와 이야기하는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

document.title: Gothorita — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gothorita

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고디보미
Name (en): Gothorita
Description (en, black): They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
Description (en, white): Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
Description (en, black-2): According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
Description (ko, x): 별빛이 힘의 원천이다. 밤이 되면 사이코 파워로 돌을 띄워 별의 배치를 표시한다.
Description (ko, y): 별빛이 빛나는 밤에 잠자는 아이들을 조종해서 논다는 이야기가 많이 남아 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 별이 빛나는 밤에 잠이 든 아이들을 데려간다고 전해져 심판의 마녀라고도 불린다.
Description (en, sword): It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.
Description (ko, shield): 별이 빛나는 밤에 가장 사이코 파워가 높아지는 듯하다. 우주와의 관계는 불명확하다.
Description (en, shield): On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

document.title: Gothitelle — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gothitelle
ID: 576
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고디모아젤
Name (en): Gothitelle
Description (en, black): Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
Description (en, white): They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.
Description (en, black-2): It can see the future from the movement of the stars. When it learns its Trainer’s life span, it cries in sadness.
Description (ko, x): 강력한 사이코 파워의 영향으로 고디모아젤 주변 공간이 비틀어져 몇만 광년이나 떨어진 하늘의 별이 비친다.
Description (ko, y): 별의 배치나 움직임으로 미래의 일을 예지하는 능력을 가지고 있다. 트레이너의 수명도 알 수 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 별의 움직임으로 미래를 본다. 엄청난 사이코 파워를 가졌지만 싸움을 좋아하지 않는 기질을 가졌다.
Description (en, sword): It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.
Description (ko, shield): 고디모아젤을 통해 자신의 최후를 보게 된 악인은 그날을 마지막으로 종적을 감추었다.
Description (en, shield): A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.body:

ID: 577
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 유니란
Name (en): Solosis
Description (en, black): They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
Description (en, white): Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.
Description (en, black-2): Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
Description (ko, x): 몸이 특수한 액체로 둘러싸여 있어 어떤 곤란한 상황이라도 문제없다.
Description (ko, y): 사이코 파워를 방출하여 달려드는 상대를 물리친다. 텔레파시로 동료와 대화한다.
Description (ko, sword): 텔레파시로 의사소통을 한다. 강한 충격을 받으면 몸을 둘러싸고 있는 액체가 흘러나온다.
Description (en, sword): It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.
Description (ko, shield): 특수한 액체로 몸을 둘러싸고 있어 우주에서도 살 수 있다고 전해진다.
Description (en, shield): Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Duosion — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Duosion
ID: 578
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 듀란
Name (en): Duosion
Description (en, black): Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
Description (en, white): When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.
Description (en, black-2): When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.
Description (ko, x): 둘로 분열된 뇌를 가지고 있어서 갑자기 다른 행동을 취할 때가 있다.
Description (ko, y): 분열한 2개의 뇌로 같은 생각을 하면 낼 수 있는 사이코 파워는 최고가 된다.
Description (ko, sword): 2개의 뇌가 의견 일치했을 때의 염동력은 주변 1km까지 영향을 미친다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.
Description (ko, shield): 분열한 2개의 뇌는 생각이 거의 일치하지 않아 전혀 행동을 예측할 수 없다.
Description (en, shield): Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

document.body:

Name (ko): 란쿨루스
Name (en): Reuniclus
Description (en, black): When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
Description (en, white): These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.
Description (en, black-2): They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
Description (ko, x): 발휘한 사이코 파워를 사용해 특수한 액체로 만들어진 팔을 조종해서 바위를 부순다.
Description (ko, y): 란쿨루스끼리 악수를 하면 뇌가 네트워크처럼 연결되어 사이코 파워가 증폭된다.
Description (ko, sword): 초능력을 사용하는 것보다는 자랑거리인 팔을 휘둘러서 때려눕히는 것을 선호한다.
Description (en, sword): While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.
Description (ko, shield): 특수한 액체를 마시면 지혜를 얻는다고 전해지지만 란쿨루스 외에는 맹독이다.
Description (en, shield): It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

Description (en, black-2): They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
Description (ko, x): 상대에게 공격당하면 전신의 깃털에서 물보라를 내뿜는다. 물안개에 숨어들어 도망친다.

Name (en): Swanna

Description (en, white): It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.
Description (en, black-2): Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
Description (ko, x): 우아한 외모와 다르게 날개로 힘차게 날개 치며 수천 km를 계속 날 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 새벽이 오면 스완나들이 춤추기 시작한다. 한가운데에서 춤추는 스완나가 무리의 우두머리다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 우아한 외모와 다르게 힘찬 날갯짓으로 수천 km를 계속 날 수 있다.

document.title: Vanillite — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Vanillite
ID: 582
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 바닐프티
Name (en): Vanillite
Description (en, black): The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
Description (en, white): This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.
Description (en, black-2): Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.
Description (ko, x): 마이너스 50도의 숨결을 내뱉는다. 눈 결정을 만들어 주변에 눈이 내리게 한다.
Description (en, x): The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
Description (ko, y): 아침 해의 에너지를 받은 고드름이 포켓몬이 되었다. 눈에 몸을 묻고 잠든다.
Description (ko, sun): 고드름에서 태어난 포켓몬이다. 차가운 숨으로 눈 결정을 만들어 눈을 뿌린다.
Description (en, sun): Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.
Description (ko, moon): 껴안으면 차가워서 기분이 좋다. 더운 지방에서는 한 집에 1마리씩 두고 소중하게 여기는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 마이너스 50도 냉기를 내뱉는다. 따듯한 장소에 있으면 조금씩 작아진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It exhales cold air that is at –58 degrees Fahrenheit. When it’s in a warm place, it shrinks little by little.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아침 햇살을 받은 고드름이 아직 녹고 싶지 않다고 소원하여 태어났다. 밤에는 눈 속에 들어가 잠든다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.
Description (ko, sword): 더운 곳에서는 살 수 없다. 냉기를 뿜어 눈을 내리게 한 뒤 쌓인 눈 속에 들어가 잠든다.
Description (en, sword): Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.
Description (ko, shield): 고드름에서 태어났다고 전해진다. 마이너스 50도의 냉기를 뿜어 주변을 얼려 살기 좋게 만든다.
Description (en, shield): Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Vanillish — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Vanillish
ID: 583
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 바닐리치
Name (en): Vanillish
Description (en, black): Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
Description (en, white): It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.
Description (en, black-2): They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
Description (ko, x): 주변 공기를 차갑게 해서 얼음 알갱이를 발생시켜서 상대의 몸을 얼려버린다.
Description (ko, y): 설산에 서식하는 포켓몬이다. 먼 옛날 빙하기 때 남쪽 땅으로 이동해 왔다.
Description (ko, sun): 더운 날에는 몸이 녹는다. 얼리면 다시 돌아오지만 몸 형태는 조금 일그러진다.
Description (en, sun): Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.
Description (ko, moon): 빙하기 때부터 존재해왔다. 얼음 결정을 조종하여 적을 얼린 뒤 박치기로 부순다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 얼음 입자를 세게 내뿜어 적의 몸을 얼린다. 알로라의 바닐리치는 전체적으로 몸집이 작다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It sprays its enemies with grains of ice to freeze them. Most Vanillish in Alola are smaller than average.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 빙하기에 꿋꿋하게 살아남은 매우 강인한 포켓몬. 특히 더운 지방에서는 뛰어난 인기를 자랑한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.
Description (ko, sword): 깨끗한 물을 마셔서 얼음으로 된 몸을 크게 만든다. 날씨가 맑은 날에는 잘 발견되지 않는다.
Description (en, sword): By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.
Description (ko, shield): 마이너스 100도의 냉기로 적을 얼리지만 목숨은 뺏지 않는 상냥한 기질을 가졌다.
Description (en, shield): It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Vanilluxe — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Vanilluxe
ID: 584
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 배바닐라
Name (en): Vanilluxe
Description (en, black): Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
Description (en, white): If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
Description (en, black-2): Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.
Description (ko, x): 두 개의 머리가 동시에 화를 내면 뿔에서 강한 눈보라가 뿜어져 나온다. 주변을 많은 눈으로 묻어 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 대량의 물을 들이마셔 몸 안에서 눈구름으로 바꾼다. 화나면 강한 눈보라를 일으킨다.
Description (ko, sun): 두 개의 머리 각각에 뇌가 있고 각자의 의견이 일치하면 강한 눈보라를 뿜어 적을 덮친다.
Description (en, sun): Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
Description (ko, moon): 한쪽 머리를 잃어도 특별히 문제없이 살 수 있다. 몸속에서 눈구름을 만든다.
Description (en, moon): Even if it loses one of its heads, it can live relatively problem-free. It makes snow clouds inside its body.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 2개의 입에서 눈보라를 뿜어낸다. 어디에서든 눈을 만들어 내기 때문에 스키어나 스노보더에게 인기다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아침 해에 녹아내리던 2마리의 바닐리치가 붙어서 추운 밤에 다시 얼어붙으면 태어난다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day’s light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.
Description (ko, sword): 분노가 정점에 달하면 눈보라를 불게 하여 적도 아군도 꽁꽁 얼려버린다.
Description (en, sword): When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.
Description (ko, shield): 체온은 마이너스 6도 전후이다. 2마리의 바닐리치가 붙어서 태어났다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

ID: 585

Name (ko): 사철록
Name (en): Deerling

Description (en, white): The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
Description (en, black-2): Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
Description (ko, x): 계절이 바뀌었을 때뿐 아니라 기온이나 습도에 따라서도 몸의 색깔은 조금 변한다.
Description (ko, y): 계절이 바뀌는 시기가 되면 털과 냄새가 변화한다. 계절을 알리는 포켓몬이다.

Name (ko): 바라철록
Name (en): Sawsbuck
Description (en, black): They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
Description (en, white): The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.
Description (en, black-2): They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
Description (ko, x): 계절에 따라 거처를 바꾼다. 사람들은 바라철록의 뿔에서 계절의 변화를 느낀다.
Description (ko, y): 계절의 변화와 함께 거처를 바꾸기에 바라철록이 봄을 나른다고 말하는 사람도 있다.

document.title: Emolga — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Emolga
ID: 587
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에몽가
Name (en): Emolga
Description (en, black): The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
Description (en, white): They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
Description (en, black-2): It glides on its outstretched membrane while shocking foes with the electricity stored in the pouches on its cheeks.
Description (ko, x): 숲의 나무 위에 산다. 망토 같은 막의 안쪽을 방전시키며 활공한다.
Description (ko, y): 볼의 전기 주머니에서 만든 전기를 막 안쪽에 모아 활공하며 전기를 발산한다.
Description (ko, sun): 망토 같은 막으로 활공한다. 전기를 흩뿌려서 적도 자기편도 전부 감전시킨다.
Description (en, sun): It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.
Description (ko, moon): 전격으로 나무열매나 벌레포켓몬을 알맞게 구워서 먹는다. 콕코구리가 뚫은 나무 구멍이 주된 서식지다.
Description (en, moon): It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 전기를 모아 하늘을 난다. 천둥이 치는 한밤중에는 하늘을 가득 메울 정도로 많다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They store up electricity to fly through the air. When thunder cracks at night, sometimes there are almost enough of them to blot out the sky.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 전기를 흩뿌리면서 날기 때문에 새포켓몬들이 다가오지 않는다. 덕분에 먹이를 독차지할 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That’s why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.
Description (ko, sword): 전기를 내뿜으며 하늘을 춤추듯이 난다. 귀엽지만 성가시다.
Description (en, sword): As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.
Description (ko, shield): 달콤한 나무열매를 매우 좋아한다. 볼주머니에 먹이를 너무 많이 넣어 잘 날지 못할 때도 있다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Karrablast — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Karrablast
ID: 588
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 딱정곤
Name (en): Karrablast
Description (en, black): These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
Description (en, white): When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.
Description (en, black-2): For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
Description (ko, x): 쪼마리와 함께 있을 때 전기적인 자극을 받으면 진화하는 이상한 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 쪼마리를 덮쳤을 때 전기 에너지를 받으면 왜인지 진화해 버린다.
Description (ko, sword): 전기 에너지에 반응하는 이상한 체질을 지녔다. 쪼마리와 함께 있으면 진화한다.
Description (en, sword): Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.
Description (ko, shield): 입에서 내뿜는 액체로 쪼마리의 껍질을 녹여서 내용물만 먹어 치운다.
Description (en, shield): It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Escavalier — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Escavalier
ID: 589
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 슈바르고
Name (en): Escavalier
Description (en, black): They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
Description (en, white): These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
Description (en, black-2): Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
Description (ko, x): 쪼마리에게서 뺏은 껍질로 몸을 에워싸 가드하면서 2개의 창으로 찔러온다.
Description (ko, y): 쪼마리의 껍질을 입고 진화한 포켓몬이다. 강철의 갑옷이 전신을 보호한다.
Description (ko, sword): 쪼마리의 껍질을 빼앗아 완전히 무장했다. 가라르지방에서는 매우 인기가 높다.
Description (en, sword): They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They’re very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.
Description (ko, shield): 창을 겨누고 적에게 돌격한다. 창파나이트와의 결투를 그린 그림이 유명하다.
Description (en, shield): It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Foongus — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Foongus
ID: 590
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 깜놀버슬
Name (en): Foongus
Description (en, black): It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
Description (en, white): For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.
Description (en, black-2): It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.
Description (ko, x): 몬스터볼을 닮은 무늬로 유인한 후 독 포자를 뿌려댄다. 왜 닮았는지는 불가사의다.
Description (ko, y): 몬스터볼과 똑 닮은 무늬로 포켓몬을 유인해 독 포자를 뿌린다.
Description (en, y): It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.
Description (ko, sword): 몬스터볼을 많이 닮았는데 그 의미와 이유는 아직 아무도 모른다.
Description (en, sword): No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.
Description (ko, shield): 양손에서 내뿜는 포자는 맹독이지만 잘 말리면 복통약이 된다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Amoonguss — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Amoonguss
ID: 591
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 뽀록나
Name (en): Amoonguss
Description (en, black): It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
Description (en, white): They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
Description (en, black-2): It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.
Description (ko, x): 몬스터볼 무늬의 삿갓을 보여주며 먹이를 유인하려 하지만 속아 넘어가는 포켓몬은 드물다.
Description (ko, y): 양팔의 몬스터볼을 닮은 삿갓을 한들한들 흔들어 먹이를 유인하는 춤을 춘다.
Description (ko, sword): 독 포자를 내뿜는다. 빨리 씻어내지 않으면 그곳에 버섯이 자라난다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.
Description (ko, shield): 평상시에는 잘 움직이지 않는다. 떨어져 있는 몬스터볼 옆에서 그저 가만히 대기할 뿐이다.
Description (en, shield): Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Frillish — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Frillish
ID: 592
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 탱그릴
Name (en): Frillish
Description (en, black): With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
Description (en, white): They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
Description (en, black-2): If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.
Description (ko, x): 먹이를 독으로 마비시켜 8000m 심해에 있다는 거처로 데려간다.
Description (ko, y): 베일 같은 손발을 휘감아 마비시켜서 8000m의 심해에 데려가 끝장낸다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 베일 같은 손발을 휘감아 헤엄치는 먹이를 심해로 끌고 간다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 적을 마비시켜서 물에 빠뜨리기 위해 베일 같은 손발에는 눈에 보이지 않는 독침이 잔뜩 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.
Description (ko, sword): 베일과도 같은 손발로 먹이를 끌어안아 8000m 아래의 심해로 끌고 들어간다.
Description (en, sword): It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean’s surface.
Description (ko, shield): 해저에 가라앉은 고대 도시의 주민이 포켓몬이 되었다는 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, shield): Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Jellicent — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Jellicent
ID: 593
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 탱탱겔
Name (en): Jellicent
Description (en, black): The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
Description (en, white): They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.
Description (en, black-2): Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
Description (ko, x): 몸 대부분이 해수다. 해저에는 탱탱겔이 가라앉힌 배로 만들어진 성이 있다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 탱탱겔의 거처로 길을 잃고 들어간 배는 가라앉으며 승무원의 생명이 흡수되어 버린다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 여객선이나 유조선 주위를 맴돌며 먹이를 끌어들이기 위해 노리고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 어부들이 두려워하는 존재다. 바다로 끌고 들어가 목숨을 빼앗아간다는 소문이 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It’s rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.
Description (ko, sword): 몸의 대부분이 바닷물과 같은 성분으로 이루어져 있다. 침몰선을 거처로 삼는다.
Description (en, sword): Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.
Description (ko, shield): 보름달이 뜨면 무리를 거느리고 해수면에 모습을 드러낸다. 먹이가 오기를 기다리는 것이다.
Description (en, shield): Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Alomomola — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Alomomola
ID: 594
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 맘복치
Name (en): Alomomola
Description (en, black): The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
Description (en, white): Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
Description (en, black-2): It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.
Description (ko, x): 넓은 바다를 떠돌아다니며 산다. 상처 입은 포켓몬을 발견하면 안고서 물가까지 옮긴다.
Description (ko, y): 상처 입거나 약해진 포켓몬을 지느러미로 부드럽게 안으며 특수한 점막으로 치료한다.
Description (ko, sun): 다친 포켓몬을 끌어안아 특수한 점액으로 상처를 덮는다. 그 이유는 불명이다.
Description (en, sun): It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.
Description (ko, moon): 넓은 바다를 떠돌아다니며 산다. 맘복치 주변에는 많은 물포켓몬들이 모여든다.
Description (en, moon): They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 어부가 긴 항해를 할 때 데려간다. 맘복치가 있으면 의사도 약도 필요 없기 때문이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there’ll be no need for a doctor or medicine.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 약해진 포켓몬을 도와주는 것은 이를 노리고 오는 포켓몬에게 자신도 공격받기 때문이라고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Joltik — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Joltik
ID: 595
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파쪼옥
Name (en): Joltik
Description (en, black): Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
Description (en, white): They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.
Description (en, black-2): Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
Description (ko, x): 스스로 전기를 만들 수 없어 다른 큰 포켓몬에 달라붙어 정전기를 흡수한다.
Description (ko, y): 몸이 큰 포켓몬에게 매달려 정전기를 빨아들인 후 축전 주머니에 전기를 모은다.
Description (ko, sword): 포켓몬의 몸에 들러붙어 정전기를 흡수한다. 스스로는 전기를 만들 수 없다.
Description (en, sword): Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.
Description (ko, shield): 다른 포켓몬에게 달라붙어 정전기를 빨아들인다. 멍파치의 엉덩이에 자주 달라붙어 있다.
Description (en, shield): Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Galvantula — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Galvantula
ID: 596
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 전툴라
Name (en): Galvantula
Description (en, black): When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
Description (en, white): They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
Description (en, black-2): It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense.
Description (ko, x): 전기를 띤 실로 함정을 설치한다. 감전돼서 움직이지 못하는 먹이를 천천히 먹어치운다.
Description (ko, y): 상대에게 공격당하면 전기를 띤 실을 무수히 뿜어내서 전기 배리어를 만든다.
Description (ko, sword): 전기를 띤 배의 털을 날려서 공격한다. 털에 찔리면 삼 일 밤낮으로 전신이 마비된다.
Description (en, sword): It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.
Description (ko, shield): 잘 날지 못하는 새끼를 노리고 새포켓몬 둥지 가까이에 전기로 된 실로 함정을 만든다.
Description (en, shield): It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Ferroseed — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ferroseed
ID: 597
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 철시드
Name (en): Ferroseed
Description (en, black): When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
Description (en, white): They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.
Description (en, black-2): It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.
Description (ko, x): 위험을 감지하면 가시를 일제히 발사하여 반격한다. 그 틈에 몸을 굴려 도망간다.
Description (ko, y): 동굴 천장에 박혀서 바위의 철분을 흡수한다. 위험이 닥치면 바늘을 쏜다.
Description (ko, sword): 가시를 날려서 몸을 지킨다. 원하는 방향으로 날리기 위해서는 많은 훈련이 필요하다.
Description (en, sword): It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.
Description (ko, shield): 이끼 낀 동굴을 좋아한다. 이끼에 함유된 효소가 가시를 크고 튼튼하게 만들어준다.
Description (en, shield): Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Ferrothorn — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ferrothorn
ID: 598
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 너트령
Name (en): Ferrothorn
Description (en, black): It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
Description (en, white): They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
Description (en, black-2): By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
Description (ko, x): 3개의 촉수를 세게 내리치고 거기에 가시를 날려 상대를 흔적도 없이 분쇄한다.
Description (ko, y): 동굴 천장에 달라붙어 아래를 지나가는 먹이를 향해 철 가시를 쏘며 덮친다.
Description (ko, sword): 가시로 암반에 상처를 낸 다음 촉수 끝을 이용해서 영양분을 흡수한다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.
Description (ko, shield): 강철보다 견고한 가시를 갖고 있다. 촉수 가시를 찔러서 바위 벽을 기어 다니며 이동한다.
Description (en, shield): Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Klink — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Klink
ID: 599
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 기어르
Name (en): Klink
Description (en, black): The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
Description (en, white): Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
Description (en, black-2): Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.
Description (ko, x): 두 개의 몸을 맞물려 회전시켜서 살아가기 위한 에너지를 만들고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 두 개의 몸은 그 조합 방법이 정해져 있다. 다른 몸과는 맞물리지 않고 떨어져 버린다.
Description (ko, sword): 2개의 몸은 쌍둥이보다도 가깝다. 다른 몸과 있으면 제대로 맞물리지 못한다.
Description (en, sword): The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
Description (ko, shield): 먼 옛날에 기어르를 본 사람이 톱니바퀴의 구조를 고안했다고 전해진다.
Description (en, shield): It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Klang — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Klang
ID: 600
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 기기어르
Name (en): Klang
Description (en, black): By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
Description (en, white): Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don’t return.
Description (en, black-2): A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.
Description (ko, x): 회전 방향을 바꿔서 동료에게 감정을 전한다. 화가 나면 회전이 빨라진다.
Description (ko, y): 꼬마기어와 왕기어로 나뉘었다. 공격을 위해 날린 꼬마기어가 돌아오지 않으면 죽게 된다.
Description (ko, sword): 전력을 다할 때는 왕기어의 바깥쪽 톱니와 꼬마기어가 맞물린다. 회전 속도를 빠르게 하기 위함이다.
Description (en, sword): When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.
Description (ko, shield): 공업 기술의 상징으로 많은 가라르의 회사에서 기업 로고로 채용하고 있다.
Description (en, shield): Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

Description (en, black-2): The minigear spins at high speed. Then the energy from the red core charges the minigear to make it ready to fire.

Description (en, white): These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
Description (en, black-2): It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
Description (ko, x): 상대를 휘감고 동그란 반점에서 전기를 흘려보내 마비시킨 뒤 통째로 문다.

document.title: Elgyem — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Elgyem
ID: 605
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 리그레
Name (en): Elgyem
Description (en, black): It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
Description (en, white): This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.
Description (en, black-2): Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.
Description (ko, x): 강력한 사이코 파워를 다룬다. 사이코 파워로 상대의 뇌를 조여서 두통을 일으킨다.
Description (ko, y): 50년 전 UFO가 추락했다는 소문이 도는 사막에서 왔다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 무시무시한 사이코 파워를 조종한다. 우주인 목격 정보의 대부분은 리그레를 보고 착각한 것이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 약 50년 전 지상에 떨어진 UFO에서 나타났다고 전해지는 수수께끼로 둘러싸인 포켓몬.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It’s said to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the sky about 50 years ago.
Description (ko, sword): TV 근처에 있으면 모니터에 기묘한 풍경이 비친다. 리그레의 고향이라 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, sword): If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.
Description (ko, shield): 약 50년 전에 발견된 포켓몬이다. 크게 발달한 뇌로 사이코 파워를 조종한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

document.title: Beheeyem — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Beheeyem
ID: 606
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 벰크
Name (en): Beheeyem
Description (en, black): It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
Description (en, white): It uses psychic power to control an opponent’s brain and tamper with its memories.
Description (en, black-2): Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven’t been decoded.
Description (ko, x): 손끝을 점멸시켜서 대화하는 듯하나 그 패턴은 아직 해독하지 못했다.
Description (ko, y): 사이코 파워로 상대의 뇌를 조종하여 기억된 영상을 다른 것으로 바꿔 버린다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 사이코 파워로 상대 기억을 바꿔 버린다. 당신도 이미 바뀐 기억일지도 모른다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents’ memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강한 사이코 파워를 가지고 있다. 3가지 색으로 빛나는 손가락으로 상대를 조종해 기억을 바꿔 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers that flash three different colors, it controls its opponents and rewrites their memories.
Description (ko, sword): 벰크가 나타난 목장에서는 배우르 1마리가 어느샌가 모습을 감춘다.
Description (en, sword): Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.
Description (ko, shield): 상대의 기억을 조작할 수 있다. 보리밭 위를 떠도는 모습이 가끔 목격된다.
Description (en, shield): Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

document.body:

Name (ko): 불켜미
Name (en): Litwick

Description (en, white): While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
Description (en, black-2): Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.
Description (ko, x): 빛을 밝혀 길 안내를 하는 것처럼 가장하여 생명력을 빨아들이고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 불켜미가 밝히는 빛은 사람과 포켓몬의 생명력을 빨아들여 불타고 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 불꽃으로 뜨거워진 몸은 약간 따뜻하다. 미아의 손을 잡고 영계로 데리고 간다.
Description (en, sword): The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.
Description (ko, shield): 흡수하는 생명이 젊으면 젊을수록 머리의 불꽃은 크고 괴이하게 타오른다.
Description (en, shield): The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

document.body:

Name: Lampent
ID: 608
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 램프라
Name (en): Lampent
Description (en, black): This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
Description (en, white): It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.
Description (en, black-2): The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
Description (ko, x): 영혼을 빨아들여 불을 밝힌다. 사람이 죽는 것을 기다리기 위해 병원을 서성거리게 되었다.
Description (ko, y): 임종 때 나타나서 영혼이 육체를 떠나면 재빨리 빨아들여 버린다.
Description (ko, sword): 누군가가 죽기 직전에 나타나기 때문에 사신의 사자로 여겨져 두려움의 대상이 되었다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it’s feared as an emissary of death.
Description (ko, shield): 램프인 척 마을 안으로 숨어든다. 죽음이 다가온 사람을 발견하면 조용히 뒤를 쫓는다.
Description (en, shield): It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

document.body:

Name: Chandelure
ID: 609
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 샹델라
Name (en): Chandelure
Description (en, black): It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
Description (en, white): Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
Description (en, black-2): The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.
Description (ko, x): 샹델라의 불꽃에 둘러싸이면 영혼이 빨려가 불타버린다. 빈 껍데기인 몸만 남는다.
Description (ko, y): 괴상한 불꽃으로 태워진 영혼은 갈 곳을 잃고 이승을 영원히 헤맨다.
Description (ko, sword): 오래된 양옥집에 산다. 팔의 불꽃을 이상하게 흔들어서 상대에게 최면을 건다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.
Description (ko, shield): 샹델라를 등불 대용으로 사용했던 저택에서는 장례식이 끊이지 않았다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

document.title: Axew — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Axew
ID: 610
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 터검니
Name (en): Axew
Description (en, black): They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
Description (en, white): They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.
Description (en, black-2): Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.
Description (ko, x): 나무열매를 이빨로 깨물어 먹는다. 이빨이 몇 차례에 걸쳐 새로 나면 강하고 날카로워진다
Description (ko, y): 이빨로 수목에 상처를 내서 영역 표시를 한다. 부러지면 바로 새 이빨이 난다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 나무열매를 이빨로 깨물어 먹는다. 이빨이 몇 차례에 걸쳐 새로 나면 강하고 날카로워진다.
Description (ko, sword): 땅속에 만든 굴에 산다. 딱딱한 나무열매를 어금니로 부수는 것을 통해 동료와 힘을 겨룬다.
Description (en, sword): These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other’s strength.
Description (ko, shield): 커다란 어금니를 부딪치며 동료와 장난친다. 어금니는 부러져도 바로 자라나서 걱정 없다.
Description (en, shield): They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.
