document.title: Fraxure — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Fraxure
ID: 611
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 액슨도
Name (en): Fraxure
Description (en, black): Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
Description (en, white): Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
Description (en, black-2): A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.
Description (ko, x): 큰 바위를 부수는 이빨을 가지고 있다. 액슨도들의 영역 싸움은 매우 격렬하다.
Description (ko, y): 이빨은 다시는 나지 않기 때문에 싸움이 끝나면 강가에 있는 바위를 사용해서 정성껏 손질한다.
Description (ko, sword): 어금니는 부러지면 다시 나지 않는다. 싸움이 끝나면 강가에 있는 바위로 정성껏 손질한다.
Description (en, sword): After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.
Description (ko, shield): 갑옷처럼 딱딱한 피부를 가졌다. 몸통박치기와 동시에 어금니로 찌르는 전법이 특기다.
Description (en, shield): Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Haxorus — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Haxorus
ID: 612
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 액스라이즈
Name (en): Haxorus
Description (en, black): They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
Description (en, white): Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.
Description (en, black-2): Its tusks are incredibly destructive. They can easily slice through a thick, sturdy steel column every time.
Description (ko, x): 상냥한 성격이지만 영역을 어지럽히는 자는 용서하지 않는다. 철을 자르는 이빨로 덤벼든다.
Description (ko, y): 철골을 두 동강 내도 상처 하나 안 나는 튼튼한 이빨을 가지고 있다. 단단한 갑옷에 덮여 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 튼튼하고 큰 어금니가 특징이다. 강도를 유지하기 위해 흙을 핥아서 미네랄을 보충한다.
Description (en, sword): Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.
Description (ko, shield): 온화한 성격이지만 화가 나면 무섭다. 철골도 베어 가르는 튼튼한 어금니를 보여 줄 것이다.
Description (en, shield): While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cubchoo — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cubchoo
ID: 613
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 코고미
Name (en): Cubchoo
Description (en, black): When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
Description (en, white): Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
Description (en, black-2): Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.
Description (ko, x): 언제나 콧물을 달고 다닌다. 콧물을 훌쩍거려 기술을 사용한다. 콧물이 기술의 재료인 셈이다.
Description (ko, y): 콧물은 건강의 척도다. 상태가 좋으면 점성이 높아지고 얼음 기술의 위력도 증가한다.
Description (ko, sword): 컨디션이 좋으면 콧물의 점성이 더해진다. 싫어하는 상대에게는 콧물을 슥 문지른다.
Description (en, sword): When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn’t like.
Description (ko, shield): 기술을 사용하기 전에 코를 훌쩍인다. 콧물에 포함된 강한 냉기가 얼음 기술의 근원이다.
Description (en, shield): It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Beartic — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Beartic
ID: 614
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 툰베어
Name (en): Beartic
Description (en, black): It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
Description (en, white): It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
Description (en, black-2): They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
Description (ko, x): 북쪽의 차가운 바다를 좋아한다. 입에서 내뿜는 숨을 얼려 바다 위에 길을 만들어 걷는다.
Description (ko, y): 내뱉는 숨을 얼려 얼음 이빨이나 손톱을 만들어서 싸운다. 추운 북쪽 땅에서 산다.
Description (ko, sword): 숨결을 얼려서 만든 송곳니는 강철보다도 단단하다. 먹이를 찾아 추운 바다를 헤엄쳐 다닌다.
Description (en, sword): It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.
Description (ko, shield): 차가운 바다에서 씩씩하게 헤엄친다. 지치면 한숨을 내쉬어 바다를 얼린 뒤 그 위에서 쉰다.
Description (en, shield): It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cryogonal — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cryogonal
ID: 615
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 프리지오
Name (en): Cryogonal
Description (en, black): When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
Description (en, white): They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
Description (en, black-2): They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.
Description (ko, x): 눈구름 속에서 태어났다. 얼음 결정으로 만들어진 사슬로 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (ko, y): 얼음 결정으로 만들어진 사슬로 먹이를 휘감아 잡고 마이너스 100도로 얼린다.
Description (en, y): They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, sword): 얼음으로 만든 사슬을 조종하여 만나는 상대를 얼린 후 어딘가로 데려간다.
Description (en, sword): With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those it encounters. It then takes its victims away to somewhere unknown.
Description (ko, shield): 뜨거워지면 수증기로 변한다. 여름철에 모습을 볼 일은 거의 없다.
Description (en, shield): When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Shelmet — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Shelmet
ID: 616
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 쪼마리
Name (en): Shelmet
Description (en, black): When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
Description (en, white): It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.
Description (en, black-2): When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
Description (ko, x): 딱정곤과 함께 있을 때 전기적인 자극을 받으면 서로의 몸이 진화한다.
Description (ko, y): 딱정곤과 함께 전기적인 에너지를 받으면 진화한다. 그 이유는 알려지지 않았다.
Description (ko, sword): 상대에게 공격받으면 껍질의 뚜껑을 꽉 닫아서 몸을 지킨다. 단, 딱정곤에게는 열리고 만다.
Description (en, sword): When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.
Description (ko, shield): 전기 에너지에 반응하는 신비한 체질을 지녔다. 딱정곤과 함께 있으면 무슨 이유인지 진화한다.
Description (en, shield): It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Accelgor — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Accelgor
ID: 617
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 어지리더
Name (en): Accelgor
Description (en, black): When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
Description (en, white): Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
Description (en, black-2): When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.
Description (ko, x): 무거운 껍데기를 벗었기 때문에 몸이 가벼워졌다. 마치 닌자 같은 몸놀림으로 싸운다.
Description (ko, y): 몸이 마르면 약해진다. 얇은 막을 몇 겹이나 두르고 건조해지는 것을 막고 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 재빠른 움직임으로 독을 날려서 싸운다. 어지리더가 주인공인 영화나 만화는 인기가 많다.
Description (en, sword): It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.
Description (ko, shield): 껍질을 벗어 몸이 가벼워졌다. 띠 형태의 점막을 몸에 둘러 건조해지는 것을 방지한다.
Description (en, shield): Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Stunfisk — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Stunfisk
ID: 618
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메더
Name (en): Stunfisk
Description (en, black): Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
Description (en, white): It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
Description (en, black-2): When its opponent can’t be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.
Description (ko, x): 피부가 단단해서 씨름꾼에게 밟혀도 아무렇지 않다. 전기를 흘려보낼 때 웃는 얼굴이 된다.
Description (ko, y): 바닷가 펄 속에 묻혀 먹이를 기다린다. 먹이가 몸에 닿으면 전기를 써서 마비시킨다.
Description (ko, sword): 갯벌이 보금자리다. 진흙 속에 사는 세균에 의해 전기를 만드는 기관이 발달했다.
Description (en, sword): Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.
Description (ko, shield): 몸의 노란 무늬에서 강한 전기를 발산할 때 무슨 이유인지 살짝 웃고 있다.
Description (en, shield): For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mienfoo — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mienfoo
ID: 619
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비조푸
Name (en): Mienfoo
Description (en, black): In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
Description (en, white): They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.
Description (en, black-2): It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
Description (ko, x): 기술을 내보내는 스피드가 자랑이다. 설령 파워는 낮더라도 많은 공격 횟수로 커버한다.
Description (ko, y): 물 흐르는 듯한 연속 공격을 펼쳐서 상대를 압도한다. 날카로운 손톱으로 상대를 베어 가른다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 아침에 느릿느릿 움직이며 여러 포즈를 취하는 무리의 모습을 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 산속에 들어가 무리의 동료와 수행에 힘쓴다. 무리에 따라 킥이나 촙의 방식이 다르다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.
Description (ko, sword): 잘 단련된 비조푸는 1분에 100회 이상 촙 공격을 할 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.
Description (ko, shield): 작아도 기질은 거칠다. 방심하고 다가간 상대에게 화려한 연타를 먹인다.
Description (en, shield): Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mienshao — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mienshao
ID: 620
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비조도
Name (en): Mienshao
Description (en, black): It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
Description (en, white): They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
Description (en, black-2): Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
Description (ko, x): 팔에 있는 털을 채찍처럼 다룬다. 양팔로 펼치는 공격은 눈에 보이지 않을 만큼 빠르다.
Description (ko, y): 양손의 털을 채찍처럼 능숙하게 다뤄 연속 공격을 시작하면 아무도 멈출 수 없다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 연속 공격으로 상대를 압도한다. 마무리는 느긋하게 힘을 모아 일격을 가한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 기묘한 소리로 짖는다면 위험하다. 눈에 보이지도 않는 킥과 촙의 연속 공격이 시작된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you’re in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!
Description (ko, sword): 진정한 강적과 만나면 몸을 가볍게 하기 위해 양손의 털을 물어뜯어 버린다.
Description (en, sword): When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.
Description (ko, shield): 눈에 보이지 않을 정도의 스피드로 구사하는 발차기는 거대한 바위도 산산이 조각낸다.
Description (en, shield): Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Druddigon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Druddigon
ID: 621
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 크리만
Name (en): Druddigon
Description (en, black): It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
Description (en, white): It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
Description (en, black-2): It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.
Description (ko, x): 좁은 동굴을 뛰어다니며 날카로운 손톱으로 먹이를 잡는다. 얼굴 피부는 바위보다 단단하다.
Description (ko, y): 날개로 햇빛을 받아 몸을 따뜻하게 한다. 체온이 내려가면 움직일 수 없게 된다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빨간 얼굴의 피부는 바위보다 딱딱하다. 좁은 동굴 안에서 적을 향해 얼굴로 돌격한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 디그다나 닥트리오가 판 터널에 침입한다. 먹이가 지나가기를 조용히 기다리고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.
Description (ko, sword): 토굴에 산다. 몸이 차가워지면 움직이지 못하기 때문에 일광욕을 거르지 않는다.
Description (en, sword): Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.
Description (ko, shield): 난폭하고 교활하다. 다른 포켓몬이 파낸 굴을 빼앗아 거처로 삼는다.
Description (en, shield): Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Golett — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Golett
ID: 622
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 골비람
Name (en): Golett
Description (en, black): The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
Description (en, white): These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.
Description (en, black-2): Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
Description (ko, x): 체내에서 불타는 에너지로 인해 활동하고 있지만 어떤 에너지인지는 불명이다.
Description (ko, y): 고대 과학의 힘으로 점토에서 만들어진 포켓몬. 수천 년 동안 계속 움직일 수 있다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 수수께끼의 에너지로 활동한다. 고대부터 계속 움직였기 때문에 슬슬 파워가 다할 때가 됐을지도 모른다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 고대인이 부하로 삼기 위해 점토를 빚어서 만들었다고 하나 에너지원은 불명확하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.
Description (ko, sword): 점토에서 만들어진 고대의 포켓몬. 어째선지 큰 바위를 늘어놓기만 하는 녀석도 있다.
Description (en, sword): They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
Description (ko, shield): 점토로 만들어진 포켓몬이다. 수천 년 전 주인의 명령을 지금도 따르고 있다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Golurk — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Golurk
ID: 623
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 골루그
Name (en): Golurk
Description (en, black): It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
Description (en, white): It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
Description (en, black-2): Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
Description (ko, x): 골루그를 만든 고대인에게 사람과 포켓몬을 지키도록 명령받았다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, y): 마하의 스피드로 하늘을 난다. 가슴의 봉인을 떼어내면 에너지가 폭주해 버린다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 고대인이 노동력으로 활용하기 위해 골루그를 발명했다고 전해진다. 주인의 명령에 충실하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master’s orders faithfully.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 가슴에 있는 봉인이 풀리면 무작정 날뛰고 다니면서 마을을 벽돌 더미로 만들어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.
Description (ko, sword): 고대인의 성벽에는 골루그가 빔을 쏘기 위한 포대와 같은 대좌가 있다.
Description (en, sword): Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
Description (ko, shield): 체내에 에너지를 생성하는 영구 기관이 있다고 하지만 아직도 밝혀지지 않았다.
Description (en, shield): There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

Name: Golurk
ID: 623
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 골루그
Name (en): Golurk
Description (en, black): It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
Description (en, white): It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
Description (en, black-2): Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
Description (ko, x): 골루그를 만든 고대인에게 사람과 포켓몬을 지키도록 명령받았다고 전해진다.

Description (en, ultra-sun): Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master’s orders faithfully.

document.title: Pawniard — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pawniard
ID: 624
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 자망칼
Name (en): Pawniard
Description (en, black): Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
Description (en, white): They fight at Bisharp’s command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.
Description (en, black-2): Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
Description (ko, x): 전신이 칼날인 포켓몬이다. 싸움에서 칼의 이가 빠지면 강가의 돌로 칼을 간다.
Description (ko, y): 자신이 상처 입어도 신경 쓰지 않고 집단으로 전신의 칼날을 박아서 상대를 공격한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹이를 베어 가른 후에는 기와 돌로 칼날을 간다. 자망칼마다 좋아하는 돌이 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 절각참의 명령에 따라 적을 공격한다. 상대를 베어 가르면 양손의 칼날을 부딪친다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It follows Bisharp’s orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.
Description (ko, sword): 예리한 칼날을 다루어 상대를 몰아넣는다. 강가에 있는 돌로 몸에 있는 칼날을 손질한다.
Description (en, sword): It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.
Description (ko, shield): 절각참을 보스로 둔 무리를 만든다. 무리를 이끄는 날을 꿈꾸며 날마다 단련을 계속한다.
Description (en, shield): A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

document.title: Bisharp — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bisharp
ID: 625
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 절각참
Name (en): Bisharp
Description (en, black): It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
Description (en, white): Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
Description (en, black-2): This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
Description (ko, x): 몇 마리의 자망칼과 싸우게 해서 상처 입고 움직일 수 없게 된 먹이를 두 동강 내버리는 무서운 포켓몬.
Description (ko, y): 많은 자망칼을 거느리며 무리를 지어 먹이를 바싹 몰아넣는다. 마무리는 절각참이 한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 아무리 강한 절각참이라도 머리의 칼날의 이가 빠지면 보스의 자리를 은퇴한다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): No matter how strong the Bisharp, it’s said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 자망칼의 무리를 거느리고 있다. 상대를 마무리할 때도 전혀 표정을 바꾸지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn’t even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.
Description (ko, sword): 많은 수의 자망칼을 거느리고 있다. 부하들이 배신하지 못하도록 항상 눈에 불을 켜고 있다.
Description (en, sword): It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.
Description (ko, shield): 칼날을 가는 돌의 장소를 두고 액슨도와 격렬하게 싸움을 벌인다.
Description (en, shield): Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Bouffalant — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bouffalant
ID: 626
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 버프론
Name (en): Bouffalant
Description (en, black): Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
Description (en, white): They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
Description (en, black-2): They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.
Description (ko, x): 무작정 돌진하여 박치기를 한다. 달리고 있는 열차를 탈선시킬 정도의 파괴력이다.
Description (ko, y): 세찬 박치기를 당해도 탐스러운 털이 데미지를 흡수해 준다.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 세차게 박치기를 해도 탐스러운 털이 데미지를 흡수해 준다.
Description (ko, sword): 박치기만으로 자동차를 부순다. 머리의 털이 풍성할수록 무리에서 지위가 올라간다.
Description (en, sword): These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.
Description (ko, shield): 20마리 정도가 무리 지어 산다. 무리를 배신한 버프론은 어째서인지 머리털이 빠진다.
Description (en, shield): These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

document.title: Rufflet — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Rufflet
ID: 627
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 수리둥보
Name (en): Rufflet
Description (en, black): They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
Description (en, white): They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
Description (en, black-2): It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.
Description (ko, x): 다리 힘으로 나무열매를 으깬다. 아무리 강한 상대라도 용감히 맞서는 습성이 있다.
Description (ko, y): 강한 상대에게도 무작정 싸움을 건다. 싸움을 계속 반복하며 강해진다.
Description (ko, sun): 무작정 싸움을 건다. 쓰러질 때마다 다칠 때마다 강하고 늠름하게 성장해간다.
Description (en, sun): They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.
Description (ko, moon): 뾰족한 발톱을 사냥감에게 꽂고 쪼아 먹는다. 나무열매도 먹지만 기본적으로 육식 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 강한 다릿심과 튼튼한 발톱으로 딱딱한 셀러의 껍질도 부수고 안에 있는 내용물을 쪼아 먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 타고난 전사라고 불린다. 태어나자마자 부모에게 도전하여 인정을 받아야 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.
Description (ko, sword): 강해 보이는 포켓몬을 발견하면 싸움을 걸지 않고는 못 배긴다. 지면 큰 소리로 울어댄다.
Description (en, sword): If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.
Description (ko, shield): 딱딱한 나무열매도 산산조각 내는 악력을 가졌다. 쉽게 다투고 아무에게나 승부를 건다.
Description (en, shield): A combative Pokémon, it’s ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

document.title: Braviary — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Braviary
ID: 628
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 워글
Name (en): Braviary
Description (en, black): They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
Description (en, white): The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
Description (en, black-2): For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
Description (ko, x): 동료를 위해서라면 아무리 상처를 입더라도 싸움을 관두지 않는 용감한 넓은 하늘의 전사.
Description (ko, y): 동료를 위해 위험을 무릅쓰고 싸운다. 자동차를 붙잡은 채로 넓은 하늘을 날 수 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 죽음조차 두려워하지 않는 용감한 기질이다. 먼 옛날에 알로라 사람들은 하늘의 용자라고 부르며 존경했다.
Description (en, sun): With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as “the hero of the sky.”
Description (ko, moon): 사는 곳을 사람에게 위협받은 과거가 있어 워글들은 한마음이 되어 저항했다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): It’s thought that people disturbed their habitats in the past, so Braviary banded together to fight back.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 안면에 상처가 많을수록 용감하다고 평가받고 뒤에 상처가 많으면 무리에서 무시당한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it’s considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 하늘의 용자라는 별명을 가졌다. 상처를 입어도 도망치지 않는 긍지 높고 용맹한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Known as “the hero of the skies,” this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it’s injured.
Description (ko, sword): 용맹하고 긍지 높은 포켓몬. 그 용감한 모습 때문에 엠블럼의 모티브로 인기가 많다.
Description (en, sword): Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.
Description (ko, shield): 혈기왕성하고 거칠어서 가라르의 배달부 자리는 아머까오에게 뺏겼다.
Description (en, shield): Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it’s Corviknight that’s taken the role of transportation in Galar.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Vullaby — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Vullaby
ID: 629
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 벌차이
Name (en): Vullaby
Description (en, black): Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
Description (en, white): They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
Description (en, black-2): Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
Description (ko, x): 날개가 작아서 날지 못한다. 진화가 가까워지면 자기 스스로 해골을 벗어버린다.
Description (ko, y): 날개는 작아서 아직 날 수 없다. 버랜지나가 모아온 해골로 엉덩이를 지키고 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 포동포동한 엉덩이를 지키는 것은 먹어버린 먹이의 뼈다. 성장할 때마다 갈아입는다.
Description (en, sun): It protects its plump posterior with the bones of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it replaces the bones.
Description (ko, moon): 아직 한창 놀 때이다. 날개가 다 자라지 않아 날지 못하기 때문에 깡충깡충 뛰어다닌다.
Description (en, moon): It can’t fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it’s still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 해골은 버랜지나가 준다. 날개가 짧아 아직 날지 못하지만, 넓은 하늘을 꿈꾸며 뛰어오른다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Mandibuzz gives it the bones it wears. Vullaby’s wings are short, so it can’t fly yet, but it jumps around, dreaming of wide open skies.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 한창 먹고 자랄 때다. 몸의 성장에 맞춰서 해골을 몇 번이고 갈아입는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
Description (ko, sword): 해골을 입어서 엉덩이를 보호한다. 착용감이 편안한 해골을 두고 동료끼리 옥신각신한다.
Description (en, sword): It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.
Description (ko, shield): 금방 크게 성장하므로 엉덩이의 해골은 둥지 안에서 대물림되어 계속 사용된다.
Description (en, shield): Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

document.title: Mandibuzz — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mandibuzz
ID: 630
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 버랜지나
Name (en): Mandibuzz
Description (en, black): It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
Description (en, white): Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
Description (en, black-2): They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
Description (ko, x): 넓은 하늘에서 원을 그리며 날고 먹이를 발견하면 덮쳐서 둥지까지 가뿐히 나른다.
Description (ko, y): 하늘에서 지상을 관찰하다 쇠약해진 먹이를 덮친다. 뼈로 몸치장하는 습성이 있다.
Description (ko, sun): 뼈로 예쁘게 치장하는 것은 수컷에게 어필하기 위한 것이라고 전해지지만 버랜지나의 수컷은 발견되지 않았다.
Description (en, sun): They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.
Description (ko, moon): 넓은 하늘을 선회하며 약해진 포켓몬을 노리고 있다. 가장 좋아하는 것은 탕구리.
Description (en, moon): It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹은 먹이의 뼈를 사용해 솜씨 좋게 둥지를 만든다. 대부분의 뼈는 탕구리의 것이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 벌차이를 위해 언제나 먹이를 찾고 있다. 약해진 포켓몬을 발견하는 대로 둥지로 데려간다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.
Description (ko, sword): 성질이 난폭하지만 미아가 된 벌차이를 발견하면 둥지를 떠날 때까지 정성껏 돌봐준다.
Description (en, sword): Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they’re ready to leave the nest.
Description (ko, shield): 주운 뼈로 몸을 장식한다. 몸에 두르는 뼈의 모양은 유행이 있는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

document.title: Heatmor — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Heatmor
ID: 631
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 앤티골
Name (en): Heatmor
Description (en, black): It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
Description (en, white): Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
Description (en, black-2): It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
Description (ko, x): 뜨겁게 타오르는 불꽃의 혀로 아이앤트의 강철 몸을 녹여서 알맹이를 먹어치운다.
Description (ko, y): 꼬리에서 빨아들인 공기를 불꽃으로 바꿔 혀처럼 사용해 아이앤트를 녹여서 먹는다.
Description (ko, sword): 꼬리의 구멍을 통해 공기를 빨아들여 불꽃을 태운다. 구멍이 막히면 상태가 나빠진다.
Description (en, sword): There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
Description (ko, shield): 불꽃을 혀처럼 사용한다. 아이앤트의 단단한 외골격을 조금씩 녹여 먹어 치운다.
Description (en, shield): A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Durant — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Durant
ID: 632
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 아이앤트
Name (en): Durant
Description (en, black): They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
Description (en, white): Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.
Description (en, black-2): Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
Description (ko, x): 천적인 앤티골에 대해서 모두와 역할 분담을 하면서 반격해 둥지에서 쫓아낸다.
Description (ko, y): 강철의 갑옷을 몸에 걸친다. 천적인 앤티골의 공격을 집단으로 막아 반격한다.
Description (ko, sword): 굴속 깊은 곳에 알을 낳는다. 앤티골에게 공격받으면 커다란 턱으로 물어서 반격한다.
Description (en, sword): They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.
Description (ko, shield): 큰 턱은 암석도 깨물어 부순다. 사다이사로부터 알을 지키기 위해 무리 지어 싸운다.
Description (en, shield): With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Deino — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Deino
ID: 633
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모노두
Name (en): Deino
Description (en, black): It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
Description (en, white): They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
Description (en, black-2): Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
Description (ko, x): 눈이 보이지 않아서 몸통박치기나 물기로 주변을 살핀다. 몸에 상처가 끊이지 않는다.
Description (ko, y): 주변의 모습을 모르기 때문에 닥치는 대로 부딪쳐서는 움직이는 것을 물어 먹어치운다.
Description (ko, sword): 무엇이든 일단 물고 보는 습성을 가졌다. 맛있었던 것은 냄새를 확실히 기억한다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.
Description (ko, shield): 눈이 보이지 않아 닥치는 대로 물면서 본인 주위의 상황을 파악한다.
Description (en, shield): Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Zweilous — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Zweilous
ID: 634
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 디헤드
Name (en): Zweilous
Description (en, black): After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
Description (en, white): Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.
Description (en, black-2): The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
Description (ko, x): 2개의 머리는 사이가 나빠서 상대보다 많이 먹는 것으로 주도권을 잡으려고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 영역 안의 먹이를 다 먹어치우면 다른 지역으로 이동한다. 두 머리는 사이가 나쁘다.
Description (ko, sword): 영역을 돌아다니며 먹이를 찾는다. 2개의 머리는 어느 쪽으로 갈지로 자주 다툰다.
Description (en, sword): While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.
Description (ko, shield): 1개의 먹이를 2개의 머리가 서로 뺏는다. 누구랑 싸운 것도 아닌데 언제나 상처투성이다.
Description (en, shield): Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Hydreigon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hydreigon
ID: 635
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 삼삼드래
Name (en): Hydreigon
Description (en, black): This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
Description (en, white): The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
Description (en, black-2): It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
Description (ko, x): 양팔에 있는 머리에는 뇌가 없다. 3개의 머리로 모든 것을 먹어치워 파괴해 버린다.
Description (ko, y): 움직이는 것에 반응하여 덮쳐서 3개의 머리로 먹어치우는 무시무시한 포켓몬.
Description (ko, sword): 움직이는 모든 것을 먹어 치운다. 삼삼드래에게 마을이 파괴되었다는 이야기는 많이 전해 내려온다.
Description (en, sword): There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.
Description (ko, shield): 3개의 머리로 번갈아 가며 물어뜯는다. 상대가 쓰러질 때까지 공격을 멈추지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Larvesta — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Larvesta
ID: 636
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 활화르바
Name (en): Larvesta
Description (en, black): This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
Description (en, white): The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
Description (en, black-2): Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
Description (ko, x): 태양에서 태어났다고 전해진다. 진화할 때 뿔에서 뿜어져 나온 불꽃으로 전신을 감싼다.
Description (ko, y): 화산 기슭에 서식한다. 5개의 뿔에서 불꽃이 나와 달려드는 상대를 격퇴한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 5개의 뿔에서 불꽃을 뿜어내 상대와 싸운다. 그 온도는 최대 3000도에 달한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 불꽃을 사용해서 몸을 지킨다. 옛날 사람들은 태양에 활화르바의 둥지가 있다고 믿고 있었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
Description (ko, sword): 먼 옛날 사람들은 활화르바가 태양에서 떨어진 것이라고 믿었다.
Description (en, sword): The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.
Description (ko, shield): 전신이 제법 따뜻하다. 뿔 끝에서 불꽃을 뿜어 천적이나 먹이를 위협한다.
Description (en, shield): Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Volcarona — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Volcarona
ID: 637
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 불카모스
Name (en): Volcarona
Description (en, black): When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
Description (en, white): A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
Description (en, black-2): Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.
Description (ko, x): 싸울 때는 6개의 날개에서 불꽃 가루를 흩뿌려서 주변 일대를 불바다로 만든다.
Description (ko, y): 화산재로 지상이 캄캄하게 되었을 때 불카모스의 불꽃이 태양을 대신했다고 한다.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 불꽃의 인분을 흩뿌리며 날아다닌다. 고대 사람들은 태양의 분노라고 부르며 두려워했다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 타오르는 불꽃의 고치에서 태어나 추위에 괴로워하는 사람이나 포켓몬을 구했다는 전설이 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
Description (ko, sword): 불꽃의 인분을 흩뿌려 화재를 일으킴으로써 추위에 고통받는 자들을 돕는다고도 한다.
Description (en, sword): Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.
Description (ko, shield): 활활 타오르는 불의 고치에서 태어났다. 고대의 벽화에 불꽃의 신으로 그려져 있다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cobalion — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cobalion
ID: 638
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 코바르온
Name (en): Cobalion
Description (en, black): This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
Description (en, white): It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
Description (en, black-2): It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
Description (ko, x): 강철의 몸과 마음을 지녔다. 째려보기만 해도 난폭한 포켓몬마저도 따르게 된다.
Description (ko, y): 강철의 마음과 몸을 지녔다. 사람이 포켓몬을 상처 입혔을 때 동료와 함께 사람을 벌했다.
Description (ko, sword): 테라키온 비리디온과 함께 하나지방의 포켓몬을 지키기 위해 인간에 맞서 싸웠다는 전설이 있다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 태어나면서부터 리더의 품격을 몸에 지녔다. 흉포한 상대도 코바르온의 앞에서는 온순하다.
Description (en, shield): From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Terrakion — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Terrakion
ID: 639
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 테라키온
Name (en): Terrakion
Description (en, black): This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
Description (en, white): Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
Description (en, black-2): Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.
Description (ko, x): 거대한 성벽을 일격에 돌파할 만한 돌진력을 가졌다. 전설로 전해지는 포켓몬이다.
Description (ko, y): 전설로 전해지는 포켓몬. 포켓몬을 지키기 위해 자랑스러운 파워로 성을 부쉈다.
Description (ko, sword): 차원이 다른 파워의 소유자. 작은 포켓몬을 괴롭히는 상대는 철저히 때려눕힌다.
Description (en, sword): It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 포켓몬을 지키기 위해 사람에게 승부를 걸었다는 전설이 하나지방에 남아 있다.
Description (en, shield): In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Virizion — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Virizion
ID: 640
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비리디온
Name (en): Virizion
Description (en, black): This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
Description (en, white): Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
Description (en, black-2): Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
Description (ko, x): 머리의 뿔은 날카로운 칼날이다. 회오리바람과 같은 움직임으로 상대를 농락하여 재빠르게 벤다.
Description (ko, y): 재빠른 몸놀림으로 상대를 농락해 포켓몬을 지킨다고 전설로 전해져 온다.
Description (ko, sword): 코바르온 테라키온과 함께 하나지방의 포켓몬들을 수호했다는 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, sword): A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.
Description (ko, shield): 회오리바람처럼 재빠른 몸동작으로 적을 농락하고 예리한 뿔로 가차 없이 베어버린다.
Description (en, shield): It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tornadus — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tornadus
ID: 641
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 토네로스
Name (en): Tornadus
Description (en, black): The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
Description (en, white): Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
Description (en, black-2): In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.
Description (ko, x): 구름처럼 생긴 에너지체에 하반신이 둘러싸여 있다. 시속 300km로 하늘을 난다.
Description (ko, y): 토네로스의 꼬리에서 뿜어져 나온 에너지가 큰 폭풍을 일으킨다. 민가를 날려버릴 정도의 힘이다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

document.title: Thundurus — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Thundurus
ID: 642

Name (ko): 볼트로스

document.body:

Name: Kyurem
ID: 646
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 큐레무
Name (en): Kyurem
Description (en, black): It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
Description (en, white): It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.
Description (en, black-2): This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
Description (ko, x): 잃어버린 몸을 진실과 이상으로 채워줄 영웅을 기다리는 얼음의 전설 포켓몬.
Description (ko, y): 강력한 냉동 에너지를 체내에서 만들어 내지만 새어 나온 냉기에 몸이 얼어 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 레시라무와 제크로무를 능가할 정도의 힘을 가졌으나 극저온의 냉기에 봉인되어 있다.
Description (en, sword): Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.
Description (ko, shield): 세포 조직을 안정시키기 위해 자신이 발생시킨 냉기로 몸을 얼어붙게 한 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Keldeo
ID: 647
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 케르디오
Name (en): Keldeo
Description (en, black): By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
Description (en, white): It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
Description (en, black-2): When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
Description (ko, x): 바다나 강 등의 수면을 달려 세계 곳곳을 뛰어다닌다. 아름다운 물가에 나타난다.
Description (ko, y): 각오를 굳히는 것으로 전신에 힘이 넘쳐흘러 재빨라지며 뛰어오르면 잔상이 보인다.
Description (ko, sword): 코바르온 테라키온 비리디온으로부터 싸움을 배웠다. 세계를 돌아다니며 수행을 거듭하고 있다.
Description (en, sword): Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.
Description (ko, shield): 혹독한 싸움을 이겨내고 이마의 뿔이 단련되면 진정한 힘이 각성한다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Fennekin
ID: 653
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 푸호꼬
Name (en): Fennekin
Description (ko, x): 잔가지를 먹으면 힘이 나서 섭씨 200도가 넘는 열기를 커다란 귀에서 내뿜는다.
Description (en, x): Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, y): 작은 나뭇가지를 들고 다니며 간식 대신 아작아작 먹는다. 귀에서 열기를 뿜어내어 상대를 위협한다.
Description (en, y): As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

Name: Braixen
ID: 654
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 테르나
Name (en): Braixen
Description (ko, x): 나뭇가지를 꼬리에 꽂고 있다. 꼬리털의 마찰열로 가지에 불을 붙여 싸운다.
Description (en, x): It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
Description (ko, y): 나뭇가지를 꼬리에서 뽑을 때 마찰로 불이 붙는다. 나뭇가지의 불꽃을 흔들어 동료에게 신호를 보낸다.
Description (en, y): When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

ID: 656
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 개구마르
Name (en): Froakie
Description (ko, x): 가슴과 등에서 거품을 내뿜는다. 탄력 있는 거품으로 공격을 막아내고 데미지를 줄인다.
Description (en, x): It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

Name: Frogadier
ID: 657
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 개굴반장
Name (en): Frogadier
Description (ko, x): 거품으로 싸인 돌멩이를 던지는 기술을 쓴다. 30m 앞에 있는 빈 캔을 맞출 정도로 컨트롤이 좋다.
Description (en, x): It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
Description (ko, y): 누구보다도 가벼운 몸을 갖고 있다. 600m를 넘는 타워의 꼭대기까지 1분이면 올라간다.
Description (en, y): Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 거품으로 싸인 돌멩이를 던지는 기술을 쓴다. 30m 앞에 있는 빈 캔을 맞힐 정도로 컨트롤이 좋다.

document.body:

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 개굴닌자
Name (en): Greninja
Description (ko, x): 물을 압축시켜 수리검을 만들어 낸다. 고속으로 회전시키며 던지면 금속도 두 동강이 난다.
Description (en, x): It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

Description (en, y): It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

document.title: Bunnelby — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bunnelby
ID: 659
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파르빗
Name (en): Bunnelby
Description (ko, x): 커다란 귀로 땅을 파고 보금자리를 만든다. 하룻밤 동안 쉬지 않고 계속 팔 수 있다.
Description (en, x): They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
Description (ko, y): 삽과 같은 귀를 가졌다. 구멍을 파는 데 단련된 귀는 두꺼운 뿌리를 자를 정도의 위력이다.
Description (en, y): It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
Description (ko, sword): 귀로 구멍을 파는 것이 특기다. 지하 10m에 달하는 굴을 하룻밤 만에 만들어버린다.
Description (en, sword): It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
Description (ko, shield): 위험에 민감하다. 아머까오의 날갯소리를 들으면 눈 깜짝할 사이에 구멍을 파고 땅으로 숨어든다.
Description (en, shield): It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Diggersby — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Diggersby
ID: 660
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파르토
Name (en): Diggersby
Description (ko, x): 커다란 귀에는 무게가 1톤을 넘는 바위를 가뿐히 들어 올릴 만한 파워가 있다. 공사 현장에서 대활약한다.
Description (en, x): With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
Description (ko, y): 굴착기에 버금가는 파워의 귀로 단단한 암반도 산산조각 낸다. 구멍을 다 파면 빈둥빈둥 지낸다.
Description (en, y): As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it’s finished digging, it lounges lazily.
Description (ko, sword): 굴착기에 뒤지지 않는 파워로 단단한 암반도 파고 들어간다. 터널 공사에서 크게 활약한다.
Description (en, sword): With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It’s a huge help during tunnel construction.
Description (ko, shield): 배의 털은 보온성이 뛰어나다. 옛날 사람들은 파르토의 몸에서 빠진 털로 방한복을 만들었다.
Description (en, shield): The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Fletchling — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Fletchling
ID: 661
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 화살꼬빈
Name (en): Fletchling
Description (ko, x): 사람을 잘 따르는 성격이다. 아름다운 지저귐과 꽁지를 흔드는 움직임으로 동료에게 신호를 보낸다.
Description (en, x): These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
Description (ko, y): 지저귀는 소리는 아름답지만 영역에 들어온 상대를 용서하지 않는 난폭한 성격이다.
Description (en, y): Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.
Description (ko, sun): 사람을 잘 따라서 다루기 쉬운 포켓몬이지만 한번 싸움이 붙으면 매우 거칠어진다.
Description (en, sun): This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.
Description (ko, moon): 흥분하면 체온이 2배까지 올라 체내의 호르몬이 활발해진다.
Description (en, moon): When it’s excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 사람을 잘 따르는 포켓몬이지만, 억지로 만지면 몸을 단숨에 발열시켜 화상을 입는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While it’s an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you’ll be burned.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 몸은 언제나 따뜻하다. 추운 지역의 트레이너는 침대에서 함께 잔다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.
Description (ko, sword): 아름답게 지저귀는 소리는 위협하고 있다는 뜻이다. 영역에 들어온 자는 용서 없이 콕콕 쪼아버린다.
Description (en, sword): Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.
Description (ko, shield): 흥분하면 체온이 확 오른다. 맨손으로 만지면 화상을 입기도 할 정도다.
Description (en, shield): When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Fletchinder — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Fletchinder
ID: 662
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 불화살빈
Name (en): Fletchinder
Description (ko, x): 부리에서 불꽃을 뿜어 풀숲을 태우고 놀라서 뛰쳐나온 사냥감을 잡는다.
Description (en, x): From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
Description (ko, y): 배에 있는 불꽃 주머니의 화력이 강해질수록 빨리 날 수 있지만 점화할 때까지 시간이 걸린다.
Description (en, y): The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
Description (ko, sun): 부리로부터 불꽃을 날려 먹이에 맞힌다. 잡은 먹이는 구운 다음 먹는다.
Description (en, sun): From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.
Description (ko, moon): 반경 수 km의 영역을 차지하고 있어 다른 불화살빈이 들어오는 것을 용서하지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): It will not tolerate other Fletchinder entering its territory, which has a radius of several miles.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 풀숲에 불꽃을 흩뿌린다. 불꽃에 놀라 뛰쳐나온 벌레포켓몬을 덥석 먹어 치운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 날기 시작한 직후의 스피드는 모든 새포켓몬 중에서도 톱클래스 수준이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 굴 속에 불똥을 쏜 다음 놀라서 빠져나온 먹이를 날카로운 발톱으로 잡는다.
Description (en, sword): Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.
Description (ko, shield): 영역에 대한 개념이 매우 강하고 호전적이다. 먹이 먹는 장소를 두고 불화살빈끼리 싸운다.
Description (en, shield): Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Talonflame — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Talonflame
ID: 663
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파이어로
Name (en): Talonflame
Description (ko, x): 격렬한 싸움으로 흥분하게 되면 온몸의 깃털 사이에서 불꽃을 뿜어내며 비행한다.
Description (en, x): In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
Description (ko, y): 사냥감을 덮칠 때의 스피드는 시속 500km이다. 강렬한 킥으로 꼼짝 못하게 한다.
Description (en, y): When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
Description (ko, sun): 좋아하는 것은 갈모매와 콕코구리다. 강렬한 킥으로 타격을 가하고 날카로운 발톱으로 꽉 잡는다.
Description (en, sun): Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.
Description (ko, moon): 깃털 사이로 불꽃을 뿜어내며 시속 500km로 먹이를 향해 똑바로 날아간다.
Description (en, moon): It zooms directly at its prey at flight speeds of close to 310 mph, while fiery embers scatter from gaps in its feathers.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 날개는 불이 붙지 않고 튼튼하다. 옛날에는 소방관들의 옷을 파이어로의 날개로 만들었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its tough wings don’t allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters’ outfits were made from Talonflame wings.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 새포켓몬이 주된 먹이다. 갑자기 접근한 뒤 강력한 킥으로 땅에 떨어뜨린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.
Description (ko, sword): 새포켓몬이 주요 먹이다. 깃털 사이로 불똥을 뿜어내며 상대를 위협한다.
Description (en, sword): Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.
Description (ko, shield): 시속 500km로 돌격한다. 먹이가 도망칠 틈을 주지 않고 강렬한 발차기로 꼼짝 못 하게 한다.
Description (en, shield): Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.body:

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 분이벌레
Name (en): Scatterbug
Description (ko, x): 새포켓몬에게 습격당하면 검은 가루를 흩뿌린다. 만지면 마비되는 독가루다.
Description (en, x): When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
Description (ko, y): 몸을 덮은 가루가 체온을 조절하고 있어 어떤 기후나 풍토의 지역에서도 살 수 있다.
Description (en, y): The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Spewpa
ID: 665
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 분떠도리
Name (en): Spewpa
Description (ko, x): 수풀의 그늘에 숨어 산다. 적에게 공격당하면 몸의 털을 뾰족하게 곤두세우며 위협한다.
Description (en, x): It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
Description (ko, y): 단단한 몸은 새포켓몬의 부리로도 상처 하나 입지 않는다. 가루를 뿌려서 방어한다.
Description (en, y): The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 비비용
Name (en): Vivillon
Description (ko, x): 세계에는 다양한 무늬의 날개를 가진 비비용이 있다. 살고 있는 곳의 기후에 영향을 받는 것 같다.
Description (en, x): Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
Description (ko, y): 살고 있는 장소의 기후나 풍토에 따라 날개의 모양이 다른 포켓몬이다. 화려한 색의 날개 가루를 뿌린다.
Description (en, y): The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

document.title: Litleo — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Litleo
ID: 667
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 레오꼬
Name (en): Litleo
Description (ko, x): 강한 상대에게 맞설 때일수록 갈기의 온도가 높아지고 전신에 힘이 넘쳐난다.
Description (en, x): The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
Description (ko, y): 강해지기 위해 무리를 벗어나 홀로 생활하게 된다. 혈기 왕성하여 쉽게 싸우려 든다.
Description (en, y): They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 어릴 때는 동료와 무리를 이룬다. 스스로 먹이를 사냥할 수 있게 되면 무리에서 쫓겨나 독립한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When they’re young, they live with a pride. Once they’re able to hunt prey on their own, they’re kicked out and have to make their own way.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 혈기가 왕성하고 호기심도 왕성하다. 화가 나거나 싸움이 시작되면 짧은 갈기가 뜨거워진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Pyroar — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pyroar
ID: 668
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 화염레오
Name (en): Pyroar
Description (ko, x): 무리 중에서 가장 커다란 불꽃 갈기를 지닌 수컷이 리더로서 동료들을 이끈다.
Description (en, x): The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
Description (ko, y): 섭씨 6000도의 숨을 내뿜어 격렬하게 상대를 위협한다. 암컷이 무리의 새끼를 지킨다.
Description (en, y): With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride’s cubs.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 수컷은 평소에 빈둥거리지만, 강적이 덤벼들면 자신을 돌보지 않고 동료를 지킨다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 섭씨 6000도의 숨결을 내뱉지만 먹이에는 사용하지 않는다. 고기는 날것을 좋아하기 때문이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

document.title: Flabébé — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Flabébé
ID: 669
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 플라베베
Name (en): Flabébé
Description (ko, x): 꽃의 숨겨진 힘을 끌어내어 자유자재로 조종한다. 플라베베가 지닌 꽃은 이미 몸의 일부다.
Description (en, x): It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
Description (ko, y): 마음에 든 꽃을 발견하면 평생을 그 꽃과 지낸다. 바람을 타고 내키는 대로 떠다닌다.
Description (en, y): When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind’s embrace with an untroubled heart.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 꽃의 힘이 없으면 위험하다. 그래도 좋아하는 색과 형태를 찾을 때까지 여행을 계속한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 머리의 관은 꽃가루를 모아서 만든 것이다. 치유의 효과가 숨겨져 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Floette — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Floette
ID: 670
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 플라엣테
Name (en): Floette
Description (ko, x): 꽃밭을 날아다니며 말라가는 꽃을 보살핀다. 꽃의 숨겨진 힘을 끌어내어 싸운다.
Description (en, x): It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
Description (ko, y): 빈틈없이 손질한 화단의 꽃이 피면 모습을 드러내어 아름다운 댄스로 축복한다.
Description (en, y): When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 꽃을 길러 자신의 무기로 이용한다. 아름답게 핀 꽃일수록 강력한 파워를 간직하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 자신의 파워를 꽃에 주고 진심을 담아 돌본다. 화단을 어지럽히는 자는 용서하지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Florges — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Florges
ID: 671
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 플라제스
Name (en): Florges
Description (ko, x): 멋진 화원이 영역이다. 화초가 내보내는 에너지를 쬐어 자신의 파워로 삼는다.
Description (en, x): It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
Description (ko, y): 옛 성의 주인은 정원을 꾸미기 위해 플라제스를 불러들여 화원을 만들게 했다.
Description (en, y): In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 기른 꽃들을 조종한다. 플라제스가 발산하는 꽃보라는 아름다움도 파워도 압도적이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수백 년의 수명을 가졌다. 정원을 지키는 일에 일생을 바친다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Skiddo
ID: 672
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메이클
Name (en): Skiddo
Description (ko, x): 사람과 살기 시작한 최초의 포켓몬이라고 한다. 온화한 성격의 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, x): Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
Description (ko, y): 물과 태양이 있으면 등에 있는 잎으로 에너지를 만들 수 있어서 먹이를 먹지 않아도 괜찮다.
Description (en, y): If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

document.title: Gogoat — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gogoat
ID: 673
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고고트
Name (en): Gogoat
Description (ko, x): 뿔을 잡을 때 느껴지는 작은 차이로 트레이너의 마음을 읽어낼 수 있기에 하나가 되어 달릴 수 있는 것이다.
Description (en, x): It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
Description (ko, y): 산악 지대에서 생활한다. 뿔을 서로 부딪쳐서 힘을 겨루어 승자가 무리의 리더가 된다.
Description (en, y): They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

document.title: Pancham — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pancham
ID: 674
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 판짱
Name (en): Pancham
Description (ko, x): 적이 얕잡아 보지 못하도록 열심히 노려보지만, 효과가 약하다. 물고 있는 잎사귀가 트레이드마크다.
Description (en, x): It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
Description (ko, y): 무서운 얼굴로 열심히 상대를 노려보지만 머리를 쓰다듬어주면 금방 해죽거린다.
Description (en, y): It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.
Description (ko, sun): 형님처럼 의지하며 따르는 부란다의 행동을 따라 하면서 성장해 간다.
Description (en, sun): It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
Description (ko, moon): 물고 있는 나뭇잎은 특별한 의미 없이 그냥 멋이다. 개구쟁이라 초급 트레이너에게는 적합하지 않다.
Description (en, moon): There’s no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It’s mischievous, so it’s not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 부란다의 뒤를 부하처럼 따라다닌다. 큰 실패를 하면 잎사귀를 빼앗겨 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 상대를 겁먹게 하려고 필사적이다. 열심히 노려 본다면 겁먹은 척을 해 주자.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.
Description (ko, sword): 형님처럼 따르는 부란다를 따라 하면서 싸우는 법과 먹이를 잡는 법을 배운다.
Description (en, sword): It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master’s actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.
Description (ko, shield): 얕잡아 보이지 않으려고 언제나 상대를 노려보고 있지만 방심하면 금방 웃는 얼굴이 되어버린다.
Description (en, shield): Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Pangoro — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pangoro
ID: 675
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 부란다
Name (en): Pangoro
Description (ko, x): 성질이 거칠어 툭하면 싸우려 들지만 약자를 괴롭히는 일은 용서하지 않는다. 잎사귀로 적의 움직임을 읽는다.
Description (en, x): Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
Description (ko, y): 공격을 받아도 풀죽지 않고 돌진하며 전신주도 부러뜨리는 파워의 완력으로 때려눕힌다.
Description (en, y): It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.
Description (ko, sun): 완력이 자랑거리이며 호쾌하다. 부란다의 트레이너가 되고 싶으면 주먹으로 이야기하는 수밖에 없다.
Description (en, sun): It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro’s Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.
Description (ko, moon): 대나무 잎의 움직임으로 적의 행동을 읽는다. 싸움꾼이지만 동료에 대한 정은 두텁다.
Description (en, moon): From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent’s movements. It’s eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 완력을 뽐내는 와일드한 포켓몬. 호쾌한 성질에 반하는 트레이너도 많다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 주먹으로 이야기하는 타입이다. 긴말 없이 냅다 때려서 덤프트럭도 날려버리는 돌진을 먹인다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn’t say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.
Description (ko, sword): 성질이 사나워서 완력으로 상대를 조용하게 만든다. 가로막구리와의 결투에 투지를 불태운다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.
Description (ko, shield): 잎사귀로 상대의 움직임을 읽는다. 대형 덤프트럭을 일격에 고철로 만들어버리는 펀치를 가졌다.
Description (en, shield): Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Furfrou
ID: 676
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 트리미앙
Name (en): Furfrou
Description (ko, x): 복슬복슬한 털을 깎고 다듬으면 모습이 아름다워질 뿐만 아니라 몸의 움직임도 좋아진다.
Description (en, x): Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
Description (ko, y): 먼 옛날 칼로스지방에서 왕을 호위하는 역할을 맡았던 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, y): Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 털을 얼마나 아름답게 커트하는지 귀족들 사이에서 경쟁하던 시대가 있었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou’s fur into the most exquisite style.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 가만히 두면 털이 점점 자라지만 신뢰하는 자가 아니면 커트를 허락하지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

document.title: Espurr — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Espurr
ID: 677
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 냐스퍼
Name (en): Espurr
Description (ko, x): 강력한 사이코 파워가 새어 나가지 않도록 방출되는 기관을 귀로 막고 있다.
Description (en, x): The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
Description (ko, y): 100m 이내에 있는 것을 날려버릴 정도의 사이코 파워를 잘 컨트롤하지 못한다.
Description (en, y): It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.
Description (ko, sword): 언제나 무표정하지만 실제로는 강력한 사이코 파워가 새어 나가지 않게 하기 위해 필사적이다.
Description (en, sword): Though Espurr’s expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.
Description (ko, shield): 프로레슬러를 날려 버릴 정도의 사이코 파워를 속에 지니고 있지만 컨트롤이 되지 않아 난처해하고 있다.
Description (en, shield): There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.
