document.title: Pikipek — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pikipek
ID: 731
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 콕코구리
Name (en): Pikipek
Description (ko, sun): 1초당 16번 나무를 쪼아서 구멍을 낸다. 낸 구멍은 먹이를 넣어두는 저장고나 둥지로 쓴다.
Description (en, sun): It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
Description (ko, moon): 나무열매가 먹이다. 먹고 남은 씨앗은 총알처럼 입에서 발사하여 공격에 사용한다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 딱딱한 부리로 나무를 쫀다. 쪼는 리듬으로 그때의 기분이나 상태를 대강 알 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 가늘어 보이지만 강인한 목 근육을 가졌다. 초당 16연타로 나무를 마구 쪼아 댄다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Trumbeak — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Trumbeak
ID: 732
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 크라파
Name (en): Trumbeak
Description (ko, sun): 먹은 나무열매 씨앗을 부리에 저장한다. 적이나 먹이와 마주치면 한 번에 발사한다.
Description (en, sun): It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
Description (ko, moon): 부리를 젖혀서 여러 가지 소리로 운다. 꽤 시끄러워서 인근에 미움을 산다.
Description (en, moon): By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 부리의 끝을 뒤로 젖혀 100가지 이상의 울음소리를 자유롭게 낼 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먹은 나무열매의 씨를 부리에서 발사한다. 씨는 대지에 흩어져서 새로운 풀과 나무가 자라난다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Toucannon — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Toucannon
ID: 733
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 왕큰부리
Name (en): Toucannon
Description (ko, sun): 부리를 발열시켜 싸운다. 그 온도는 100도를 훨씬 넘어 쪼이기만 해도 큰 화상을 입는다.
Description (en, sun): When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
Description (ko, moon): 체내의 가스를 부리 안에서 폭발시켜 씨앗을 발사. 큰 바위도 가루로 만들어버릴 정도의 파워다.
Description (en, moon): Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 동료와 부리를 부딪히며 커뮤니케이션한다. 부딪히는 강도나 횟수로 기분을 전달한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 암수의 사이가 좋다고 알려져 있다. 행운을 부르기 위해 결혼식에 데리고 온다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Yungoos — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Yungoos
ID: 734
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 영구스
Name (en): Yungoos
Description (ko, sun): 날카로운 이빨로 아무거나 물어버린다. 원래 알로라에 서식하지 않고 다른 지방에서 데리고 왔다.
Description (en, sun): With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
Description (ko, moon): 먹이를 찾아 계속 돌아다닌다. 날이 저물 즈음엔 지쳐서 쓰러지듯이 그 자리에서 잠든다.
Description (en, moon): It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 긴 몸통은 거의 위장으로 이루어져 있다. 대식가여서 식비를 무시할 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It’s a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 무엇이든 먹지만 신선하고 살아 있는 것을 좋아해서 먹이를 찾아 길을 누비고 다닌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Gumshoos — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Gumshoos
ID: 735
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 형사구스
Name (en): Gumshoos
Description (ko, sun): 먹이의 흔적을 찾으면 끈질기게 그 자리에 잠복하지만 날이 저물면 꾸벅꾸벅 존다.
Description (en, sun): When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
Description (ko, moon): 꼬렛과 레트라를 좋아하지만 주행성이라 마주치지 못한다. 강한 인내력이 자랑인 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it’s diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 원래 알로라에 없었지만, 옛날 꼬렛이 대량으로 발생했을 때 데려왔다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it wasn’t originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매우 인내심이 강한 성질이지만 좋아하는 꼬렛을 발견하면 이성을 잃고 덤벼든다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Grubbin — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Grubbin
ID: 736
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 턱지충이
Name (en): Grubbin
Description (ko, sun): 튼튼한 턱으로 나무를 갉아서 수액을 마신다. 평소에는 땅속에서 산다.
Description (en, sun): Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
Description (ko, moon): 새포켓몬에게 공격받지 않도록 전류포켓몬이 사는 장소에 모여있는 일이 많다.
Description (en, moon): They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 혹시 소굴을 발견하더라도 손을 넣으면 안 된다. 싫어하는 턱지충이에게 물린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): If you find its nest, you shouldn’t stick your hand inside. You’ll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 끈적끈적한 실을 뿜어 상대의 움직임을 멈추고 날카롭고 튼튼한 턱으로 집어서 처리한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.
Description (ko, sword): 커다란 턱은 굵은 가지를 부러뜨릴 정도의 위력을 가졌다. 천적인 파라꼬도 견디지 못하고 도망친다.
Description (en, sword): Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.
Description (ko, shield): 커다란 턱으로 숲에서 땅을 파고 굴을 만든다. 달콤한 수액을 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, shield): It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Charjabug — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Charjabug
ID: 737
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 전지충이
Name (en): Charjabug
Description (ko, sun): 체내에 축전 기능을 갖추고 있다. 캠핑할 때 1마리 있으면 아주 고마운 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sun): Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
Description (ko, moon): 먹은 먹이를 소화할 때 발생하는 전기 에너지를 전기 주머니에 저장하고 있다.
Description (en, moon): From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 낙엽에 묻혀 거의 움직이지 않고 그저 부엽토만 먹는다. 잘못 밟으면 찌릿찌릿하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll get a shock!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 공격을 받아도 튼튼한 껍질로 철저히 방어한다. 끈질긴 상대에게는 전기로 반격한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.
Description (ko, sword): 튼튼한 껍질로 몸을 보호한다. 턱의 끝부분에서 전기를 흘려보내 반격한다.
Description (en, sword): While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
Description (ko, shield): 먹은 낙엽을 소화할 때 전기가 발생하는 구조로 되어 있다. 배의 전기 주머니에 충전된다.
Description (en, shield): Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Vikavolt — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Vikavolt
ID: 738
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 투구뿌논
Name (en): Vikavolt
Description (ko, sun): 날아다니며 틈을 노린다. 전기 에너지를 큰 턱으로 모아서 적에게 발사한다.
Description (en, sun): It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
Description (ko, moon): 배에 있는 발전기관에서 전기를 일으킨다. 전격 빔으로 새포켓몬도 압도한다.
Description (en, moon): It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 복부에 발전 기관을 갖고 있다. 큰 턱에 에너지를 모아 굉장한 전격을 쏜다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아크로바틱한 비행으로 적을 교란한다. 풀이 죽은 틈을 타 전격 빔을 가한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
Description (ko, sword): 복부에서 만든 전기를 커다란 턱에 집중시켜서 고출력의 빔을 쏜다.
Description (en, sword): It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
Description (ko, shield): 예비 배터리로서 전지충이를 안고 날면 높은 전력의 전자빔을 연사할 수 있다.
Description (en, shield): If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

document.title: Crabrawler — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Crabrawler
ID: 739
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 오기지게
Name (en): Crabrawler
Description (ko, sun): 가위로 약점을 가드 하면서 틈을 노려 펀치를 날린다. 진 쪽은 거품을 물고 다운된다.
Description (en, sun): While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
Description (ko, moon): 심하게 때려서 집게는 잘 떨어지지만 바로 자란다. 집게 속살은 적지만 풍미가 있고 맛있다.
Description (en, moon): It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 딱딱한 집게는 공격과 수비에 모두 능하다. 오기지게끼리의 싸움은 복싱 같다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 야자나무로 착각하고 나시에 오르는 일도 있다. 분노를 사 내동댕이쳐진 다음 짓밟힌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Crabominable — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Crabominable
ID: 740
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모단단게
Name (en): Crabominable
Description (ko, sun): 톱을 노리려다 설산에서 헤매게 되고 추위를 견디던 중에 털이 생겨서 진화했다.
Description (en, sun): It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
Description (ko, moon): 아무튼 무작정 때린다. 여차하면 집게를 스스로 끊어 로켓처럼 발사해서 때린다.
Description (en, moon): It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 집게 안에 냉기를 모아 때려눕힌다. 두꺼운 얼음벽도 가루로 만들어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 생각하기보다는 일단 때리고 본다. 눈사태를 펀치 러시로 되받아쳤다는 기록도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

document.title: Crabominable — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Crabominable
ID: 740
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모단단게
Name (en): Crabominable
Description (ko, sun): 톱을 노리려다 설산에서 헤매게 되고 추위를 견디던 중에 털이 생겨서 진화했다.
Description (en, sun): It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
Description (ko, moon): 아무튼 무작정 때린다. 여차하면 집게를 스스로 끊어 로켓처럼 발사해서 때린다.
Description (en, moon): It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 집게 안에 냉기를 모아 때려눕힌다. 두꺼운 얼음벽도 가루로 만들어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 생각하기보다는 일단 때리고 본다. 눈사태를 펀치 러시로 되받아쳤다는 기록도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

document.title: Oricorio — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Oricorio
ID: 741
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 춤추새
Name (en): Oricorio
Description (ko, sun): 날개를 부딪쳐서 발화시킨다. 화려한 스텝을 밟으면서 격렬한 불꽃을 퍼붓는다.
Description (en, sun): It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
Description (ko, moon): 다홍꿀을 빨아들인 춤추새. 정열적인 스텝으로 적의 몸도 마음도 불태운다.
Description (en, moon): This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 정열적인 댄스로 적의 마음을 사로잡아 방심하게 한 후 타오르는 불꽃으로 태워버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 다홍꿀을 빨아들인 춤추새. 트레이너가 틀린 지시를 내리면 격렬하게 화를 내는 격정적인 성격이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

document.title: Cutiefly — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cutiefly
ID: 742
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에블리
Name (en): Cutiefly
Description (ko, sun): 꽃의 꿀이나 꽃가루가 먹이다. 오라를 느끼는 힘을 지니고 있어 필 것 같은 꽃을 구별한다.
Description (en, sun): It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
Description (ko, moon): 꽃을 닮은 오라를 가진 사람의 머리 위에는 많은 에블리가 모여든다.
Description (en, moon): Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 꽃의 꿀과 화분을 좋아한다. 꽃밭에서 먹이를 두고 버터플과 옥신각신한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 생물의 오라를 느낀다. 오라를 통해 움직임을 먼저 읽어서 적을 농락하는 것이 특기다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes’ movements and make fools of them.
Description (ko, sword): 꽃가루와 꿀을 아주 좋아한다. 꼬모카의 꽃가루를 노리고 에블리가 주변을 날아다닌다.
Description (en, sword): Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur’s pollen.
Description (ko, shield): 상대가 내뿜는 오라로 다음 행동을 예측한다. 공격을 가볍게 피하고 반격한다.
Description (en, shield): An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

document.title: Ribombee — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Ribombee
ID: 743
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 에리본
Name (en): Ribombee
Description (ko, sun): 꽃가루를 뭉쳐서 경단을 만든다. 식용부터 전투용까지 많은 종류가 있다.
Description (en, sun): It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
Description (ko, moon): 에리본의 꽃가루경단은 영양 만점인 것도 있다. 영양제로 팔리기도 한다.
Description (en, moon): Some of Ribombee’s pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 화분이 축축해져서 비를 싫어한다. 구름의 움직임이 수상해지면 나무 구멍에서 움직이지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 습도나 바람의 방향으로 날씨를 예측할 수 있다. 맑은 날씨가 이어지는 때에만 모습을 보인다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.
Description (ko, sword): 꽃가루와 꿀을 섞어서 경단을 만든다. 조합하는 종류와 양에 따라 효과가 달라진다.
Description (en, sword): It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.
Description (ko, shield): 비에 젖는 것을 매우 싫어한다. 흐린 날이 많은 가라르지방에서는 모습을 좀처럼 보기 힘들다.
Description (en, shield): Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

document.title: Rockruff — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Rockruff
ID: 744
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 암멍이
Name (en): Rockruff
Description (ko, sun): 잘 따르기 때문에 초보자에게 추천하는 포켓몬으로 불리지만 크면 기질이 거칠어진다.
Description (en, sun): It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
Description (ko, moon): 옛날부터 사람과 살아왔다. 트레이너가 슬퍼하면 그것을 헤아리고 곁을 떠나지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer’s side.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 자라면서 거칠고 공격적으로 변한다. 감당이 안 돼서 버리는 트레이너도 적지 않다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 목에 있는 바위를 비벼대는 것은 친밀하다는 증거다. 단 바위는 날카로워서 꽤 아프다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that’s proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
Description (ko, sword): 잘 따르지만 무는 버릇이 있어 계속 기르기에는 상당한 노력이 필요하다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.
Description (ko, shield): 목의 바위를 땅에 세게 부딪쳐서 상대를 위협한다. 풀이 죽은 순간에 덮친다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

document.title: Lycanroc — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lycanroc
ID: 745
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 루가루암
Name (en): Lycanroc
Description (ko, sun): 재빨리 움직여 적을 어지럽힌다. 발톱이나 이빨 외에 갈기의 뾰족한 바위도 무기의 하나다.
Description (en, sun): Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
Description (ko, moon): 어릴 때부터 바르게 키우면 절대 트레이너를 배신하지 않는 믿음직한 동료가 된다.
Description (en, moon): When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 바위로 된 갈기는 날카로운 나이프처럼 잘 잘린다. 천천히 먹이를 궁지로 몰아 약하게 만든 후 숨통을 끊는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 갈기에 있는 바위는 나이프보다 예리하고 날카롭다. 떨어진 파편은 부적으로써 소중히 여겨진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
Description (ko, sword): 냉정하며 신중하다. 갈기의 바위는 잘 드는 면도날처럼 날카롭다.
Description (en, sword): This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.
Description (ko, shield): 빠른 움직임으로 먹이를 차츰차츰 궁지에 몰아넣는다. 이빨은 항상 급소를 노리고 있다.
Description (en, shield): With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

Description (ko, ultra-sun): 바위로 된 갈기는 날카로운 나이프처럼 잘 잘린다. 천천히 먹이를 궁지로 몰아 약하게 만든 후 숨통을 끊는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 갈기에 있는 바위는 나이프보다 예리하고 날카롭다. 떨어진 파편은 부적으로써 소중히 여겨진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
Description (ko, sword): 냉정하며 신중하다. 갈기의 바위는 잘 드는 면도날처럼 날카롭다.
Description (en, sword): This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.
Description (ko, shield): 빠른 움직임으로 먹이를 차츰차츰 궁지에 몰아넣는다. 이빨은 항상 급소를 노리고 있다.
Description (en, shield): With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

document.title: Wishiwashi — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Wishiwashi
ID: 746
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 약어리
Name (en): Wishiwashi
Description (ko, sun): 위험해지면 눈을 글썽이면서 반짝인다. 그 빛에 모이는 동료와 함께 적에 대항한다.
Description (en, sun): When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
Description (ko, moon): 너무도 약하고 너무도 맛있어서 항상 모두가 노리지만 괴롭히면 험한 꼴을 당한다.
Description (en, moon): It’s awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 약해서 무리 지어 행동한다. 하지만 혼자 떨어져서 헤엄치는 모습도 자주 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They’re weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 위험해지면 눈을 반짝여서 동료를 부른다. 그 빛은 40km 밖까지 도달한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it’s in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
Description (ko, sword): 1마리로는 너무나도 허약해서 무리를 지어 상대에게 맞서는 능력을 습득했다.
Description (en, sword): Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.
Description (ko, shield): 위험을 느끼면 눈물을 글썽인다. 눈물의 빛은 그들만의 신호로 신호를 받고 많은 동료가 모인다.
Description (en, shield): When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

document.title: Mareanie — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mareanie
ID: 747
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 시마사리
Name (en): Mareanie
Description (ko, sun): 머리에 있는 독 가시로 먹이를 찌른다. 약해졌을 때 10개의 촉수로 잡아서 마무리한다.
Description (en, sun): It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
Description (ko, moon): 해저나 해안을 기어다닌다. 코산호의 머리에서 자라는 산호를 아주 좋아한다.
Description (en, moon): It’s found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola’s head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 코산호의 가지를 먹기 때문에 자연스럽게 떨어지는 가지를 모아 가공하는 장인들의 미움을 받고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 머리 이외의 곳이라면 찢겨 나가더라도 금방 재생한다. 하룻밤 자고 나면 원래대로 돌아온다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they’re cut off. After a good night’s sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.
Description (ko, sword): 가시에 찔리면 먼저 저리기 시작하며 이윽고 마구 긁고 싶을 정도의 가려움에 고통받는다.
Description (en, sword): The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it’s impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
Description (ko, shield): 알로라지방의 시마사리와 달리 가라르의 시마사리는 코산호의 가지의 맛을 아직 모른다.
Description (en, shield): Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Toxapex — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Toxapex
ID: 748
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 더시마사리
Name (en): Toxapex
Description (ko, sun): 12개의 다리로 해저를 기어 다닌다. 더시마사리가 기어 다닌 자리에는 코산호의 찌꺼기가 흩어져있다.
Description (en, sun): Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
Description (ko, moon): 더시마사리의 독에 당하면 3일 밤낮으로 심한 고통에 시달리며 살아나더라도 후유증이 남는다.
Description (en, moon): Those attacked by Toxapex’s poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 맹독의 가시를 날려서 적을 공격한다. 다가온 상대는 발톱으로 쓸어버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 12개의 다리로 내부를 지키는 돔을 만든다. 조수의 흐름에 영향을 받지 않아 매우 쾌적하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn’t affect Toxapex in there, so it’s very comfortable.
Description (ko, sword): 가라르지방의 차가운 수온을 견디기 위해 다리로 돔을 만든 뒤 체온으로 내부를 덥힌다.
Description (en, sword): To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.
Description (ko, shield): 고래왕도 사흘 밤낮 괴로워할 정도의 맹독을 체내 독주머니에 듬뿍 비축하고 있다.
Description (en, shield): Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mudbray — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mudbray
ID: 749
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 머드나기
Name (en): Mudbray
Description (ko, sun): 다리에 달라붙은 진흙이 다리를 튼튼히 받들어 힘차게 달려나갈 수 있다.
Description (en, sun): The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
Description (ko, moon): 고집이 세고 제멋대로인 성격이다. 흙을 삼켜서 진흙을 만들어 진흙 장난을 하는 것이 일과다.
Description (en, moon): It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 진흙 놀이를 매우 좋아한다. 매일 진흙을 뒤집어쓰지 않으면 스트레스가 쌓여 말을 듣지 않게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It loves playing in the mud. If it isn’t showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 상당한 힘을 가졌다. 자신의 체중의 50배에 달하는 짐을 실어도 전혀 아무렇지도 않다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.
Description (ko, sword): 체중의 50배에 달하는 짐을 가볍게 운반할 정도로 힘이 장사다. 진흙을 다루는 데에 능하다.
Description (en, sword): Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It’s skilled at making use of mud.
Description (ko, shield): 흙을 먹어서 만든 진흙을 다리에 바르면 험한 길에서도 미끄러지지 않고 걸을 수 있게 된다.
Description (en, shield): It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mudsdale — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mudsdale
ID: 750
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 만마드
Name (en): Mudsdale
Description (ko, sun): 입에서 뱉어내는 진흙이 굳으면 비바람에도 끄떡없어 옛날 집의 벽에는 자주 발려 있었다.
Description (en, sun): It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
Description (ko, moon): 진흙을 두른 묵직한 킥이 특기 공격. 대형 트럭도 간단하게 고철이 되고 만다.
Description (en, moon): Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 어떤 일에도 동요하지 않고 차분하다. 입에 머금은 흙과 침을 섞어 특수한 진흙을 만든다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 10톤이나 되는 짐을 끌면서 삼일 밤낮 쉬지 않고 산길을 걸을 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
Description (ko, sword): 진흙으로 굳힌 다리는 바위보다도 단단해져서 일격에 트럭을 파괴할 정도의 위력을 보인다.
Description (en, sword): Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale’s legs sets harder than stone. It’s so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
Description (ko, shield): 10톤이 넘는 짐을 끌고 자지도 쉬지도 않고 가라르지방을 종단할 수 있는 지구력이 있다.
Description (en, shield): Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Dewpider — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dewpider
ID: 751
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 물거미
Name (en): Dewpider
Description (ko, sun): 먹이를 찾아서 지상으로 올라온다. 수포를 뒤집어쓴 것은 호흡과 부드러운 머리를 보호하기 위해서다.
Description (en, sun): It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
Description (ko, moon): 먹이나 적을 발견하면 머리에 쓴 수포를 튕겨서 물을 맞힌다.
Description (en, moon): When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 물거미끼리 만나면 머리의 수포를 자랑하며 어필한다. 작은 쪽이 뒤로 물러난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other’s way.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 물속에 녹아 있는 산소로만 호흡할 수 있어서 수포를 쓰고 육지를 돌아다닌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.
Description (ko, sword): 엉덩이로 수포를 부풀려서 머리를 감싼다. 동료끼리 수포의 크기를 비교한다.
Description (en, sword): It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.
Description (ko, shield): 평소에는 물속에서 생활하지만 먹이를 찾으러 육지로 올라올 때는 수포를 뒤집어쓴다.
Description (en, shield): Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Araquanid — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Araquanid
ID: 752
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 깨비물거미
Name (en): Araquanid
Description (ko, sun): 두부의 수포로 박치기한다. 작은 포켓몬이라면 그대로 수포에 싸여 익사한다.
Description (en, sun): It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
Description (ko, moon): 겉보기와 다르게 주위를 잘 챙긴다. 작고 약한 동료를 발견하면 수포 안에 넣어서 지킨다.
Description (en, moon): Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 평소에는 물 안에서 지낸다. 배가 부를 때는 숨통을 끊은 먹이를 머리의 수포에 넣어 둔다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 중요한 것을 수포에 넣어 두는 습성이 있다. 주의하지 않으면 트레이너도 넣어 두려 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn’t watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
Description (ko, sword): 다리로 수포를 날려서 먹이를 감싼 다음 익사시킨다. 그리고는 시간을 들여 천천히 음미한다.
Description (en, sword): It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.
Description (ko, shield): 머리의 수포 안에 물거미를 넣어 남은 먹이를 먹이면서 돌봐준다.
Description (en, shield): It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

Description (en, moon): Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 평소에는 물 안에서 지낸다. 배가 부를 때는 숨통을 끊은 먹이를 머리의 수포에 넣어 둔다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 중요한 것을 수포에 넣어 두는 습성이 있다. 주의하지 않으면 트레이너도 넣어 두려 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn’t watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
Description (ko, sword): 다리로 수포를 날려서 먹이를 감싼 다음 익사시킨다. 그리고는 시간을 들여 천천히 음미한다.
Description (en, sword): It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.
Description (ko, shield): 머리의 수포 안에 물거미를 넣어 남은 먹이를 먹이면서 돌봐준다.
Description (en, shield): It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Fomantis — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Fomantis
ID: 753
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 짜랑랑
Name (en): Fomantis
Description (ko, sun): 낮에는 빛을 쐬어 자고 밤이 되면 더욱 안전한 잠자리를 찾아 걸어 다닌다.
Description (en, sun): During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
Description (ko, moon): 산뜻하고 달콤한 향기가 난다. 짜랑랑이 숨어있는 풀밭에는 곧잘 에블리가 무리 지어있다.
Description (en, moon): They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 해가 뜨면 4장의 잎을 펼치고 일광욕한다. 머리끝에서 좋은 냄새가 난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 햇빛을 매우 좋아한다. 착실하게 일광욕을 하면 선명한 빛으로 자란다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
Description (ko, sword): 태양 빛을 받으면 달콤하고 좋은 향기가 나서 벌레포켓몬들이 모여든다.
Description (en, sword): When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.
Description (ko, shield): 낮에는 햇빛을 받으며 새근새근 잔다. 한밤중에 잠에서 깨어 활동을 시작한다.
Description (en, shield): During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Lurantis — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lurantis
ID: 754
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 라란티스
Name (en): Lurantis
Description (ko, sun): 선명한 몸의 색을 유지하기 위해서 굉장히 손이 가지만 그것을 취미로 하는 유별난 사람도 있다.
Description (en, sun): It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
Description (ko, moon): 낫 모양의 꽃잎에서 빔을 발사한다. 두꺼운 철판도 두 동강 나는 위력이다.
Description (en, moon): It fires beams from its sickle-shaped petals. These beams are powerful enough to cleave through thick metal plates.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 벌레포켓몬인 척하는 것은 몸을 지키기 위해서다. 양팔의 꽃잎은 예리해서 잘 자른다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 춤추듯 적을 베어 가른다. 우아한 모습 때문에 가장 아름다운 풀포켓몬이라 불린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it’s dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 아름다운 꽃 포켓몬이다. 잘 자란 라란티스는 훌륭하고 선명한 빛을 띤다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.
Description (ko, shield): 양팔의 꽃잎은 얇고 예리하다. 빛을 모아 빔을 쏘기도 한다.
Description (en, shield): The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Morelull — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Morelull
ID: 755
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 자마슈
Name (en): Morelull
Description (ko, sun): 깜빡이면서 빛나는 포자를 주변에 뿌린다. 그 빛을 본 자는 깊은 잠에 빠진다.
Description (en, sun): It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
Description (ko, moon): 낮에는 자면서 나무뿌리에서 양분을 흡수한다. 밤에 일어나면 새로운 나무를 찾아 걸어 다닌다.
Description (en, moon): As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빛이 나는 포자를 주변에 흩뿌린다. 위험하지만 자마슈가 사는 숲의 밤 여행 투어는 인기가 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they’re dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 어둡고 습한 곳을 좋아한다. 밤이 되면 버섯의 갓에 모인 포자가 발광한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.
Description (ko, sword): 머리의 갓은 매우 맛있다. 숲속의 포켓몬들에게 먹히지만 하룻밤 만에 재생한다.
Description (en, sword): Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.
Description (ko, shield): 낮에도 어두운 숲에서 생활한다. 점멸하면서 빛나는 포자를 흩뿌려 적을 잠들게 한다.
Description (en, shield): Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Shiinotic — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Shiinotic
ID: 756
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마셰이드
Name (en): Shiinotic
Description (ko, sun): 한밤중에 마셰이드가 사는 숲에 가는 것은 위험하다. 이상한빛에 유인되어 다시는 돌아올 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, sun): Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
Description (ko, moon): 깜빡이는 포자를 뿜어내어 잠으로 유도한다. 잠든 먹이의 정기를 빨아들인다.
Description (en, moon): It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹이를 잠들게 하고 팔 끝으로 생기를 빼앗는다. 동료가 약해지면 생기를 보내 도와준다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 영역을 두고 파라섹트와 싸움을 시작하면 부근 일대는 포자투성이가 되어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
Description (ko, sword): 깜빡이는 포자의 빛으로 먹이를 유인해서 잠들게 한다. 손끝으로 생기를 흡수한다.
Description (en, sword): Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.
Description (ko, shield): 한밤중에 숲속에서 빛을 발견하더라도 다가가면 안 된다. 마셰이드가 잠들어 버리게 한다.
Description (en, shield): If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Salandit — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Salandit
ID: 757
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 야도뇽
Name (en): Salandit
Description (ko, sun): 체액을 태워 독가스를 피운다. 가스를 들이마신 적이 휘청거리면 덮친다.
Description (en, sun): It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
Description (ko, moon): 화산이나 건조한 바위에 산다. 달콤한 향기의 독가스를 발산해 벌레포켓몬을 유인하여 덮친다.
Description (en, moon): Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 수컷은 거의 암컷의 지시에 따른다. 잡아 온 먹이도 거의 바치기 때문에 영양 부족으로 진화할 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can’t evolve.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 독가스로 상대를 비틀비틀 약하게 만든 뒤 덮친다. 언제나 비틀거리는 얼루기에게 약하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn’t deal well with Spinda, since it’s always reeling.
Description (ko, sword): 독주머니에서 만든 체액을 꼬리의 불꽃으로 가열해서 독가스를 발생시키는 구조로 되어 있다.
Description (en, sword): Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit’s poisonous gas.
Description (ko, shield): 먹이의 뒤로 숨어들어서 눈치채기 전에 독가스를 퍼부어 움직이지 못하게 한다.
Description (en, shield): This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Salazzle — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Salazzle
ID: 758
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 염뉴트
Name (en): Salazzle
Description (ko, sun): 어찌 된 영문인지 암컷만 발견되고 있다. 야도뇽의 수컷을 거느리며 역하렘을 만들어서 산다.
Description (en, sun): For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
Description (ko, moon): 독가스에는 많은 양의 페로몬이 포함되어있다. 희석하면 관능적인 향수가 만들어진다.
Description (en, moon): Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 동굴 깊은 곳에서 살며 페로몬으로 헤롱헤롱하게 만들어 야도뇽을 시중들게 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먹이를 잡지 못한 야도뇽은 불꽃을 뿜어내는 손바닥으로 세차게 따귀를 때려서 벌을 준다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
Description (ko, sword): 염뉴트는 암컷만이 존재한다. 페로몬 가스를 발생시켜서 수컷 야도뇽을 매료시킨다.
Description (en, sword): Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
Description (ko, shield): 염뉴트들의 싸움은 거느리고 있는 수컷 야도뇽의 수로 승패가 정해지는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Stufful — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Stufful
ID: 759
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 포곰곰
Name (en): Stufful
Description (ko, sun): 사랑스러운 외모지만 화가 나서 버둥거리는 손발에 부딪히면 프로레슬러라도 날아가 버린다.
Description (en, sun): Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
Description (ko, moon): 친밀한 사이나 동료 이외의 사람이 만지면 굉장한 힘으로 날뛰기 때문에 매우 위험하다.
Description (en, moon): A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It’s an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 큰 나무도 꺽을 만큼 힘이 세다. 엉덩이의 기관에서 냄새를 풍겨 동료와 커뮤니케이션을 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 껴안거나 만지는 것을 아주 싫어한다. 바둥바둥 날뛰면서 저항하는 힘이 굉장하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
Description (ko, sword): 푹신푹신한 털은 감촉이 뛰어나지만 섣불리 손을 댔다간 호되게 반격을 당하고 만다.
Description (en, sword): Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.
Description (ko, shield): 앞발을 바둥바둥 흔들어 몸을 지키는 모습은 귀엽지만 큰 나무도 꺾을 정도의 위력이 있다.
Description (en, shield): The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Bewear — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bewear
ID: 760
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이븐곰
Name (en): Bewear
Description (ko, sun): 압도적인 근력을 가지는 아주 위험한 포켓몬이다. 서식지는 기본 출입금지다.
Description (en, sun): This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
Description (ko, moon): 동료끼리 서로 껴안는 버릇이 있다. 그 힘 때문에 척추가 부러져서 세상을 떠나는 트레이너도 많다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 손을 크게 휘두르는 것은 위협과 경계의 신호다. 재빨리 도망치지 않으면 목숨을 보장할 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn’t run away as fast as possible.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 무시무시한 괴력을 자랑한다. 알로라지방에서 가장 위험한 포켓몬이라 부르는 사람도 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.
Description (ko, sword): 동료로 인정하면 애정을 표현하기 위해 껴안으려 하지만 뼈가 으스러질 수 있으므로 위험하다.
Description (en, sword): Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.
Description (ko, shield): 격투가가 무색할 정도의 기술로 먹이를 잡아 양쪽 겨드랑이에 끼우고 거처로 갖고 간다.
Description (en, shield): The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

document.title: Bounsweet — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bounsweet
ID: 761
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 달콤아
Name (en): Bounsweet
Description (ko, sun): 맛있는 냄새가 몸에서 풍긴다. 냄새를 맡고 다가온 왕큰부리에게 통째로 먹힌다.
Description (en, sun): A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
Description (ko, moon): 사람이 먹기에는 너무 달지만 달콤아의 땀을 물에 희석하면 적당히 달콤한 주스가 된다.
Description (en, moon): Although it’s too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet’s sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 달고 맛있는 냄새 때문에 새포켓몬이 타깃으로 삼지만 영리하지 않아 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it’s not intelligent enough to care.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 새포켓몬에게 삼켜질 것 같으면 머리의 꼭지를 회전시켜서 저항하지만 대체로 소용없다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It’s usually a fruitless attempt.
Description (ko, sword): 몸에서 나는 열매의 달콤한 향기가 새포켓몬의 식욕을 강하게 자극한다.
Description (en, sword): Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 습격당할 때 흘리는 땀은 달콤하고 맛있다. 그 향기가 적을 더 늘리고 만다.
Description (en, shield): When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Steenee — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Steenee
ID: 762
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 달무리나
Name (en): Steenee
Description (ko, sun): 몸을 지키기 위해 꼭지가 발달했다. 상당히 단단해서 새포켓몬이 쪼아도 전혀 문제없다.
Description (en, sun): The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
Description (ko, moon): 언제나 힘차게 뛰어오른다. 힘찬 모습과 좋은 향기 때문에 주변에 포켓몬이 모여든다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 딱딱한 꼭지로 보호되기 때문에 새포켓몬과도 문제없이 논다. 쪼여도 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn’t care.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 뛰어오르듯 돌아다니면서 머리의 꼭지를 휘두른다. 부딪히면 상당히 아프다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They’re quite painful when they smack you!
Description (ko, sword): 춤추듯이 회전해서 달콤한 향기를 흩날린다. 그 향기를 맡으면 행복한 기분이 든다.
Description (en, sword): As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.
Description (ko, shield): 쪼아대는 파크로우를 머리의 꼭지로 후려치고 예리한 발차기를 먹인다.
Description (en, shield): Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tsareena — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tsareena
ID: 763
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 달코퀸
Name (en): Tsareena
Description (ko, sun): 다리를 활용한 발차기가 특기다. 쓰러뜨린 상대를 걷어차며 큰 웃음으로 승리를 어필한다.
Description (en, sun): Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
Description (ko, moon): 다리가 예쁜 포켓몬으로 알려져 미용 클리닉 등의 광고의 마스코트가 되었다.
Description (en, moon): A Pokémon known for the beauty of its well-shaped legs, it sometimes appears as a mascot in advertisements for beauty salons.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 아름다운 발차기의 전문가다. 킥복싱의 챔피언도 일격으로 녹아웃시킨다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 공격적인 기질을 가진 포켓몬으로 킥의 명수다. 상대를 차올릴 때마다 크게 웃는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.
Description (ko, sword): 늘씬하게 뻗은 다리와 잔인한 마음씨를 가진 공포의 대상. 상대를 사정없이 짓밟는다.
Description (en, sword): This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.
Description (ko, shield): 단단하고 뾰족한 발끝으로 킥을 먹여서 상대의 몸과 마음에 지워지지 않는 상처를 남긴다.
Description (en, shield): A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Comfey — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Comfey
ID: 764
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 큐아링
Name (en): Comfey
Description (ko, sun): 영양 만점의 줄기에 꽃을 붙인다. 꽃이 활성화해서 향기로운 아로마가 풍긴다.
Description (en, sun): It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
Description (ko, moon): 덩굴에 붙어 있는 꽃을 띄운 목욕은 긴장을 풀어주는 효과가 있어 많은 여성들에게 인기가 높다.
Description (en, moon): Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머리에서 끈적거리는 시위를 늘려서 꽃을 따서 치장한다. 꽃이 없으면 불안하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn’t have any flowers, it feels uneasy.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 딴 꽃에 체액을 묻혀 몸에 붙인다. 꽃잎에서 감도는 향기는 치유 효과가 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.
Description (ko, sword): 덩굴을 사용해 꽃을 따서 자신을 꾸민다. 몸에 붙은 꽃은 무슨 이유에서인지 시들지 않는다.
Description (en, sword): Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.
Description (ko, shield): 매우 좋은 향기가 나는 포켓몬이다. 몸에 붙이는 꽃이 달라서 큐아링마다 향이 다르다
Description (en, shield): These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Oranguru — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Oranguru
ID: 765
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 하랑우탄
Name (en): Oranguru
Description (ko, sun): 굉장히 똑똑한 것으로 유명하다. 미숙한 트레이너를 깔보기 때문에 베테랑에게 맞는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sun): Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
Description (ko, moon): 정글 오지의 나무 위에 산다. 드물게 바닷가에 나타나서 야도킹과 지혜를 겨룬다.
Description (en, moon): Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 평소에는 나무 위에서 명상하며 지낸다. 제멋대로 몬스터볼을 던져 포켓몬에게 명령한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 하랑우탄끼리는 사이가 좋지 않아서 누가 더 똑똑하고 수준이 높은지 지혜 겨루기를 반복한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Oranguru don’t get along with each other, so they’re always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.
Description (ko, sword): 잎사귀와 털로 만든 부채를 휘둘러 포켓몬들을 마음대로 조종할 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 숲 구석구석까지 파악하고 있어 상처 입은 포켓몬이 있으면 약초를 찾아 치료한다.
Description (en, shield): It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Passimian — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Passimian
ID: 766
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 내던숭이
Name (en): Passimian
Description (ko, sun): 20마리 전후의 그룹을 만든다. 그 결속은 상당히 강하며 절대 동료를 버리지 않는다.
Description (en, sun): They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
Description (ko, moon): 딱딱한 나무열매를 사용해서 싸운다. 그 테크닉은 대대로 보스로부터 그룹 동료들에게 전수된다.
Description (en, moon): They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 침으로 어깨에 잎사귀를 붙여서 마킹한다. 잎사귀의 위치로 어느 무리인지 알 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 나무열매가 무기이자 주식이다. 무리 중에서 가장 멀리 나무열매를 던지는 자가 보스다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.
Description (ko, sword): 보스의 지시를 따라 훌륭한 팀플레이로 좋아하는 나무열매를 찾기 위해 동료와 협동한다.
Description (en, sword): Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.
Description (ko, shield): 20마리 정도가 무리 지어 생활한다. 정해진 역할을 해내면서 혹독한 자연에서 꿋꿋하게 살아남았다.
Description (en, shield): Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Wimpod — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Wimpod
ID: 767
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 꼬시레
Name (en): Wimpod
Description (ko, sun): 겁이 많아서 많은 다리를 버둥거리며 필사적으로 도망친다. 도망간 자리는 반짝반짝 깨끗하다.
Description (en, sun): This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
Description (ko, moon): 해변부터 해저까지 다양한 장소에 산다. 썩은 먹이라도 기꺼이 먹는 자연의 청소부.
Description (en, moon): Its habitat varies from beaches to seabeds. A natural scavenger, it will gleefully chow down on anything edible, no matter how rotten.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 떨어져 있는 것은 뭐든지 줍는다. 동전을 갖고 있을 때도 있어 니로우나 나옹이 노리고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매우 소심한 포켓몬. 무언가가 다가오기만 해도 고속으로 다리를 움직여서 도망친다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.
Description (ko, sword): 상한 것이든 쓰레기든 닥치는 대로 먹어 치우는 자연의 청소부. 둥지 주변은 언제나 깨끗하다.
Description (en, sword): It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.
Description (ko, shield): 무리가 모여 다니며 항상 주위를 경계한다. 적의 기척을 느끼면 뿔뿔이 흩어져 도망간다.
Description (en, shield): Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Golisopod — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Golisopod
ID: 768
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 갑주무사
Name (en): Golisopod
Description (ko, sun): 날카롭고 거대한 발톱으로 공격한다. 공기나 해수마저 두 동강 낼 정도의 실력이다.
Description (en, sun): With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
Description (ko, moon): 6개의 팔로 능숙하게 싸운다. 평소에는 심해의 바위굴에서 명상하듯 조용히 지낸다.
Description (en, moon): It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸을 덮고 있는 두꺼운 껍질은 다이아몬드 정도의 강도다. 이기기 위해서는 수단을 가리지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 자유롭게 늘었다 줄었다 하는 발톱이 최대의 무기다. 꼬시레를 거느리고 있을 때도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.
Description (ko, sword): 이기기 위해서는 수단을 가리지 않는다. 상대의 빈틈을 찌른 뒤 앞발의 작은 발톱으로 마무리한다.
Description (en, sword): It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.
Description (ko, shield): 해저의 굴이나 침몰선이 거처다. 케오퍼스와 싸워서 진 쪽이 먹이가 된다.
Description (en, shield): They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Sandygast — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Sandygast
ID: 769
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모래꿍
Name (en): Sandygast
Description (ko, sun): 객사한 자의 원통함이 아이가 만든 모래언덕에 깃들어 탄생했다.
Description (en, sun): Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
Description (ko, moon): 입안에 손을 넣은 자를 조종한다. 모래언덕의 몸집을 크게 만들기 위해서다.
Description (en, moon): It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머리의 삽을 마음에 들어한다. 되찾으러 온 아이와 싸우다가 열을 올리면서 치고 받고 싸운다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 모래장난으로 만든 모래산은 돌아갈 때 부수지 않으면 영혼이 깃들어서 모래꿍이 될지도 모른다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): If you build sand mounds when you’re playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
Description (ko, sword): 모래산에 죽은 자의 원념이 깃들어 포켓몬이 되었다. 머리의 삽을 마음에 들어 한다.
Description (en, sword): Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.
Description (ko, shield): 주로 모래사장에 산다. 입안에 손을 넣은 상대를 조종하여 자신을 크게 만든다.
Description (en, shield): Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

document.title: Palossand — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Palossand
ID: 770
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모래성이당
Name (en): Palossand
Description (ko, sun): 사람을 조종하여 모래언덕을 모래성으로까지 진화시켰다. 저주의 힘도 깊어졌다.
Description (en, sun): Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
Description (ko, moon): 성 아래에는 정기를 빨려 바싹 말라버린 자들의 뼈가 대량으로 묻혀있다.
Description (en, moon): Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 한 알의 모래에도 의지가 있다. 작은 포켓몬을 산 채로 삼켜서 생기를 뺏는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they’re still alive.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 모래바람을 일으켜서 상대의 움직임을 봉인하고 생기를 뺏는 무서운 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.
Description (ko, sword): 해변의 악몽이라고도 불린다. 모래를 조종하여 먹이를 가라앉힌 뒤 영혼을 흡수한다.
Description (en, sword): Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.
Description (ko, shield): 해변에 살지만 물을 싫어한다. 세찬 비를 맞으면 성의 형태를 유지하지 못한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

document.title: Pyukumuku — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pyukumuku
ID: 771
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 해무기
Name (en): Pyukumuku
Description (ko, sun): 해변 등 얕은 바다에 산다. 몸에서 체내기관을 꺼내서 먹이를 잡거나 적과 싸운다.
Description (en, sun): It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
Description (ko, moon): 모래 해변에 많이 있다. 몸을 감싸는 끈적끈적한 점액은 햇볕에 탄 피부 관리에 편리하다.
Description (en, moon): These Pokémon line the beaches. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 해무기던지기라는 문화는 육지로 밀려온 해무기를 바다로 던져 돌려보내는 습관에서 시작되었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 전신이 체액으로 미끈거린다. 실수로 밟으면 넘어지고 화를 내며 때리려 든다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!
Description (ko, sword): 따뜻하고 얕은 여울에 산다. 상대와 마주치면 체내 기관을 입으로 뿜어서 때려눕힌다.
Description (en, sword): It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.
Description (ko, shield): 보습 효과가 뛰어난 점액이 피부를 감싸고 있어 며칠을 육지에 있어도 마르지 않는다.
Description (en, shield): It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

document.title: Type: Null — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Type: Null
ID: 772
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 타입:널
Name (en): Type: Null
Description (ko, sun): 무거운 제어마스크를 쓰고 있어 본래의 능력을 발휘할 수 없다. 특별한 힘을 숨기고 있다.
Description (en, sun): The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
Description (ko, moon): 인공의 포켓몬이다. 폭주할 위험이 있어 제어마스크로 힘을 봉인하고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 특정 임무를 위해 개발된 포켓몬 병기다. 실험 중에 폭주해서 중단되었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 폭주의 위험이 있어 제어마스크를 통해 본래의 힘을 봉인하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): There’s danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
Description (ko, sword): 극비였던 연구 자료가 도난당한 뒤 가라르지방에서 새로 만들어졌다는 소문이 있다.
Description (en, sword): Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.
Description (ko, shield): 신화 속 포켓몬을 모델로 만들었지만 힘이 폭주하는 것을 억제하는 마스크를 쓰고 있다.
Description (en, shield): It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

document.title: Silvally — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Silvally
ID: 773
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 실버디
Name (en): Silvally
Description (ko, sun): 파트너와의 신뢰로 각성한다. 자유자재로 타입을 바꾸는 능력을 발휘하며 싸운다.
Description (en, sun): Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
Description (ko, moon): 그 이름은 타입:널을 처음으로 이 모습으로 진화시킨 소년에 의해 지어졌다.
Description (en, moon): Although its name was Type: Null at first, the boy who evolved it into this form gave it the name by which it is now known.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 각성으로 진화한 모습이다. 무거운 마스크에서 벗어나 스피드가 크게 올라갔다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 제어마스크를 파괴할 수 있었던 것은 파트너와의 유대를 통해 강한 정신력을 얻었기 때문이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
Description (ko, sword): 파트너와의 강한 유대에 의해 숨겨진 능력을 각성했다. 자유자재로 타입을 바꿀 수 있다.
Description (en, sword): A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.
Description (ko, shield): 본래의 힘을 해방하게 하는 마지막 요소는 신뢰하는 트레이너와의 유대였다.
Description (en, shield): The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

document.title: Minior — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Minior
ID: 774
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 메테노
Name (en): Minior
Description (ko, sun): 원래 오존층에 살고 있으며 몸의 껍질이 무거워지면 지상을 향해 떨어진다.
Description (en, sun): Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
Description (ko, moon): 강한 충격을 받으면 껍데기는 떨어져 나간다. 나노입자가 돌연변이하여 태어난 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 오존층에 살며 더 강한 포켓몬의 먹이가 된다. 도망치다 지상으로 떨어진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 겉껍질은 매우 튼튼하지만 지상에 낙하할 때의 충격으로 산산이 조각나 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

Description (en, ultra-moon): Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

document.title: Komala — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Komala
ID: 775
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 자말라
Name (en): Komala
Description (ko, sun): 잔 채 태어나고 잔 채 죽는다. 모든 행동은 꾸고 있는 꿈에 의한 잠버릇인 것 같다.
Description (en, sun): It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
Description (ko, moon): 안고 있는 나무는 태어났을 때 부모로부터 받은 것이다. 잘 길들이면 트레이너의 팔에도 달라붙는다.
Description (en, moon): The log it holds was given to it by its parents at birth. It has also been known to cling to the arm of a friendly Trainer.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 태어날 때부터 계속 자고 있다. 깊은 수면에 빠져 있을 때는 일체 움직이지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It stays asleep from the moment it’s born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 죽을 때까지 계속 잠들어 있는 이유는 먹이인 잎사귀에 마취 성분이 포함되어 있기 때문이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Turtonator — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Turtonator
ID: 776
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 폭거북스
Name (en): Turtonator
Description (ko, sun): 등의 등껍질은 폭발물이다. 실수로 때리면 대폭발한다. 배의 구멍이 약점이다.
Description (en, sun): The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
Description (ko, moon): 콧구멍으로 불꽃과 독가스를 뿜는다. 배설물은 폭발물이며 다양한 용도가 있다.
Description (en, moon): It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 화산에 살며 황이나 광물을 먹는다. 먹은 먹이의 성분이 폭발하는 등껍질의 바탕이 된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 폭발하는 등껍질은 성가시게도 습기에 약하다. 비가 내리는 날에는 동굴 깊은 곳에서 가만히 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.
Description (ko, sword): 폭약으로 코팅된 등껍질을 짊어지고 있다. 공격하는 상대에게 대폭발로 반격한다.
Description (en, sword): Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.
Description (ko, shield): 화산에서 살며 먹은 유황이 등껍질에 있는 폭약의 원료가 된다. 위험하게도 배설물 역시 폭발물이다.
Description (en, shield): Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Togedemaru — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Togedemaru
ID: 777
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 토게데마루
Name (en): Togedemaru
Description (ko, sun): 등의 가시 털은 평소에 누워 있다가 흥분하면 곤두서 덮쳐오는 적을 찌른다.
Description (en, sun): The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
Description (ko, moon): 등의 기다란 털은 피뢰침이다. 낙뢰를 끌어들여 번개를 맞으면 전기 주머니에 저장한다.
Description (en, moon): The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 등에 난 14개의 바늘 털은 놀라거나 흥분했을 때 멋대로 곤두선다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 전기를 만드는 힘은 그다지 강하지 않아서 번개를 맞아서 충전한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!
Description (ko, sword): 등에 난 긴 털로 번개나 전기포켓몬의 전격을 받아 전기 주머니에 충전한다.
Description (en, sword): With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
Description (ko, shield): 위기에 처하면 몸을 둥글게 말고 등의 가시를 곤두세워 마구잡이로 전격을 쏘아댄다.
Description (en, shield): When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Mimikyu — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Mimikyu
ID: 778
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 따라큐
Name (en): Mimikyu
Description (ko, sun): 정체불명. 누더기 속을 본 어떤 학자는 공포에서 헤어나오지 못하고 쇼크사했다.
Description (en, sun): Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
Description (ko, moon): 무시무시한 모습을 누더기로 가리고 사람이나 다른 포켓몬에게 다가가는 외로움이 많은 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 얌전하고 외로움을 잘 타지만, 넝마 조각의 속을 보려고 하면 격렬하게 싫어하며 저항한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what’s under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 바람이 불어서 우연히 속을 봐 버린 트레이너는 그날 밤 고통에 몸부림치다 죽었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon’s rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
Description (ko, sword): 겁을 주지 않기 위해 피카츄와 닮은 누더기를 쓰고 있지만 오히려 더 으스스해졌다.
Description (en, sword): It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
Description (ko, shield): 연구를 위해 누더기 속을 들여다본 학자가 알 수 없는 병으로 목숨을 잃었다.
Description (en, shield): There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

Name (en): Mimikyu
