Description (en, sun): Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
Description (ko, moon): 무시무시한 모습을 누더기로 가리고 사람이나 다른 포켓몬에게 다가가는 외로움이 많은 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 얌전하고 외로움을 잘 타지만, 넝마 조각의 속을 보려고 하면 격렬하게 싫어하며 저항한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what’s under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

Description (en, ultra-moon): A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon’s rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.

document.title: Bruxish — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Bruxish
ID: 779
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 치갈기
Name (en): Bruxish
Description (ko, sun): 머리의 돌기에서 사이코 파워를 발산할 때 아주 귀에 거슬리는 이가는 소리가 주변에 울려 퍼진다.
Description (en, sun): When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
Description (ko, moon): 염동력으로 먹이를 마비시켜 튼튼한 이빨로 깨물어 부순다. 셀러의 껍질도 거뜬히 부순다.
Description (en, moon): It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder’s shell is no match for it.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 모래로 숨어들어 머리의 돌기에서 사이코 파워를 방사한다. 주변의 상태를 탐지하면서 먹이를 기다린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 시마사리의 바늘도 뚫지 못할 정도로 두꺼운 피부를 가졌다. 튼튼한 이빨로 어적어적 바늘을 갉아서 먹는다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

document.title: Drampa — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Drampa
ID: 780
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 할비롱
Name (en): Drampa
Description (ko, sun): 마음이 따뜻하고 착하다. 하지만 한번 화에 사로잡히면 거친 숨결로 주변을 파괴해 버린다.
Description (en, sun): It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
Description (ko, moon): 사람을 잘 따르고 아이를 좋아한다. 사이 좋은 아이와 놀기 위해 깊은 산 속에서 마을로 내려온다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 친구가 된 아이가 괴롭힘을 당하면 괴롭힌 아이의 집에 찾아가서 태워버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully’s house and burn it to the ground.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 마을에 나타나서 아이들과 논다. 위험에 처해도 아이를 지켜주기 때문에 어머니도 안심할 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they’re in danger, so their moms don’t have to worry.
Description (ko, sword): 해발 3000m가 넘는 산에 산다. 드물게 마을로 내려와 아이들과 논다.
Description (en, sword): The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
Description (ko, shield): 사람을 잘 따르고 마음이 착하지만 한번 화가 나면 강풍을 일으켜 모든 것을 쓰러뜨려 버린다.
Description (en, shield): Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

document.title: Dhelmise — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Dhelmise
ID: 781
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 타타륜
Name (en): Dhelmise
Description (ko, sun): 큰 닻을 빙빙 휘둘러 고래왕조차 일격에 KO 시킨다. 녹색의 해초가 본체다.
Description (en, sun): Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
Description (ko, moon): 바다를 떠도는 해초의 영혼이 다시 태어났다. 해저의 쓰레기를 해초에 감아서 몸을 유지한다.
Description (en, moon): The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 녹색의 해초를 휘감아 생기를 빨아들인다. 주로 고래왕처럼 몸집이 큰 것을 노린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 사슬 같은 녹색 해초는 수백 미터나 늘어난다. 희한하게도 수레기와 사이가 좋다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.
Description (ko, sword): 해저를 떠도는 해초가 침몰선의 부품을 거두어들여서 고스트포켓몬으로 다시 태어났다.
Description (en, sword): After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.
Description (ko, shield): 바다에 닻을 내려 먹이를 기다린다. 몸집이 큰 고래왕을 잡아 생기를 빨아들인다.
Description (en, shield): After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Jangmo-o — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Jangmo-o
ID: 782
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 짜랑꼬
Name (en): Jangmo-o
Description (ko, sun): 비늘을 때려 마음을 전달한다. 짜랑꼬가 사는 고산에서는 금속음이 메아리친다.
Description (en, sun): It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
Description (ko, moon): 인적이 없는 산에 산다. 짜랑꼬끼리 싸우면서 조금씩 성장해간다.
Description (en, moon): They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 머리의 비늘로 바위나 지면을 마구 두드려 상대를 위협한다. 소리로 동료와 연락도 취한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 적에게 등을 보이지 않고 싸운다. 용감한 기질을 갖고 있어서 고대의 전사는 곧잘 동료로 삼았다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.
Description (ko, sword): 머리의 비늘을 동료끼리 부딪히며 싸우는 법을 배운다. 이를 통해 기술과 정신을 단련한다.
Description (en, sword): They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.
Description (ko, shield): 털이 금속처럼 단단해져서 생긴 비늘을 부딪쳐서 소리를 내고 동료와 소통한다.
Description (en, shield): Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Hakamo-o — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Hakamo-o
ID: 783
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 짜랑고우
Name (en): Hakamo-o
Description (ko, sun): 기합을 외치며 먹이에게 달려든다. 비늘의 펀치는 상대를 갈기갈기 찢는다.
Description (en, sun): It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
Description (ko, moon): 비늘은 점점 새로 자란다. 새로워질수록 비늘은 단단하고 예리해진다.
Description (en, moon): It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they’re regrown.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 비늘을 부딪히며 소리를 낸다. 리듬이 최고조에 달할 때 공격해 온다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 떨어진 비늘을 두드려서 냄비나 프라이팬으로 가공한다. 열전도율이 좋아서 사용하기 편하다고 호평이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they’re a popular item.
Description (ko, sword): 비늘이 떨어진 상처투성이인 몸은 강자라는 증표다. 상대를 쓰러뜨린 후 상처를 보여준다.
Description (en, sword): The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.
Description (ko, shield): 비늘을 부딪쳐 우렁찬 소리를 낸 후 상대에게 덤벼들어 날카로운 손톱으로 갈기갈기 찢는다.
Description (en, shield): Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Kommo-o — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Kommo-o
ID: 784
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 짜랑고우거
Name (en): Kommo-o
Description (ko, sun): 적을 보면 꼬리의 비늘을 짤랑짤랑 소리를 내며 위협한다. 약한 자는 허둥대며 도망간다.
Description (en, sun): When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
Description (ko, moon): 단단한 비늘은 공방일체. 한때 무기나 일용품으로 가공되어 쓰여졌다.
Description (en, moon): Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹이의 숨통을 끊고 포효하면 여기저기에서 축하하는 동료의 금속음이 메아리친다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강철의 비늘을 두른 주먹을 휘두르며 용감하게 싸운다. 자신 있는 특기는 어퍼컷이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
Description (ko, sword): 상대와 마주치면 꼬리의 비늘로 소리를 내어 위협한다. 이에 겁먹지 않은 강자만을 상대로 싸운다.
Description (en, sword): It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.
Description (ko, shield): 짜랑고우거의 비늘로 만든 갑옷을 두른 고대의 전사가 유적에 그려져 있다.
Description (en, shield): Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

Name (ko): 카푸꼬꼬꼭
Name (en): Tapu Koko
Description (ko, sun): 호기심 왕성한 멜레멜레의 수호신이다. 번개 구름을 불러 우레를 몸에 비축한다.
Description (en, sun): This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
Description (ko, moon): 눈에 보이지 않는 스피드로 적을 교란한다. 심하게 화를 잘 내지만 왜 화가 났는지는 금방 잊어버린다.
Description (en, moon): It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 수호신이라고 불리지만 기분을 해치는 사람이나 포켓몬을 공격하는 난폭한 신이기도 하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 번개를 조종하는 멜레멜레의 수호신. 호기심이 왕성해서 가끔 사람들 앞에 나타난다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tapu Lele — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tapu Lele
ID: 786
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 카푸나비나
Name (en): Tapu Lele
Description (ko, sun): 천진난만하고 잔혹한 아칼라의 수호신이다. 향기로운 꽃향기가 에너지의 근원이다.
Description (en, sun): This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
Description (ko, moon): 팔랑팔랑 날아다니며 이상하게 빛나는 인분을 흩뿌린다. 이것에 닿은 자는 곧 건강을 되찾는다고 한다.
Description (en, moon): As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빛나는 인분을 흩뿌려 사람이나 포켓몬의 상처를 치료한다. 아칼라에서 모시는 수호신이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수호신으로 불리지만 천진난만하면서 잔혹한 성질도 겸비한 자연의 화신이라 할 수 있는 존재다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tapu Bulu — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tapu Bulu
ID: 787
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 카푸브루루
Name (en): Tapu Bulu
Description (ko, sun): 큰 나무를 뽑아서 빙빙 휘두른다. 초목을 무성하게 만들어 그 에너지를 흡수한다.
Description (en, sun): It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
Description (ko, moon): 울라울라의 수호신으로 게으름뱅이다. 초목을 조종해 적을 묶어서 움직임을 멈추게 하고 뿔로 단번에 받는다.
Description (en, moon): The guardian deity of Ula’ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 수호신으로 불리지만 적이라고 간주한 자는 철저하게 때려 부수는 격렬함을 갖고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 꼬리로 소리를 내어 위치를 알림으로써 불필요한 싸움을 피한다. 초목을 조종하는 울라울라의 수호신.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Tapu Fini — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Tapu Fini
ID: 788
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 카푸느지느
Name (en): Tapu Fini
Description (ko, sun): 짙은 안개로 적을 혼란시켜 자멸하게 만드는 무서움을 지녔다. 해류가 에너지의 근원이다.
Description (en, sun): The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
Description (ko, moon): 물을 조종하는 포니의 수호신. 부정을 없애는 깨끗한 물을 만들어낸다고 전해져 온다.
Description (en, moon): The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 짙은 안개 속에 살고 있다고 두려움과 존경을 받아 왔다. 물을 조종하는 포니의 수호신이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수호신으로 불리지만 무턱대고 다가오는 상대에게는 무서운 재앙을 가져다주는 일도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cosmog — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cosmog
ID: 789
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 코스모그
Name (en): Cosmog
Description (ko, sun): 연약한 가스 상태의 몸이다. 대기의 먼지를 모으며 천천히 성장한다.
Description (en, sun): Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
Description (ko, moon): 먼 옛날에는 별의 아이라는 이름으로 불렸다. 다른 세계의 포켓몬이라고 전해지지만 자세한 것은 불명확하다.
Description (en, moon): In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It’s said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 의지할 곳 없는 가스 상태의 몸은 약한 바람에도 휩쓸리지만, 전혀 신경 쓰지 않는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 이 세계의 포켓몬인지는 의문이다. 위험해지면 워프를 사용해서 안전한 장소에 몸을 숨긴다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Whether or not it’s a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it’s in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.
Description (ko, sword): 다른 우주에서 찾아왔다. 가스로 된 몸은 매우 가벼워서 산들바람에도 날아가 버릴 정도다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.
Description (ko, shield): 경계심이 없고 호기심이 왕성해 위험한 상황에 맞닥뜨리는 경우가 많다. 위기에 처하면 워프해서 도망친다.
Description (en, shield): Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Cosmoem — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Cosmoem
ID: 790
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 코스모움
Name (en): Cosmoem
Description (ko, sun): 죽은 것처럼 전혀 움직이지 않지만 만지면 어렴풋이 따뜻하다. 아주 옛날에는 달의 고치로 불렸다.
Description (en, sun): Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
Description (ko, moon): 단단한 껍질 안의 검은 코어에 무언가가 계속 모여들고 있다. 다른 세계의 포켓몬으로 전해진다.
Description (en, moon): There’s something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먼 옛날 알로라를 지배하던 왕은 별의 고치라고 부르며 숭상하기 위한 제단을 만들었다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 빛을 흡수하면서 성장을 계속하고 있다. 금색의 껍질은 놀라울 정도로 튼튼하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
Description (ko, sword): 인간의 지식을 뛰어넘는 강도를 가진 껍질에 둘러싸여 있다. 별의 빛을 받아서 성장한다.
Description (en, sword): The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.
Description (ko, shield): 대기의 티끌을 굉장한 기세로 빨아들여 진화 에너지를 코어에서 열심히 만들고 있다.
Description (en, shield): It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Solgaleo — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Solgaleo
ID: 791
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 솔가레오
Name (en): Solgaleo
Description (ko, sun): 다른 세계에 산다고 전해진다. 온몸에서 격렬한 빛을 내뿜어 깜깜한 밤도 한낮처럼 비춘다.
Description (en, sun): It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
Description (ko, moon): 코스모그가 진화한 수컷이라고 전해진다. 제3의 눈이 뜰 때 다른 세계로 달려나간다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 울트라홀을 연 결과 다른 세계의 에너지나 생명을 이 세계로 부르기도 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 아득히 먼 옛날의 문헌에 태양을 삼키는 짐승이라는 이름으로 기록이 남아 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): In writings from the distant past, it’s called by the name “the beast that devours the sun.”
Description (ko, sword): 전신에서 빛을 발산해서 마치 태양 같은 모습이 되면 어둠을 물리치고 세상을 비춘다.
Description (en, sword): When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.
Description (ko, shield): 태양을 삼키는 짐승이라고 불렸다. 굉장한 양의 빛 에너지를 방출한다.
Description (en, shield): Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Lunala — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Lunala
ID: 792
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 루나아라
Name (en): Lunala
Description (ko, sun): 코스모그가 진화한 암컷이라고 전해진다. 제3의 눈이 떠오를 때 다른 세계로 날아간다.
Description (en, sun): It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
Description (ko, moon): 다른 세계에 산다고 전해진다. 빛을 계속 먹어치워 한낮에도 깜깜한 밤처럼 어둡게 만든다.
Description (en, moon): Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먼 옛날 문헌에 달을 현혹하는 짐승이라는 이름으로 기록되어 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name “the beast that calls the moon.”
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 다른 세계로 통하는 구멍을 통해 미지의 힘이나 생명을 이 세계로 불러들이는 경우도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
Description (ko, sword): 달을 현혹하는 짐승이라는 이름을 가졌다. 모든 빛을 에너지로 변환해서 살고 있다.
Description (en, sword): Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.
Description (ko, shield): 주위의 빛을 모두 빼앗아 자신 스스로 만월의 모습이 되어 밤하늘에 빛을 발산한다.
Description (en, shield): It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Nihilego — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Nihilego
ID: 793
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 텅비드
Name (en): Nihilego
Description (ko, sun): 수수께끼에 싸인 UB의 일종. 길을 가던 사람이 기생 당해 난폭해지는 모습이 목격되었다.
Description (en, sun): One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
Description (ko, moon): UB의 일종. 의지가 있는지는 불명확하지만 가끔 소녀 같은 행동을 보인다.
Description (en, moon): One of the Ultra Beasts. It’s unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): UB라고 불리는 다른 세계의 생명체다. 강한 신경독을 갖고 있을 것으로 추정된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 울트라홀을 통해 이 세계에 나타났다. 포켓몬이나 인간에게 기생해서 사는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Buzzwole — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Buzzwole
ID: 794
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 매시붕
Name (en): Buzzwole
Description (ko, sun): 다른 세계에서 나타난 UB이다. 스스로 몸을 보여주는 행동이 자랑인지 위협인지 알 수 없다.
Description (en, sun): This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
Description (ko, moon): 정체불명의 생물 UB. 한 방의 펀치로 덤프트럭을 분쇄하는 광경이 목격되었다.
Description (en, moon): A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 이 세계와는 성질이 다르고 위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는 흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 이상할 정도로 팽창하는 근육을 자랑한다. 울트라비스트의 일종.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Pheromosa — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Pheromosa
ID: 795
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 페로코체
Name (en): Pheromosa
Description (ko, sun): 위험한 UB 중 1마리이다. 굉장한 속도로 대지를 질주하는 모습이 목격되었다.
Description (en, sun): One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
Description (ko, moon): UB의 일종. 이 세계의 물건에 불결함을 느끼는 것인지 전혀 손을 대려 하지 않는다.
Description (en, moon): One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 다른 세계에 사는 생명체다. 가늘고 부드러운 몸이지만, 강한 파워를 간직하고 있는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 이 세계와는 성질이 다르고 위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는 흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Xurkitree — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Xurkitree
ID: 796
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 전수목
Name (en): Xurkitree
Description (ko, sun): 온몸에서 엄청난 전격을 내뿜는 광경이 목격되었다. 수수께끼의 생물 UB 중 하나다.
Description (en, sun): One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
Description (ko, moon): 울트라홀에서 출현했다. 발전소를 습격한 것으로 보아 전기가 에너지원인 것으로 여겨진다.
Description (en, moon): It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 이 세계와는 성질이 다르고 위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는 흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 울트라비스트라고 불린다. 나무처럼 땅에 손발을 꽂고 움직이지 않는 것도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
document.licence: PokéAPI project terms; Pokémon names and original text rights reserved to their owners

document.title: Celesteela — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Celesteela
ID: 797
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 철화구야
Name (en): Celesteela
Description (ko, sun): 울트라홀에서 나타났다. 고속으로 하늘을 나는 모습이 목격된 울트라비스트다.
Description (en, sun): It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
Description (ko, moon): UB의 일종. 2개의 팔에서 가스를 뿜어내어 숲을 불태워버리는 모습이 확인되었다.
Description (en, moon): One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 위험한 UB의 일종이다. 거대한 두 팔에서 에너지 반응이 강하게 검출된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 이 세계와는 성질이 다르고 위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는 흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

Name (en): Kartana

document.title: Guzzlord — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Guzzlord
ID: 799
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 악식킹
Name (en): Guzzlord
Description (ko, sun): 산을 깎아 먹고 빌딩을 삼키는 모습이 보고되었다. 울트라비스트 중 하나이다.
Description (en, sun): It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
Description (ko, moon): 위험생물 비스트의 일종. 항상 무언가를 먹고 있는 듯하지만 왜인지 배설물은 발견되지 않았다.
Description (en, moon): A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 이 세계와는 성질이 다르고 위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는 흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): UB라고 불리는 미지의 생명체. 늘 배가 고픈 상태인 것인지 계속해서 무언가를 먹고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

document.title: Necrozma — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Necrozma
ID: 800
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 네크로즈마
Name (en): Necrozma
Description (ko, sun): 지하에서 잠들어 있던 것 같다. 태고의 다른 세계에서 왔다고 추측되는 UB같은 생물이다.
Description (en, sun): Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
Description (ko, moon): 빛이 에너지원인 듯하다. 레이저 광선을 마구 쏘아대는 매우 난폭한 성질을 가졌다.
Description (en, moon): Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 에너지인 빛을 찾아 날뛰는 모습은 어딘지 모르게 괴로워 보인다. 다른 세계의 존재인 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It’s apparently from another world.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 빛이 에너지원이다. 빛을 받지 못하면 불순물이 쌓여서 검게 변해 움직일 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Light is the source of its energy. If it isn’t devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
Description (ko, sword): 빛을 에너지원으로 하여 살고 있다. 지하에 잠들어 있었기 때문에 체내에 쌓인 불순물에 의해 검게 변했다.
Description (en, sword): It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.
Description (ko, shield): 살기 위해 빛을 찾아 날뛰며 돌아다닌다. 레이저 광선을 쏘아 온갖 것을 산산조각 낸다.
Description (en, shield): It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

document.title: Magearna — PokéAPI species CSV
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Magearna
ID: 801
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마기아나
Name (en): Magearna
Description (ko, sun): 500년 이상 전에 만들어진 인조포켓몬이다. 사람의 말을 이해하지만 말은 못 한다.
Description (en, sun): This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
Description (ko, moon): 기계장치로 된 몸은 그릇에 불과하다. 소울하트라고 불리는 인조 영혼이 본체다.
Description (en, moon): Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 의식을 동조시켜 상대의 마음을 이해한다. 사람을 도울 때 편리한 능력이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 약 500년 전 과학자에 의해 만들어졌다. 소울하트라고 불리는 파츠가 본체다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: Marshadow
ID: 802
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 마샤도
Name (en): Marshadow
Description (ko, sun): 그림자 안에 숨어 들을 수 있어 사람들 앞에 모습을 보이지 않아 그 존재는 환상이었다.
Description (en, sun): Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
Description (ko, moon): 상대의 그림자에 숨어들어 그 움직임과 힘을 복사한다. 겁이 많고 나약한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, moon): It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 상대 그림자에 숨어들어 움직임이나 능력을 흉내 낸다. 그러다가 진짜보다 강해진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it’s imitating.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 사람이나 포켓몬의 그림자 속에 숨는다. 숨은 상대의 마음을 이해하고 능력을 복사한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
Description (ko, sword): 권법의 달인의 그림자에 숨어들어 움직임을 복사했기 때문에 궁극의 오의를 익힐 수 있었다.
Description (en, sword): By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.
Description (ko, shield): 모든 그림자 안에 숨어들 수 있는 능력을 갖고 있어 오랫동안 누구에게도 발견되지 않았다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

Description (en, shield): Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

Description (en, sword): It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
Description (ko, shield): 아무리 단단한 나무열매 껍질도 이빨로 아작아작 갉아 먹는다. 가라르에서 쉽게 볼 수 있는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, shield): Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파라꼬
Name (en): Rookidee

Description (en, sword): It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
Description (ko, shield): 작은 몸을 기민하게 날려 틈을 노리는 전법으로 몸집이 큰 상대를 농락한다.
Description (en, shield): Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

Name (en): Corvisquire

Description (en, sword): Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
Description (ko, shield): 혹독한 싸움을 헤쳐 나와 상대의 역량을 정확히 판단하는 힘을 습득했다.

Description (en, sword): This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

Description (en, sword): It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

Description (en, shield): It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

Name (en): Nickit

Description (en, sword): It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

Description (en, sword): Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
